AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cost management stack: monthly budget with KMS-encrypted SNS alerts at 80% and 99% of actual spend'

# Deployment notes:
# - Deploy this stack to us-east-1. AWS Budgets is a global service. Its notifications
#   publish to SNS topics in the region where this stack is deployed.
# - SMS delivery works only if the account is out of the SNS SMS sandbox, or if the
#   destination number is verified in the sandbox. SMS spend limits must also be set.
#   Email subscriptions need the recipient to click the confirmation link.
#   None of these steps can be automated in this template, so it creates no extra
#   resources for them.

Parameters:
  BudgetLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Monthly budget limit in USD

  NotificationProtocol:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - sms
      - email
    Default: sms
    Description: Delivery method for budget alerts

  NotificationEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: '+61400000000'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}|[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an E.164 phone number (e.g. +61400000000) or a valid email address
    Description: Mobile number in E.164 format with country code +61 (sms) or email address (email)

Resources:
  BillingTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting the billing alerts SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: cost-management
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: Billing Alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt BillingTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: cost-management
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BillingAlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref BillingAlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref BillingAlertTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 'sns:Publish'
              - 'sns:Subscribe'
              - 'sns:Receive'
            Resource: !Ref BillingAlertTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  BillingAlertSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingAlertTopic
      Protocol: !Ref NotificationProtocol
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint

  MonthlyCostBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    DependsOn: BillingAlertTopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-cost-budget'
        BudgetType: COST
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: !Ref BudgetLimit
          Unit: USD
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingAlertTopic
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 99
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingAlertTopic

Outputs:
  BillingAlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS-encrypted SNS topic that receives budget alerts
    Value: !Ref BillingAlertTopic

  BillingTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the billing alerts topic
    Value: !GetAtt BillingTopicKey.Arn

  BillingTopicKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key that encrypts the billing alerts topic
    Value: !Ref BillingTopicKeyAlias

  MonthlyCostBudgetName:
    Description: Name of the monthly cost budget
    Value: !Ref MonthlyCostBudget

  NotificationSubscriptionArn:
    Description: ARN of the alert subscription (pending until confirmed for email)
    Value: !Ref BillingAlertSubscription

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained Cognito machine-to-machine (M2M) authentication and authorization infrastructure for the ontology lookup service, with configuration values published to SSM Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: ontology-lookup-service
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-40 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It must not contain the reserved words aws, amazon or cognito.
    Description: Application name. It is used in the Cognito domain prefix, the resource server identifier and the SSM parameter path prefix.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: OLSGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Ref AppName
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the ontology lookup service

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${AppName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-m2m-client'
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${AppName}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  ClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/client-id'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref M2MClient
      Description: Cognito M2M app client ID for the ontology lookup service.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ClientSecretParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/client-secret'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !GetAtt M2MClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Cognito M2M app client secret. CloudFormation cannot create SecureString parameters, so this is stored as String. Read access to this path is restricted with IAM (see ParameterReadPolicy).
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  UserPoolIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/user-pool-id'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for the ontology lookup service.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  OAuthScopeParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/oauth-scope'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Sub '${AppName}/read'
      Description: OAuth scope granted to the M2M client.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  DiscoveryUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the Cognito user pool.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  TokenUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/token-url'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL for the client credentials grant.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  DomainParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/domain'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito hosted domain for the ontology lookup service.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ParameterReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Grants read-only access to the ontology lookup service auth configuration in SSM Parameter Store. Attach only to principals that need the client credentials.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadAuthParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AppName}/*'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ClientId:
    Description: Cognito M2M app client ID.
    Value: !Ref M2MClient
  TokenUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
  SsmParameterPrefix:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix for the auth configuration.
    Value: !Sub '/${AppName}/'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless content moderation API. API Gateway REST API (ContentModeration) with a prod stage and a Python 3.14 Lambda that runs Amazon Rekognition DetectModerationLabels on an image fetched from a URL.

Resources:
  ContentModerationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionDetectModerationLabels
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'

  ContentModerationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/invokeContentModeration
      RetentionInDays: 14

  ContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Description: Fetches an image from a URL and returns Amazon Rekognition moderation labels.
      # Change note: the request specified python3.11, but AWS deprecated that runtime
      # on 2026-06-30 and blocked creating new functions with it on 2026-07-31.
      # python3.14 is used instead. The inline code runs on it unchanged.
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ContentModerationLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 25
      MemorySize: 256
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref ContentModerationLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.parse
          import urllib.error
          import boto3

          MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
          ALLOWED_EXT = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')
          rek = boto3.client('rekognition')


          def resp(code, body):
              return {'statusCode': code,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps(body)}


          def err(code, msg):
              return resp(code, {'error': msg})


          def handler(event, context):
              raw = (event or {}).get('body')
              if not raw:
                  return err(400, 'Request body is required')
              try:
                  data = json.loads(raw)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return err(400, 'Request body must be valid JSON')
              url = data.get('url') if isinstance(data, dict) else None
              if not isinstance(url, str) or not url.strip():
                  return err(400, "Field 'url' must be a non-empty string")
              url = url.strip()
              parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
              if parsed.scheme.lower() not in ('http', 'https') or not parsed.netloc:
                  return err(400, 'Only http and https URLs are allowed')
              path = urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.path).lower()
              if not path.endswith(ALLOWED_EXT):
                  return err(415, 'Unsupported image format; allowed: jpg, jpeg, png')

              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'ContentModeration/1.0'})
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
                      length = r.headers.get('Content-Length')
                      if length and length.isdigit() and int(length) > MAX_BYTES:
                          return err(413, 'Image exceeds 5MB limit')
                      img = r.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  if e.code == 404:
                      return err(404, 'Image not found')
                  return err(502, 'Failed to fetch image: upstream HTTP %d' % e.code)
              except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError) as e:
                  reason = getattr(e, 'reason', e)
                  if isinstance(e, TimeoutError) or isinstance(reason, TimeoutError):
                      return err(504, 'Timed out fetching image')
                  return err(502, 'Failed to fetch image')

              if len(img) > MAX_BYTES:
                  return err(413, 'Image exceeds 5MB limit')
              if not img:
                  return err(404, 'Image not found or empty')
              if not (img.startswith(b'\xff\xd8\xff') or img.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')):
                  return err(415, 'Content is not a valid JPEG or PNG image')

              try:
                  out = rek.detect_moderation_labels(Image={'Bytes': img}, MinConfidence=60)
              except rek.exceptions.InvalidImageFormatException:
                  return err(415, 'Rekognition rejected the image format')
              except rek.exceptions.ImageTooLargeException:
                  return err(413, 'Image too large for Rekognition')
              except (rek.exceptions.ThrottlingException,
                      rek.exceptions.ProvisionedThroughputExceededException):
                  return err(503, 'Moderation service busy, retry later')
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Rekognition error: %s' % e)
                  return err(502, 'Moderation service error')

              labels = [{'Name': l.get('Name'),
                         'ParentName': l.get('ParentName', ''),
                         'Confidence': l.get('Confidence')}
                        for l in out.get('ModerationLabels', [])]
              return resp(200, {'ModerationLabels': labels,
                                'ModerationModelVersion': out.get('ModerationModelVersion')})

  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: Content moderation API backed by Amazon Rekognition
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ModerateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ContentModerationApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: moderate

  ModeratePostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ModerateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ContentModerationFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ApiGatewayInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ContentModerationFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/*/POST/moderate

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ModeratePostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      Description: Deployment for ContentModeration API

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: POST endpoint for content moderation
    Value: !Sub https://${ContentModerationApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ProdStage}/moderate
  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the ContentModeration REST API
    Value: !Ref ContentModerationApi
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the moderation Lambda function
    Value: !Ref ContentModerationFunction
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the moderation Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ContentModerationFunction.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ContentModerationLambdaRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Scheduled workflow that closes AWS Organizations member accounts tagged
  organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED, then re-tags them ACKNOWLEDGED.
  This stack MUST be deployed in the AWS Organizations management account,
  in us-east-1, where the global Organizations API endpoint lives.

# Design note: the Resource Groups Tagging API (tag:GetResources) is intentionally
# NOT used to discover tagged accounts, because its support for Organizations
# account resources is unverified. Instead, the workflow pages through
# organizations:ListAccounts and filters each account with
# organizations:ListTagsForResource. Both are confirmed Step Functions
# AWS SDK service integrations.

Resources:
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-account-closure'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: org-account-closure

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Organizations account-closure state machine
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: account-closure-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAccountsNoResourceLevelSupport
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DescribeAndReadTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*'
              - Sid: CloseOnlyAccountsRequestedForClosure
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/organizations:account-closure: REQUESTED
              - Sid: TagOnlyClosureAcknowledgement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*'
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    aws:TagKeys:
                      - organizations:account-closure
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:RequestTag/organizations:account-closure: ACKNOWLEDGED
              - Sid: StepFunctionsLogDeliveryNoResourceLevelSupport
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: XRayTracingNoResourceLevelSupport
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: org-account-closure

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: org-account-closure
      Definition:
        Comment: >-
          Close ACTIVE Organizations accounts tagged
          organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED, then tag them ACKNOWLEDGED.
          One ListAccounts page is processed per loop iteration with bounded
          Map concurrency to stay within the EXPRESS 5-minute limit.
        StartAt: ListAccountsFirstPage
        States:
          ListAccountsFirstPage:
            Type: Task
            Comment: First page of ListAccounts (no NextToken in the input).
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts
            Parameters:
              MaxResults: 20
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxAttempts: 5
                JitterStrategy: FULL
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException
                  - Organizations.AwsOrganizationsNotInUseException
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: OrganizationNotInUse

            Type: Task

            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts
            Parameters:
              MaxResults: 20
              NextToken.$: $.NextToken
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException

                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxAttempts: 5
                JitterStrategy: FULL

                  - Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException
                  - Organizations.AwsOrganizationsNotInUseException
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: OrganizationNotInUse
            Next: ProcessAccountsPage
          OrganizationNotInUse:
            Type: Succeed
            Comment: No organization exists in this account; nothing to do.
          ProcessAccountsPage:
            Type: Map
            Comment: Inline Map over the accounts in the current page.
            ItemsPath: $.Accounts
            MaxConcurrency: 5
            ItemSelector:
              AccountId.$: $$.Map.Item.Value.Id
            ResultSelector:
              ProcessedCount.$: States.ArrayLength($)
            ResultPath: $.PageResult
            ItemProcessor:
              ProcessorConfig:
                Mode: INLINE
              StartAt: ListAccountTags
              States:
                ListAccountTags:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultSelector:
                    RequestedTags.$: '$.Tags[?(@.Key==''organizations:account-closure'' && @.Value==''REQUESTED'')]'
                  ResultPath: $.TagCheck
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                        - Organizations.TargetNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: CountRequestedTags
                CountRequestedTags:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Filter step that counts matching closure tags.
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                    RequestedCount.$: States.ArrayLength($.TagCheck.RequestedTags)
                  Next: IsClosureRequested
                IsClosureRequested:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.RequestedCount
                      NumericGreaterThan: 0
                      Next: DescribeAccount
                  Default: NotRequested
                NotRequested:
                  Type: Succeed
                DescribeAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultSelector:
                    Status.$: $.Account.Status
                  ResultPath: $.Account
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                        - Organizations.TargetNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: CheckAccountStatus
                CheckAccountStatus:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: ACTIVE
                      Next: CloseAccount
                    - Variable: $.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: SUSPENDED
                      Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                    - Variable: $.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: PENDING_CLOSURE
                      Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                  Default: SkipAccount
                SkipAccount:
                  Type: Succeed
                CloseAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultPath: $.CloseResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountAlreadyClosedException
                      ResultPath: $.CloseResult
                      Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ConstraintViolationException
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordConstraintViolation
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                RecordConstraintViolation:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Close-account quota or management-account restriction; skip this account.
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                    Outcome: SKIPPED_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION
                    Error.$: $.Error.Error
                    Cause.$: $.Error.Cause
                  End: true
                TagAccountAcknowledged:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceId.$: $.AccountId
                    Tags:
                      - Key: organizations:account-closure
                        Value: ACKNOWLEDGED
                  ResultPath: $.TagResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                        - Organizations.TargetNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: AccountAcknowledged
                AccountAcknowledged:
                  Type: Succeed
                RecordAccountError:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Record the error and end this iteration so other accounts continue.
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                    Outcome: FAILED
                    Error.$: $.Error.Error
                    Cause.$: $.Error.Cause
                  End: true
            Next: HasMorePages
          HasMorePages:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.NextToken
                IsPresent: true
                Next: ListAccountsNextPage
            Default: AllPagesProcessed
          AllPagesProcessed:
            Type: Succeed

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: StudyBuddy authentication stack - Amazon Cognito user pool with Lambda triggers, Hosted UI (Cognito-provided domain), Google identity provider backed by AWS Secrets Manager, and a frontend app client.

Parameters:
  FrontendDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: studybuddy.example.com
    Description: Host name of the StudyBuddy frontend (no scheme, no path, no trailing slash). Used to build OAuth callback and logout URLs.
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid host name such as studybuddy.example.com, without scheme, path, or trailing slash.

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used in resource names and tags.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google OAuth credentials (placeholders - operators replace after deployment)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'studybuddy/${EnvironmentName}/google-oauth'
      Description: Google OAuth client credentials for the StudyBuddy Cognito Google identity provider. Replace client_id and client_secret with real values after deployment.
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"client_id": "REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"}'
        GenerateStringKey: client_secret
        PasswordLength: 64
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom resource that reads the Google credentials at deploy time
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleCredentialsReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadGoogleOAuthSecret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  GoogleCredentialsReaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-google-credentials-reader'
      Description: CloudFormation custom resource that reads Google OAuth credentials from Secrets Manager.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt GoogleCredentialsReaderRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          secrets_client = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or "GoogleCredentials"
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return

                  secret_arn = event["ResourceProperties"]["SecretArn"]
                  response = secrets_client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                  secret = json.loads(response["SecretString"])

                  client_id = secret.get("client_id")
                  client_secret = secret.get("client_secret")
                  if not client_id or not client_secret:
                      raise ValueError("Secret must contain non-empty client_id and client_secret keys")

                  data = {"ClientId": client_id, "ClientSecret": client_secret}
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, secret_arn, noEcho=True)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print("Failed to read Google credentials: %s" % type(exc).__name__)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id,
                                   reason="Failed to read Google credentials: %s" % type(exc).__name__)
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  GoogleCredentialsReaderLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${GoogleCredentialsReaderFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  GoogleCredentials:
    Type: Custom::GoogleCredentials
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt GoogleCredentialsReaderFunction.Arn
      SecretArn: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret
      LogGroupName: !Ref GoogleCredentialsReaderLogGroup
      RotationNonce: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito trigger Lambda functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PreSignUpRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PreSignUpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-pre-signup'
      Description: StudyBuddy Cognito pre sign-up trigger.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PreSignUpRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps({
                  "trigger": event.get("triggerSource"),
                  "userPoolId": event.get("userPoolId"),
              }))
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PreSignUpLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PreSignUpFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  PostConfirmationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-post-confirmation'
      Description: StudyBuddy Cognito post confirmation trigger.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps({
                  "trigger": event.get("triggerSource"),
                  "userPoolId": event.get("userPoolId"),
              }))
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostConfirmationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PostConfirmationFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  PostAuthenticationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication'
      Description: StudyBuddy Cognito post authentication trigger.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps({
                  "trigger": event.get("triggerSource"),
                  "userPoolId": event.get("userPoolId"),
              }))
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthenticationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PostAuthenticationFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito user pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-users'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: StudyBuddy
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PreSignUpInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostAuthenticationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google identity provider
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !GetAtt GoogleCredentials.ClientId
        client_secret: !GetAtt GoogleCredentials.ClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: profile email openid
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
        username: sub

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI domain (Cognito-provided prefix)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Frontend app client
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudyBuddyWebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-web'
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomainName}/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomainName}/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - given_name
        - family_name
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the StudyBuddy Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the StudyBuddy Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the StudyBuddy frontend app client.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyWebClient

  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Base URL of the Cognito Hosted UI.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  GoogleRedirectURI:
    Description: Authorized redirect URI to register in the Google Cloud console OAuth client.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/idpresponse'

  GoogleOAuthSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the Google OAuth client_id and client_secret. Put the real values here, then update the stack with a new RotationNonce value on the GoogleCredentials resource.
    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret

        - Key: Layer
