final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a CodeBuild project that publishes CloudFormation templates to a bucket
  in every enabled AWS region, with SNS and EventBridge build status notifications.

# NOTE: The regional template buckets (<ProjectName>-<AccountId>-<region>) are created
# by the CodeBuild build, not by CloudFormation. Deleting this stack does NOT remove
# them. When decommissioning, empty and delete those buckets manually.
#
# NOTE: All buckets are private. Templates and the index are reached through IAM or
# presigned URLs only. If you need public or organization-wide sharing, add it on
# purpose through bucket policies (for example with an aws:PrincipalOrgID condition).
# The central artifact bucket is encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key, so any
# principal reading the index or artifacts from it also needs kms:Decrypt on the
# artifact key (see the ArtifactKeyArn output), in addition to S3 permissions.
#
# NOTE: The regional buckets intentionally use SSE-S3 (AES256). KMS keys are regional,
# so a customer-managed key per region would require the build to create KMS keys in
# every region, which is outside this stack's resource set and least-privilege scope.
# SSE-S3 also keeps packaged nested-stack and Lambda artifacts readable by
# CloudFormation without cross-key grants.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: cfn-template-publisher
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,29}$'
    MaxLength: 30
    Description: >-
      Lowercase name used for resources, IAM scopes and regional bucket names.
      The 30-character limit keeps <ProjectName>-<AccountId>-<region> within 63 characters.
    ConstraintDescription: 3-30 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$'
    Description: Optional email address for build notifications. Leave empty to skip the subscription.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid email address.

Conditions:
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key for the notification topic (EventBridge cannot publish to
  # topics encrypted with the AWS-managed alias/aws/sns key).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NotificationKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} build notification topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  NotificationKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-notifications
      TargetKeyId: !Ref NotificationKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key for the central artifact and index bucket (data at rest).
  # Kept separate from the notification key so the EventBridge grant does not
  # extend to stored artifacts. The key policy only trusts the account root;
  # the CodeBuild role receives access through its inline IAM policy.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} artifact bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-artifacts
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS notifications
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-build-notifications
      DisplayName: !Sub ${ProjectName} build notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref NotificationKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  NotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref NotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgePublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  NotificationEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref NotificationTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Central artifact and index bucket (private, SSE-KMS with customer-managed key)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-artifacts
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/codebuild/${ProjectName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeBuild service role (least privilege, inline policies only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeBuildServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Service role for the ${ProjectName} CodeBuild template publisher
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: template-publisher
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RegionalTemplateBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:CreateBucket'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:GetBucketVersioning'
                  - 's3:PutBucketVersioning'
                  - 's3:GetEncryptionConfiguration'
                  - 's3:PutEncryptionConfiguration'
                  - 's3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock'
                  - 's3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock'
                  - 's3:PutBucketOwnershipControls'
                  - 's3:GetBucketPolicy'
                  - 's3:PutBucketPolicy'
                  - 's3:PutBucketTagging'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-*/*
              - Sid: CentralArtifactBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
              - Sid: ArtifactBucketKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'kms:ViaService': !Sub s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: CodeCommitSourceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'codecommit:GitPull'
                  - 'codecommit:GetRepository'
                  - 'codecommit:GetBranch'
                  - 'codecommit:ListBranches'
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}*
              - Sid: RegionDiscoveryAndIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:DescribeRegions'
                  - 'sts:GetCallerIdentity'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TemplateValidation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:ValidateTemplate'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub ${LogGroup.Arn}:*
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
                  - 'ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer'
                  - 'ecr:BatchGetImage'
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/${ProjectName}*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeBuild project
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ProjectName
      Description: Packages and publishes CloudFormation templates to a private bucket in every enabled region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
      TimeoutInMinutes: 60
      QueuedTimeoutInMinutes: 60
      ConcurrentBuildLimit: 1
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      LogsConfig:
        CloudWatchLogs:
          Status: ENABLED
          GroupName: !Ref LogGroup
        S3Logs:
          Status: DISABLED
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/amazonlinux-x86_64-standard:5.0
        ImagePullCredentialsType: CODEBUILD
        PrivilegedMode: false
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: PROJECT_NAME
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref ProjectName
          - Name: ACCOUNT_ID
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Name: HOME_REGION
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref AWS::Region
          - Name: ARTIFACT_BUCKET
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
          - Name: BUCKET_PREFIX
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}
          - Name: SOURCE_REPO_NAME
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref ProjectName
          - Name: SOURCE_BRANCH
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: main
          - Name: TEMPLATES_DIR
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: templates
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        # Not wrapped in Fn::Sub on purpose: shell ${VAR} syntax is used throughout,
        # and all stack-specific values arrive through environment variables.
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          env:
            shell: bash
          phases:
            install:
              runtime-versions:
                python: 3.12
              commands:
                - pip3 install --quiet --upgrade git-remote-codecommit
            pre_build:
              commands:
                - |
                  bash <<'SCRIPT'
                  set -euo pipefail
                  STATE_DIR=/tmp/publisher-state
                  rm -rf "$STATE_DIR" /tmp/source
                  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR/regions"
                  : > "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions"
                  : > "$STATE_DIR/succeeded_regions"
                  : > "$STATE_DIR/index.tsv"

                  CALLER_ACCOUNT="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)"
                  if [ "$CALLER_ACCOUNT" != "$ACCOUNT_ID" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: running in account $CALLER_ACCOUNT, expected $ACCOUNT_ID" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "Publishing for project $PROJECT_NAME in account $CALLER_ACCOUNT (home region $HOME_REGION)"

                  echo "Cloning codecommit::${HOME_REGION}://${SOURCE_REPO_NAME} (branch ${SOURCE_BRANCH})"
                  if ! git clone --depth 1 --branch "$SOURCE_BRANCH" "codecommit::${HOME_REGION}://${SOURCE_REPO_NAME}" /tmp/source; then
                    echo "ERROR: unable to clone CodeCommit repository '${SOURCE_REPO_NAME}' branch '${SOURCE_BRANCH}' in ${HOME_REGION}." >&2
                    echo "Create the repository (its name must start with '${PROJECT_NAME}') and push templates to '${TEMPLATES_DIR}/'." >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi

                  SRC_ROOT="/tmp/source/${TEMPLATES_DIR}"
                  if [ ! -d "$SRC_ROOT" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: templates directory '${TEMPLATES_DIR}' not found in repository" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  find "$SRC_ROOT" -type f \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.json' \) | sort > "$STATE_DIR/templates"
                  if [ ! -s "$STATE_DIR/templates" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: no *.yaml, *.yml or *.json templates found under '${TEMPLATES_DIR}'" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "Found $(wc -l < "$STATE_DIR/templates") template(s)"

                  while IFS= read -r tpl; do
                    size="$(wc -c < "$tpl")"
                    if [ "$size" -le 51200 ]; then
                      echo "Validating ${tpl#"$SRC_ROOT"/}"
                      aws cloudformation validate-template --region "$HOME_REGION" --template-body "file://$tpl" > /dev/null
                    else
                      echo "Skipping inline validation of ${tpl#"$SRC_ROOT"/} (larger than 51200 bytes)"
                    fi
                  done < "$STATE_DIR/templates"

                  aws ec2 describe-regions --region "$HOME_REGION" \
                    --filters Name=opt-in-status,Values=opt-in-not-required,opted-in \
                    --query 'Regions[].RegionName' --output text | tr '\t' '\n' | sed '/^$/d' | sort > "$STATE_DIR/region_list"
                  if [ ! -s "$STATE_DIR/region_list" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: no enabled regions discovered" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "Enabled regions: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$STATE_DIR/region_list")"
                  SCRIPT
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  bash <<'SCRIPT'
                  set -euo pipefail
                  STATE_DIR=/tmp/publisher-state
                  SRC_ROOT="/tmp/source/${TEMPLATES_DIR}"

                  # Regional buckets intentionally use SSE-S3 (AES256); see template header comment.
                  ensure_bucket() {
                    local region="$1" bucket="$2"
                    if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                      echo "[$region] Bucket $bucket already exists"
                    else
                      echo "[$region] Creating bucket $bucket"
                      if [ "$region" = "us-east-1" ]; then
                        aws s3api create-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" > /dev/null
                      else
                        aws s3api create-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                          --create-bucket-configuration "LocationConstraint=${region}" > /dev/null
                      fi
                      aws s3api wait bucket-exists --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region"
                    fi
                    aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true
                    aws s3api put-bucket-ownership-controls --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --ownership-controls 'Rules=[{ObjectOwnership=BucketOwnerEnforced}]'
                    aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --server-side-encryption-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault":{"SSEAlgorithm":"AES256"},"BucketKeyEnabled":true}]}'
                    aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled
                    local policy
                    policy="$(printf '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"DenyInsecureTransport","Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":"s3:*","Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::%s","arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"],"Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:SecureTransport":"false"}}}]}' "$bucket" "$bucket")"
                    aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" --policy "$policy"
                    aws s3api put-bucket-tagging --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --tagging "TagSet=[{Key=Name,Value=${PROJECT_NAME}},{Key=Project,Value=${PROJECT_NAME}}]"
                  }

                  process_region() {
                    local region="$1"
                    local bucket="${BUCKET_PREFIX}-${region}"
                    local records="$STATE_DIR/regions/${region}.tsv"
                    : > "$records"
                    ensure_bucket "$region" "$bucket"
                    while IFS= read -r tpl; do
                      local rel="${tpl#"$SRC_ROOT"/}"
                      local out="$STATE_DIR/packaged/${region}/${rel}"
                      mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
                      local fmt_args=()
                      case "$tpl" in
                        *.json) fmt_args=(--use-json) ;;
                      esac
                      echo "[$region] Packaging $rel"
                      aws cloudformation package --region "$region" \
                        --template-file "$tpl" \
                        --s3-bucket "$bucket" \
                        --s3-prefix "artifacts/${rel%.*}" \
                        --output-template-file "$out" \
                        ${fmt_args[@]+"${fmt_args[@]}"} > /dev/null
                      aws s3 cp "$out" "s3://${bucket}/templates/${rel}" --region "$region" --only-show-errors
                      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$region" "$bucket" "templates/${rel}" >> "$records"
                    done < "$STATE_DIR/templates"
                  }

                  while IFS= read -r region; do
                    echo "=== Processing region $region ==="
                    set +e
                    ( set -euo pipefail; process_region "$region" )
                    rc=$?
                    set -e
                    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
                      echo "$region" >> "$STATE_DIR/succeeded_regions"
                      cat "$STATE_DIR/regions/${region}.tsv" >> "$STATE_DIR/index.tsv"
                      echo "[$region] OK"
                    else
                      echo "$region" >> "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions"
                      echo "[$region] FAILED (exit code $rc); continuing with remaining regions" >&2
                    fi
                  done < "$STATE_DIR/region_list"

                  echo "Succeeded regions: $(wc -l < "$STATE_DIR/succeeded_regions"), failed regions: $(wc -l < "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions")"
                  SCRIPT
            post_build:
              commands:
                - |
                  bash <<'SCRIPT'
                  set -euo pipefail
                  STATE_DIR=/tmp/publisher-state
                  if [ "${CODEBUILD_BUILD_SUCCEEDING:-0}" != "1" ] || [ ! -f "$STATE_DIR/index.tsv" ]; then
                    echo "An earlier phase failed; skipping index generation" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi

                  python3 - "$STATE_DIR/index.tsv" "$STATE_DIR/index.html" "$STATE_DIR/index.json" "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions" <<'PY'
                  import datetime
                  import html
                  import json
                  import os
                  import sys
                  import urllib.parse

                  tsv_path, html_path, json_path, failed_path = sys.argv[1:5]
                  project = os.environ["PROJECT_NAME"]
                  build_id = os.environ.get("CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID", "unknown")
                  generated = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

                  entries = []
                  with open(tsv_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                      for line in fh:
                          line = line.rstrip("\n")
                          if not line:
                              continue
                          region, bucket, key = line.split("\t")
                          entries.append({
                              "region": region,
                              "bucket": bucket,
                              "key": key,
                              "s3_uri": f"s3://{bucket}/{key}",
                              "url": f"https://{bucket}.s3.{region}.amazonaws.com/{urllib.parse.quote(key)}",
                          })

                  with open(failed_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                      failed = [r.strip() for r in fh if r.strip()]

                  with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                      json.dump({"project": project, "buildId": build_id, "generated": generated,
                                 "failedRegions": failed, "templates": entries}, fh, indent=2)

                  rows = "\n".join(
                      "<tr><td>{}</td><td>{}</td><td><a href=\"{}\">{}</a></td></tr>".format(
                          html.escape(e["region"]), html.escape(e["key"]),
                          html.escape(e["url"]), html.escape(e["s3_uri"]))
                      for e in entries)
                  failed_html = html.escape(", ".join(failed)) if failed else "none"
                  page = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
                  <html lang="en">
                  <head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>{html.escape(project)} CloudFormation templates</title></head>
                  <body>
                  <h1>{html.escape(project)} CloudFormation templates</h1>
                  <p>Generated {generated} by build {html.escape(build_id)}.</p>
                  <p>Buckets are private: use IAM credentials or presigned URLs to access templates.</p>
                  <p>Failed regions: {failed_html}</p>
                  <table border="1" cellpadding="4">
                  <thead><tr><th>Region</th><th>Key</th><th>Location</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>
                  {rows}
                  </tbody>
                  </table>
                  </body>
                  </html>
                  """
                  with open(html_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                      fh.write(page)
                  print(f"Indexed {len(entries)} template object(s)")
                  PY

                  aws s3 cp "$STATE_DIR/index.html" "s3://${ARTIFACT_BUCKET}/index.html" \
                    --region "$HOME_REGION" --content-type 'text/html; charset=utf-8' --only-show-errors
                  aws s3 cp "$STATE_DIR/index.json" "s3://${ARTIFACT_BUCKET}/index.json" \
                    --region "$HOME_REGION" --content-type 'application/json' --only-show-errors
                  echo "Index uploaded to s3://${ARTIFACT_BUCKET}/index.html"

                  if [ -s "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: publishing failed in regions: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions")" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "All regions published successfully"
                  SCRIPT
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build status notifications
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildStatusRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-build-status
      Description: !Sub Sends ${ProjectName} CodeBuild status changes to SNS
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codebuild
        detail-type:
          - CodeBuild Build State Change
        detail:
          project-name:
            - !Ref CodeBuildProject
          build-status:
            - SUCCEEDED
            - FAILED
            - STOPPED
      Targets:
        - Id: BuildNotificationTopic
          Arn: !Ref NotificationTopic
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              project: $.detail.project-name
              status: $.detail.build-status
              buildId: $.detail.build-id
              region: $.region
              time: $.time
            InputTemplate: '"CodeBuild project <project> finished with status <status>. Build: <buildId>. Region: <region>. Time: <time>."'

Outputs:
  ProjectName:
    Description: CodeBuild project name
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildProject
  CodeBuildProjectArn:
    Description: CodeBuild project ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
  CodeBuildServiceRoleArn:
    Description: CodeBuild service role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Central artifact and index bucket
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  ArtifactKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key encrypting the central artifact bucket (readers need kms:Decrypt on it)
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
  IndexLocation:
    Description: S3 location of the generated index page (private; use IAM or presigned URLs)
    Value: !Sub s3://${ArtifactBucket}/index.html
  RegionalBucketNamePattern:
    Description: Naming pattern of the regional buckets created by the build (not managed by CloudFormation)
    Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-<region>
  SourceRepositoryName:
    Description: CodeCommit repository the build clones (create it and push templates to templates/)
    Value: !Ref ProjectName
  NotificationTopicArn:

    Value: !GetAtt NotificationKey.Arn

    Description: EventBridge rule forwarding build status changes
    Value: !GetAtt BuildStatusRule.Arn
  LogGroupName:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Adds Security Hub automation rules that suppress reviewed and accepted findings.
  By default, this template adds automation rules to an existing, already-enabled
  AWS Security Hub, with the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark and AWS Foundational Security Best
  Practices standards already enabled. It creates a minimal Security Hub subscription, with no
  standards enabled, only when CreateSecurityHub is "true". This lets the stack deploy in an account
  where Security Hub is not yet enabled. For production, deploy this stack in the Security Hub delegated
  administrator account, in the home Region, with CreateSecurityHub set to "false". The rules then
  apply to member-account findings.

# NOTE: The control IDs, bucket names and GuardDuty finding type in this template are
# representative. Before production use, replace them with the exact reviewed and accepted values
# from the organization's exception register. Keep each criterion field to 20 values or fewer.
#
# NOTE: Production deployments, where Security Hub is already enabled in the delegated
# administrator account and home Region, must set CreateSecurityHub to "false". Creating a Hub in an
# account that is already subscribed fails.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Security Hub subscription
        Parameters:
          - CreateSecurityHub
      - Label:
          default: Scoped account IDs (leave blank to fall back to the administrator account)
        Parameters:
          - CisScopedAccountId
          - EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId
          - AutomationAccountIdA
          - AutomationAccountIdB
      - Label:
          default: Human IAM users excluded from IAM suppression
        Parameters:
          - ExcludedHumanUser1
          - ExcludedHumanUser2

Parameters:
  CreateSecurityHub:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >-
      Set to "false" when deploying into an account where Security Hub is already enabled. That is the
      normal production case for this template. Creating a Hub in an already-subscribed account fails.
      Set to "true" only to create a minimal Security Hub subscription with no standards enabled.

  CisScopedAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID or empty.
    Description: Designated sub-account whose reviewed CIS findings are suppressed. Leave blank to use the administrator account.

  EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID or empty.
    Description: Account with an accepted exception for EBS encryption by default (EC2.7). Leave blank to use the administrator account.

  AutomationAccountIdA:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID or empty.
    Description: First automation account that runs infrequently. Leave blank to use the administrator account.

  AutomationAccountIdB:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID or empty.
    Description: Second automation account that runs infrequently. Leave blank to use the administrator account.

  ExcludedHumanUser1:
    Type: String
    Default: security-admin-user
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM user name (1-64 characters).
    Description: Named human IAM user whose IAM findings must NOT be suppressed.

  ExcludedHumanUser2:
    Type: String
    Default: breakglass-user
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM user name (1-64 characters).
    Description: Second named human IAM user whose IAM findings must NOT be suppressed.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateSecurityHub: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityHub, "true"]
  HasCisScopedAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CisScopedAccountId, ""]]
  HasEbsEncryptionExemptAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId, ""]]
  HasAutomationAccountIdA: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AutomationAccountIdA, ""]]
  HasAutomationAccountIdB: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AutomationAccountIdB, ""]]

Resources:
  # Minimal, optional Security Hub subscription. It is created only when CreateSecurityHub is "true".
  # No standards are enabled. Production deployments with an existing Hub skip this resource.
  SecurityHubSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::Hub
    Condition: ShouldCreateSecurityHub
    Properties:
      EnableDefaultStandards: false
      ControlFindingGenerator: SECURITY_CONTROL
      AutoEnableControls: false
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression

  # Rule 1: Organization-wide IAM findings, excluding named human users.
  SuppressOrgWideIamFindingsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-OrgWide-IAM-Findings
      Description: Suppresses reviewed and accepted IAM findings organization-wide, excluding named human IAM users.
      RuleOrder: 10
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: IAM.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.6
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.9
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsIamUser
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: AwsAccount
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceId:
          - Value: !Sub ':user/${ExcludedHumanUser1}'
            Comparison: NOT_CONTAINS
          - Value: !Sub ':user/${ExcludedHumanUser2}'
            Comparison: NOT_CONTAINS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: IAM findings reviewed and accepted organization-wide. Named human users are excluded from this suppression and must still be remediated.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 2: CIS findings scoped to one designated sub-account.
  SuppressCisFindingsDesignatedSubAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-CIS-Findings-Designated-SubAccount
      Description: Suppresses reviewed and accepted CIS benchmark findings for the designated sub-account only.
      RuleOrder: 20
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !If [HasCisScopedAccountId, !Ref CisScopedAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceAssociatedStandardsId:
          - Value: ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark
            Comparison: PREFIX
          - Value: standards/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark
            Comparison: PREFIX
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: CloudWatch.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.4
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.6
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.8
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.9
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.10
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.11
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.12
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.13
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.14
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudTrail.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: KMS.4
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: CIS controls reviewed and accepted for the designated sub-account.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 3: Organization-wide CIS and FSBP findings (admin ports for bastion/testing,
  # S3 account-level public access block and HTTPS-only access, AWS Config regional coverage).
  SuppressOrgWideCisFsbpFindingsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-OrgWide-CIS-FSBP-Findings
      Description: Suppresses reviewed and accepted CIS and AWS FSBP findings organization-wide (admin ports for bastion and testing, S3 public-access and HTTPS settings, AWS Config regional coverage).
      RuleOrder: 30
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          # Security groups permitting administrative ports (bastion hosts and testing)
          - Value: EC2.13
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.14
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.18
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.19
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.53
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.54
            Comparison: EQUALS
          # S3 public-access block and HTTPS-only access settings
          - Value: S3.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: S3.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          # AWS Config regional coverage
          - Value: Config.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: CIS and AWS FSBP findings reviewed and accepted organization-wide. Admin ports are needed for bastion hosts and testing, S3 public-access and HTTP-access settings are accepted, and AWS Config regional coverage is accepted as configured.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 4: Public-access findings for known, intentionally public buckets.
  SuppressPublicAccessIntentionallyPublicBucketsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Public-Access-Intentionally-Public-Buckets
      Description: Suppresses public-access findings for a known list of S3 buckets that are public on purpose.
      RuleOrder: 40
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: S3.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: S3.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: S3.8
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsS3Bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
        # Replace with the approved intentionally public bucket ARNs (20 or fewer).
        ResourceId:
          - Value: arn:aws:s3:::example-static-website-bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:s3:::example-public-assets-bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:s3:::example-public-downloads-bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: These buckets are intentionally public (static website or public assets) and have been reviewed and approved.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 5: EBS default encryption finding for one specific account.
  SuppressEbsDefaultEncryptionSingleAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-EBS-Default-Encryption-Single-Account
      Description: Suppresses the EBS default encryption finding (EC2.7) for one exempt account.
      RuleOrder: 50
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: EC2.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !If [HasEbsEncryptionExemptAccountId, !Ref EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: EBS encryption by default has an accepted exception for this account.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 6: Unused credentials and access key rotation for two infrequent automation accounts.
  SuppressUnusedCredentialKeyRotationAutomationAccountsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Unused-Credential-Key-Rotation-Automation-Accounts
      Description: Suppresses unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for two accounts that run automation infrequently.
      RuleOrder: 60
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: IAM.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.8
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.22
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !If [HasAutomationAccountIdA, !Ref AutomationAccountIdA, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: !If [HasAutomationAccountIdB, !Ref AutomationAccountIdB, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: These accounts run automation infrequently. Unused credentials and access key rotation timing are expected and accepted.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 7: Expected cross-account Bedrock API activity reported by GuardDuty.
  # The Type value below is the ASFF-formatted GuardDuty finding type and is NOT confirmed.
  # Check it against the GuardDuty finding-type catalog before deploying. If the exact type cannot
  # be confirmed, remove the Type criterion and keep only these filters:
  #   ProductName EQUALS GuardDuty
  #   Title CONTAINS Bedrock
  SuppressGuardDutyCrossAccountBedrockActivityRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-GuardDuty-CrossAccount-Bedrock-Activity
      Description: Suppresses one specific GuardDuty finding type for expected and approved cross-account Amazon Bedrock API activity.
      RuleOrder: 70
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ProductName:
          - Value: GuardDuty
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Type:
          - Value: TTPs/Discovery/Discovery:IAMUser-AnomalousBehavior
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Title:
          - Value: Bedrock
            Comparison: CONTAINS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: Cross-account Amazon Bedrock API calls are expected and approved.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

    Description: ARN of the Suppress-GuardDuty-CrossAccount-Bedrock-Activity automation rule (order 70).
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressGuardDutyCrossAccountBedrockActivityRule.RuleArn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Test MCP tool Lambda (bac-mcp-tool) for the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway used by an AWS operations agent.

Resources:
  OpsArtifactsBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the bac-mcp-tool ops artifacts S3 bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: bac-mcp-tool
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: agentcore-gateway-testing

  OpsArtifactsBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/bac-mcp-tool-ops-artifacts
      TargetKeyId: !Ref OpsArtifactsBucketKey

  OpsArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OpsArtifactsBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: bac-mcp-tool
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: agentcore-gateway-testing

  OpsArtifactsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OpsArtifactsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OpsArtifactsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OpsArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  BacMcpToolLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: bac-mcp-tool
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: agentcore-gateway-testing

  BacMcpToolExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BacMcpToolPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool:*'
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                  - bedrock:Converse
                  - bedrock:ConverseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
              - Sid: CostExplorerAndUsageRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources
                  - ce:GetCostForecast
                  - ce:GetUsageForecast
                  - ce:GetDimensionValues
                  - ce:GetTags
                  - ce:GetCostCategories
                  - ce:GetReservationUtilization
                  - ce:GetReservationCoverage
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilization
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansCoverage
                  - ce:GetRightsizingRecommendation
                  - ce:GetAnomalies
                  - cur:DescribeReportDefinitions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3ObjectOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${OpsArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: S3ListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt OpsArtifactsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: OpsBucketKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt OpsArtifactsBucketKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: bac-mcp-tool
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: agentcore-gateway-testing

  BacMcpToolFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: BacMcpToolLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Description: Test MCP tool for the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway used by an AWS operations agent.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 1024
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Role: !GetAtt BacMcpToolExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          OPS_BUCKET_NAME: !Ref OpsArtifactsBucket
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event, default=str))
              tool_name = None
              if context is not None and getattr(context, "client_context", None):
                  custom = getattr(context.client_context, "custom", None) or {}
                  tool_name = custom.get("bedrockAgentCoreToolName")
              result = {
                  "status": "ok",
                  "tool": tool_name or "bac-mcp-tool",
                  "bucket": os.environ.get("OPS_BUCKET_NAME"),
                  "echo": event,
              }
              logger.info("Returning result: %s", json.dumps(result, default=str))
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps(result, default=str),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: bac-mcp-tool
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: agentcore-gateway-testing

  AgentCoreGatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role assumed by Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke Lambda MCP tools.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AgentCoreGatewayPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeMcpToolLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BacMcpToolFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${BacMcpToolFunction.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: ManageBedrockAgentCoreResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:*
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToAgentCore
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: S3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${OpsArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: S3ListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt OpsArtifactsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: OpsBucketKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt OpsArtifactsBucketKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: bac-mcp-tool
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: agentcore-gateway-testing
