AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI with an
  Elastic Beanstalk compatibility component. The pipeline runs daily, scans each image for vulnerabilities
  and uses a 50 GB encrypted gp3 root volume. A customer managed KMS key encrypts the AMI, which is shared
  with an AWS Organization and with dev and prod accounts. Images are deleted after 6 months. Build
  instances run in an isolated private subnet and reach AWS only through VPC endpoints. Uses the CIS
  Marketplace parent image (r5sqt5uxgygqi) when subscribed and falls back to AWS-managed AL2023 ARM64 until
  subscribed. Enables Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning; see Metadata.Prerequisites.

Metadata:
  Prerequisites:
    MarketplaceSubscription: >-
      The template checks at deploy time whether this account is subscribed to the AWS Marketplace listing
      cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi. If the account is not subscribed, the
      recipe builds from the AWS-managed amazon-linux-2023-arm64 image and the AMIs are tagged
      ParentImageSource=al2023. After you subscribe, increase RecipeVersion and update the stack to switch to the
      CIS parent image (AMIs are then tagged ParentImageSource=cis).
    InspectorActivation: >-
      The stack turns on Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning in the deployment account and region through the
      InspectorEc2Enablement custom resource, because Image Builder vulnerability scanning depends on it.
      Inspector bills per scanned instance. Deleting the stack does not turn Inspector off, because it is an
      account-wide setting that other workloads may rely on. In an AWS Organization where a delegated Inspector
      administrator manages member accounts, that administrator may need to enable this account; the custom
      resource reports this case as a failure. The stack creates the AWSServiceRoleForAmazonInspector2 and
      AWSServiceRoleForAmazonInspector2Agentless service-linked roles if they do not exist, so an SCP that denies
      iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole makes the deployment fail.
    OrganizationSharing: >-
      Replace the dummy default values of OrganizationId, DevAccountId and ProdAccountId with real values before
      the first pipeline run. OrganizationId and OrganizationManagementAccountId must point to a real AWS
      Organization when you share launch permissions. If you leave OrganizationManagementAccountId empty, the
      current account is used as the management account.
    KmsCrossAccountAccess: >-
      The dev and prod accounts and the Organization can launch the shared encrypted AMI only because the
      template KMS key policy grants them decrypt and grant rights on the key. Do not remove those key policy
      statements.
    NotificationSubscription: >-
      After deployment, subscribe an endpoint (for example email or an SQS queue) to NotificationTopic to
      receive pipeline build notifications.
    NetworkIsolation: >-
      Build and test instances have no internet access. They reach AWS services only through the interface VPC
      endpoints (ssm, ssmmessages, ec2messages, imagebuilder, kms, logs, sts) and the S3 gateway endpoint, which
      also serves the Amazon Linux 2023 dnf repositories. Any future component that downloads from non-AWS URLs
      needs an explicit, narrowly scoped egress path.
    VersionBumps: >-
      Image Builder components and recipes are immutable. Increase ComponentVersion or RecipeVersion whenever you
      change the component document or the recipe definition.
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - ComponentVersion
          - RecipeVersion
      - Label:
          default: Distribution
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
          - OrganizationManagementAccountId
          - DevAccountId
          - ProdAccountId
      - Label:
          default: Networking
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PrivateSubnetCidr

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: eb-al2023-arm
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Use 3-32 characters (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens).
    Description: Name prefix used for resources and tags.
  ComponentVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    Description: Semantic version of the Elastic Beanstalk component.
  RecipeVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    Description: Semantic version of the image recipe. Increase it to re-check the CIS Marketplace subscription.
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-a1b2c3d4e5
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    Description: ID of the AWS Organization that receives AMI launch permissions.
  OrganizationManagementAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    Description: Management account ID of the AWS Organization. Leave empty to use the current account.
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Dev deployment account ID that receives AMI launch permissions (dummy default).
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Prod deployment account ID that receives AMI launch permissions (dummy default).
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.80.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    Description: CIDR block for the Image Builder VPC.
  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.80.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    Description: CIDR block for the isolated private subnet that runs build and test instances and VPC endpoints.

Conditions:
  HasOrganizationManagementAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (isolated - no internet path, AWS access via VPC endpoints)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  BuildInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Image Builder build instances - no inbound, HTTPS to VPC endpoints and S3 only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt S3PrefixList.PrefixListId
          Description: HTTPS to S3 through the gateway endpoint (dnf repositories, awstoe, build logs)
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS from build instances only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS responses within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  VpcEndpointIngressFromBuildInstances:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref BuildInstanceSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS from Image Builder build instances

  BuildInstanceEgressToVpcEndpoints:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref BuildInstanceSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssmmessages-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ec2messages-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  ImageBuilderEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.imagebuilder'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-kms-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-sts-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-s3-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 prefix list lookup (no intrinsic function returns the regional pl-* ID)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrefixListLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role for the Lambda function that looks up the regional S3 managed prefix list ID
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'lambda.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribePrefixLists
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribePrefixLists
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribePrefixLists
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  PrefixListLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Returns the AWS-managed S3 prefix list ID for the current region
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'prefix-list-lookup')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  name = event['ResourceProperties']['PrefixListName']
                  response = boto3.client('ec2').describe_prefix_lists(
                      Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [name]}]
                  )
                  prefix_lists = response.get('PrefixLists', [])
                  if not prefix_lists:
                      raise ValueError('Prefix list not found: ' + name)
                  prefix_list_id = prefix_lists[0]['PrefixListId']
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                   {'PrefixListId': prefix_list_id}, prefix_list_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc))
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  S3PrefixList:
    Type: Custom::PrefixListLookup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupFunction.Arn
      PrefixListName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Parent image selection (CIS Marketplace image if subscribed, else AL2023 ARM64)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ParentImageSelectorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role for the Lambda function that selects the Image Builder parent image
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'lambda.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadImageBuilderImages
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAndGetImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  ParentImageSelectorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Selects the CIS Marketplace parent image when subscribed, otherwise AWS-managed AL2023 ARM64
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ParentImageSelectorRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse


          def cis_image_available(name):
              client = boto3.client('imagebuilder')
              kwargs = {'owner': 'AWSMarketplace', 'maxResults': 25}
              while True:
                  response = client.list_images(**kwargs)
                  for image in response.get('imageVersionList', []):
                      if image.get('name') == name or ('/' + name + '/') in image.get('arn', ''):
                          return True
                  token = response.get('nextToken')
                  if not token:
                      return False
                  kwargs['nextToken'] = token


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'parent-image-selector')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  try:
                      subscribed = cis_image_available(props['CisImageName'])
                  except Exception as lookup_error:
                      print('CIS image lookup failed, using fallback: ' + str(lookup_error))
                      subscribed = False
                  if subscribed:
                      arn, source = props['CisImageArn'], 'cis'
                  else:
                      arn, source = props['FallbackImageArn'], 'al2023'
                  print('Selected parent image ' + arn + ' (' + source + ')')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                   {'ParentImageArn': arn, 'Source': source},
                                   'parent-image-selector-' + source)
              except Exception as exc:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc))
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-Level-1

  ParentImageSelector:
    Type: Custom::ParentImageSelector
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ParentImageSelectorFunction.Arn
      CisImageName: cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi
      CisImageArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws-marketplace:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x'
      FallbackImageArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      RecipeVersion: !Ref RecipeVersion

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning enablement (required for image scanning)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InspectorEnablementRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role for the Lambda function that enables Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning in this account
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'lambda.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EnableInspectorEc2Scanning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EnableInspector
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:Enable
                  - inspector2:BatchGetAccountStatus
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CreateInspectorServiceLinkedRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/inspector2.amazonaws.com/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/agentless.inspector2.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName:
                      - inspector2.amazonaws.com
                      - agentless.inspector2.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ReadInspectorServiceLinkedRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:GetRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/inspector2.amazonaws.com/*'

  InspectorEnablementFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Enables Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning in the current account and waits until it is active
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt InspectorEnablementRole.Arn
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          PHYSICAL_ID = 'inspector-ec2-enablement'
          POLL = 15
          SAFETY_MS = 30000
          GRACE = 120
          SLRS = {
              'inspector2.amazonaws.com': 'AWSServiceRoleForAmazonInspector2',
              'agentless.inspector2.amazonaws.com': 'AWSServiceRoleForAmazonInspector2Agentless',
          }


          def check_time(context, what):
              if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < SAFETY_MS + POLL * 1000:
                  raise RuntimeError('Timed out waiting for ' + what)


          def ensure_roles(context):
              iam = boto3.client('iam')
              created = []
              for service, role in SLRS.items():
                  try:
                      iam.create_service_linked_role(AWSServiceName=service)
                      print('Created service-linked role ' + role)
                      created.append(role)
                  except ClientError as err:
                      e = err.response['Error']
                      if e.get('Code') == 'InvalidInput' and 'has been taken' in e.get('Message', ''):
                          print('Service-linked role already present: ' + role)
                      else:
                          raise RuntimeError('Cannot create service-linked role ' + role
                                             + ' (check SCPs): ' + str(err))
              for role in created:
                  while True:
                      try:
                          iam.get_role(RoleName=role)
                          break
                      except ClientError as err:
                          if err.response['Error'].get('Code') != 'NoSuchEntity':
                              raise
                      check_time(context, 'IAM propagation of ' + role)
                      time.sleep(5)
              if created:
                  check_time(context, 'IAM propagation')
                  time.sleep(15)


          def status(client, key):
              r = client.batch_get_account_status()
              if r.get('failedAccounts'):
                  raise RuntimeError('BatchGetAccountStatus failed: ' + str(r['failedAccounts']))
              accounts = r.get('accounts', [])
              if not accounts:
                  return 'DISABLED'
              return accounts[0].get('resourceState', {}).get(key.lower(), {}).get('status', 'DISABLED')


          def enable(client, context, types):
              for attempt in (1, 2, 3):
                  try:
                      return client.enable(resourceTypes=types)
                  except ClientError as err:
                      if (attempt == 3 or err.response['Error'].get('Code') != 'AccessDeniedException'
                              or 'CreateServiceLinkedRole' not in str(err)):
                          raise
                      print('Enable attempt ' + str(attempt) + ' hit IAM propagation delay, retrying')
                      check_time(context, 'Inspector enable retry')
                      time.sleep(15)


          def enable_and_wait(context, types):
              client = boto3.client('inspector2')
              key = types[0]
              s = status(client, key)
              print('Initial Inspector ' + key + ' status: ' + s)
              if s == 'ENABLED':
                  return
              ensure_roles(context)
              r = enable(client, context, types)
              if r.get('failedAccounts'):
                  raise RuntimeError('Inspector enable failed (a delegated Inspector administrator may '
                                     'need to enable this account): ' + str(r['failedAccounts']))
              started = time.time()
              while True:
                  s = status(client, key)
                  print('Inspector ' + key + ' status: ' + s)
                  if s == 'ENABLED':
                      return
                  if s in ('SUSPENDED', 'SUSPENDING'):
                      raise RuntimeError('Inspector ' + key + ' scanning is ' + s)
                  if s in ('DISABLED', 'DISABLING') and time.time() - started > GRACE:
                      raise RuntimeError('Inspector ' + key + ' scanning stayed ' + s + ' after enable')
                  check_time(context, 'Inspector ' + key + ' scanning; last status ' + s)
                  time.sleep(POLL)


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, PHYSICAL_ID)
                      return
                  types = event['ResourceProperties'].get('ResourceTypes') or ['EC2']
                  enable_and_wait(context, types)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Status': 'ENABLED'}, PHYSICAL_ID)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print('Inspector enablement failed: ' + str(exc))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, PHYSICAL_ID, reason=str(exc)[:500])

            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAccountUseViaAwsServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:

            Resource: '*'

  ElasticBeanstalkComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-elastic-beanstalk-prep'
      Version: !Ref ComponentVersion
      Description: Prepares a CIS hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image for Elastic Beanstalk
      ChangeDescription: Initial Elastic Beanstalk compatibility configuration
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AmiKmsKey.Arn
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkCompatibility
        description: Installs and configures prerequisites so Elastic Beanstalk can bootstrap instances launched from this AMI.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSystemPackages
                action: UpdateOS
              - name: InstallBeanstalkPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install aws-cfn-bootstrap amazon-cloudwatch-agent amazon-ssm-agent jq tar gzip unzip python3 python3-pip
                    - dnf clean all
              - name: PrepareBeanstalkDirectories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /var/app
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /var/log/eb-hooks
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                    - echo "eb-prepared-by=ec2-image-builder" > /etc/elasticbeanstalk/ami-info
              - name: EnableAgents
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
                    - systemctl enable chronyd || true
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateBeanstalkPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - rpm -q aws-cfn-bootstrap amazon-cloudwatch-agent amazon-ssm-agent jq
                    - test -x /opt/aws/bin/cfn-init
                    - test -d /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - test -d /var/app
                    - uname -m | grep -q aarch64
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestBeanstalkBootstrapTooling
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - /opt/aws/bin/cfn-init --version
                    - systemctl is-enabled amazon-ssm-agent
                    - test -f /etc/elasticbeanstalk/ami-info
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Compliance: CIS-Level-1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless Maths MCP server (test): API Gateway + Lambda + Cognito'

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores.
    Description: API Gateway deployment stage name.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool app client.

Resources:
  MathsMcpUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  MathsMcpUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  MathsMcpLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MathsMcpLambdaLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}:*'

  MathsMcpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Description: Maths MCP server placeholder handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt MathsMcpLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,Authorization",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS"
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps({"status": "ok", "message": "Maths MCP placeholder"})
              }

  MathsMcpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: Maths MCP server REST API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MathsMcpCognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cognito-authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt MathsMcpUserPool.Arn

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MathsMcpApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref MathsMcpCognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  RootGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt MathsMcpApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MathsMcpLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MathsMcpApi}/*'

  MathsMcpDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
      - RootGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      Description: !Sub 'Maths MCP API deployment for ${DeploymentStage}'

Outputs:
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Description: Public health check URL (no authentication required)
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MathsMcpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/'
  McpEndpointUrl:
    Description: MCP endpoint URL protected by Cognito
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MathsMcpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/mcp'
  RestApiId:
    Description: API Gateway REST API ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpApi
  DeploymentStageName:
    Description: API Gateway stage name
    Value: !Ref DeploymentStage
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MathsMcpUserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito user pool app client ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPoolClient
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Maths MCP Lambda function name
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: Maths MCP Lambda function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MathsMcpFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an ECR repository, an ECS Fargate task definition, a task role,
  an execution role and a log group. The container image URI is built from the
  current account ID, region, repository name and a fixed, immutable image tag.

Parameters:
  RepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: sample-app
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be lowercase alphanumeric characters, optionally separated by a
      single period, underscore or hyphen.
    Description: Name of the ECR repository that holds the container image.

  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: v1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid image tag of 1-128 characters (letters, digits,
      underscore, period, hyphen) and must not start with a period or hyphen.
    Description: >-
      The fixed, immutable image tag that the task definition is pinned to.
      Do not use "latest".

Resources:
  SampleRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref RepositoryName
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName

  ContainerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${RepositoryName}'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: ECS task execution role used by the ECS agent to pull the image and write logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcrImagePull
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # ecr:GetAuthorizationToken does not support resource-level
              # permissions and must be granted on "*".
              - Sid: EcrAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPullFromSampleRepository
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: !GetAtt SampleRepository.Arn
        - PolicyName: ContainerLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteContainerLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: ECS task role assumed by the application code running in the container.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadSampleRepository
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadOnlySampleRepository
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                Resource: !GetAtt SampleRepository.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained Cognito authentication stack for nih-grants. Creates the user pool with MFA and enforced advanced security, web and general app clients, an identity pool, authenticated and unauthenticated IAM roles, a KMS-encrypted context bucket and its KMS key and alias.

Parameters:
  AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether the identity pool allows unauthenticated (guest) identities.

Conditions:
  AllowUnauthenticated: !Equals [!Ref AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities, 'true']

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for S3 encryption of the nih-grants context bucket
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: nih-grants-s3-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/nih-grants-s3-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  ContextBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  ContextBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ContextBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ContextBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ContextBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: nih-grants-user-pool
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 11
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: Your verification code
        EmailMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: nih-grants

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  GeneralClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: nih_grants_identity_pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: !If [AllowUnauthenticated, true, false]
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref WebClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
        - ClientId: !Ref GeneralClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-cognito-authenticated-role
      Description: Role assumed by authenticated nih-grants Cognito identities
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-authenticated-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ContextBucketObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:PutObjectTagging'
                  - 's3:GetObjectTagging'
                  - 's3:DeleteObjectTagging'
                Resource: !Sub '${ContextBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KmsAccessViaAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'kms:RequestAlias': alias/nih-grants-s3-key
              - Sid: WebSocketConnect
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'execute-api:Invoke'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/$connect'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-cognito-unauthenticated-role
      Description: Role assumed by unauthenticated nih-grants Cognito identities (no permissions attached)
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn
      RoleMappings:
        WebClientMapping:
          IdentityProvider: !Sub '${UserPool.ProviderName}:${WebClient}'
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: AuthenticatedRole
        GeneralClientMapping:
          IdentityProvider: !Sub '${UserPool.ProviderName}:${GeneralClient}'
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: AuthenticatedRole

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolProviderName:
    Description: Cognito user pool provider name
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
  WebClientId:
    Description: Web app client ID
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  GeneralClientId:
    Description: General-use app client ID
    Value: !Ref GeneralClient
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: Cognito identity pool ID
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
  AuthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the authenticated identity role
    Value: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the unauthenticated identity role
    Value: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn
  ContextBucketName:
    Description: Name of the context S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref ContextBucket
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key for the context bucket
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  KmsAliasName:
    Description: Alias name of the KMS key
    Value: !Ref KmsAlias

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Builds a serverless email-submission REST API (POST /email) on Amazon API Gateway
  that validates the JSON body and sends the message directly through Amazon SES,
  secured with an API key and a usage plan with throttling and a monthly quota.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT - SES identity is omitted by design:
# This template does NOT create an AWS::SES::EmailIdentity. A sender identity
# can't be verified automatically in a greenfield account: an email identity
# needs someone to click a verification link, and a domain identity needs DNS
# records. New accounts also start in the SES sandbox. The "from" address
# (and, while the account is in the SES sandbox, every recipient address)
# must be verified in Amazon SES outside this template before SendEmail
# will succeed.
#
# Also omitted by design: there are no stateful data stores, so no
# DeletionPolicy/UpdateReplacePolicy Retain is required, and there are no
# Lambda functions because API Gateway integrates with SES directly.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.
    Description: Name of the API Gateway deployment stage.

  ApiKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: email-apikey
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens and underscores.
    Description: Name of the API Gateway API key.

Resources:
  # REST API
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-email-api"
      Description: Serverless REST API that accepts email submissions and sends them via Amazon SES.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # Resource path: /email
  EmailResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: email

  # JSON schema model
  EmailModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Name: EmailModel
      ContentType: application/json
      Description: JSON schema for an email submission request.
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: EmailModel
        type: object
        required:
          - to
          - from
          - html
          - text
        properties:
          to:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            items:
              type: string
          cc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          bcc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          from:
            type: string
          subject:
            type: string
          html:
            type: string
          text:
            type: string

  # Request validator
  EmailRequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Name: EmailBodyValidator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: false

  # IAM role for the SES integration
  ApiGatewaySesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to call Amazon SES SendEmail.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowSesSendEmail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*"

  # POST method with SES service integration
  EmailPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref EmailResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      OperationName: SendEmail
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref EmailRequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref EmailModel
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:email:path//"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewaySesRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000
        RequestParameters:
          integration.request.header.Content-Type: "'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: |
            #set($root = $input.path('$'))##
            #set($body = "Action=SendEmail&Source=$util.urlEncode($root.from)")##
            #foreach($addr in $root.to)##
            #set($body = "${body}&Destination.ToAddresses.member.${foreach.count}=$util.urlEncode($addr)")##
            #end##
            #if($root.cc)##
            #foreach($addr in $root.cc)##
            #set($body = "${body}&Destination.CcAddresses.member.${foreach.count}=$util.urlEncode($addr)")##
            #end##
            #end##
            #if($root.bcc)##
            #foreach($addr in $root.bcc)##
            #set($body = "${body}&Destination.BccAddresses.member.${foreach.count}=$util.urlEncode($addr)")##
            #end##
            #end##
            #if($root.subject)##
            #set($subject = $root.subject)##
            #else##
            #set($subject = "")##
            #end##
            #set($body = "${body}&Message.Subject.Data=$util.urlEncode($subject)")##
            #set($body = "${body}&Message.Body.Html.Data=$util.urlEncode($root.html)")##
            #set($body = "${body}&Message.Body.Text.Data=$util.urlEncode($root.text)")##
            $body
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            SelectionPattern: ''
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "status": "sent",
                  "requestId": "$context.requestId"
                }
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "status": "error",
                  "message": "The email request was rejected by Amazon SES.",
                  "requestId": "$context.requestId"
                }
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "status": "error",
                  "message": "Amazon SES failed to process the request.",
                  "requestId": "$context.requestId"
                }

  # Deployment
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - EmailPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment of the email submission API.

  # Logging prerequisites
  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to push execution and access logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs"

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key encrypting the API Gateway access log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-email-api-access"
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  # Stage
  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      Description: Stage for the email submission API.
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength","apiKeyId":"$context.identity.apiKeyId","integrationStatus":"$context.integration.status","errorMessage":"$context.error.message"}'
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          MetricsEnabled: true
          DataTraceEnabled: false
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 500
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000

  # API key
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Reusable nested stack that subscribes email, SQS, Lambda and HTTPS endpoints
  to one SNS topic. Each subscription is created only when its parameter differs
  from its sentinel default. If no TopicArn is passed in, a fallback topic is
  created so standalone deployments still succeed. The fallback topic is
  encrypted with a customer managed KMS key that this stack creates. Any AWS
  service other than SNS that publishes to the fallback topic must be added to
  that key's policy. When a TopicArn is passed in, the owner of that topic is
  responsible for its encryption. NOTE - Email subscriptions must be confirmed
  by the recipient through the confirmation email that SNS sends. NOTE - This
  template does not create an AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy, because that resource needs
  the queue URL of a queue this template does not own. The owner of the external
  queue must grant sns.amazonaws.com the sqs:SendMessage action, with an
  aws:SourceArn condition set to the topic ARN.

Parameters:
  TopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ARN of the SNS topic supplied by the parent stack. Use NONE to create a
      fallback topic in this stack instead.
    Default: 'NONE'
    AllowedPattern: '^(NONE|arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256})$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be NONE or a valid SNS topic ARN.

  EmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Email address to subscribe. Leave as example@example.com to skip the
      email subscription.
    Default: 'example@example.com'
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.

  SqsQueueArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ARN of an existing SQS queue to subscribe. Leave as NONE to skip the SQS
      subscription.
    Default: 'NONE'
    AllowedPattern: '^(NONE|arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sqs:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,80})$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be NONE or a valid SQS queue ARN.

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ARN of an existing Lambda function to subscribe. Leave as NONE to skip the
      Lambda subscription.
    Default: 'NONE'
    AllowedPattern: '^(NONE|arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:lambda:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:function:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}(:[A-Za-z0-9$_-]+)?)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be NONE or a valid Lambda function ARN.

  HttpsEndpointUrl:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      HTTPS endpoint URL to subscribe. Leave as https://example.com/placeholder
      to skip the HTTPS subscription.
    Default: 'https://example.com/placeholder'
    AllowedPattern: '^https://.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a URL that starts with https://.

Conditions:
  UseProvidedTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TopicArn, 'NONE']]
  CreateFallbackTopic: !Not [Condition: UseProvidedTopic]
  CreateEmailSubscription: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EmailAddress, 'example@example.com']]
  CreateSqsSubscription: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SqsQueueArn, 'NONE']]
  CreateLambdaSubscription: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LambdaFunctionArn, 'NONE']]
  CreateHttpsSubscription: !Not [!Equals [!Ref HttpsEndpointUrl, 'https://example.com/placeholder']]

Resources:
  FallbackTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateFallbackTopic
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the fallback SNS topic of this nested stack.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  FallbackTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateFallbackTopic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref FallbackTopicKey

  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref EmailAddress
      TopicArn: !If [UseProvidedTopic, !Ref TopicArn, !Ref FallbackTopic]

  # The owner of the external queue must add a queue policy that grants
  # sns.amazonaws.com the sqs:SendMessage action, with aws:SourceArn set to the
  # effective topic ARN. This template does not create an AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
  # because that resource needs the URL of a queue this template does not own.
  SqsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateSqsSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: sqs
      Endpoint: !Ref SqsQueueArn
      TopicArn: !If [UseProvidedTopic, !Ref TopicArn, !Ref FallbackTopic]
      RawMessageDelivery: false

  LambdaSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateLambdaSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: lambda
      Endpoint: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      TopicArn: !If [UseProvidedTopic, !Ref TopicArn, !Ref FallbackTopic]

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: CreateLambdaSubscription
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      Principal: sns.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !If [UseProvidedTopic, !Ref TopicArn, !Ref FallbackTopic]

  HttpsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateHttpsSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: https
      Endpoint: !Ref HttpsEndpointUrl
      TopicArn: !If [UseProvidedTopic, !Ref TopicArn, !Ref FallbackTopic]
      DeliveryPolicy:
        healthyRetryPolicy:
          minDelayTarget: 20
          maxDelayTarget: 600
          numRetries: 10
          numNoDelayRetries: 0
          numMinDelayRetries: 2
          numMaxDelayRetries: 3
          backoffFunction: exponential
        throttlePolicy:
          maxReceivesPerSecond: 10

Outputs:
  EffectiveTopicArn:
    Description: >-
      ARN of the SNS topic in use. This is the passed-in topic, or the fallback
      topic if none was passed in.
    Value: !If [UseProvidedTopic, !Ref TopicArn, !Ref FallbackTopic]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EffectiveTopicArn'

  FallbackTopicKeyArn:
    Condition: CreateFallbackTopic
    Description: >-
      ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts the fallback topic.
      Publishers need permission on this key to publish to the topic.
    Value: !GetAtt FallbackTopicKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FallbackTopicKeyArn'

  EmailSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Description: ARN of the email subscription. It stays pending until the recipient confirms it.
    Value: !Ref EmailSubscription
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmailSubscriptionArn'

  SqsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateSqsSubscription
    Description: ARN of the SQS subscription.
    Value: !Ref SqsSubscription
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SqsSubscriptionArn'

  LambdaSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateLambdaSubscription
    Description: ARN of the Lambda subscription.
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubscription
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaSubscriptionArn'

  HttpsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateHttpsSubscription
    Description: ARN of the HTTPS subscription, which retries with exponential backoff.
    Value: !Ref HttpsSubscription
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HttpsSubscriptionArn'
