AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions calculator demo

Resources:
  CalculatorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/Calculator
      RetentionInDays: 3

  CalculatorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CalculatorLambdaLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CalculatorLogGroup.Arn

  CalculatorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: Calculator
      Description: Performs add, subtract, multiply, or divide on a list of operands
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CalculatorLambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref CalculatorLogGroup
        LogFormat: Text
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          class CalculationError extends Error {
            constructor(message) {
              super(message);
              this.name = 'CalculationError';
            }
          }

          const operations = {
            add: (a, b) => a + b,
            subtract: (a, b) => a - b,
            multiply: (a, b) => a * b,
            divide: (a, b) => {
              if (b === 0) {
                throw new CalculationError('Division by zero is not allowed');
              }
              return a / b;
            }
          };

          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('Received event:', JSON.stringify(event));

            const operator = event && event.operator;
            const operands = event && event.operands;

            const operation = operations[operator];
            if (!operation) {
              throw new CalculationError('Unsupported operator: ' + operator);
            }

            if (!Array.isArray(operands) || operands.length < 2) {
              throw new CalculationError('operands must be an array of at least two numbers');
            }

            if (!operands.every((n) => typeof n === 'number' && Number.isFinite(n))) {
              throw new CalculationError('All operands must be finite numbers');
            }

            const result = operands.slice(1).reduce((acc, n) => operation(acc, n), operands[0]);

            return {
              operator: operator,
              operands: operands,
              result: result
            };
          };

  CalculatorStateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CalculatorStateMachineInvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CalculatorFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CalculatorFunction.Arn}:*'

  CalculatorStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: Calculator-StateMachine
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt CalculatorStateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        CalculatorFunctionArn: !GetAtt CalculatorFunction.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Calculator demo that routes to an operation based on the operator field
        StartAt: SelectOperator
        States:
          SelectOperator:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: add
                Next: Add
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: subtract
                Next: Subtract
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: multiply
                Next: Multiply
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: divide
                Next: Divide
            Default: UnknownOperator
          Add:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${CalculatorFunctionArn}
              Payload.$: $
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.error
                Next: CalculationFailed
            End: true
          Subtract:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${CalculatorFunctionArn}
              Payload.$: $
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.error
                Next: CalculationFailed
            End: true
          Multiply:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${CalculatorFunctionArn}
              Payload.$: $
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.error
                Next: CalculationFailed
            End: true
          Divide:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${CalculatorFunctionArn}
              Payload.$: $
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.error
                Next: CalculationFailed
            End: true
          UnknownOperator:
            Type: Fail
            Error: UnknownOperator
            Cause: Unsupported operator; expected add, subtract, multiply, or divide
          CalculationFailed:
            Type: Fail
            Error: CalculationError
            Cause: The Calculator Lambda function failed to compute a result (for example, invalid operands or division by zero)

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Calculator-StateMachine state machine
    Value: !Ref CalculatorStateMachine
  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the calculator state machine
    Value: !GetAtt CalculatorStateMachine.Name
  CalculatorFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Calculator Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt CalculatorFunction.Arn

    Value: !Ref CalculatorLogGroup
  SampleInput:
    Description: Sample input format for starting a state machine execution

  PrefixListLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt HelperFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, time, urllib.request, boto3
          from botocore.config import Config
          def send(e, c, st, d, pid, why=''):
              b = json.dumps(dict({k: e[k] for k in ('StackId', 'RequestId', 'LogicalResourceId')}, Status=st, Reason=(why or c.log_stream_name)[:900], PhysicalResourceId=pid, Data=d)).encode()
              for i in range(3):
                  try:
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(e['ResponseURL'], b, {'Content-Type': ''}, method='PUT'), timeout=10) as r:
                          return print('Sent %s: HTTP %s' % (st, r.status))
                  except Exception as x:
                      print('Send attempt %d failed: %s %s' % (i + 1, type(x).__name__, getattr(x, 'code', '')))
                      time.sleep(i + 1)
              raise RuntimeError('Response delivery failed')
          def handler(e, c):
              print('Received %s for %s' % (e.get('RequestType'), e.get('LogicalResourceId')))
              pid, st, d, why = e.get('PhysicalResourceId') or c.log_stream_name, 'SUCCESS', {}, ''
              if e.get('RequestType') == 'Delete':
                  return send(e, c, st, d, pid)
              try:
                  n = e['ResourceProperties']['PrefixListName']
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', config=Config(connect_timeout=5, read_timeout=10, retries={'max_attempts': 3}))
                  ls = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [n]}])['PrefixLists']
                  if not ls:
                      raise RuntimeError('Prefix list not found: ' + n)
                  pid = d['PrefixListId'] = ls[0]['PrefixListId']
              except Exception as x:
                  print('Error: %s' % x)
                  st, why = 'FAILED', str(x)
              send(e, c, st, d, pid, why)

  # Delete is a no-op: the account setting is not changed back.
  ImageBlockPublicAccessFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt HelperFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, time, urllib.request, boto3
          from botocore.config import Config
          def send(e, c, st, d, pid, why=''):
              b = json.dumps(dict({k: e[k] for k in ('StackId', 'RequestId', 'LogicalResourceId')}, Status=st, Reason=(why or c.log_stream_name)[:900], PhysicalResourceId=pid, Data=d)).encode()
              for i in range(3):
                  try:
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(e['ResponseURL'], b, {'Content-Type': ''}, method='PUT'), timeout=10) as r:
                          return print('Sent %s: HTTP %s' % (st, r.status))
                  except Exception as x:
                      print('Send attempt %d failed: %s %s' % (i + 1, type(x).__name__, getattr(x, 'code', '')))
                      time.sleep(i + 1)
              raise RuntimeError('Response delivery failed')
          def handler(e, c):
              print('Received %s for %s' % (e.get('RequestType'), e.get('LogicalResourceId')))
              pid, st, d, why = 'ImageBlockPublicAccess', 'SUCCESS', {}, ''
              if e.get('RequestType') == 'Delete':
                  return send(e, c, st, d, pid)
              try:
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', config=Config(connect_timeout=5, read_timeout=15, retries={'max_attempts': 3}))
                  get = lambda: ec2.get_image_block_public_access_state()['ImageBlockPublicAccessState']
                  s = get()
                  print('Initial state: ' + s)
                  if s != 'unblocked':
                      ec2.disable_image_block_public_access()
                      while s != 'unblocked' and c.get_remaining_time_in_millis() > 90000:
                          time.sleep(10)
                          s = get()
                  if s != 'unblocked':
                      raise RuntimeError('Timed out waiting for image block public access to unblock (state: %s)' % s)
                  d['State'] = s
              except Exception as x:
                  print('Error: %s' % x)
                  st, why = 'FAILED', str(x)
              send(e, c, st, d, pid, why)

  MongoDbStagingFunction:

      MemorySize: 1024
      EphemeralStorage:
        Size: 2048
      Role: !GetAtt MongoDbStagingFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import gzip, hashlib, json, os, re, tempfile, time, urllib.request
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          BASE = 'https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/'
          KEY_URL = 'https://pgp.mongodb.com/server-8.0.asc'
          PKGS = ('mongodb-database-tools', 'mongodb-mongosh-shared-openssl3')
          R = '{http://linux.duke.edu/metadata/repo}'
          C = '{http://linux.duke.edu/metadata/common}'
          s3 = None
          def send(e, c, st, d, pid, why=''):
              b = json.dumps(dict({k: e[k] for k in ('StackId', 'RequestId', 'LogicalResourceId')}, Status=st, Reason=(why or c.log_stream_name)[:900], PhysicalResourceId=pid, Data=d)).encode()
              for i in range(3):
                  try:
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(e['ResponseURL'], b, {'Content-Type': ''}, method='PUT'), timeout=10) as r:
                          return print('Sent %s: HTTP %s' % (st, r.status))
                  except Exception as x:
                      print('Send attempt %d failed: %s %s' % (i + 1, type(x).__name__, getattr(x, 'code', '')))
                      time.sleep(i + 1)
              raise RuntimeError('Response delivery failed')
          def left(ctx):
              if ctx.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 60000:
                  raise RuntimeError('MongoDB RPM download exceeded time budget')
          def get(url, ctx):
              left(ctx)
              with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as r:
                  return r.read()
          def vkey(v):
              return [(1, int(p)) if p.isdigit() else (0, p) for p in re.findall(r'[0-9]+|[A-Za-z]+', v or '')]
          def newest(ctx):
              md = ET.fromstring(get(BASE + 'repodata/repomd.xml', ctx))
              href = next(d.find(R + 'location').get('href') for d in md.findall(R + 'data') if d.get('type') == 'primary')
              raw = get(BASE + href, ctx)
              prim = ET.fromstring(gzip.decompress(raw) if href.endswith('.gz') else raw)
              best = {}
              for p in prim.findall(C + 'package'):
                  n = p.findtext(C + 'name')
                  if n not in PKGS or p.findtext(C + 'arch') != 'x86_64':
                      continue
                  v = p.find(C + 'version')
                  k = (int(v.get('epoch') or 0), vkey(v.get('ver')), vkey(v.get('rel')))
                  if n not in best or k > best[n][0]:
                      cs = p.find(C + 'checksum')
                      best[n] = (k, p.find(C + 'location').get('href'), cs.get('type'), cs.text.strip())
              missing = [n for n in PKGS if n not in best]
              if missing:
                  raise RuntimeError('Packages not found: ' + ', '.join(missing))
              return best.values()
          def stage(bucket, prefix, href, ctype, want, ctx):
              if ctype != 'sha256':
                  raise RuntimeError('No SHA-256 checksum for ' + href)
              h = hashlib.sha256()
              with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile() as f:
                  left(ctx)
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(BASE + href, timeout=30) as r:
                      print('Downloading %s (%s bytes)' % (href, r.headers.get('Content-Length', '?')))
                      for chunk in iter(lambda: r.read(1048576), b''):
                          left(ctx)
                          h.update(chunk)
                          f.write(chunk)
                  f.flush()
                  if h.hexdigest() != want:
                      raise RuntimeError('SHA-256 mismatch for ' + href)
                  left(ctx)
                  s3.upload_file(f.name, bucket, prefix + os.path.basename(href))
                  print('Staged ' + os.path.basename(href))
          def empty(bucket):
              try:
                  for pg in s3.get_paginator('list_object_versions').paginate(Bucket=bucket, Prefix='mongodb/'):
                      objs = [{'Key': o['Key'], 'VersionId': o['VersionId']} for o in pg.get('Versions', []) + pg.get('DeleteMarkers', [])]
                      for i in range(0, len(objs), 1000):
                          s3.delete_objects(Bucket=bucket, Delete={'Objects': objs[i:i + 1000], 'Quiet': True})
              except ClientError as x:
                  if x.response['Error']['Code'] != 'NoSuchBucket':
                      raise
          def handler(event, ctx):
              global s3
              print('Received %s for %s' % (event.get('RequestType'), event.get('LogicalResourceId')))
              pid, st, d, why = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or ctx.log_stream_name, 'SUCCESS', {}, ''
              if event.get('RequestType') == 'Delete' and not pid.endswith('/mongodb'):
                  return send(event, ctx, st, d, pid)
              try:
                  s3 = boto3.client('s3')
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  bucket = props['BucketName']
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      empty(bucket)
                  else:
                      prefix = props['Prefix']
                      if not prefix.startswith('mongodb/') or not prefix.endswith('/'):
                          raise ValueError('Invalid prefix: ' + prefix)
                      s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=prefix + 'server-8.0.asc', Body=get(KEY_URL, ctx))
                      staged = []
                      for _, href, ctype, sha in newest(ctx):
                          stage(bucket, prefix, href, ctype, sha, ctx)
                          staged.append(os.path.basename(href))
                      pid = bucket + '/mongodb'
                      d = {'Prefix': prefix, 'Rpms': ','.join(staged)}
              except Exception as x:
                  print('Error: %s' % x)
                  st, why = 'FAILED', str(x)
              send(event, ctx, st, d, pid, why)

      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Latest regional SSM Agent
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ssm-agent
        description: Install the latest SSM Agent
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallSsmAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y https://s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/amazon-ssm-${AWS::Region}/latest/linux_amd64/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
          - name: validate

  MongoDbToolsComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mongodb-tools'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: MongoDB 8.0 repo, database tools and mongosh
      Data: !Sub |
        name: mongodb-tools
        description: MongoDB 8.0 repository, database tools and mongosh (RPMs staged in S3)
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadStagedMongoDbRpms
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - rm -rf /tmp/mongodb-staging
                    - mkdir -p /tmp/mongodb-staging
                    - aws s3 cp --recursive --region ${AWS::Region} s3://${MongoDbStagingBucket}/mongodb/8.0/${ImageVersion}/ /tmp/mongodb-staging/
                    - ls -l /tmp/mongodb-staging/server-8.0.asc /tmp/mongodb-staging/*.rpm
              - name: ImportMongoDbGpgKey
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - rpm --import /tmp/mongodb-staging/server-8.0.asc
              - name: VerifyMongoDbRpmSignatures
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    # dnf does not check GPG signatures on local packages by default, so check them here.
                    - for rpmfile in /tmp/mongodb-staging/*.rpm; do rpmkeys --checksig "$rpmfile" || { echo "Signature verification failed for $rpmfile" >&2; exit 1; }; done
              - name: InstallMongoDbTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf install -y --disablerepo=mongodb-org-8.0 /tmp/mongodb-staging/*.rpm
                    - rm -rf /tmp/mongodb-staging
              - name: AddMongoDbRepo
                action: CreateFile
                inputs:
                  - path: /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo
                    overwrite: true
                    content: |
                      [mongodb-org-8.0]
                      name=MongoDB Repository
                      baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/
                      gpgcheck=1
                      enabled=1
                      gpgkey=https://pgp.mongodb.com/server-8.0.asc
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateMongoDbTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mongosh --version
                    - mongodump --version
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PythonSynapseComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-python-synapseclient'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Python 3 and synapseclient via CodeArtifact
      Data: !Sub |
        name: python-synapseclient
        description: Python 3 with the synapseclient library
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallPython
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y python3 python3-pip
              - name: InstallSynapseClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    # The token lives only in shell variables for this step. It is never written to pip config or disk.
                    - CODEARTIFACT_TOKEN="$(aws codeartifact get-authorization-token --region ${AWS::Region} --domain ${CodeArtifactDomain.Name} --domain-owner ${CodeArtifactDomain.Owner} --duration-seconds 900 --query authorizationToken --output text)"
                    - CODEARTIFACT_ENDPOINT="$(aws codeartifact get-repository-endpoint --region ${AWS::Region} --domain ${CodeArtifactDomain.Name} --domain-owner ${CodeArtifactDomain.Owner} --repository ${CodeArtifactRepository.Name} --format pypi --query repositoryEndpoint --output text)"
                    - CODEARTIFACT_HOST_PATH="$(echo "$CODEARTIFACT_ENDPOINT" | cut -d/ -f3- | sed 's|/*$||')"
                    # --ignore-installed stops pip from trying to uninstall dependencies that RPMs own.
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade --ignore-installed --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check --index-url "https://aws:$CODEARTIFACT_TOKEN@$CODEARTIFACT_HOST_PATH/simple/" synapseclient
                    - unset CODEARTIFACT_TOKEN CODEARTIFACT_ENDPOINT CODEARTIFACT_HOST_PATH
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateSynapseClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient"
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuildStarterFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartBastionImageBuild
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartPipelineExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: imagebuilder:StartImagePipelineExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt BastionImagePipeline.Arn
              # A build start resolves the pipeline and its recipe, configs and components as the caller.
              - Sid: ReadPipelineDependencies
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetImagePipeline
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BastionImagePipeline.Arn
                  - !GetAtt BastionImageRecipe.Arn
                  - !GetAtt BastionInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
                  - !GetAtt BastionDistributionConfiguration.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:component/${AWS::StackName}-ssm-agent/${ImageVersion}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:component/${AWS::StackName}-mongodb-tools/${ImageVersion}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:component/${AWS::StackName}-python-synapseclient/${ImageVersion}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:component/${AWS::StackName}-dotnet-sdk/${ImageVersion}/*'
              # Image Builder checks the caller against the AWS-owned parent image named in the recipe.
              - Sid: ReadAwsManagedParentImage
                Effect: Allow
                Action: imagebuilder:GetImage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/*'
              # ec2:DescribeImages does not support resource-level permissions (parent AMI lookup).
              - Sid: DescribeParentAmi
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeImages
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageImageBuilds
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:CancelImageCreation
                  - imagebuilder:DeleteImage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:image/*'
              - Sid: CreateImageBuilderServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/imagebuilder.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForImageBuilder'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com

  # DeleteImage does NOT deregister the distributed public AMI, by design.
  ImageBuildStarterFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 240
      Role: !GetAtt ImageBuildStarterFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, time, urllib.request, uuid, boto3
          from botocore.config import Config
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          ACTIVE = ('PENDING', 'CREATING', 'BUILDING', 'TESTING', 'DISTRIBUTING', 'INTEGRATING')
          ib = None
          def send(e, c, st, d, pid, why=''):
              b = json.dumps(dict({k: e[k] for k in ('StackId', 'RequestId', 'LogicalResourceId')}, Status=st, Reason=(why or c.log_stream_name)[:900], PhysicalResourceId=pid, Data=d)).encode()
              for i in range(3):
                  try:
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(e['ResponseURL'], b, {'Content-Type': ''}, method='PUT'), timeout=10) as r:
                          return print('Sent %s: HTTP %s' % (st, r.status))
                  except Exception as x:
                      print('Send attempt %d failed: %s %s' % (i + 1, type(x).__name__, getattr(x, 'code', '')))
                      time.sleep(i + 1)
              raise RuntimeError('Response delivery failed')
          def start(p, token):
              try:
                  return ib.start_image_pipeline_execution(imagePipelineArn=p['ImagePipelineArn'], clientToken=token)['imageBuildVersionArn']
              except ClientError as x:
                  err = x.response['Error']
                  if err['Code'] != 'InvalidParameterValueException' or 'not authorized' not in err.get('Message', ''):
                      raise
                  print('Authorization not yet effective, retrying once in 20 s')
                  time.sleep(20)
                  return ib.start_image_pipeline_execution(imagePipelineArn=p['ImagePipelineArn'], clientToken=str(uuid.uuid4()))['imageBuildVersionArn']
          def status(arn):
              return ib.get_image(imageBuildVersionArn=arn)['image']['state']['status']
          def remove(arn, ctx):
              try:
                  s = status(arn)
                  if s in ACTIVE:
                      ib.cancel_image_creation(imageBuildVersionArn=arn, clientToken=str(uuid.uuid4()))
                      while s in ACTIVE and ctx.get_remaining_time_in_millis() > 120000:
                          time.sleep(15)
                          s = status(arn)
                      if s in ACTIVE:
                          raise RuntimeError('Timed out waiting for image build to cancel (status: %s)' % s)
                  ib.delete_image(imageBuildVersionArn=arn)
              except ClientError as x:
                  if x.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                      raise
          def handler(event, ctx):
              global ib
              print('Received %s for %s' % (event.get('RequestType'), event.get('LogicalResourceId')))
              pid, st, d, why = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or ctx.log_stream_name, 'SUCCESS', {}, ''
              rt = event.get('RequestType')
              if rt == 'Delete' and not pid.startswith('arn:'):
                  return send(event, ctx, st, d, pid)
              try:
                  ib = boto3.client('imagebuilder', config=Config(connect_timeout=5, read_timeout=20, retries={'max_attempts': 3}))
                  p = event['ResourceProperties']
                  if rt == 'Delete':
                      remove(pid, ctx)
                  elif rt == 'Update' and pid.startswith('arn:') and event.get('OldResourceProperties', {}).get('ImageRecipeArn') == p['ImageRecipeArn']:
                      d = {'ImageBuildVersionArn': pid}
                  else:
                      pid = start(p, event['RequestId'])
                      d = {'ImageBuildVersionArn': pid}
              except Exception as x:
                  print('Error: %s' % x)
                  st, why = 'FAILED', str(x)
              send(event, ctx, st, d, pid, why)

        - AttributeName: job_id

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates six monthly AWS Budgets for security and observability service costs
  (AWS Config, Amazon CloudWatch and CloudWatch Events, Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon
  Inspector, AWS Security Hub, and S3-based security logging). Each budget tracks
  unblended actual cost and alerts through a KMS-encrypted SNS topic. Assumption:
  the Service cost filter values (AWS Config, AmazonCloudWatch, CloudWatch Events,
  Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, Amazon Simple Storage
  Service) match the Cost Explorer service dimension names. Linked-account
  parameters fall back to the deploying account when left empty.

Parameters:
  MonitoringMemberAccountA:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: First linked member account for the CloudWatch budget. If you leave it empty, the deploying account is used.
  MonitoringMemberAccountB:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Second linked member account for the CloudWatch budget. If you leave it empty, the deploying account is used.
  SecurityLoggingMemberAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Linked member account for the S3 security logging budget. If you leave it empty, the deploying account is used.
  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address that receives budget alerts through the SNS topic.

Conditions:
  HasMonitoringAccountA: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MonitoringMemberAccountA, '']]
  HasMonitoringAccountB: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MonitoringMemberAccountB, '']]
  HasSecurityLoggingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityLoggingMemberAccount, '']]
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]

Resources:
  BudgetAlertsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key that encrypts the budget alerts SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsToUseKeyForSnsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  BudgetAlertsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-budget-alerts'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BudgetAlertsKey

  BudgetAlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: Budget Alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref BudgetAlertsKey

  BudgetAlertsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref BudgetAlertsTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'SNS:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref BudgetAlertsTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  BudgetAlertsEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref BudgetAlertsTopic

  AwsConfigBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn: BudgetAlertsTopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-aws-config-monthly'
        BudgetType: COST
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: 10000
          Unit: USD
        CostFilters:
          Service:
            - AWS Config
        CostTypes:
          IncludeCredit: false
          IncludeDiscount: false
          IncludeRefund: false
          IncludeTax: false
          IncludeRecurring: true
          IncludeUpfront: true
          IncludeOtherSubscription: true
          IncludeSubscription: true
          IncludeSupport: false
          UseBlended: false
          UseAmortized: false
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BudgetAlertsTopic
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: FORECASTED
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 100
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BudgetAlertsTopic

  CloudWatchBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn: BudgetAlertsTopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cloudwatch-monthly'
        BudgetType: COST
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: 10000

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Sets up a SageMaker notebook instance for RAPIDS AI development, with an IAM execution role and a lifecycle configuration that installs a RAPIDS conda environment and registers a Jupyter kernel.

# NOTE: ml.t3.medium is a CPU-only instance type. RAPIDS libraries such as cuDF
# and cuML need an NVIDIA GPU to run (for example ml.g4dn.xlarge or ml.g5.xlarge).
# On ml.t3.medium the RAPIDS environment installs, but GPU workloads will not run.
# The instance type stays ml.t3.medium as requested.
# The notebook runs on the Amazon Linux 2023 platform (notebook-al2023-v1). The AL1
# and AL2 notebook platforms are deprecated for new instances.

Resources:
  RapidsSageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RapidsLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e
              # Runs as root at notebook creation. The long RAPIDS install runs in the
              # background as ec2-user so this script returns well within the 5-minute limit.
              sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF'
              set -e
              ENV_DIR=/home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs/rapids
              LOG_FILE=/home/ec2-user/SageMaker/rapids-install.log
              mkdir -p /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs
              if [ ! -d "$ENV_DIR" ]; then
                nohup bash -c "source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/bin/activate && \
                  CONDA_OVERRIDE_CUDA=12.5 conda create -y -p $ENV_DIR \
                    -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                    rapids=24.12 python=3.11 'cuda-version>=12.0,<=12.5' ipykernel && \
                  $ENV_DIR/bin/python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name 'Python (RAPIDS)' && \
                  echo 'RAPIDS installation complete'" > "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
              fi
              EOF
      OnStart:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e
              # Runs as root on every notebook start. Kernel specs outside
              # /home/ec2-user/SageMaker are lost on restart, so re-register them here.
              sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF'
              set -e
              ENV_DIR=/home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs/rapids
              LOG_FILE=/home/ec2-user/SageMaker/rapids-install.log
              if [ -x "$ENV_DIR/bin/python" ]; then
                "$ENV_DIR/bin/python" -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name 'Python (RAPIDS)'
              else
                mkdir -p /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs
                if ! pgrep -f "conda create -y -p $ENV_DIR" > /dev/null; then
                  rm -rf "$ENV_DIR"
                  nohup bash -c "source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/bin/activate && \
                    CONDA_OVERRIDE_CUDA=12.5 conda create -y -p $ENV_DIR \
                      -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                      rapids=24.12 python=3.11 'cuda-version>=12.0,<=12.5' ipykernel && \
                    $ENV_DIR/bin/python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name 'Python (RAPIDS)' && \
                    echo 'RAPIDS installation complete'" > "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
                fi
              fi
              EOF

  RapidsNotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      # CPU-only instance type (see note at top of template); RAPIDS GPU workloads need a GPU instance.
      InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      RoleArn: !GetAtt RapidsSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      LifecycleConfigName: !GetAtt RapidsLifecycleConfig.NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName
      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks
      DirectInternetAccess: Enabled
      RootAccess: Enabled
      # Amazon Linux 2023 notebook platform, which SageMaker supports for new instances.
      PlatformIdentifier: notebook-al2023-v1
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsNotebookInstance.NotebookInstanceName
  NotebookInstanceArn:
    Description: ARN of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !Ref RapidsNotebookInstance
  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM execution role used by the notebook instance
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
  LifecycleConfigName:
    Description: Name of the notebook instance lifecycle configuration
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsLifecycleConfig.NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  FSxN S3AP event-driven pipeline SLO dashboard and alarms, deployed only when enabled.
  Creates four SLO CloudWatch alarms (EventIngestionLatency, ProcessingSuccessRate,
  FPolicyReconnectTime, ReplayCompletionTime) and a CloudWatch dashboard with SLO,
  synthetic canary and alarm status widgets.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnableSloDashboard
          - ProjectPrefix
          - DashboardRegion
          - SnsTopicArn
      - Label:
          default: Metric namespaces
        Parameters:
          - MetricNamespace
          - CanaryMetricNamespace
      - Label:
          default: SLO thresholds
        Parameters:
          - EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds
          - ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent
          - FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds
          - ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds
      - Label:
          default: Alarm evaluation
        Parameters:
          - AlarmPeriodSeconds
          - AlarmEvaluationPeriods

Parameters:
  EnableSloDashboard:
    Type: String
    Description: Set to "true" to deploy the SLO dashboard and alarm set.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix applied to every dashboard and alarm name.
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2-41 characters, starting with a letter or digit.

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch namespace of the four SLO metrics.
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch namespace of the synthetic canary metrics.
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255

  DashboardRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: Region used by every dashboard widget.
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name such as us-east-1.

  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional SNS topic ARN for alarm and OK notifications. Leave empty to disable notifications.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid SNS topic ARN.

  EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: P99 event ingestion latency SLO threshold in seconds.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 0

  ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent:
    Type: Number
    Description: Average processing success rate SLO threshold in percent.
    Default: 99.5
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100

  FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum FPolicy reconnect time SLO threshold in seconds.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0

  ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum replay completion time SLO threshold in seconds (default 5 minutes).
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0

  AlarmPeriodSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: Alarm evaluation period in seconds.
    Default: 300
    AllowedValues:
      - 60
      - 300
      - 900
      - 3600

  AlarmEvaluationPeriods:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of consecutive periods that must breach before alarming.
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100

Conditions:
  IsEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableSloDashboard
    - 'true'
  HasSnsTopic: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref SnsTopicArn
      - ''

Resources:
  # Unconditional, zero-cost placeholder so the stack is valid when the flag is "false".
  PlaceholderHandle:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::WaitConditionHandle

  # NOTE: The SLO metrics below are defined WITHOUT dimensions. Publishers must emit
  # these metrics without dimensions (or dimensions must be added here later),
  # otherwise the alarms and dashboard widgets will never see data.

  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-event-ingestion-latency'
      AlarmDescription: P99 event ingestion latency (seconds) exceeds the SLO threshold (default 5s) for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      DatapointsToAlarm: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-processing-success-rate'
      AlarmDescription: Average processing success rate (percent) falls below the SLO threshold (default 99.5%) for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      DatapointsToAlarm: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-fpolicy-reconnect-time'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum FPolicy reconnect time (seconds) exceeds the SLO threshold (default 30s) for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      DatapointsToAlarm: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-replay-completion-time'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum replay completion time (seconds) exceeds the SLO threshold (default 300s / 5 minutes) for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      DatapointsToAlarm: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # The dashboard depends on the alarms only via GetAtt references inside Fn::Sub.
  SloDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: IsEnabled
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${ProjectPrefix} - Event Ingestion Latency (P99)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "stacked": false,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency", { "stat": "p99", "period": 300, "label": "EventIngestionLatency P99 (s)" } ]
                ],
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "value": ${EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds}, "label": "SLO P99 threshold", "color": "#d62728" }
                  ]
                },
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Seconds", "showUnits": false } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${ProjectPrefix} - Processing Success Rate (Average)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "stacked": false,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate", { "stat": "Average", "period": 300, "label": "ProcessingSuccessRate (%)" } ]
                ],
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "value": ${ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent}, "label": "SLO success rate threshold", "color": "#d62728", "fill": "below" }
                  ]
                },
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 90, "max": 100, "label": "Percent", "showUnits": false } }
              }
            },
            {

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-service Cognito user pool for testing JWT authentication flows with an
  AgentCore Gateway and MCP server. Greenfield deployment - every resource is
  defined in this template.

Parameters:
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/callback,http://localhost:8080/callback"
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited list of OAuth callback URLs for the web client.
      Cognito allows plain http only for localhost.

  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/logout,http://localhost:8080/logout"
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited list of sign-out URLs for the web client.
      Cognito allows plain http only for localhost.

  DomainPrefixBase:
    Type: String
    Default: "agentcore-jwt-test"
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-42 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens, must start and end
      with a letter or number, and must not contain "aws", "amazon" or "cognito".
    Description: >-
      Base for the hosted UI domain prefix. The account ID is appended to make it
      globally unique. Must not contain "aws", "amazon" or "cognito".

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-agentcore-user-pool'
      # Self-service signup: users can register through the hosted UI or the SignUp API
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      # Email is the sign-in identifier
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      # Users verify themselves by email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: "Verify your AgentCore test account"
        EmailMessage: "Your verification code is {####}"
      # COGNITO_DEFAULT uses Cognito's built-in sender, so no SES identity is needed.
      # It has a low daily send limit, which is fine for testing.
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      # MFA is off to keep programmatic testing simple.
      # Set it to OPTIONAL or ON outside testing.
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      UserPoolTags:
        Purpose: agentcore-jwt-testing

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      # Cognito prefix domain (hosted UI for signup and login); globally unique and all lowercase
      Domain: !Sub '${DomainPrefixBase}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ApiResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: "api"
      Name: "AgentCore API"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: mcp
          ScopeDescription: "Access to MCP server"
        - ScopeName: gateway
          ScopeDescription: "Access to AgentCore Gateway"

  # Public web client: authorization code grant with PKCE plus programmatic auth flows.
  # PKCE (code_challenge with S256) is enforced by the client during the
  # authorization request. CloudFormation has no property to require PKCE.
  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${ApiResourceServer}/mcp'
        - !Sub '${ApiResourceServer}/gateway'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  # Machine-to-machine clients. Client secrets are generated by Cognito and are
  # not exposed in Outputs. Read them with:
  #   aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client --user-pool-id <UserPoolId> --client-id <ClientId>
  # The client_credentials grant only issues access tokens; the ID and refresh
  # token validity values are set because the request asks for them.
  GatewayM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-gateway-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ApiResourceServer}/gateway'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  McpM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mcp-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ApiResourceServer}/mcp'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  OidcDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL for the AgentCore Gateway / MCP JWT authorizer
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  IssuerUrl:
    Description: JWT issuer URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'

  HostedUiBaseUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI base URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  AuthorizeEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 authorize endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'

  SignupUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI self-service signup URL for the web client
    Value: !Sub
      - 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/signup?client_id=${WebClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${FirstCallbackUrl}'
      - FirstCallbackUrl: !Select [0, !Ref CallbackURLs]

  WebClientId:
    Description: Public web client ID (authorization code with PKCE, USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, USER_SRP_AUTH)
    Value: !Ref WebClient

  GatewayM2MClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine client ID for AgentCore Gateway (secret available via describe-user-pool-client)
    Value: !Ref GatewayM2MClient

  McpM2MClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine client ID for the MCP server (secret available via describe-user-pool-client)
    Value: !Ref McpM2MClient

  GatewayScope:
    Description: Full custom scope string for AgentCore Gateway allowedScopes
    Value: !Sub '${ApiResourceServer}/gateway'

  McpScope:
    Description: Full custom scope string for MCP server allowedScopes
    Value: !Sub '${ApiResourceServer}/mcp'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates an API Gateway REST API secured by Cognito, a machine-to-machine (M2M) OAuth client, and a KMS key that EventBridge can use.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyServerlessLandUserPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyWebClient
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool app client.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
  CallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:3000/callback
    Description: Callback URL for the app client.
  LogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:3000/logout
    Description: Logout URL for the app client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: petstore-api

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - petstore-auth
          - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: petstore-api.example.com
      Name: PetstoreApi
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: domestic.read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the domestic petstore API

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutURL
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key usable by Amazon EventBridge
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-eventbridge-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-petstore-api'
      Description: Petstore API secured by a Cognito User Pool authorizer
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoUserPoolAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: https://petstore-demo-endpoint.execute-api.com/petstore/pets
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs'

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment of the petstore API

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-petstore-api-access'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}'
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          MetricsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL of the API Gateway prod stage
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ApiStage}'
  AppClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool app client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint of the Cognito User Pool domain
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
