AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates the VPC and DNS for a Puppet Quick Start deployment, including a VPC, public subnet, internet gateway, public routing, and a private Route 53 hosted zone with A records for the Puppet master and agents.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. The public subnet CIDR must fall within this range.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/19'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet. Must fall within the VPC CIDR, and must contain the Puppet master and agent IP addresses. Instances in this subnet do not receive public IP addresses automatically; instances that need direct internet access must request one explicitly (for example an Elastic IP or AssociatePublicIpAddress on the network interface).

  PuppetMasterIp:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.10'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Private IP address for puppet.example.com. Must fall within the public subnet CIDR (CloudFormation cannot validate this).

  LinuxAgentIp:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.11'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Private IP address for linuxagent.example.com. Must fall within the public subnet CIDR (CloudFormation cannot validate this).

  WindowsAgentIp:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.12'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Private IP address for windowsagent.example.com. Must fall within the public subnet CIDR (CloudFormation cannot validate this).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: example.com
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Private internal DNS zone for the Puppet Quick Start deployment
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  PuppetMasterRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetMasterIp

  LinuxAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIp

  WindowsAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIp

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created for the Puppet Quick Start deployment
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet created for the Puppet Quick Start deployment
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with Cloud Map private DNS service
  discovery (SRV records) and step-based CPU auto scaling. Creates its own VPC,
  public and private subnets, internet gateway, NAT gateway, ECS cluster, IAM
  roles, CloudWatch log group and CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name used in resource names, tags, the Cloud Map namespace and the log group name.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-service
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Name of the microservice, used for the ECS service, task definition family, container, Cloud Map service and log group path.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Container image to run (public Docker Hub image by default).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port the container listens on. Used for port mappings, security group rules and the Cloud Map SRV record.

  ContainerCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '256'
    AllowedValues:
      - '256'
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '4096'
    Description: Task CPU units. The CPU and memory pair must be a valid Fargate combination.

  ContainerMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues:
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '3072'
      - '4096'
      - '8192'
    Description: Task memory in MiB. The CPU and memory pair must be a valid Fargate combination.

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Initial number of running tasks (must be within the auto scaling bounds of 2 to 10).

  EnableCustomTaskRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create an optional IAM task role the containers can assume to access other AWS resources.

Conditions:
  CreateCustomTaskRole: !Equals [!Ref EnableCustomTaskRole, 'true']

Mappings:
  NetworkConfig:
    VPC:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
    PublicSubnet:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/24
    PrivateSubnet1:
      CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
    PrivateSubnet2:
      CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet1, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet2, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Cluster and Security
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Egress note: outbound traffic is limited to TCP on the container port inside
  # the VPC and TCP 443 to the internet via the NAT gateway. The two /1 HTTPS
  # rules together still reach every public HTTPS address; they restrict the
  # protocol and port, not the destination hosts. The default Docker Hub image
  # has no fixed IP ranges, so destination hosts cannot be narrowed further
  # without moving the image to a private registry reached via VPC endpoints.
  # DNS queries to the Amazon VPC resolver are not filtered by security groups.
  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Security group for ${ServiceName} containers in ${EnvironmentName}'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Allow container traffic from within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: East-west calls to sibling services discovered through Cloud Map within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
        - Description: HTTPS only via NAT for image pulls, CloudWatch Logs and AWS APIs - lower half of IPv4, all public HTTPS hosts reachable
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/1
        - Description: HTTPS only via NAT for image pulls, CloudWatch Logs and AWS APIs - upper half of IPv4, all public HTTPS hosts reachable
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 128.0.0.0/1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-container-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Logging and IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateCustomTaskRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadServiceParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Task Definition
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref ServiceName
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - CreateCustomTaskRole
        - !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cloud Map Service Discovery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.internal'
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for the ${EnvironmentName} environment'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Cloud Map service for ${ServiceName} in ${EnvironmentName}'
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !GetAtt PrivateDnsNamespace.Id
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: PrivateRoute
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        MaximumPercent: 200
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService.Name}'
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  LowCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: Scale down when average CPU utilization is at or below 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  HighCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: Scale up in graduated steps when average CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the private subnets
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

  ContainerSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the container security group
    Value: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup

  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  ECSServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

  ECSServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS service
    Value: !Ref ECSService

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the task definition
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition

  NamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace
    Value: !GetAtt PrivateDnsNamespace.Id

  DiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service
    Value: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn

  ServiceDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Description: Private DNS name other services use to discover this service
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.internal'

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group for container logs
    Value: !Ref LogGroup

  TaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task execution role
    Value: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn

  TaskRoleArn:
    Condition: CreateCustomTaskRole
    Description: ARN of the optional custom task role
    Value: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demos with an OCI primary region.
  Creates a VPC, internet gateway, private subnet, route table, transit gateway with
  VPC attachment, HTTPS-only security group, an optional static-route site-to-site VPN
  to OCI, and VPC flow logs encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.

# Note: no speculative properties (such as TransitGatewayAttachmentId on
# AWS::EC2::VPNConnection, or VpnTunnelOptionsSpecifications preshared keys) are set.
# VPN tunnel options stay at AWS defaults, which the OCI side can match.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
      - Label:
          default: Network addressing
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetCidr
          - InternalCidr
          - OciBackboneCidr
      - Label:
          default: OCI site-to-site VPN
        Parameters:
          - EnableOciVpn
          - OciVpnPeerIp
          - OciCustomerGatewayAsn

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: oci-hybrid-backbone
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 3-32 characters using lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used in resource Name tags, the KMS alias and the log group name.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (x.x.x.x/y).
    Description: CIDR block for the AWS VPC.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (x.x.x.x/y).
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet. It must fall inside VpcCidr.

  InternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (x.x.x.x/y).
    Description: Internal CIDR range. It is the only allowed source for HTTPS inbound.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.16.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (x.x.x.x/y).
    Description: >-
      OCI backbone CIDR. It must not overlap VpcCidr. It is the only allowed HTTPS outbound
      destination and the destination of the VPC and transit gateway routes to OCI.

  EnableOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the customer gateway and the site-to-site VPN to OCI. OciVpnPeerIp must also be set.

  OciVpnPeerIp:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI IPSec headend. Leave empty to skip creating the VPN.

  OciCustomerGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 31898
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967294
    Description: BGP ASN of the OCI side (OCI public ASN is 31898). CustomerGateway requires it even though routing is static.

Conditions:
  CreateOciVpn: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref EnableOciVpn, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OciVpnPeerIp, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Core VPC networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpc
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-igw
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-private-subnet
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-rt
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub ${ProjectName} transit gateway for OCI hybrid interconnect
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-tgw
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-tgw-rt
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpcTransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-tgw-vpc-attachment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpcAttachmentRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpcTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TgwRouteToVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpcTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  OciRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcTransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HttpsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTPS inbound from the internal CIDR and HTTPS outbound to the OCI backbone only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCidr
          Description: HTTPS inbound from the internal CIDR range
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: HTTPS outbound to the OCI backbone CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-https-sg
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional site-to-site VPN to OCI (static routes only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      IpAddress: !Ref OciVpnPeerIp
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciCustomerGatewayAsn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-oci-cgw
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-oci-vpn
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpnAttachmentLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the VPN transit gateway attachment lookup function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpn-attachment-lookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeTgwAttachments
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpn-lookup-role
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpnAttachmentLookupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}-vpn-lookup
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpn-lookup-logs
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpnAttachmentLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Description: Looks up the transit gateway attachment ID of the OCI VPN connection
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref VpnAttachmentLookupLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import time
          import urllib.request

          import boto3

          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")


          def send(event, context, status, data, physical_id, reason=""):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or "See CloudWatch Logs stream " + context.log_stream_name,
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data,
              }).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)


          def find_attachment(vpn_id, tgw_id, context):
              filters = [
                  {"Name": "resource-type", "Values": ["vpn"]},
                  {"Name": "resource-id", "Values": [vpn_id]},
                  {"Name": "transit-gateway-id", "Values": [tgw_id]},
              ]
              while True:
                  resp = ec2.describe_transit_gateway_attachments(Filters=filters)
                  for att in resp.get("TransitGatewayAttachments", []):
                      if att.get("State") == "available":
                          return att["TransitGatewayAttachmentId"]
                  if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 60000:
                      raise TimeoutError("VPN transit gateway attachment did not become available in time")
                  time.sleep(15)


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "vpn-attachment-lookup-pending")
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      send(event, context, "SUCCESS", {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  props = event["ResourceProperties"]
                  attachment_id = find_attachment(props["VpnConnectionId"], props["TransitGatewayId"], context)
                  print("Found VPN attachment " + attachment_id)
                  send(event, context, "SUCCESS", {"AttachmentId": attachment_id}, attachment_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print("Lookup failed: " + str(exc))
                  send(event, context, "FAILED", {}, physical_id, str(exc)[:200])
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpn-lookup
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpnAttachmentLookup:
    Type: Custom::VpnAttachmentLookup
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupFunction.Arn
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref OciVpnConnection
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  VpnAttachmentRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookup.AttachmentId
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TgwRouteToOci:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookup.AttachmentId
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flow logs with KMS encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}-vpn-lookup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-flowlogs-key
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  FlowLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-flowlogs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-flowlogs
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver to the encrypted CloudWatch log group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-log-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DeliverFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-flowlogs-role
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpc-flowlog
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the backbone VPC
    Value: !Ref Vpc
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: CIDR block of the backbone VPC
    Value: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet
    Value: !Ref Subnet
  RouteTableId:

  VpcTransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway VPC attachment

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the HTTPS-only security group

  FlowLogKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the flow logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn

    Description: Alias of the flow log KMS key

  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group that holds VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
  FlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC flow log
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog
  OciCustomerGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Description: ID of the OCI customer gateway
    Value: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
  OciVpnConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Description: ID of the site-to-site VPN connection to OCI
    Value: !Ref OciVpnConnection
  OciVpnTransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Description: Transit gateway attachment ID of the OCI VPN connection
    Value: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookup.AttachmentId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline: S3, IAM, five Glue jobs and their schedules'

Resources:
  AdminConsoleBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the QuickSight admin console S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminConsoleBucketKey

  AdminConsoleBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminConsoleBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AdminConsoleGlueRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the QuickSight admin console Glue data preparation jobs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminConsoleFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ServiceFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:*'
                  - 'quicksight:*'
                  - 'glue:*'
                  - 'cloudwatch:*'
                  - 'logs:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AdminConsoleBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucketMultipartUploads'
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucket.Arn
              - Sid: AdminConsoleObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:ListMultipartUploadParts'
                Resource: !Sub '${AdminConsoleBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: AdminConsoleKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleDatasetInfoJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Collects QuickSight dataset and object access information (Python Shell)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_dataset_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--OBJECT_ACCESS_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/object_access/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleUserAccessInfoJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Collects QuickSight user and group membership information (Python Shell)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_user_access_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--GROUP_MEMBERSHIP_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/group_membership/'
        '--OBJECT_ACCESS_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/object_access/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleFolderInfoJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Collects QuickSight folder assets, lookup and path information (Python Shell)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_folder_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--FOLDER_ASSETS_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_assets/'
        '--FOLDER_LOOKUP_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_lookup/'
        '--FOLDER_PATH_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_path/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleGroupMembershipEtlJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Transforms QuickSight group membership data (Glue ETL)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_group_membership_etl.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--GROUP_MEMBERSHIP_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/group_membership/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleCloudTrailEtlJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Prepares CloudTrail log data for the admin console (Glue ETL)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_cloudtrail_etl.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--CLOUDTRAIL_TABLE_NAME': cloudtrail_logs
        '--CLOUDTRAIL_LOG_LOCATION': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/cloudtrail/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleDatasetInfoTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the dataset info job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleDatasetInfoJob

  AdminConsoleUserAccessInfoTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the user access info job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleUserAccessInfoJob

  AdminConsoleFolderInfoTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the folder info job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleFolderInfoJob

  AdminConsoleGroupMembershipEtlTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the group membership ETL job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleGroupMembershipEtlJob

  AdminConsoleCloudTrailEtlTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the CloudTrail ETL job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleCloudTrailEtlJob

Outputs:
  AdminConsoleBucketName:
    Description: Name of the admin console S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminConsoleBucketName'

  AdminConsoleBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the admin console bucket
    Value: !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucketKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminConsoleBucketKeyArn'

  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight group membership data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/group_membership/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GroupMembershipS3Path'

  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight object access data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/object_access/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ObjectAccessS3Path'

  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight folder assets data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_assets/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderAssetsS3Path'

  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight folder lookup data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_lookup/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderLookupS3Path'

  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight folder path data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_path/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderPathS3Path'

  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail log table
    Value: cloudtrail_logs
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogTableName'

  CloudTrailLogS3Location:
    Description: S3 location of the CloudTrail log data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/cloudtrail/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogS3Location'

  AdminConsoleGlueRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the admin console Glue jobs
    Value: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminConsoleGlueRoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds custom ECS-optimized AMIs from the latest
  Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI. It runs a Chef (CINC) recipe stored in a KMS-encrypted
  S3 bucket and uses a custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and collects
  metadata before it creates the AMI. Every image is scanned with Amazon Inspector, which
  this stack activates, and tested. The AMI is then distributed to a target region. A
  lifecycle policy deprecates old AMIs. Builds run in a private subnet that reaches AWS
  services only through VPC endpoints. This stack creates all networking, encryption,
  storage and IAM resources.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-al2-golden
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (2-41 characters).
    Description: Name prefix used for every resource and for the Project tag.
  DistributionRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code, for example us-east-1.
    Description: Region where the resulting AMI is distributed and shared with the current account.
  ParentImageId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
    Description: Public SSM parameter that resolves to the latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI.
  ArtifactVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.1
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version, for example 1.0.1.
    Description: Semantic version for the component, image recipe and workflow. Increase it whenever you change any of them.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m5.large
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.medium
      - t3.large
      - m5.large
      - m5.xlarge
      - c5.large
      - c5.xlarge
    Description: Instance type used for build and test instances.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 500
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB. The ECS-optimized AL2 AMI needs at least 30 GiB.
  RootVolumeType:
    Type: String
    Default: gp3
    AllowedValues:
      - gp3
      - gp2
      - io1
      - io2
    Description: Root EBS volume type.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.42.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    Description: CIDR block for the build VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.42.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    Description: CIDR block for the private build subnet (no internet route). It must fall inside VpcCidr.
  ChefRecipeKey:
    Type: String
    Default: chef/recipes/default.rb
    AllowedPattern: '^chef/[a-zA-Z0-9!_.*()/-]+\.rb$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be under the chef/ prefix and end in .rb.
    Description: S3 object key of the Chef recipe that the component downloads and runs.
  CincClientVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 18.2.7
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a CINC Client release version, for example 18.2.7.
    Description: Pinned version of the open-source CINC Client (Chef Infra compatible) EL7 x86_64 RPM, staged in S3 for offline installation.
  PipelineSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 3 * * ? *)
    Description: Schedule expression for the daily pipeline run, in UTC.
  AmiDeprecationAgeDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Age in days after which the lifecycle policy deprecates AMIs.
  AmisToRetain:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Minimum number of the newest AMIs the lifecycle policy never deprecates.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues: [7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 365]
    Description: Retention period, in days, for CloudWatch log groups and S3 build logs.

          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-private-subnet'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc

        - Key: Project

  FlowLogGroup:

    Properties:

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

        - Key: Project

  VpcFlowLog:

      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-sg'
      GroupDescription: Image Builder build and test instances - no ingress, egress limited to VPC endpoints and S3
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints (SSM, Image Builder, KMS)
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt S3PrefixList.PrefixListId
          Description: HTTPS to S3 through the gateway endpoint
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt S3PrefixList.PrefixListId
          Description: HTTP to S3-hosted Amazon Linux 2 yum repositories through the gateway endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'

      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt BuildSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: HTTPS from Image Builder build and test instances
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
          Description: Non-routable placeholder that removes the default allow-all egress rule
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-s3-gateway'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssmmessages'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ec2messages'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
