      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-kms'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key, artifact and log bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${ProjectName} Image Builder artifact bucket'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-artifacts'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: expire-build-logs
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: logs/
            ExpirationInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
          - Id: expire-noncurrent-versions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
          - Id: abort-incomplete-uploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper function: seeds Chef artifacts, resolves the S3 prefix list and
  # activates Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning (required for image scanning)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HelperFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HelperFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: seed-artifacts-lookup-and-inspector
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt HelperFunctionLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: SeedChefArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/chef/*'
              - Sid: EncryptArtifactsViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: LookupS3PrefixList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ActivateInspectorEc2Scanning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:Enable
                  - inspector2:BatchGetAccountStatus
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CreateInspectorServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/inspector2.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: inspector2.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: CreateInspectorAgentlessServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/agentless.inspector2.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: agentless.inspector2.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HelperFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Image Builder helper for ${ProjectName} - seeds Chef artifacts into S3, resolves the regional S3 prefix list ID and activates Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt HelperFunctionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: Text
        LogGroup: !Ref HelperFunctionLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client("s3")
          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
          inspector = boto3.client("inspector2")

          POLL_SECONDS = 15
          SAFETY_MARGIN_SECONDS = 30
          DISABLED_GRACE_SECONDS = 60


          def seed_artifacts(props, context):
              bucket = props["BucketName"]
              recipe_key = props["RecipeKey"]
              installer_key = props["InstallerKey"]
              s3.put_object(
                  Bucket=bucket,
                  Key=recipe_key,
                  Body=props["RecipeContent"].encode("utf-8"),
                  ContentType="text/x-ruby",
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(props["InstallerUrl"], timeout=240) as resp:
                  s3.upload_fileobj(
                      resp,
                      bucket,
                      installer_key,
                      ExtraArgs={"ContentType": "application/x-rpm"},
                  )
              return {"Key": recipe_key, "InstallerKey": installer_key}, recipe_key


          def lookup_prefix_list(props, context):
              resp = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(
                  Filters=[{"Name": "prefix-list-name", "Values": [props["PrefixListName"]]}]
              )
              lists = resp.get("PrefixLists", [])
              if not lists:
                  raise ValueError("Prefix list %s not found" % props["PrefixListName"])
              pl_id = lists[0]["PrefixListId"]
              return {"PrefixListId": pl_id}, pl_id


          def ec2_scan_status(account_id):
              resp = inspector.batch_get_account_status(accountIds=[account_id])
              for account in resp.get("accounts", []):
                  if account.get("accountId") == account_id:
                      return account.get("resourceState", {}).get("ec2", {}).get("status")
              return None


          def enable_inspector(props, context):
              account_id = props["AccountId"]
              physical_id = "inspector2-ec2-%s" % account_id
              status = ec2_scan_status(account_id)
              print("Inspector EC2 scan status before activation: %s" % status)
              if status == "ENABLED":
                  return {"Ec2ScanStatus": status}, physical_id

              resp = inspector.enable(resourceTypes=["EC2"])
              failed = resp.get("failedAccounts", [])
              if failed:
                  raise RuntimeError("Inspector activation failed: %s" % failed)

              started = time.time()
              deadline = started + context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() / 1000.0 - SAFETY_MARGIN_SECONDS
              while time.time() < deadline:
                  status = ec2_scan_status(account_id)
                  print("Inspector EC2 scan status: %s" % status)
                  if status == "ENABLED":
                      return {"Ec2ScanStatus": status}, physical_id
                  if status == "SUSPENDED" or (
                      status == "DISABLED" and time.time() - started > DISABLED_GRACE_SECONDS
                  ):
                      raise RuntimeError("Inspector EC2 scanning ended in state %s" % status)
                  time.sleep(POLL_SECONDS)
              raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for Inspector EC2 scanning (last state %s)" % status)


          MODES = {
              "SeedArtifacts": seed_artifacts,
              "PrefixList": lookup_prefix_list,
              "EnableInspector": enable_inspector,
          }


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              mode = props.get("Mode")
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", context.log_stream_name)
              data = {}
              status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS
              try:
                  # Delete is a no-op for every mode: seeded objects stay in the retained
                  # bucket and Inspector is account-wide, so it is never disabled here.
                  if event["RequestType"] in ("Create", "Update"):
                      if mode not in MODES:
                          raise ValueError("Unknown mode: %s" % mode)
                      data, physical_id = MODES[mode](props, context)
              except Exception as exc:  # report every failure back to CloudFormation
                  print("Request failed (%s): %s" % (mode, exc))
                  status = cfnresponse.FAILED
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, data, physical_id)
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  S3PrefixList:
    Type: Custom::S3PrefixList
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt HelperFunction.Arn
      Mode: PrefixList
      PrefixListName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'

  InspectorEc2Activation:
    Type: Custom::InspectorActivation
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt HelperFunction.Arn
      Mode: EnableInspector
      AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  SeedChefRecipe:
    Type: Custom::SeedChefRecipe
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt HelperFunction.Arn
      Mode: SeedArtifacts
      BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      RecipeKey: !Ref ChefRecipeKey
      InstallerUrl: !Sub 'https://downloads.cinc.sh/files/stable/cinc/${CincClientVersion}/el/7/cinc-${CincClientVersion}-1.el7.x86_64.rpm'
      InstallerKey: !Sub 'chef/installers/cinc-${CincClientVersion}-1.el7.x86_64.rpm'
      RecipeContent: |
        # Default Chef recipe seeded by CloudFormation for the ECS AL2 golden AMI.
        package 'jq'

        directory '/etc/imagebuilder' do
          owner 'root'
          group 'root'
          mode '0755'
        end

        file '/etc/imagebuilder/chef-baked' do
          content "Configured by Chef through EC2 Image Builder\n"
          owner 'root'
          group 'root'
          mode '0644'
        end

        service 'docker' do
          action :enable
        end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-instance'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: chef-artifacts-and-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadChefArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/chef/*'
              - Sid: WriteBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/logs/*'
              - Sid: ListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - Sid: UseArtifactKeyViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-instance'
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-execution'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: imagebuilder-workflow-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Ec2ReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeRegions
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeExportImageTasks
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2BuildLifecycle
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2ManageImageBuilderInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ec2:ResourceTag/CreatedBy: EC2 Image Builder
              - Sid: PassBuildInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildInstanceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
              - Sid: ReadInstanceProfile
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:GetInstanceProfile
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildInstanceProfile.Arn
              - Sid: SsmOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetCommandInvocation
                  - ssm:ListCommands
                  - ssm:ListCommandInvocations
                  - ssm:CancelCommand
                  - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
                  - ssm:CreateAssociation
                  - ssm:DeleteAssociation
                  - ssm:DescribeAssociation
                  - ssm:DescribeAssociationExecutions
                  - ssm:ListInventoryEntries
                  - ssm:GetInventory
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ImageBuilderRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:Get*
                  - imagebuilder:List*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: InspectorScanResults
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:ListCoverage
                  - inspector2:ListFindings
                  - inspector2:BatchGetAccountStatus
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-lifecycle'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chef-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ArtifactVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs CINC Client (Chef Infra compatible) from S3, then downloads and runs a Chef recipe from S3
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Version ${ArtifactVersion}'
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: !Sub
        - |
          name: ${ProjectName}-chef-recipe
          description: Installs CINC Client from S3, downloads a Chef recipe from S3 and runs it in local mode.
          schemaVersion: 1.0
          phases:
            - name: build
              steps:
                - name: PrepareWorkspace
                  action: CreateFolder
                  inputs:
                    - path: /tmp/chef
                - name: DownloadInstaller
                  action: S3Download
                  maxAttempts: 3
                  inputs:
                    - source: s3://${Bucket}/${InstallerKey}
                      destination: /tmp/chef/cinc.rpm
                - name: InstallChef
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - |
                        set -euo pipefail
                        if ! rpm -q cinc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                          rpm -Uvh /tmp/chef/cinc.rpm
                        fi
                - name: DownloadRecipe
                  action: S3Download
                  maxAttempts: 3
                  inputs:
                    - source: s3://${Bucket}/${RecipeKey}
                      destination: /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
                - name: RunRecipe
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - |
                        set -euo pipefail
                        export CHEF_LICENSE=accept-silent
                        if command -v cinc-apply >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                          cinc-apply /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
                        elif [ -x /opt/cinc/bin/cinc-apply ]; then
                          /opt/cinc/bin/cinc-apply /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
                        else
                          chef-apply /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
                        fi
                - name: Cleanup
                  action: DeleteFolder
                  inputs:
                    - path: /tmp/chef
                      force: true
            - name: validate
              steps:
                - name: ValidateChefOutput
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - test -f /etc/imagebuilder/chef-baked
            - name: test
              steps:
                - name: TestImage
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - test -f /etc/imagebuilder/chef-baked
                      - systemctl is-enabled docker
                      - test -f /etc/ecs/ecs.config || test -d /etc/ecs
        - Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
          RecipeKey: !GetAtt SeedChefRecipe.Key
          InstallerKey: !GetAtt SeedChefRecipe.InstallerKey
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ArtifactVersion
      Description: ECS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 image customized with a Chef recipe
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageId
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref RootVolumeType
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    DependsOn:
      - BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation
      - S3GatewayEndpoint
      - SsmEndpoint
      - SsmMessagesEndpoint
      - Ec2MessagesEndpoint
      - ImageBuilderEndpoint
      - KmsEndpoint
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-infrastructure'
      Description: Private build and test infrastructure for the ECS AL2 golden AMI
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: logs/imagebuilder
      ResourceTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-distribution'
      Description: !Sub 'Distributes the ${ProjectName} AMI to the target region and shares it with this account'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref DistributionRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecs-al2-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Custom ECS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 AMI built by ${ProjectName}'
            AmiTags:
              Project: !Ref ProjectName
              BaseImage: amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  BuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-workflow'
      Version: !Ref ArtifactVersion
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Build workflow that updates the SSM agent, runs components, collects metadata and creates the AMI
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Version ${ArtifactVersion}'
      Data: |
        name: custom-build-image
        description: Launch the build instance, update the SSM agent, run components, collect metadata and create the AMI.
        schemaVersion: 1.0

        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"

          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              documentName: AWS-UpdateSSMAgent
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
              parameters:
                allowDowngrade:
                  - "false"

          - name: ApplyBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: CollectMetadata
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              and:
                - stringEquals: "AMI"
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
                - booleanEquals: true
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.collectImageMetadata"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: CreateOutputAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              stringEquals: "AMI"
              value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

        outputs:
          - name: "ImageId"
            value: "$.stepOutputs.CreateOutputAMI.imageId"
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn: InspectorEc2Activation
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-pipeline'
      Description: Daily pipeline that builds, scans and tests the custom ECS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !GetAtt BuildWorkflow.Arn
        - WorkflowArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:workflow/test/test-image/x.x.x'
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref PipelineSchedule
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  AmiLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ami-lifecycle'
      Description: !Sub 'Deprecates ${ProjectName} AMIs older than the configured age'
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      Status: ENABLED
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref AmiDeprecationAgeDays
            Unit: DAYS
            RetainAtLeast: !Ref AmisToRetain
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Project: !Ref ProjectName
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions five EC2 instances in a new private VPC together with their CloudWatch alarms (CPU utilization, status check, and attached EBS reachability) and a KMS-encrypted SNS notification topic.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used as a prefix in Name tags and alarm names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: Public SSM parameter path for the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.

Resources:
  MonitoringVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-monitoring-vpc'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet'

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for monitored instances - no inbound access, HTTPS egress to in-VPC endpoints only
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt MonitoringVpc.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS to in-VPC endpoints only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-sg'

  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-role'

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  EbsEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the EBS root volumes of the monitored EC2 instances
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseThroughEbsForAccountPrincipals
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowGrantsForAttachedEbsResources
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action: kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ebs-key'

  EbsEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-ebs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EbsEncryptionKey

  InstanceLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-lt'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1

  Instance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref InstanceProfile
      Monitoring: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            VolumeSize: 30
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsEncryptionKey.Arn
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-1'

  Instance2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref InstanceProfile
      Monitoring: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            VolumeSize: 30
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsEncryptionKey.Arn

      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-2'

  Instance3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId

  Instance4:

    Properties:

        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId

        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:

          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-5'

  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the EC2 alarm notification SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*

            Principal:

            Action:

            Resource: '*'
      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-alarm-topic-key'

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:

    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-alarm-topic'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Test DynamoDB table with CloudWatch health and performance alarms.

Parameters:
  ReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    Description: Receiving region used as the ReceivingRegion dimension for replication alarms.

Resources:
  DynamoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-test-table"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing

  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the DynamoDB alarm SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmPublishing
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-alarm-topic"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} DynamoDB Alarms"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AlarmTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing

  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when write throttle events occur on the table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ThrottledRequests-PutItem"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when PutItem requests are throttled on the table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
        - Name: Operation
          Value: PutItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConditionalCheckFailedRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ConditionalCheckFailedRequests"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when conditional check failures occur on the table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConditionalCheckFailedRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when DynamoDB user errors occur in this account and region.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:

    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SystemErrors-PutItem"

      Dimensions:

      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Content-level PII classification scanner for S3 Access Points using Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional. Leave empty (default) to run the scanner outside any VPC, which only works for
      Internet-origin access points. Check the access point first with
      "aws s3control get-access-point --query NetworkOrigin"; if it returns VPC, supply that VPC ID here.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Required when VpcId is set. Comma-separated subnet IDs in that VPC for the Lambda function and the
      Interface endpoints. Comprehend endpoints are not offered in every Availability Zone, so these
      subnets must be in AZs that support the Comprehend endpoint service.
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Required when VpcId is set. Security group ID attached to the Lambda function (must allow outbound TCP 443).
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Required when VpcId is set and CreateVpcEndpoints is true. Route table IDs of the Lambda subnets, used by the S3 and DynamoDB Gateway endpoints.
  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
    Description: >-
      Only used when VpcId is set. Creates S3 and DynamoDB Gateway endpoints and Comprehend and SNS
      Interface endpoints. Set to "false" if the target VPC already has an endpoint for ANY of S3,
      DynamoDB, Comprehend or SNS - a duplicate Interface endpoint, or a second S3 or DynamoDB Gateway
      endpoint on the same route tables, fails and rolls back the whole stack.
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Scanner Lambda memory in MB.
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Scanner Lambda timeout in seconds (900 is the Lambda maximum).
  DefaultLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    AllowedValues: [en, es]
    Description: Default Comprehend language code (DetectPiiEntities supports en and es).
  DefaultMaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Cost and runtime control - default maximum number of files scanned per invocation.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to PII findings notifications. Leave empty for no subscription.

Conditions:
  DeployInVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition DeployInVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Rules:
  VpcInputsRequired:
    RuleCondition: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, '']]
        AssertDescription: SecurityGroupId must be supplied when VpcId is set.
      - Assert: !Not [!Contains [!Ref SubnetIds, '']]
        AssertDescription: SubnetIds must contain one or more non-empty subnet IDs when VpcId is set.
  RouteTablesRequiredForEndpoints:
    RuleCondition: !And
      - !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
      - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not [!Contains [!Ref RouteTableIds, '']]
        AssertDescription: RouteTableIds must be supplied when VpcId is set and CreateVpcEndpoints is true (needed by the S3 and DynamoDB Gateway endpoints).

Resources:
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: AccessPointArn
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: AccessPointArn
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  FindingsTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for PII scanner SNS findings topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  FindingsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt FindingsTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  FindingsEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref FindingsTopic

  ScannerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${ScannerFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pii-scanner
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Logs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner:*
              - Sid: AccessPointRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*
              - Sid: AccessPointObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*/object/*
              - Sid: Comprehend
                Effect: Allow
                Action: comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReportTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - Sid: Notifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref FindingsTopic
              - Sid: TopicKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt FindingsTopicKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
              - !If
                - DeployInVpc
                - Sid: VpcNetworking
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                    - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                    - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                    - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                    - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                  Resource: '*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS from the PII scanner Lambda to the Comprehend and SNS Interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref SecurityGroupId
          Description: HTTPS from the scanner Lambda security group
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  DynamoDbGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  # Comprehend endpoints are not offered in every AZ; SubnetIds must be in supported AZs.
  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner
      Description: Scans objects behind an S3 Access Point for PII with Comprehend DetectPiiEntities
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      VpcConfig: !If
        - DeployInVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ReportTable
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref FindingsTopic
          DEFAULT_LANGUAGE: !Ref DefaultLanguageCode
          DEFAULT_MAX_FILES: !Ref DefaultMaxFiles
          SCANNER_VPC_ID: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: pii-scanner
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os,json,boto3
          from datetime import datetime,timezone
          from decimal import Decimal
          from botocore.config import Config
          E=os.environ
          s3=boto3.client('s3');cp=boto3.client('comprehend');sn=boto3.client('sns')
          tb=boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(E['TABLE_NAME'])
          BIN=('.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.gif','.zip','.gz','.tar','.pdf','.exe','.bin','.jar','.mp3','.mp4','.mov','.parquet','.avro','.orc')
          def chunks(b,n=90000):
            i=0
            while i<len(b):
              j=min(i+n,len(b))
              while j<len(b) and j>i+1 and (b[j]&0xC0)==0x80:j-=1
              yield b[i:j].decode('utf-8','ignore');i=j
          def precheck(arn):
            p=arn.split(':');name=p[5].split('/',1)[1]
            try:
              ap=boto3.client('s3control',config=Config(connect_timeout=5,read_timeout=10,retries={'max_attempts':2})).get_access_point(AccountId=p[4],Name=name)
            except Exception as e:
              print('network-origin pre-check skipped: %s'%e);return
            if ap.get('NetworkOrigin')=='VPC':
              v=ap.get('VpcConfiguration',{}).get('VpcId')
              if v!=E.get('SCANNER_VPC_ID'):
                raise Exception('Access point %s is VPC-scoped to %s. Redeploy the stack with VpcId=%s and SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds from that VPC.'%(name,v,v))
          def handler(ev,ctx):
            arn=ev['accessPointArn'];dm=int(E['DEFAULT_MAX_FILES'])
            mx=int(ev.get('maxFiles',dm))
            if not ev.get('overrideMaxFiles'):mx=min(mx,dm)
            lang=ev.get('languageCode',E['DEFAULT_LANGUAGE']);sb=int(ev.get('sampleBytes',1048576))
            mg=min(60000,ctx.get_remaining_time_in_millis()//4)
            precheck(arn)
            kw={'Bucket':arn,'Prefix':ev.get('prefix','')}
            # continuationToken = last key processed; resumes via StartAfter
            if ev.get('continuationToken'):kw['StartAfter']=ev['continuationToken']
            n=hit=err=0;agg={};nxt=None;last=None
            while True:
              r=s3.list_objects_v2(**kw)
              for o in r.get('Contents',[]):
                if n>=mx or ctx.get_remaining_time_in_millis()<mg:
                  nxt=last or ev.get('continuationToken') or '';break
                k=o['Key'];last=k
                if o['Size']==0 or k.lower().endswith(BIN):continue
                try:
                  b=s3.get_object(Bucket=arn,Key=k,Range='bytes=0-%d'%(sb-1))['Body'].read()
                  if b'\x00' in b[:8192]:continue
                  n+=1;cnt={};sc={}
                  for t in chunks(b):
                    if not t.strip():continue
                    for x in cp.detect_pii_entities(Text=t,LanguageCode=lang)['Entities']:
                      y=x['Type'];cnt[y]=cnt.get(y,0)+1;sc[y]=max(sc.get(y,0),x['Score'])
                  tb.put_item(Item={'AccessPointArn':arn,'ObjectKey':k,'ScannedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'BytesScanned':len(b),'Truncated':o['Size']>len(b),'EntityCounts':cnt,'MaxScores':{y:Decimal(str(round(v,4))) for y,v in sc.items()},'HasPii':bool(cnt),'LanguageCode':lang})
                  if cnt:
                    hit+=1
                    for y,c in cnt.items():agg[y]=agg.get(y,0)+c
                except Exception as e:
                  err+=1;print('ERROR %s: %s'%(k,e))
              else:
                if r.get('IsTruncated'):
                  kw['ContinuationToken']=r['NextContinuationToken'];continue
              break
            if hit:
              top=dict(sorted(agg.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1])[:5])
              try:sn.publish(TopicArn=E['SNS_TOPIC_ARN'],Subject='PII found behind S3 access point',Message=json.dumps({'accessPoint':arn,'objectsWithPii':hit,'scanned':n,'topEntityTypes':top}))
              except Exception as e:print('SNS publish failed: %s'%e)
            return {'scanned':n,'withPii':hit,'errors':err,'nextContinuationToken':nxt}

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the PII scanner Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table holding per-object classification reports
    Value: !Ref ReportTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the AWS Glue Data Catalog databases and tables for querying Amazon
  Neptune property-graph (LPG) and RDF data, for example through the Amazon
  Athena Neptune connector. Only catalog metadata is created.

Parameters:
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the Glue database that holds the property-graph (LPG) tables.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters of lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

  RDFGlueDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the Glue database that holds the RDF tables.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters of lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue databases
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
        Description: Glue database with tables describing Neptune property-graph (LPG) vertices, edges and views.

  GraphDatabaseRDF:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RDFGlueDatabaseName
        Description: Glue database with tables describing Neptune RDF data queried by class or SPARQL.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LPG tables
  # Tables describe Neptune data rather than S3 data, so StorageDescriptor
  # Location and SerDe settings are left out. If a downstream tool needs a
  # Location, add a placeholder only after checking it is valid.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: edge
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: out
              Type: string
            - Name: in
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: view
          query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').as('source').out('route').as('destination').select('source','destination').by('code').limit(10)"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: source
              Type: string
            - Name: destination
              Type: string

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDF tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AirportRDFTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: class
          classuri: 'class:Airport'
          subject: id
          preds_prefix: prop
          strip_uri: 'true'
          prefix_class: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/'
          prefix_prop: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  RouteRDFTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: sparql
          strip_uri: 'true'
          prefix_prop: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/'
          prefix_op: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/'
          sparql: 'select ?incode ?outcode ?dist where { ?resin op:route ?resout . GRAPH ?route { ?resin op:route ?resout } . ?route prop:dist ?dist . ?resin prop:code ?incode . ?resout prop:code ?outcode . }'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

  RouteRDFNoPrefixTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: sparql
          strip_uri: 'true'
          sparql: 'select ?incode ?outcode ?dist where { ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/route> ?resout . GRAPH ?route { ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/route> ?resout } . ?route <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/dist> ?dist . ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?incode . ?resout <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?outcode . }'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

Outputs:
  GraphDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database for property-graph (LPG) tables.
    Value: !Ref GraphDatabase

  GraphDatabaseParameterName:
    Description: LPG Glue database name supplied through the GlueDatabaseName parameter.
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabaseName

  GraphDatabaseRDFName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database for RDF tables.
    Value: !Ref GraphDatabaseRDF

  GraphDatabaseRDFParameterName:
    Description: RDF Glue database name supplied through the RDFGlueDatabaseName parameter.
    Value: !Ref RDFGlueDatabaseName

  LPGTableNames:
    Description: Tables created in the property-graph (LPG) Glue database.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref AirportTable
        - !Ref CountryTable
        - !Ref ContinentTable
        - !Ref RouteTable
        - !Ref CustomAirportTable

  RDFTableNames:
    Description: Tables created in the RDF Glue database.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref AirportRDFTable
        - !Ref RouteRDFTable
        - !Ref RouteRDFNoPrefixTable

        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA

          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

        RecoveryMechanisms:

      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1

        AccessToken: hours

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the public Route 53 DNS zone for radiotopia.fm and its full set of
  production DNS records. It also creates the CloudFront distributions and the
  private S3 origin buckets that the subdomain records point to, a
  customer-managed KMS key that encrypts the origin buckets, and an AWS WAF Web
  ACL that protects the CloudFront distributions. Built for a greenfield account
  in us-east-1.

Mappings:
  DomainConfig:
    Domain:
      Name: radiotopia.fm

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DNS query logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/route53/radiotopia.fm
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  QueryLogResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: radiotopia-fm-route53-query-logging
      PolicyDocument: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Sid": "Route53QueryLogging",
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": { "Service": "route53.amazonaws.com" },
                "Action": [ "logs:CreateLogStream", "logs:PutLogEvents" ],
                "Resource": "${LogGroupArn}",
                "Condition": {
                  "StringEquals": { "aws:SourceAccount": "${AWS::AccountId}" }
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        - LogGroupArn: !GetAtt QueryLogGroup.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public hosted zone
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DependsOn: QueryLogResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !FindInMap [DomainConfig, Domain, Name]
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for radiotopia.fm (production)
      QueryLoggingConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt QueryLogGroup.Arn
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key for the S3 origin buckets.
  # Added to meet the HIGH-severity customer-managed-key encryption control
  # (AWS-0132), as a documented exception to the objective 30 resource-type
  # allowlist. The key policy uses a wildcard distribution ARN because
  # referencing the distributions here would create a dependency cycle; the
  # bucket policies still pin access to each specific distribution ARN.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for radiotopia.fm CloudFront S3 origin buckets
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontServicePrincipalDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action: kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              StringLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 origin buckets (private, SSE-KMS encrypted, versioned)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: media.radiotopia.fm

  TowerBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: tower.radiotopia.fm

  V1Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: v1.radiotopia.fm

  PlusBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
