      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: plus.radiotopia.fm

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront Origin Access Control
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-radiotopia-s3-oac'
        Description: OAC for radiotopia.fm S3 origin buckets
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AWS WAF Web ACL protecting the CloudFront distributions.
  # Added to meet the HIGH-severity CloudFront WAF control (AWS-0011), as a
  # documented exception to the objective 30 resource-type allowlist.
  # CLOUDFRONT scope is valid because this stack deploys in us-east-1.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontWebAcl:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-radiotopia-cloudfront-waf'
      Description: Web ACL protecting radiotopia.fm CloudFront distributions
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: radiotopia-cloudfront-waf
      Rules:
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: radiotopia-common-rule-set
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: radiotopia-known-bad-inputs
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: radiotopia-ip-reputation
        - Name: RateLimitPerIp
          Priority: 3
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: radiotopia-rate-limit
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront distributions
  # NOTE: Aliases (e.g. media.radiotopia.fm) and an ACM certificate ARN in
  # ViewerCertificate are added in a later stack update, after the registrar
  # delegates radiotopia.fm to this hosted zone's name servers. Until then, an
  # ACM certificate cannot validate, so the default CloudFront certificate is
  # used. CloudFront enforces MinimumProtocolVersion only once the ACM
  # certificate and Aliases are attached in that post-delegation update; in
  # that update keep MinimumProtocolVersion at TLSv1.2_2021 or higher and set
  # SslSupportMethod: sni-only.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: radiotopia.fm media distribution
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CloudFrontWebAcl.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: MediaS3Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt MediaBucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt OriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: MediaS3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TowerDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: radiotopia.fm tower distribution
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CloudFrontWebAcl.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: TowerS3Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt TowerBucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt OriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: TowerS3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  V1Distribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: radiotopia.fm v1 distribution
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CloudFrontWebAcl.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: V1S3Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt V1Bucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt OriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: V1S3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PlusDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: radiotopia.fm plus distribution
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CloudFrontWebAcl.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: PlusS3Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt PlusBucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt OriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: PlusS3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bucket policies: CloudFront OAC read access + deny non-TLS access
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref MediaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontServicePrincipalReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${MediaBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/${MediaDistribution}'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt MediaBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${MediaBucket.Arn}/*'

              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  TowerBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TowerBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontServicePrincipalReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${TowerBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/${TowerDistribution}'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TowerBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TowerBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  V1BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref V1Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontServicePrincipalReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${V1Bucket.Arn}/*'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (MCP protocol) for a protein variant
  effect prediction agent, including a Lambda gateway target, a Cognito custom JWT
  authorizer, a least-privilege gateway IAM role, and SSM parameters publishing the
  configuration.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deployment note (greenfield vs. brownfield):
# The original request asks for the Lambda ARN, the Cognito discovery URL and the
# Cognito client ID to be read from existing SSM parameters. This template targets
# a greenfield account where those parameters do not exist. Resolving them with
# {{resolve:ssm:...}} or AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<String> would fail at deploy
# time. So this template creates minimal stand-ins for those dependencies (backend
# Lambda + Cognito user pool/client), publishes their values to SSM, and references
# them directly with !Ref / !GetAtt.
# In a brownfield account, the stand-in resources (BackendFunction,
# BackendFunctionRole, UserPool, UserPoolDomain, UserPoolResourceServer,
# UserPoolClient and the *Parameter resources) can be replaced with SSM parameter
# lookups, e.g. Parameters typed as AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<String>.
#
# Region note: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway and AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
# are newer resource types. Confirm they are available in the target region
# (e.g. us-east-1) before deploying. If cfn-lint does not recognize them, update
# the cfn-lint resource specifications (cfn-lint --update-specs).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must start with a letter or number; max 41 characters.
    Description: Project name used in resource names, SSM parameter paths and tags.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway exposing protein variant effect prediction tools via MCP
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Description of the AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^([0-9a-zA-Z][-]?){1,100}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Alphanumeric characters with single hyphens between them, up to 100 characters, or blank.
    Description: Optional gateway name. Leave blank to generate one from the project name (<ProjectName>-gateway).

Conditions:
  HasCustomGatewayName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']]

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Backend stand-in: Lambda function implementing the MCP tools
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BackendFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-backend-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Application
          Value: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  BackendFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-variant-effect-backend'
      Description: Stand-in backend for protein variant effect prediction tools exposed through the AgentCore Gateway.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt BackendFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          VALID_AMINO_ACIDS = set("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY")


          def _tool_name(context):
              """Extract the tool name from the AgentCore Gateway client context.

              The gateway sends the name as '<target-name>___<tool-name>'.
              """
              try:
                  custom = context.client_context.custom or {}
              except AttributeError:
                  custom = {}
              full_name = custom.get("bedrockAgentCoreToolName", "")
              return full_name.split("___")[-1] if full_name else ""


          def _invoke_endpoint(event):
              sequence = str(event.get("sequence", "")).strip().upper()
              if not sequence:
                  return {"error": "The 'sequence' argument is required."}
              invalid = sorted(set(sequence) - VALID_AMINO_ACIDS)
              if invalid:
                  return {"error": "Sequence contains invalid residues: " + "".join(invalid)}
              variants = event.get("variants") or []
              return {
                  "job_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                  "status": "SUBMITTED",
                  "sequence_length": len(sequence),
                  "variant_count": len(variants),
                  "submitted_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              }


          def _get_results(event):
              job_id = str(event.get("job_id", "")).strip()
              if not job_id:
                  return {"error": "The 'job_id' argument is required."}
              return {
                  "job_id": job_id,
                  "status": "COMPLETED",
                  "results": {
                      "message": "Stub result: replace this backend with the real prediction service.",
                      "predictions": [],
                  },
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              event = event or {}
              tool = _tool_name(context)
              if tool == "invoke_endpoint":
                  response = _invoke_endpoint(event)
              elif tool == "get_results":
                  response = _get_results(event)
              else:
                  response = {"error": "Unknown tool: " + (tool or "<none>")}
              print(json.dumps({"tool": tool, "has_error": "error" in response}))
              return response
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Application
          Value: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Auth stand-in: Cognito user pool for machine-to-machine JWT auth
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-userpool'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: invoke
          ScopeDescription: Invoke tools exposed by the AgentCore Gateway
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read job results through the AgentCore Gateway

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway/invoke'
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dependency configuration published to SSM Parameter Store
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/lambda-arn'
      Description: ARN of the backend Lambda function used as the AgentCore Gateway target.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !GetAtt BackendFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/cognito-discovery-url'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL of the Cognito user pool used by the gateway JWT authorizer.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/cognito-client-id'
      Description: Cognito app client ID allowed by the gateway JWT authorizer.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  CognitoUserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/cognito-user-pool-id'
      Description: Cognito user pool ID backing the gateway JWT authorizer.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore Gateway IAM role (least privilege)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: Service role assumed by the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke the backend Lambda target.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeBackendLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt BackendFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Application
          Value: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore Gateway (MCP) with Cognito custom JWT authorizer
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Gateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If [HasCustomGatewayName, !Ref GatewayName, !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway']
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      ProtocolConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          SupportedVersions:
            - '2025-03-26'
          Instructions: Tools for submitting protein sequences for variant effect prediction and retrieving job results.
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
          AllowedClients:
            - !Ref UserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  BackendFunctionGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref BackendFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayArn

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway target: Lambda with inline MCP tool schema
  # (GatewayTarget does not support Tags, so none are set here.)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    DependsOn:
      - GatewayRole
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-target'
      Description: Lambda target exposing protein variant effect prediction tools.
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt BackendFunction.Arn
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: Submit a protein sequence (and optional variants) for variant effect prediction. Returns a job ID.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Description: Prediction job submission request.
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Wild-type protein sequence using one-letter amino acid codes.
                      variants:
                        Type: array
                        Description: Optional list of variants to score, e.g. A123V.
                        Items:
                          Type: string
                    Required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: Check the completion status of a prediction job and retrieve its results.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Description: Job status request.
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Job ID returned by invoke_endpoint.
                    Required:
                      - job_id

Outputs:
  GatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayId'

  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayArn'

  GatewayUrl:
    Description: MCP endpoint URL of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayUrl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayUrl'

  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleArn'

  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name storing the gateway role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayRoleArnParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleArnParameterName'

  GatewayTargetId:
    Description: Identifier of the AgentCore Gateway Lambda target.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayTarget.TargetId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayTargetId'

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the backend Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt BackendFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaFunctionArn'

  CognitoUserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID used for gateway authentication.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUserPoolId'

  CognitoClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID allowed by the gateway JWT authorizer.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoClientId'

  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoDiscoveryUrl'

  CognitoTokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint for client_credentials tokens.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoTokenEndpoint'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private VPC for secured application deployment, with optional NAT egress and a KMS-encrypted artifact bucket.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  AlbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the first private ALB subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  AlbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the second private ALB subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the private Lambda subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet hosting the NAT Gateway (used only when NAT is enabled).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Set to true to create a NAT Gateway for outbound internet egress (OAuth / external IdP flows).

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, "true"]

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  AlbPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-private-subnet-1"

  AlbPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-private-subnet-2"

  LambdaPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-private-subnet"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  AlbPrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbPrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  AlbPrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbPrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates one Step Functions state machine (a STANDARD two-step Pass workflow) behind two
  separate regional API Gateway REST APIs. One API exposes a GET endpoint and the other
  exposes a POST endpoint. Each API has its own least-privilege IAM role that can start
  executions of the state machine and nothing else. Each API is deployed to its own
  throttled stage.

Resources:
  # Step Functions
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Simple two-step pass workflow
        StartAt: StepOne
        States:
          StepOne:
            Type: Pass
            Result:
              step: one
            ResultPath: $.stepOne
            Next: StepTwo
          StepTwo:
            Type: Pass
            Result:
              step: two
            ResultPath: $.stepTwo
            End: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # IAM roles for API Gateway
  GetApiStartExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowStartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PostApiStartExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowStartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # GET API
  GetApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-get-api'
      Description: REST API exposing a GET endpoint that starts a Step Functions execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  GetApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution

  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiStartExecutionRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            #set($qs = $input.params().querystring)
            {
              "input": "{#foreach($key in $qs.keySet())\"$util.escapeJavaScript($key)\": \"$util.escapeJavaScript($qs.get($key))\"#if($foreach.hasNext),#end#end}",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: "$input.json('$')"
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: "$input.json('$')"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      Description: Deployment of the GET API

  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment
      StageName: getstage
      Description: Stage for the GET API
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 10
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # POST API
  PostApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-post-api'
      Description: REST API exposing a POST endpoint that starts a Step Functions execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PostApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution

  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostApiResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiStartExecutionRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: "$input.json('$')"
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: "$input.json('$')"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      Description: Deployment of the POST API

  PostApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostApiDeployment
      StageName: poststage
      Description: Stage for the POST API
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 10
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

    Value: !Sub 'https://${GetApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${GetApiStage}/execution'

    Value: !GetAtt PostApiStartExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights - Foundation IAM roles and Secrets Manager secrets for the
  Hospitality Insights project. NOTE - this template defines IAM roles with explicit
  RoleNames and must be deployed with the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability.

Metadata:
  DeploymentNotes:
    Capabilities: >-
      This stack creates IAM roles with explicit RoleName values. Deploy with
      --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.
    DownstreamResources: >-
      DynamoDB tables, SQS queues, SNS topics, S3 buckets and Step Functions state
      machines are created by other stacks. Permissions in this stack are scoped by
      the name prefix <ProjectName>-<Environment>-* so no literal IDs are needed.
    Secrets: >-
      Both secrets are created with generated placeholder values and use the default
      AWS-managed KMS key (aws/secretsmanager). An operator must replace the
      ScrapingBee placeholder with the real API key after deployment. Both secrets are
      retained on stack deletion or replacement.
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Project Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - Environment
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: Project name
      Environment:
        default: Deployment environment

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: ProjectName may contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used as a prefix for resource names, ARNs, secrets and tags.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scraper Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScraperLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the Hospitality Insights scraper Lambda functions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSConsumeAndProduce
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3RawDataWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bedrock AgentCore runtime role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Only bedrock-agentcore actions confirmed in the IAM Service Authorization
  # Reference are listed (GetWorkloadAccessToken, GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT,
  # GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId, CreateEvent, ListEvents, GetMemoryRecord).
  # No speculative action names are used. No AWS::BedrockAgentCore::* resources
  # are created in this template; only the execution role is in scope.
  AgentCoreRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-runtime-role'
      Description: Execution role for the Hospitality Insights Bedrock AgentCore runtime.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-runtime-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockInvokeModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
              - Sid: AgentCoreWorkloadIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessToken
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workload-identity-directory/default'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workload-identity-directory/default/workload-identity/*'
              - Sid: AgentCoreSessionMemory
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateEvent
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListEvents
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetMemoryRecord
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:memory/*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: S3Read
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: RuntimeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*'
              - Sid: RuntimeLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: RuntimeDescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              # X-Ray trace submission and CloudWatch PutMetricData do not support
              # resource-level permissions; metrics are restricted by namespace.
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:

        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

        - Key: Environment

        - Key: Environment

  dead letter queue for non-dev environments, CloudWatch alarms for old messages

      - staging
      - prod

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Description: Application name used as the prefix for all resource names
    Default: audit-events
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-40 characters of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional email address that receives alarm notifications. Leave empty to skip the subscription.
    Default: ''

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 3600
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 3
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 604800
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 1800
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 2
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      MaxReceiveCount: 3
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 900
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 1

Conditions:
  IsNotDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]

Resources:
  AuditKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit events queues and alarm topic'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey

  DeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-events-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DlqMessageRetentionPeriod]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-events'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNotDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MaxReceiveCount]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditQueuesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref AuditEventsQueue
        - !If [IsNotDev, !Ref DeadLetterQueue, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource: !If
              - IsNotDev
              - - !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
                - !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
              - - !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-alarms'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic

  OldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-events-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Triggers when the oldest message in the ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit events queue exceeds the environment age threshold, indicating consumers are falling behind or stalled.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, AlarmEvaluationPeriods]
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, OldestMessageAgeThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DeadLetterQueueMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-events-dlq-messages'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Triggers when any message is visible in the ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit events dead letter queue, indicating messages failed processing.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events queue
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue

  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn

  AuditEventsQueueName:
    Description: Name of the audit events queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName

  DeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: URL of the audit events dead letter queue
    Value: !Ref DeadLetterQueue

  DeadLetterQueueArn:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue
    Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting the audit data
    Value: !GetAtt AuditKmsKey.Arn

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key encrypting the audit data
    Value: !Ref AuditKmsKeyAlias

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic receiving alarm notifications
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

  OldestMessageAgeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the oldest message age alarm
    Value: !Ref OldestMessageAgeAlarm

  DeadLetterQueueAlarmName:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: Name of the dead letter queue activity alarm
    Value: !Ref DeadLetterQueueMessagesAlarm

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito identity stack for the researchapp / AgentCore application. Creates a user pool
  with optional software-token MFA, admin and customer groups, a hosted domain, a custom
  resource server, web and machine-to-machine app clients, an unwired post-confirmation
  group-assignment Lambda, and SSM parameters under /app/researchapp/agentcore/.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine (client credentials) app client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web (authorization code) app client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: false
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators of researchapp AgentCore
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customers of researchapp AgentCore
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: researchapp-agentcore
      Name: researchapp-agentcore-api
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp AgentCore resources

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - researchapp-agentcore/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp-agentcore/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  GroupAssignmentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the researchapp AgentCore post-confirmation group assignment function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AddUserToCustomerGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  # Post-confirmation group assignment function. Intentionally NOT wired as an active trigger.
  # To activate it later, add LambdaConfig.PostConfirmation to the user pool referencing this
  # function's ARN and add an AWS::Lambda::Permission allowing cognito-idp.amazonaws.com to
  # invoke it (SourceArn set to the user pool ARN).
  GroupAssignmentFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Adds newly confirmed users to the customer group (inactive trigger)
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt GroupAssignmentRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          GROUP_NAME: !Ref CustomerGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              if event.get("triggerSource") != "PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp":
                  return event
              group_name = os.environ["GROUP_NAME"]
              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=event["userPoolId"],
                  Username=event["userName"],
                  GroupName=group_name,
              )
              logger.info("Added user to group %s", group_name)
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  GroupAssignmentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${GroupAssignmentFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # The M2M client secret is stored in Secrets Manager (encrypted at rest) instead of a
  # plain-text SSM String parameter. SSM only stores the secret's ARN.
  MachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-secret
      Description: Client credentials for the researchapp AgentCore machine-to-machine app client
      SecretString: !Sub '{"client_id":"${MachineAppClient}","client_secret":"${MachineAppClient.ClientSecret}"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user-pool-id
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user-pool-arn
      Description: Cognito user pool ARN for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web-client-id
      Description: Web app client ID (authorization code flow) for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-id
      Description: Machine-to-machine app client ID (client credentials flow) for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  MachineClientSecretArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-secret-arn
      Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the machine-to-machine client secret
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClientSecret
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  MachineScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-oauth-scopes
      Description: OAuth scopes granted to the machine-to-machine client
      Type: String
      Value: researchapp-agentcore/read
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  WebScopesParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web-oauth-scopes
      Description: OAuth scopes granted to the web app client (space separated)
      Type: String
      Value: openid email profile researchapp-agentcore/read
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery-url
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the researchapp AgentCore user pool
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  TokenUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token-url
      Description: OAuth2 token endpoint for the researchapp AgentCore Cognito domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  AuthorizeUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize-url
      Description: OAuth2 authorize endpoint for the researchapp AgentCore Cognito domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  CognitoDomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito-domain
      Description: Cognito hosted domain for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  WebAppClientId:
    Description: Web app client ID
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineAppClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine app client ID
    Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
  MachineClientSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret containing the machine client secret
    Value: !Ref MachineClientSecret
  CognitoDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain
    Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
  TokenUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
  AuthorizeUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 authorize endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
  GroupAssignmentFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the unwired post-confirmation group assignment Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt GroupAssignmentFunction.Arn
  SsmParameterPath:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path holding the configuration
    Value: /app/researchapp/agentcore/
