AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the CryptoTickerAPI AWS AppSync GraphQL API with an HTTP data source for
  the CoinGecko API and a DynamoDB data source (APIDataTable) for ticker price history.

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: CryptoTickerAPI

  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AWS AppSync to push CryptoTickerAPI logs to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ERROR
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: CryptoTickerAPI

  APIDataTableDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AWS AppSync to read and write price history in APIDataTable
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: APIDataTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  CoinGeckoDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS AppSync for the CoinGecko HTTP data source
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CoinGeckoHttpDataSourceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - appsync:GetDataSource
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:appsync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:apis/${CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId}/datasources/CoinGeckoDataSource

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Description: HTTP data source for the public CoinGecko price API
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSourceRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  APIDataTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source storing ticker price history
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        UseCallerCredentials: false

  CryptoTickerAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord!]!
          nextToken: String
        }

  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: FetchTickerPriceFunction
      Description: Fetches the current USD price for a ticker from CoinGecko
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const id = ctx.args.symbol.trim().toLowerCase();
          return {
            method: 'GET',
            resourcePath: '/api/v3/simple/price',
            params: {
              query: { ids: id, vs_currencies: 'usd' },
              headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
            },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          if (ctx.result.statusCode !== 200) {
            util.error(`CoinGecko returned status ${ctx.result.statusCode}`, 'UpstreamError');
          }
          const id = ctx.args.symbol.trim().toLowerCase();
          const body = JSON.parse(ctx.result.body);
          const entry = body[id];
          if (!entry || entry.usd === undefined || entry.usd === null) {
            util.error(`No price found for ticker ${id}`, 'NotFound');
          }
          return { ticker: id, priceUsd: entry.usd };
        }

  StoreTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: StoreTickerPriceFunction
      Description: Stores a historical price record for the ticker in APIDataTable
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { ticker, priceUsd } = ctx.prev.result;
          const timestamp = util.time.nowISO8601();
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ hk: ticker, sk: timestamp }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ticker, priceUsd, timestamp }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return {
            ticker: ctx.result.ticker,
            priceUsd: ctx.result.priceUsd,
            timestamp: ctx.result.timestamp,
          };
        }

  TickerQueryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StoreTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const limit = ctx.args.limit ?? 25;
          const query = {
            operation: 'Query',
            query: {
              expression: '#hk = :hk',
              expressionNames: { '#hk': 'hk' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':hk': ctx.source.ticker }),
            },
            scanIndexForward: false,
            limit: limit,
          };
          if (ctx.args.nextToken) {
            query.nextToken = ctx.args.nextToken;
          }
          return query;
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return {
            items: ctx.result.items ?? [],
            nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken ?? null,
          };
        }

  CryptoTickerAPIKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: ID of the CryptoTickerAPI AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: GraphQL endpoint URL of the CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the CryptoTickerAPI AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.Arn
  ApiKey:
    Description: Default API key for calling the CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPIKey.ApiKey
  APIDataTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores price history
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable
  APIDataTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table that stores price history
    Value: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Elemental MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints,
  plus optional VOD (packaging group and configurations backed by a stack-created source
  bucket) and live-to-VOD archiving support (stack-created archive bucket, customer managed
  KMS encryption key, and IAM role).

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming and Tagging
        Parameters:
          - LogicalNamePrefix
          - Environment
          - CustomTagKey
          - CustomTagValue
      - Label:
          default: Live Packaging
        Parameters:
          - OutputType
          - ManifestName
          - HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
          - StartoverWindowSeconds
      - Label:
          default: VOD and Live-to-VOD
        Parameters:
          - ArchiveBucket
          - VodSourceBucket

Parameters:
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: live-stream
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; must start with a letter or number; max 31 characters.
    Description: Prefix used for every resource Id and name.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment, applied as the Environment tag.

  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag key. Leave empty to skip the custom tag.

  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag value (used only when CustomTagKey is set).

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Which origin endpoint(s) and VOD packaging configuration(s) to create.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-64 characters of letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
    Description: Manifest name for the origin endpoints and the VOD packaging manifests.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: HLS segment duration in seconds (live HLS endpoint and VOD HLS configuration).

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Startover window in seconds for the origin endpoints (0 disables startover).

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Empty, or up to 21 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens starting with a letter or number.
    Description: >-
      Name suffix for a stack-created live-to-VOD archive bucket. A non-empty value enables
      archiving and sets origin endpoint Origination to DENY. Leave empty to disable.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Empty, or up to 21 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens starting with a letter or number.
    Description: >-
      Name suffix for a stack-created VOD source content bucket. A non-empty value enables
      the VOD workflow. Leave empty to disable.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, '']]
  EnableArchive: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  EnableVod: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  EnableBucketAccess: !Or
    - !Condition EnableArchive
    - !Condition EnableVod
  CreateHls: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateDash: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateVodHls: !And
    - !Condition EnableVod
    - !Condition CreateHls
  CreateVodDash: !And
    - !Condition EnableVod
    - !Condition CreateDash

Resources:
  BucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: EnableBucketAccess
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${LogicalNamePrefix} MediaPackage VOD source and live-to-VOD archive buckets'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3UseByAccountPrincipals
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-media-buckets-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  BucketEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: EnableBucketAccess
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${LogicalNamePrefix}-media-buckets'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BucketEncryptionKey

  ArchiveS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EnableArchive
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-${ArchiveBucket}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BucketEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:

          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions

            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-archive'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodSourceS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EnableVod
    DeletionPolicy: Retain

    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-${VodSourceBucket}-${AWS::AccountId}'

      Tags:

        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ArchiveS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EnableArchive
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
              - 's3:GetBucketRequestPayment'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
            Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleObjectAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'

  VodSourceS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
              - 's3:GetBucketRequestPayment'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
            Resource: !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleObjectRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'

  MediaPackageS3Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableBucketAccess
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mp-s3-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Allows AWS Elemental MediaPackage to read VOD source content and write live-to-VOD archives.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - !If
          - EnableVod
          - PolicyName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-source-read'
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: VodSourceBucketAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                    - 's3:GetBucketRequestPayment'
                    - 's3:ListBucket'
                  Resource: !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
                - Sid: VodSourceObjectRead
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                  Resource: !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
                - Sid: VodSourceKeyDecrypt
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'kms:Decrypt'
                    - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  Resource: !GetAtt BucketEncryptionKey.Arn
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - EnableArchive
          - PolicyName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-archive-write'
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ArchiveBucketAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                    - 's3:GetBucketRequestPayment'
                    - 's3:ListBucket'
                  Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
                - Sid: ArchiveObjectReadWrite
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                    - 's3:PutObject'
                  Resource: !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
                - Sid: ArchiveKeyUse
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'kms:Decrypt'
                    - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                    - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  Resource: !GetAtt BucketEncryptionKey.Arn
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mediapackage-s3-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LiveChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'Live streaming channel for ${LogicalNamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  HlsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHls
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls'
      ChannelId: !Ref LiveChannel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix}'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If
        - EnableArchive
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: 60
        PlaylistType: NONE
        AdMarkers: NONE
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDash
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash'
      ChannelId: !Ref LiveChannel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix}'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If
        - EnableArchive
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestWindowSeconds: 60
        MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
        MinUpdatePeriodSeconds: 15
        SuggestedPresentationDelaySeconds: 25
        Profile: NONE
        ManifestLayout: FULL
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodHlsConfig:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodHls
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-hls'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            AdMarkers: NONE
            IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
            RepeatExtXKey: false
            ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-hls'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodDashConfig:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodDash
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-dash'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            ManifestLayout: FULL
            MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
            Profile: NONE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-dash'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

Outputs:

  MediaPackageS3RoleArn:

  VodPackagingGroupId:

  VodPackagingGroupArn:

  VodPackagingGroupDomainName:

    Description: MediaPackage VOD packaging group playback domain name.

    Value: !Ref VodDashConfig

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the IAM roles, instance profiles and managed policies that Cluster API
  Provider AWS (CAPA) needs for EC2-based and EKS-based cluster lifecycle
  management. Deploy with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Resources:
  ControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cloud Provider AWS Control Plane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ControlPlaneCompute
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cluster API Provider AWS Controllers
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: NetworkingComputeAndLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateCarrierGateway
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:DeleteCarrierGateway
              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:GetSecurityGroupsForVpc
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeInstanceRefreshes
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - tag:GetResources
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingGroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CancelInstanceRefresh
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:StartInstanceRefresh
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:autoscaling:*:${AWS::AccountId}:autoScalingGroup:*:autoScalingGroupName/*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': autoscaling.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ElbServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: SpotServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/spot.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForEC2Spot'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': spot.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: PassCapaRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io'
          - Sid: BootstrapSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:TagResource
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: EksAccessEntries
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:access-entry/*'

  ControllersEksPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers-eks.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cluster API Provider AWS Controllers (EKS)
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EksOptimizedAmiParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*:*:parameter/aws/service/eks/optimized-ami/*'
          - Sid: EksServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': eks.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EksNodegroupServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSNodegroup'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EksFargateServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSForFargate'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': eks-fargate.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: IamInspectionAndOidc
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:AddClientIDToOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:CreateOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:DeleteOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:GetOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListOpenIDConnectProviders
              - iam:TagOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:UpdateOpenIDConnectProviderThumbprint
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: PassEksRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'iam:PassedToService': eks.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EksClusterAndNodegroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:AssociateEncryptionConfig
              - eks:AssociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:CreateFargateProfile
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:DisassociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:UpdateAddon
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KmsForEksEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'kms:ResourceAliases': alias/cluster-api-provider-aws-*

  NodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cloud Provider AWS nodes
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: NodeEc2AndEcr
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
              - ecr:ListImages
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: NodeNetworkInterfaceTagging
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ec2:CreateTags
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
          - Sid: BootstrapSecretRetrieval
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: SsmSessionManager
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
              - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
            Resource: '*'

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksPolicy

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  DynamoDB table with configurable keys, PROVISIONED or on-demand billing, point-in-time
  recovery, and optional customer-managed KMS encryption and CloudWatch alarms that notify an SNS topic.

# Notes:
# - The table has DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy set to Retain. Deleting the stack
#   leaves the table and its data in place, so you must delete the table yourself.
# - The KMS key is also retained after the stack is deleted. Retained keys keep costing money
#   until you schedule them for deletion.
# - When EnableCustomerManagedKms is 'false', DynamoDB uses its default AWS-owned key,
#   so data is always encrypted at rest.
# - Changing the key schema (partition key or sort key) replaces the table. Because of
#   Retain, the old table stays and the new one fails to create while the name is taken.
#   Change the AppName or EnvironmentName, or migrate the data, before you change keys.
# - When AlertEmail is set, AWS sends a confirmation email. Alerts are delivered only
#   after someone confirms the subscription.
# - The SNS topic is encrypted with the customer-managed key only when CMK is enabled.
#   The AWS-managed key alias/aws/sns is never used, because CloudWatch cannot publish
#   to topics encrypted with it.
# - Alarms use plain metrics with only the TableName and Operation dimensions.
#   No SEARCH expressions are used.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: myapp
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    Description: Application name used in resource names and tags.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,255}$'
    Description: Partition (HASH) key attribute name.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Partition key attribute type.
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,255}$'
    Description: Sort (RANGE) key attribute name. Leave empty for no sort key.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Sort key attribute type. Used only when SortKeyName is set.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: DynamoDB billing mode.
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40000
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units. Used only with PROVISIONED billing.
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40000
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units. Used only with PROVISIONED billing.
  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Turn on point-in-time recovery.
  EnableCustomerManagedKms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Encrypt the table (and alarm topic) with a customer-managed KMS key.
  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Create CloudWatch alarms and an SNS topic for alerts.
  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to the alarm topic. Leave empty for no subscription.
  ThrottleAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Throttle events in 5 minutes at which the throttle alarms fire.
  SystemErrorAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: System errors in 5 minutes per operation at which the error alarms fire.

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  PitrEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  UseCmk: !Equals [!Ref EnableCustomerManagedKms, 'true']
  CreateAlarms: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, 'true']
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]
  CreateEmailSubscription: !And
    - !Condition CreateAlarms
    - !Condition HasAlertEmail
  EncryptAlarmTopic: !And
    - !Condition CreateAlarms
    - !Condition UseCmk

Resources:
  TableKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseCmk
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${AppName}-${EnvironmentName} DynamoDB table and alarm topic'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowSNSToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TableKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseCmk
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TableKmsKey

  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-table'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [PitrEnabled, true, false]
      SSESpecification: !If
        - UseCmk
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TableKmsKey.Arn
        - SSEEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !If
        - EncryptAlarmTopic
        - !Ref TableKmsKey
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-read-throttles'
      AlarmDescription: Read requests to the DynamoDB table are being throttled.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-write-throttles'
      AlarmDescription: Write requests to the DynamoDB table are being throttled.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  GetItemSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-getitem-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB GetItem requests are returning system (HTTP 500) errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
        - Name: Operation
          Value: GetItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  PutItemSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-putitem-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB PutItem requests are returning system (HTTP 500) errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
        - Name: Operation
          Value: PutItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  UpdateItemSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-updateitem-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB UpdateItem requests are returning system (HTTP 500) errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
        - Name: Operation
          Value: UpdateItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DeleteItemSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-deleteitem-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB DeleteItem requests are returning system (HTTP 500) errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
        - Name: Operation
          Value: DeleteItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300

      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  QuerySystemErrorsAlarm:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Builds Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for x86_64 and arm64 with EC2 Image Builder.
  The AMIs include Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages (synapseclient,
  pandas, pysftp) and SSM user sudo access, and are distributed publicly and
  to an AWS Organization. Build instances run in a private VPC without
  internet access, using VPC endpoints, CodeArtifact and S3. NOTE (intended
  security trade-off): root volumes are left unencrypted because AMIs backed
  by encrypted EBS snapshots cannot be made public. NOTE (deployment caveat):
  new accounts enable EC2 Block public access for AMIs by default; run
  aws ec2 disable-image-block-public-access for this account and region
  before running the pipelines. Organization sharing works only if the
  deploying account belongs to the organization or its management account
  allows the share, and is enabled only when OrganizationId and
  OrganizationManagementAccountId are both supplied.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Image Settings
        Parameters:
          - ImageVersion
          - RootVolumeSize
      - Label:
          default: Organization Sharing
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
          - OrganizationManagementAccountId

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version (major.minor.patch), e.g. 1.0.0.
    Description: >-
      Semantic version applied to the image recipes and the component. Increment
      it whenever recipe or component content changes.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 16384
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB for the built AMIs (minimum 8 for AL2023).

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(o-[a-z0-9]{10,32})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid AWS Organization ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx).
    Description: >-
      AWS Organization ID to share the AMIs with. Leave empty to disable
      organization sharing.

  OrganizationManagementAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: >-
      12-digit account ID of the organization's management account. Required
      together with OrganizationId to build the organization ARN.

Conditions:
  ShareWithOrganization: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (greenfield account, private only: no internet gateway, no
  # public IPs, no 0.0.0.0/0 route)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-vpc'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateSubnetSecondary:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  ArtifactStagingFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Docker Compose staging custom resource
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StageBuildArtifacts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutComposeBinaries
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${BuildArtifactBucket.Arn}/docker-compose/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-x86_64'
                  - !Sub '${BuildArtifactBucket.Arn}/docker-compose/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-aarch64'
              - Sid: EncryptComposeBinaries
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildArtifactKey.Arn
              - Sid: LookupS3PrefixList
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # Not attached to the VPC: it fetches the pinned Compose release from GitHub
  # at deploy time so build instances never need internet access.
  ArtifactStagingFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Stages pinned Docker Compose binaries in S3 and looks up the S3 prefix list ID
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ArtifactStagingFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 600
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hashlib
          import os
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')


          def fetch(url, path):
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'imagebuilder-artifact-stager'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp, open(path, 'wb') as out:
                  while True:
                      chunk = resp.read(1024 * 1024)
                      if not chunk:
                          break
                      out.write(chunk)


          def sha256(path):
              digest = hashlib.sha256()
              with open(path, 'rb') as f:
                  for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                      digest.update(chunk)
              return digest.hexdigest()


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              physical_id = 'compose-' + props['ComposeVersion'] + '-' + props['BucketName']
              data = {}
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] != 'Delete':
                      lists = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(
                          Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [props['S3PrefixListName']]}]
                      )['PrefixLists']
                      if not lists:
                          raise ValueError('S3 prefix list not found: ' + props['S3PrefixListName'])
                      data['S3PrefixListId'] = lists[0]['PrefixListId']

                      base = 'https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/' + props['ComposeVersion'] + '/'
                      for arch in props['Architectures']:
                          name = 'docker-compose-linux-' + arch
                          path = '/tmp/' + name
                          fetch(base + name, path)
                          fetch(base + name + '.sha256', path + '.sha256')
                          with open(path + '.sha256') as f:
                              expected = f.read().split()[0].strip()
                          actual = sha256(path)
                          if actual != expected:
                              raise ValueError('Checksum mismatch for ' + name)
                          s3.upload_file(path, props['BucketName'], props['KeyPrefix'] + name)
                          os.remove(path)
                          os.remove(path + '.sha256')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc))
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildArtifactStaging:
    Type: Custom::BuildArtifactStaging
    DependsOn: BuildArtifactBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ArtifactStagingFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref BuildArtifactBucket

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder component
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DockerPythonToolsComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-docker-python-tools'
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and grants ssm-user sudo access
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Version ${ImageVersion}'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Data: !Sub |
        name: docker-python-tools
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and configure ssm-user sudo access.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - mkdir -p /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins
                    - aws s3 cp --only-show-errors --region ${AWS::Region} "s3://${BuildArtifactBucket}/docker-compose/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m)" /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod 0755 /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install python3 python3-pip
                    - aws codeartifact login --tool pip --region ${AWS::Region} --domain ${CodeArtifactDomain.Name} --domain-owner ${AWS::AccountId} --repository ${PypiRepository.Name}
                    - python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
                    - python3 -m pip config unset global.index-url || true
              - name: EnableSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - id -u ssm-user >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash ssm-user
                    - usermod -aG docker ssm-user
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
              - name: Cleanup
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf clean all
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - docker --version
                    - systemctl is-enabled docker
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - docker compose version
                    - docker-compose version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('Python imports OK')"
              - name: VerifySsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - test -f /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - grep -q '^ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL$' /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users

  # Image recipes (root volumes intentionally unencrypted so AMIs can be public)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86_64'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tools
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x'
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x'
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt DockerPythonToolsComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64'

      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x'

      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration for x86_64 and arm64 builds
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required

      ResourceTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: Distributes AMIs publicly and optionally to an AWS Organization
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tools (${AWS::StackName})'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns: !If
                - ShareWithOrganization
                - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationManagementAccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # DependsOn on the VPC endpoints and artifact staging is a deliberate
  # exception to the "no explicit DependsOn" rule: nothing else references the
  # endpoints, and builds must not start before private DNS and the staged
  # Docker Compose binaries are available.

      - SsmMessagesVpcEndpoint
      - Ec2MessagesVpcEndpoint
      - ImageBuilderVpcEndpoint
      - LogsVpcEndpoint
      - StsVpcEndpoint
      - CodeArtifactApiVpcEndpoint
      - CodeArtifactRepositoriesVpcEndpoint
      - S3InterfaceVpcEndpoint
      - S3GatewayVpcEndpoint
      - BuildPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
      - BuildArtifactStaging
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86_64-pipeline'
      Description: Builds, tests and distributes the Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt X86ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SharedInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt ImageDistributionConfiguration.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

      - Ec2MessagesVpcEndpoint
      - ImageBuilderVpcEndpoint
      - LogsVpcEndpoint
