AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo - Cognito identity stack. Creates a user pool
  (agentops-ecommerce-users), a public SRP web client (agentops-web-client), three
  user groups (team-alpha, team-beta, admin), a Secrets Manager generated shared demo
  password, and a custom resource Lambda that seeds six demo users.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '32'
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        Environment: demo

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - custom:role
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Description: Team Alpha members of the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Description: Team Beta members of the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Platform administrators of the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  DemoPasswordSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: Shared password for the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo users
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"purpose": "agentops-demo-users"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 16
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  SeederRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the AgentOps demo user seeder Lambda
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: seeder-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/agentops-demo-user-seeder'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/agentops-demo-user-seeder:*'
        - PolicyName: seeder-cognito
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
        - PolicyName: seeder-secret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref DemoPasswordSecret
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  SeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-demo-user-seeder
      Description: Seeds the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo users into Cognito
      Runtime: python3.13
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt SeederRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref DemoPasswordSecret
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import logging
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          log = logging.getLogger()
          log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          idp = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
          sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
          PID = 'agentops-demo-user-seed'
          USERS = [
              ('alice@demo.local', 'member', 'TeamAlphaGroup'),
              ('bob@demo.local', 'member', 'TeamAlphaGroup'),
              ('charlie@demo.local', 'team_admin', 'TeamAlphaGroup'),
              ('dave@demo.local', 'member', 'TeamBetaGroup'),
              ('eve@demo.local', 'team_admin', 'TeamBetaGroup'),
              ('admin@demo.local', 'admin', 'AdminGroup'),
          ]

          def err_code(e):
              return e.response.get('Error', {}).get('Code', 'Unknown')

          def seed(pool, props, pw):
              for email, role, group_key in USERS:
                  attrs = [
                      {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                      {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                      {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role},
                  ]
                  try:
                      idp.admin_create_user(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email,
                                            UserAttributes=attrs, MessageAction='SUPPRESS')
                  except ClientError as e:
                      if err_code(e) != 'UsernameExistsException':
                          raise
                      idp.admin_update_user_attributes(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email,
                                                       UserAttributes=attrs)
                  idp.admin_set_user_password(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email,
                                              Password=pw, Permanent=True)
                  idp.admin_add_user_to_group(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email,
                                              GroupName=props[group_key])
                  log.info('Seeded %s (role=%s)', email, role)

          def purge(pool):
              for email, _, _ in USERS:
                  try:
                      idp.admin_delete_user(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email)
                      log.info('Deleted %s', email)
                  except ClientError as e:
                      if err_code(e) != 'UserNotFoundException':
                          log.warning('Could not delete %s: %s', email, err_code(e))
                  except Exception as e:
                      log.warning('Could not delete %s: %s', email, type(e).__name__)

          def handler(event, context):
              status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS
              reason = None
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              try:
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  pool = props['UserPoolId']
                  log.info('%s request for pool %s', request_type, pool)
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      purge(pool)
                  else:
                      secret = sm.get_secret_value(SecretId=os.environ['SECRET_ARN'])
                      pw = json.loads(secret['SecretString'])['password']
                      seed(pool, props, pw)
              except Exception as e:
                  detail = err_code(e) if isinstance(e, ClientError) else type(e).__name__
                  log.error('Seeder error during %s: %s', request_type, detail)
                  if request_type != 'Delete':
                      status = cfnresponse.FAILED
                      reason = 'Demo user seeding failed: %s' % detail
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, {'SeededUsers': str(len(USERS))},
                               PID, reason=reason)
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  SeederLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${SeederFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  DemoUserSeed:
    Type: Custom::DemoUserSeeder
    DependsOn: SeederLogGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      TeamAlphaGroup: !Ref TeamAlphaGroup
      TeamBetaGroup: !Ref TeamBetaGroup
      AdminGroup: !Ref AdminGroup

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Public app client ID (agentops-web-client)
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  Region:
    Description: AWS region where the user pool is deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the demo user seeder Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
  DemoPasswordSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret holding the shared demo user password (retrieve with aws secretsmanager get-secret-value)
    Value: !Ref DemoPasswordSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Client VPN usage reporting through CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and a
  CloudWatch Dashboard, covering AD/SAML, Mutual Auth and Mixed Auth endpoints.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Reporting Configuration
        Parameters:
          - QueryFolderPath
          - ClientVpnLogGroupName
    ParameterLabels:
      QueryFolderPath:
        default: Query folder path (organisational prefix)
      ClientVpnLogGroupName:
        default: Client VPN connection log group name (without leading slash)

Parameters:
  QueryFolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,200}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-200 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', '/' or '-'.
    Description: >-
      Optional folder prefix used to group and organise the Client VPN reporting
      queries (applied to the dashboard name and widget titles).

  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._#-][A-Za-z0-9._/#-]{0,510}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      1-511 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', '/', '#' or '-', and must not
      start with '/'. The stack prepends a leading '/' to form the final log group
      name, which avoids the AWS-reserved 'aws/' prefix.
    Description: >-
      Client VPN connection log group name without a leading slash. The stack
      prepends '/' to form the final log group name (for example, the default
      becomes /aws/aws-client-vpn/prod), which avoids the AWS-reserved 'aws/'
      prefix. The log group is created by this template.

Resources:
  ClientVpnLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key encrypting the AWS Client VPN connection log group /${ClientVpnLogGroupName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: client-vpn-reporting
        - Key: QueryFolder
          Value: !Ref QueryFolderPath

  ClientVpnLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ClientVpnLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: client-vpn-reporting
        - Key: QueryFolder
          Value: !Ref QueryFolderPath

  ClientVpnUsageDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Join
        - ''
        - - !Join
            - '-'
            - !Split
              - '/'
              - !Join
                - '-'
                - !Split
                  - '.'
                  - !Ref QueryFolderPath
          - '-client-vpn-usage-report'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 5,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# AWS Client VPN Usage Report\n**Query folder path:** `${QueryFolderPath}`  \n**Source log group:** `/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}`\n\n**Authentication type classification rules**\n\n| authType | Rule |\n|---|---|\n| Mixed Auth | `username` present **and** `common-name` present |\n| AD/SAML | `username` present, `common-name` blank |\n| Mutual Auth | `common-name` present, `username` blank |\n| Unknown | both `username` and `common-name` blank |"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 5,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Total Usage per Endpoint",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, sum(`ingress-bytes`) as ingressBytes, sum(`egress-bytes`) as egressBytes, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 5,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Usage per Authentication Type",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers, sum(`ingress-bytes`) as ingressBytes, sum(`egress-bytes`) as egressBytes, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by authType, `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 11,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Distinct Users",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | stats count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, authType | sort distinctUsers desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 11,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Distinct Users – Per User Activity",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter not isblank(user) | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, max(@timestamp) as lastSeen by user, authType, `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort lastSeen desc | limit 1000"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 17,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Connection Durations",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType | filter ispresent(`connection-duration-seconds`) | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, avg(`connection-duration-seconds`) as avgSeconds, min(`connection-duration-seconds`) as minSeconds, max(`connection-duration-seconds`) as maxSeconds, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, authType | sort totalSeconds desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 17,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Connection Durations – Longest Connections",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter ispresent(`connection-duration-seconds`) | stats max(`connection-duration-seconds`) as durationSeconds, max(@timestamp) as lastSeen by `connection-id`, user, authType, `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort durationSeconds desc | limit 100"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 23,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – AD/SAML Breakdown",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter authType = 'AD/SAML' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 8,
              "y": 23,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Mutual Auth Breakdown",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter authType = 'Mutual Auth' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 16,
              "y": 23,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Mixed Auth Breakdown",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter authType = 'Mixed Auth' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication (Cognito) - user pool, app clients, staff role groups, M2M resource server and hosted domain.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names, the domain prefix and tags.

Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool"
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      DeletionProtection: !If [IsProd, ACTIVE, INACTIVE]
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Application: AnyCompanyHotel

  SpaClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      WriteAttributes:
        - email

  AdminAuthClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-auth-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel system administrators with full access.
      Precedence: 0

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Property managers responsible for a single hotel property.
      Precedence: 20

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Regional managers overseeing multiple properties within a region.
      Precedence: 10

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Revenue managers responsible for pricing and yield management.
      Precedence: 30

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Front desk staff handling guest check-in, check-out and reservations.
      Precedence: 40

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Housekeeping staff managing room status and cleaning schedules.
      Precedence: 50

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/read"
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/write"
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"

    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn"

  UserPoolProviderUrl:
    Description: Issuer URL of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolProviderUrl"

  SpaClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the public SPA app client (SRP auth, no secret).
    Value: !Ref SpaClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SpaClientId"

  AdminAuthClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the admin auth client for server-side test harnesses and simulators.
    Value: !Ref AdminAuthClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AdminAuthClientId"

    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-M2MClientId"

    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication stack for the Hospitality Insights application in the prod environment, with a user pool, hosted UI domain, app client, post-authentication Lambda trigger, user groups and optional SAML SSO federation.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Application name used in resource names, tags and the hosted UI domain.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or 1-32 characters of letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
    Description: Name of the federated SAML identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  SSOLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^https://.+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or an HTTPS URL.
    Description: SAML metadata/login URL of the identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  HostedUIDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-42 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens, must not start or end with a hyphen, and must not contain the reserved words aws, amazon or cognito.
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The account ID is appended to keep it globally unique. Must not contain aws, amazon or cognito.
  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost/callback
    AllowedPattern: ^https://.+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL.
    Description: OAuth callback URL for the hosted UI.
  LogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost/logout
    AllowedPattern: ^https://.+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL.
    Description: OAuth sign-out URL for the hosted UI.

Conditions:
  EnableSSO: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOLoginUrl, '']]

Resources:
  PostAuthLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub KMS key encrypting the ${AppName}-${Environment} post-authentication Lambda log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-logs-key

  PostAuthLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt PostAuthLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-logs

  PostAuthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-role
      Description: !Sub Execution role for the ${AppName}-${Environment} Cognito post-authentication Lambda
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostAuthLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt PostAuthLogGroup.Arn
        - PolicyName: PostAuthUpdateLastLogin
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-role

  PostAuthFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth
      Description: Cognito post-authentication trigger that records the user's last login time in custom:last_login
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PostAuthLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime
          import logging

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get("userPoolId")
              username = event.get("userName")
              timestamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
              try:
                  cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": timestamp}
                      ],
                  )
                  logger.info("Updated last_login for user in pool %s", user_pool_id)
              except Exception:
                  # Never block sign-in because the attribute update failed.
                  logger.exception("Failed to update last_login for user in pool %s", user_pool_id)
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-user-pool
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '0'
            MaxLength: '64'
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Name: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-user-pool

  PostAuthInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  SSOIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SSOLoginUrl
        IDPSignout: 'true'
      AttributeMapping:
        email: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub ${HostedUIDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutUrl
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - EnableSSO
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SSOIdentityProvider
        - - COGNITO
      AuthSessionValidity: 3
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1
      Description: Administrators with full access to Hospitality Insights.

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2
      Description: Standard users with regular access to Hospitality Insights.

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3
      Description: Power users with extended access to Hospitality Insights.

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolProviderUrl:
    Description: Issuer URL of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool app client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Domain prefix of the Cognito hosted UI.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
  HostedUIBaseUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the Cognito hosted UI.
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com
  HostedUILoginUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI login URL for the app client.
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login?client_id=${UserPoolClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${CallbackUrl}
  PostAuthFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-authentication Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
  AdminGroupName:
    Description: Name of the Admin user group.
    Value: !Ref AdminGroup
  RegularUserGroupName:
    Description: Name of the RegularUser user group.
    Value: !Ref RegularUserGroup
  PowerUserGroupName:
    Description: Name of the PowerUser user group.
    Value: !Ref PowerUserGroup
  SSOIdentityProviderName:
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Description: Name of the federated SAML identity provider.
    Value: !Ref SSOIdentityProvider

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for client connection and session management, using a DynamoDB session table with TTL, direct DynamoDB integrations for $connect and $disconnect, and a Lambda echo function for $default.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage.

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sessions'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableWriteDelete
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Store new connection in the session table
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole.Arn
      TemplateSelectionExpression: '\$default'
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          #set($ttl = $context.requestTimeEpoch / 1000 + 7200)
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Item": {
              "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"},
              "ttl": {"N": "$ttl"}
            }
          }

  ConnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref ConnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: '$default'

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$connect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: ConnectRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Remove disconnected connection from the session table
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole.Arn
      TemplateSelectionExpression: '\$default'
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Key": {
              "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"}
            }
          }

  DisconnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref DisconnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: '$default'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$disconnect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DisconnectRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  EchoFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  EchoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Echoes incoming WebSocket messages back to the client
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt EchoFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": event.get("body", "")}

  EchoFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${EchoFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Lambda proxy integration for echo function
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EchoFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DefaultRoute
      RouteResponseSelectionExpression: '$default'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'

  DefaultRouteResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::RouteResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteId: !Ref DefaultRoute
      RouteResponseKey: '$default'

  EchoFunctionInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      FunctionName: !Ref EchoFunction
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: WebSocket API deployment

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      Description: WebSocket API stage
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 50

Outputs:
  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: WebSocket connection URL
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}'
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: WebSocket API ID
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi
  SessionTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB session table name
    Value: !Ref SessionTable
  EchoFunctionArn:
    Description: Echo Lambda function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt EchoFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Basic test VPC with one public subnet, an internet gateway, a public route table and a network ACL allowing all TCP and UDP traffic. Instances in the public subnet do not get public IP addresses automatically. They must request one at launch or use an Elastic IP.

    Type: String

    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0/16
      - 172.19.0.0/16

        - Key: Environment

      Egress: true

        From: 0
        To: 65535

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry

      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an AWS FIS experiment template for cross-region chaos testing. It
  disrupts network connectivity from this region to a target region and pauses
  S3 and DynamoDB cross-region replication. It also creates the IAM role it
  needs and a KMS-encrypted CloudWatch log group for experiment logs.

# NOTE: TargetRegion must be different from the deployment region (AWS::Region).
# The template does not enforce this with a Rule, because support for pseudo
# parameters in Rule assertions is uncertain. Pick a different region when you
# deploy this stack.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name, for example us-west-2.
    Description: >-
      Region that application traffic and replication are cut off from. It must
      differ from the region you deploy this stack in.

  DisruptionDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    AllowedPattern: '^PT([1-9][0-9]?M|1[0-2]H|[1-9]H)$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be an ISO 8601 duration from PT1M to PT99M, or from PT1H to PT12H.
    Description: >-
      How long the network disruption and replication pause last, as an ISO 8601
      duration. The default is 20 minutes.

Resources:
  ExperimentLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key that encrypts FIS cross-region chaos experiment logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}/cross-region-chaos'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: fis-cross-region-chaos-logs

  ExperimentLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/fis-cross-region-chaos-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ExperimentLogKey

  ExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}/cross-region-chaos'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ExperimentLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: fis-cross-region-chaos-logs

  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role that AWS FIS assumes to run the cross-region chaos experiment.
      MaxSessionDuration: 43200
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisNetworkDisruption
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: NetworkDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayPeeringAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcPeeringConnections
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:GetManagedPrefixListEntries
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RouteTableDisruptCrossRegionConnectivity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateManagedPrefixList
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteManagedPrefixList
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:ModifyManagedPrefixList
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:ReplaceRouteTableAssociation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: TransitGatewayDisruptCrossRegionConnectivity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
        - PolicyName: FisS3ReplicationPause
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Discovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3PauseReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PauseReplication
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    's3:ResourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        - PolicyName: FisDynamoDbReplicationPause
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDbDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDbPauseReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetResourcePolicy
                  - dynamodb:PutResourcePolicy
                  - dynamodb:DeleteResourcePolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
        - PolicyName: FisLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: LogDeliverySetup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteExperimentLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: UseExperimentLogKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ExperimentLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: fis-cross-region-chaos

  CrossRegionChaosExperiment:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Cut off application network traffic to the target region and pause S3
        and DynamoDB cross-region replication on resources tagged
        ChaosAllowed=true.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      # Placeholder stop condition, used because a greenfield account has no
      # CloudWatch alarms. Before you run this in production, replace it with
      # alarm-based stop conditions (Source: aws:cloudwatch:alarm, with Value
      # set to the alarm ARN).
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Targets:
        TransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        S3Buckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        DynamoDbGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
      # None of the actions sets StartAfter, so all four start at the same time
      # and the disruptions overlap in one window.
      Actions:
        disruptTransitGatewayConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:transit-gateway-disrupt-cross-region-connectivity
          Description: Block transit gateway traffic from this region to the target region.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref DisruptionDuration
            region: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: TransitGateways
        disruptSubnetConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:route-table-disrupt-cross-region-connectivity
          Description: Block subnet traffic from this region to the target region.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref DisruptionDuration
            region: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            Subnets: Subnets
        pauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication
          Description: Pause S3 replication to buckets in the target region.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref DisruptionDuration
            region: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            Buckets: S3Buckets
        pauseDynamoDbReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause replication on DynamoDB global tables.
          # This action only accepts 'duration'. It has no 'region' parameter,
          # so it pauses replication to every replica of each targeted table.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref DisruptionDuration
          Targets:
            Tables: DynamoDbGlobalTables
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
      ExperimentOptions:
        AccountTargeting: single-account
        EmptyTargetResolutionMode: skip
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cross-region-chaos'
        Purpose: fis-cross-region-chaos

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: ID of the FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Ref CrossRegionChaosExperiment
  FisExperimentRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role that FIS assumes to run the experiment.
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
  ExperimentLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group for experiment logs.
    Value: !Ref ExperimentLogGroup
  ExperimentLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch log group for experiment logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
  ExperimentLogKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the experiment logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ExperimentLogKey.Arn
  ExperimentLogKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key that encrypts the experiment logs.
    Value: !Ref ExperimentLogKeyAlias
  TargetRegionUsed:
    Description: Region that traffic and replication are cut off from.
    Value: !Ref TargetRegion
  DisruptionDurationUsed:
    Description: How long the disruptions last (ISO 8601).
    Value: !Ref DisruptionDuration

      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr

    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:

      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting VPC flow logs for ${EnvironmentName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-kms-key'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs'

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs for ${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: UseFlowLogsKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-role'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder test pipeline with a custom component, custom build workflow, recipe, distribution and lifecycle policy

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (greenfield account - private subnet, AWS services via
  # interface VPC endpoints, no internet path)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-private-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  ImageBuilderPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  ImageBuilderSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateRouteTable

  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 Image Builder build and test instances (egress to VPC endpoints only)
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS from Image Builder build and test instances
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-endpoint-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  SsmVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Component
  # NOTE: the WebDownload source below is a public internet host. With the
  # private, endpoint-only network it is unreachable at build time. Resolving
  # this requires a user decision: (a) a reviewed NAT/egress exception, or
  # (b) hosting the installer in a stack-created S3 bucket (s3:// source).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Downloads, installs and runs Chef Client on Linux
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Downloads, installs and runs Chef Client on Linux
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefInstaller
                action: WebDownload
                maxAttempts: 3
                inputs:
                  - source: https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
                    destination: /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    overwrite: true
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chmod 0700 /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    - sudo bash /tmp/chef-install.sh -P chef -v 18
              - name: RunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo mkdir -p /tmp/chef-repo/cookbooks
                    - cd /tmp/chef-repo
                    - sudo CHEF_LICENSE=accept-silent chef-client --local-mode --chef-license accept-silent
              - name: CleanupChefInstaller
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo rm -f /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    - sudo rm -rf /tmp/chef-repo
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - CHEF_LICENSE=accept-silent chef-client --version
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Custom build workflow
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: ssmAgent
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              documentName: AWS-UpdateSSMAgent
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
              parameters:
                allowDowngrade:
                  - "false"
          - name: ApplyBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: InventoryCollection
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              and:
                - stringEquals: "AMI"
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
                - booleanEquals: true
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.collectImageMetadata"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: RunSanitizeScript
            action: SanitizeInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              and:
                - stringEquals: "AMI"
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
                - not:
                    stringEquals: "Windows"
                    value: "$.imagebuilder.platform"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: CreateOutputAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              stringEquals: "AMI"
              value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
        outputs:
          - name: ImageId
            value: "$.stepOutputs.CreateOutputAMI.imageId"
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Recipe
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized recipe with Chef Client and chrony time configuration test
      ParentImage: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SampleComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/x.x.x
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:

    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration

      InstanceTypes:
