      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      ResourceTags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Distribution configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Description: Distributes the sample AMI to us-east-1 with launch permissions for the current account
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: AMI built by the sample Image Builder pipeline
            AmiTags:
              Environment: Dev
              Project: sample-image-builder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Pipeline
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      Description: Daily image pipeline building the sample AMI
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt SampleImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SampleInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SampleDistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !GetAtt SampleWorkflow.Arn
        - WorkflowArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:workflow/test/test-image/x.x.x
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 9 * * ? *)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Lifecycle policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deprecates Dev AMIs older than 6 months
      Status: ENABLED
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:

            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: Dev
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a Cognito authentication layer (User Pool, Identity Pool, and IAM roles)
  for a Lex web UI using either Lex V1 or Lex V2, with optional live chat API access.

# NOTE: Lex V1 is deprecated by AWS. Its IAM actions and ARNs are still valid for
# existing bots. To use only the Lex V2 path, set BotName to "" and supply
# LexV2BotId and LexV2BotAliasId.
#
# NOTE: If both BotName and LexV2BotId are provided, both the V1 and V2 policies are
# attached. This is intentional: V1 is used if a bot name is provided, and V2 is used
# if a bot ID is provided. The two are not mutually exclusive.

Parameters:
  CognitoIdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: identity pool
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\s+=,.@-]+$'
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool.

  BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: OrderFlowers
    Description: >-
      Lex V1 bot name. Leave empty to skip the Lex V1 policies (Lex V1 is deprecated).

  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Lex V2 bot ID. When set, the Lex V2 policies are attached.

  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Lex V2 bot alias ID. Use it together with LexV2BotId.

  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, unauthenticated identities cannot call the Lex and API actions.

  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, adds permission to call the livechat endpoint through execute-api.

Conditions:
  NeedsLexV1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BotName, '']]
  NeedsLexV2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']]
  ShouldForceCognitoLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'true']
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']
  EnableUnauthLiveChat: !And
    - !Condition EnableLiveChat
    - !Not [!Condition ShouldForceCognitoLogin]

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      AliasAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: 'OFF'
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref CognitoIdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role for unauthenticated Cognito identities of the Lex web UI.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - !If
          - NeedsLexV1

  RequireUsEast1:
    Assertions:

        - Key: ManagedBy

    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

      Description: Customer managed key for passengerlist.org S3 site origin bucket encryption

      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'

            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontOACDecrypt

              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com

            Resource: '*'

            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:

            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: PassengerlistIpReputation
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Customer support authentication stack - Amazon Cognito user pool with admin and customer groups, a web app client (authorization code), a machine-to-machine client (client credentials), a resource server, a hosted UI domain, a PostConfirmation Lambda that adds sign-ups to the customer group, and SSM parameters for backend services.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (3-32 characters).
    Description: Application name used for resource naming and tagging.
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport-auth
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must not start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The account ID is appended to keep it globally unique.
  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport-api
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_:/.-]{1,256}$'
    Description: Identifier of the Cognito resource server that defines the custom read scope.
  CallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:8080/callback
    AllowedPattern: '^https://.+$|^http://localhost(:[0-9]+)?/.*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL (http is allowed only for localhost).
    Description: OAuth callback URL for the web application client.
  LogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:8080/logout
    AllowedPattern: '^https://.+$|^http://localhost(:[0-9]+)?/.*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL (http is allowed only for localhost).
    Description: Sign-out URL for the web application client.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
    Description: Retention in days for the PostConfirmation Lambda log group.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AppName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators of the customer support system (highest precedence).
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customers of the customer support system. New sign-ups are added automatically.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Ref ResourceServerIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the customer support API.

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read'
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutURL
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PostConfirmationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito PostConfirmation Lambda that assigns new users to the customer group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostConfirmationLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AppName}-post-confirmation:*'
        - PolicyName: PostConfirmationAddUserToGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Component
          Value: customer-support-auth

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-post-confirmation'
      Description: Adds newly confirmed sign-ups to the customer Cognito group.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          GROUP_NAME = os.environ["CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME"]


          def handler(event, context):
              if event.get("triggerSource") != "PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp":
                  return event

              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]

              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  GroupName=GROUP_NAME,
              )
              logger.info("Added user to group %s", GROUP_NAME)
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Component
          Value: customer-support-auth

  PostConfirmationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PostConfirmationFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Component
          Value: customer-support-auth

  PostConfirmationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  WebAppClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito web application client ID for the customer support system.
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito machine-to-machine client ID. Retrieve the secret at runtime with cognito-idp DescribeUserPoolClient.
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/userpool_id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for the customer support system.
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  OAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_auth_scope
      Type: String
      Description: Custom OAuth read scope defined by the Cognito resource server.
      Value: !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_discovery_url
      Type: String
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the Cognito user pool.
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  TokenEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_token_url
      Type: String
      Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint of the Cognito hosted UI domain.
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  AuthorizeEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_auth_url
      Type: String
      Description: OAuth 2.0 authorize endpoint of the Cognito hosted UI domain.
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  DomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Description: Fully qualified Cognito hosted UI domain.
      Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  WebAppClientId:
    Description: Web application client ID (authorization code grant).
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine client ID (client credentials grant). The secret is not exported; use DescribeUserPoolClient at runtime.
    Value: !Ref MachineClient
  HostedUIDomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
  SsmParameterPathPrefix:
    Description: SSM parameter path prefix holding the authentication configuration.
    Value: /app/customersupport/agentcore/

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the IAM roles needed by Amazon SageMaker Projects and their AWS Service Catalog
  product templates. A parameter controls whether each role is created. Every role uses
  the /service-role/ path and has a maximum session duration of one hour.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Core SageMaker Projects Roles
        Parameters:
          - CreateExecutionRole
          - CreateLaunchRole
          - CreateUseRole
      - Label:
          default: Service Roles Used by SageMaker Project Templates
        Parameters:
          - CreateCloudformationRole
          - CreateCodeBuildRole
          - CreateCodePipelineRole
          - CreateEventsRole
          - CreateApiGatewayRole
          - CreateFirehoseRole
          - CreateGlueRole
          - CreateLambdaRole

Parameters:
  CreateExecutionRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole.
  CreateLaunchRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'NO'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole.
  CreateUseRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'NO'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole.
  CreateCloudformationRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCloudformationRole.
  CreateCodeBuildRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodeBuildRole.
  CreateCodePipelineRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodePipelineRole.
  CreateEventsRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsEventsRole.
  CreateApiGatewayRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsApiGatewayRole.
  CreateFirehoseRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsFirehoseRole.
  CreateGlueRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsGlueRole.
  CreateLambdaRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLambdaRole.

Conditions:
  CreateExecutionRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateExecutionRole, 'YES']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploys a two-AZ VPC with public and private subnets, an Internet Gateway, and one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone.

Metadata:
  SecurityNotes:
    PublicSubnets: Public subnets reach the internet through the Internet Gateway route in the public route table. Public IPs are not auto-assigned on launch for security reasons, so any future public-facing resource must explicitly request its own public IP or Elastic IP.

Mappings:
  NetworkConfig:
    VPC:
      Cidr: 10.10.0.0/16
    PublicSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
    PublicSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.10.1.0/24
    PrivateSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.10.10.0/24
    PrivateSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.10.11.0/24

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, Cidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS standby stack for a cross-cloud disaster recovery blueprint with OCI as the
  primary cloud. Deploys a VPC, private subnet, hardened EC2 health-check endpoint
  with an Elastic IP, SSM interface endpoints, and KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: oci-aws-dr
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-32 characters of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
    Description: Project name used in resource Name tags and the flow log group name.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.82.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.82.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-rtb'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (KMS encrypted)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} DR standby VPC Flow Logs encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-dr-standby-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs-kms'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # The log group name carries a per-stack suffix (last segment of the stack ID)
  # so a group retained by a previous failed/rolled-back stack never collides.
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Fn::Sub:
          - '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-dr-standby-${StackSuffix}'
          - StackSuffix:
              Fn::Select:
                - 2
                - Fn::Split:
                    - '/'
                    - !Ref 'AWS::StackId'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver records to the DR standby log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EBS encryption key (dedicated, explicitly referenced by the root volume so
  # the launch does not depend on the account's implicit default EBS key)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EbsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} DR standby EBS volume encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEbsUseViaEC2
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowEbsGrantsViaEC2
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              Bool:
                'kms:GrantIsForAWSResource': true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ebs-kms'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EbsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-ebs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EbsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NOTE: HTTP/HTTPS ingress is restricted to 10.0.0.0/8 as requested, so the
  # Elastic IP endpoint will NOT answer health checks from the public internet.
  # OCI-side health checks must originate from 10.0.0.0/8 sources (e.g. over a
  # site-to-site VPN or interconnect, or from a source NATed into that range).
  # Ingress must not be widened to 0.0.0.0/0.
  # NOTE: The instance serves HTTP on port 80 only. The HTTPS (443) ingress rule
  # is retained as requested for a future TLS listener; no certificate or TLS
  # server is configured in this template.
  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: DR standby health-check instance - HTTP/HTTPS from internal 10.0.0.0/8 only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTP health check from internal network
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
        - Description: HTTPS from internal network (reserved for future TLS listener)
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to internal network (includes SSM VPC endpoints)
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: SSM interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS from the DR standby instance only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from DR standby instance
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.82.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM interface endpoints (instance egress is limited to HTTPS in 10.0.0.0/8,
  # so public SSM endpoints are unreachable without these)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-ssm'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-ssmmessages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-ec2messages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Compute
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: DR standby instance role for AWS Systems Manager access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  # LaunchTemplateName is intentionally omitted so CloudFormation generates a
  # unique name and interrupted rollbacks cannot cause name collisions.
  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      TagSpecifications:
        - ResourceType: launch-template
          Tags:
            - Key: Name
              Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-lt'
            - Key: Environment
              Value: dr-standby
            - Key: DRRole
              Value: standby
            - Key: PrimaryCloud
              Value: OCI
            - Key: StandbyCloud
              Value: AWS
            - Key: Project
              Value: !Ref ProjectName
            - Key: ManagedBy
              Value: CloudFormation
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}'
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt InstanceProfile.Arn
        Monitoring:
          Enabled: true
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
        # Root volume size is inherited from the AMI snapshot.
        BlockDeviceMappings:
          - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
            Ebs:
              VolumeType: gp3
              Encrypted: true
              KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsKmsKey.Arn
              DeleteOnTermination: true
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: volume
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-root-volume'
              - Key: Environment
                Value: dr-standby
              - Key: DRRole
                Value: standby
              - Key: PrimaryCloud
                Value: OCI
              - Key: StandbyCloud
                Value: AWS
              - Key: Project
                Value: !Ref ProjectName
              - Key: ManagedBy
                Value: CloudFormation
          - ResourceType: network-interface
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-eni'
              - Key: Environment
                Value: dr-standby
              - Key: DRRole
                Value: standby
              - Key: PrimaryCloud
                Value: OCI
              - Key: StandbyCloud
                Value: AWS
              - Key: Project
                Value: !Ref ProjectName
              - Key: ManagedBy
                Value: CloudFormation

  StandbyInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      # Mirrors the launch template root volume exactly so encryption is explicit
      # on the instance itself.
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsKmsKey.Arn
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64:
          Fn::Sub: |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -euo pipefail
            # Outbound access is limited to HTTPS inside 10.0.0.0/8, so no packages
            # are installed; the preinstalled python3 serves the static page.
            mkdir -p /var/www/html
            cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'EOF'
            <!DOCTYPE html>
            <html>
              <head><title>${ProjectName} DR Standby</title></head>
              <body>
                <h1>${ProjectName} - AWS DR standby</h1>
                <p>Status: OK</p>
                <p>Primary cloud: OCI | Standby cloud: AWS</p>
              </body>
            </html>
            EOF
            echo "OK" > /var/www/html/health
            cat > /etc/systemd/system/dr-healthcheck.service <<'EOF'
            [Unit]
            Description=DR standby static health-check web server
            After=network-online.target
            Wants=network-online.target

            [Service]
            Type=simple
            ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 80 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /var/www/html
            Restart=always
            RestartSec=5

            [Install]
            WantedBy=multi-user.target
            EOF
            systemctl daemon-reload
            systemctl enable --now dr-healthcheck.service
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-instance'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  StandbyEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref StandbyInstance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the DR standby VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the DR standby private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetId'
  InstanceId:
    Description: ID of the DR standby health-check EC2 instance

  InstancePrivateIp:

  ElasticIP:

  HealthCheckUrl:

    Value: !Sub 'http://${StandbyEIP}/health'

      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HealthCheckUrl'
  InstanceSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID of the DR standby instance
    Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceSecurityGroupId'
  InstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the DR standby instance IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt InstanceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceRoleArn'
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group receiving VPC Flow Logs

    Export:

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:

    Value: !GetAtt EbsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EbsKmsKeyArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Route 53 DNS zone for prxu.org in Production: Google Workspace mail
  (TXT and MX records), CloudFront CDN alias records (A/AAAA) and service
  CNAMEs. Assumed legacy hostnames: cdn and cdn-staging are CNAMEs to
  dovetail-cdn and dovetail-cdn-staging. Deploy this stack in us-east-1
  (US East, N. Virginia), because CLOUDFRONT-scope WAFv2 web ACLs can only
  be created there.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assumptions and notes
# - DEPLOYMENT REGION: deploy this stack in us-east-1. The shared WAFv2 WebACL
#   uses Scope CLOUDFRONT, and AWS only allows that scope in us-east-1. No
#   region is hardcoded in any resource property.
# - The request does not name the legacy CNAME hostnames. This template uses
#   cdn.<domain>         -> dovetail-cdn.<domain>
#   cdn-staging.<domain> -> dovetail-cdn-staging.<domain>
# - The backends for the authenticated feed proxy and the dovetail router are
#   not specified, and nothing outside this template may be referenced. Their
#   CNAMEs therefore point at in-zone CDN hostnames.
# - ACM DNS validation CNAME records are left out on purpose. ACM creates the
#   validation record name and value (_<random-token>.<host> ->
#   _<random-token>.acm-validations.aws.) only after a certificate request is
#   made, so the values are not known ahead of time and cannot be hardcoded.
#   Hardcoding values from another account would be invalid. If certificates
#   are needed, define AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate resources with
#   ValidationMethod DNS and DomainValidationOptions.HostedZoneId set to this
#   zone, and ACM will create the validation records itself. CloudFront needs
#   those certificates in us-east-1. Until they exist, the distributions use
#   the default CloudFront certificate and have no Aliases. Each distribution
#   already sets MinimumProtocolVersion TLSv1.2_2021. That TLS 1.2 minimum
#   takes effect once custom certificates and Aliases are added.
# - The origin bucket is encrypted with a customer managed KMS key. The key
#   policy grants CloudFront access scoped to this account's distributions
#   (wildcard SourceArn). It does not list individual distributions, which
#   would create a circular dependency (Key -> Distribution -> Bucket -> Key).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org.
    AllowedPattern: ^([a-z0-9-]+\.)+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a lowercase fully qualified domain name ending with a period (for example prxu.org.).
    Description: Hosted zone domain name, including the trailing period.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    AllowedValues:
      - Production
      - Staging
      - Development
    Description: Deployment environment used for tagging.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=REPLACE_ME
    Description: Public Google Workspace domain verification TXT value. This is not a secret.

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted zone
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public DNS zone for ${DomainName} (${Environment}) - Google Workspace mail, CloudFront CDNs and service CNAMEs'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: email-and-cdn-dns

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google Workspace mail records
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'

  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key for the origin bucket
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the shared CloudFront S3 origin bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontOACUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: email-and-cdn-dns

  OriginBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cdn-origin'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref OriginBucketKey

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared private S3 origin bucket and Origin Access Control
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: email-and-cdn-dns

  OriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-oac'
        Description: Shared Origin Access Control for the CDN origin bucket
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared WAFv2 WebACL (CLOUDFRONT scope - stack must be in us-east-1)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CdnWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn-webacl'
      Description: Shared WAF web ACL for all CDN CloudFront distributions
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: CdnWebACL
      Rules:
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
        - Name: RateLimitPerIP
          Priority: 3
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitPerIP
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: email-and-cdn-dns

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront distributions (one per CDN subdomain, each with its own prefix)
  # The cache policy ID is the AWS managed "CachingOptimized" policy.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DovetailCdn:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}'
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CdnWebACL.Arn
        Origins:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple learning VPC with optional Internet Gateway, public subnet, route table, and security group components.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    Description: Prefix used in the Name tag of every resource.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create and attach an Internet Gateway.

  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the public subnet.

  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the public route table.

  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the web security group.

  AllowedSourceCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    Description: IPv4 CIDR range allowed to reach HTTP and HTTPS ports.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0).

Conditions:
  HasInternetGateway: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  HasPublicSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, 'true']
  HasRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, 'true']
  HasSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, 'true']
  HasPublicRoute: !And
    - !Condition HasInternetGateway
    - !Condition HasRouteTable
  HasSubnetRouteAssociation: !And
    - !Condition HasPublicSubnet
    - !Condition HasRouteTable

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: HasInternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PublicSubnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: HasRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PublicRT'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicRoute
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasSubnetRouteAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: HasSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP and HTTPS inbound traffic
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSourceCidr
          Description: Allow HTTP
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSourceCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-WebSG'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-VpcId'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Landing zone hub VPC with public and private subnets across two Availability Zones,
  NAT gateways, a Transit Gateway for multi-account spoke connectivity, VPC flow logs
  to CloudWatch Logs, and private VPC endpoints for SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM Messages,
  CloudWatch Logs and S3.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name prefix used in resource Name tags and export names.

Mappings:
  NetworkConfig:
    Vpc:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
    PublicSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.0.1.0/24
    PublicSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.0.2.0/24
    PrivateSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.0.10.0/24
    PrivateSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.0.11.0/24
    SpokeSummary:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.0/8

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # NOTE: Spoke accounts must be granted access to this Transit Gateway through
  # AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) outside this template. A RAM resource
  # share requires spoke account IDs or an AWS Organizations ARN, which do not
  # exist in a greenfield deployment.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "${EnvironmentName} hub Transit Gateway for spoke connectivity"
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-hub-tgw-attachment"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRoute1ToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, SpokeSummary, Cidr]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRoute2ToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, SpokeSummary, Cidr]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc"
      RetentionInDays: 90
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsToCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog

      ResourceId: !Ref VPC

      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60

          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, Vpc, Cidr]

      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp

          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, Vpc, Cidr]

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ssm-instance-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SSMInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref SSMInstanceRole
