AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Student Services Bedrock AgentCore identity and IAM layer for the educational platform - shared base policy, per-domain least-privilege execution roles, and per-domain Cognito OAuth2 client credentials identity.

Resources:
  StudentServicesBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Shared base permissions for Student Services Bedrock AgentCore execution roles (model invocation, logging, metrics, tracing, and SSM parameter access).
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*:log-stream:*
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:GetSamplingRules
              - xray:GetSamplingTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*

  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Bedrock AgentCore execution role for the StudentServicesAgent domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudentServices
        - Key: Component
          Value: StudentServicesAgent

  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Bedrock AgentCore execution role for the CourseRegistration domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudentServices
        - Key: Component
          Value: CourseRegistration

  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Bedrock AgentCore execution role for the CourseCatalog domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KnowledgeBaseRetrieve
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KnowledgeBaseRetrieve
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:knowledge-base/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudentServices
        - Key: Component
          Value: CourseCatalog

  CourseReviewExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Bedrock AgentCore execution role for the CourseReview domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudentServices
        - Key: Component
          Value: CourseReview

  LoanApplicationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Bedrock AgentCore execution role for the LoanApplication domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerInvokeEndpoint
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerInvokeEndpoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudentServices
        - Key: Component
          Value: LoanApplication

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-studentservicesgateway-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: StudentServices
        Component: StudentServicesGateway

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub studentservicesgateway-${AWS::AccountId}

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Implements the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark section 3 log-metric-filter-and-alarm controls (3.1–3.14) with a KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail management events, CloudWatch Logs metric filters, CloudWatch alarms, Logs Insights query definitions, and a KMS-encrypted SNS topic for alarm notifications.

Resources:
  CisMonitoringKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for CIS section 3 monitoring resources in stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Section3

  CisMonitoringKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CisMonitoringKey

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Section3

  CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-cloudtrail-to-cwl'
      Description: Allows a CloudTrail trail to deliver management events to the CIS monitoring log group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailDeliveryToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowLogStreamCreationAndDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Sets up AWS Security Hub across the AWS Organization through AWS Control Tower
  lifecycle events. Deploy in the Control Tower management account, in the landing
  zone home region. Makes the audit account the Security Hub delegated administrator
  and enrolls the log archive account and all future Control Tower accounts as members
  by assuming the AWSControlTowerExecution role.

Resources:
  SecurityHubAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by SSM Automation to configure Security Hub across the Organization.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSuperwerkerParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/account_id_audit
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/account_id_logarchive
              - Sid: AssumeControlTowerExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution
              - Sid: SecurityHubDelegatedAdmin
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: OrganizationsForSecurityHubDelegation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                  - organizations:ListAWSServiceAccessForOrganization
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecurityHubServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/securityhub.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForSecurityHub
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: securityhub.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: superwerker-securityhub

  SecurityHubEventsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by EventBridge to start the Security Hub SSM Automation documents.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubEventsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartSecurityHubAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubSetupOrgDocument}:$DEFAULT
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubSetupOrgDocument}:*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubAddMemberDocument}:$DEFAULT
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubAddMemberDocument}:*
              - Sid: PassAutomationRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: superwerker-securityhub

  SecurityHubSetupOrgDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: superwerker-securityhub
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Makes the audit account the Security Hub delegated administrator and enrolls the log archive account as a member.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role SSM Automation assumes to run this document.
            default: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
          Partition:
            type: String
            description: AWS partition used to build cross-account role ARNs.
            default: !Ref AWS::Partition
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/account_id_audit
            outputs:
              - Name: AuditAccountId
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
                Type: String
          - name: GetLogArchiveAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/account_id_logarchive
            outputs:
              - Name: LogArchiveAccountId
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
                Type: String
          - name: ValidateAccountIds
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 60
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.AuditAccountId }}'
                LogArchiveAccountId: '{{ GetLogArchiveAccountId.LogArchiveAccountId }}'
              Script: |
                import re

                PATTERN = re.compile(r'^\d{12}$')

                def handler(events, context):
                    for key in ('AuditAccountId', 'LogArchiveAccountId'):
                        value = str(events.get(key, '')).strip()
                        if not PATTERN.match(value):
                            raise ValueError(
                                f'Invalid {key} "{value}": expected a 12-digit AWS account ID. '
                                'Check /superwerker/account_id_audit and /superwerker/account_id_logarchive in Parameter Store.'
                            )
                    return {'Valid': True}
          - name: SetupOrganizationAdmin
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.AuditAccountId }}'
                Partition: '{{ Partition }}'
                Region: '{{ global:REGION }}'
              Script: |
                import re
                import time
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                PATTERN = re.compile(r'^\d{12}$')
                ROLE_NAME = 'AWSControlTowerExecution'
                RETRYABLE = ('InvalidAccessException', 'ResourceNotFoundException', 'LimitExceededException', 'TooManyRequestsException')

                def validate(name, value):
                    value = str(value).strip()
                    if not PATTERN.match(value):
                        raise ValueError(f'Invalid {name} "{value}": expected a 12-digit AWS account ID.')
                    return value

                def assume(partition, account_id, region):
                    creds = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region).assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:{partition}:iam::{account_id}:role/{ROLE_NAME}',
                        RoleSessionName='superwerker-securityhub',
                    )['Credentials']
                    return boto3.session.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=region,
                    )

                def ensure_hub(sh):
                    try:
                        sh.describe_hub()
                        return 'AlreadyEnabled'
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ('InvalidAccessException', 'ResourceNotFoundException'):
                            raise
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceConflictException':
                            raise
                    return 'Enabled'

                def handler(events, context):
                    partition = events['Partition']
                    region = events['Region']
                    audit_id = validate('AuditAccountId', events['AuditAccountId'])

                    audit_session = assume(partition, audit_id, region)
                    audit_sh = audit_session.client('securityhub')
                    hub_status = ensure_hub(audit_sh)

                    boto3.client('organizations', region_name=region).enable_aws_service_access(
                        ServicePrincipal='securityhub.amazonaws.com'
                    )

                    mgmt_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region)
                    admins = []
                    for page in mgmt_sh.get_paginator('list_organization_admin_accounts').paginate():
                        admins.extend(a['AccountId'] for a in page.get('AdminAccounts', []) if a.get('Status') == 'ENABLED')
                    if admins and audit_id not in admins:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            f'Security Hub delegated administrator is already set to {admins}, not the audit account {audit_id}. '
                            'Remove the existing delegated administrator before running this automation.'
                        )
                    admin_status = 'AlreadyDelegated'
                    if audit_id not in admins:
                        mgmt_sh.enable_organization_admin_account(AdminAccountId=audit_id)
                        admin_status = 'Delegated'

                    org_config_status = 'Unchanged'
                    for attempt in range(12):
                        try:
                            config = audit_sh.describe_organization_configuration()
                            if config.get('OrganizationConfiguration', {}).get('ConfigurationType') == 'CENTRAL':
                                org_config_status = 'CentralConfigurationInUse'
                            elif not config.get('AutoEnable'):
                                audit_sh.update_organization_configuration(AutoEnable=True)
                                org_config_status = 'AutoEnableTurnedOn'
                            break
                        except ClientError as e:
                            if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in RETRYABLE or attempt == 11:
                                raise
                            time.sleep(10)

                    return {
                        'AuditHub': hub_status,
                        'DelegatedAdmin': admin_status,
                        'OrganizationConfiguration': org_config_status,
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: DelegatedAdmin
                Selector: $.Payload.DelegatedAdmin
                Type: String
          - name: AddLogArchiveMember
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.AuditAccountId }}'
                MemberAccountId: '{{ GetLogArchiveAccountId.LogArchiveAccountId }}'
                Partition: '{{ Partition }}'
                Region: '{{ global:REGION }}'
              Script: |
                import re
                import time
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                PATTERN = re.compile(r'^\d{12}$')
                ROLE_NAME = 'AWSControlTowerExecution'
                ACTIVE = ('Enabled', 'Associated')
                RECREATE = ('Removed', 'Resigned', 'Deleted')

                def validate(name, value):
                    value = str(value).strip()
                    if not PATTERN.match(value):
                        raise ValueError(f'Invalid {name} "{value}": expected a 12-digit AWS account ID.')
                    return value

                def assume(partition, account_id, region):
                    creds = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region).assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:{partition}:iam::{account_id}:role/{ROLE_NAME}',
                        RoleSessionName='superwerker-securityhub',
                    )['Credentials']
                    return boto3.session.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=region,
                    )

                def ensure_hub(sh):
                    try:
                        sh.describe_hub()
                        return
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ('InvalidAccessException', 'ResourceNotFoundException'):
                            raise
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceConflictException':
                            raise

                def member_status(admin_sh, member_id):
                    members = admin_sh.get_members(AccountIds=[member_id]).get('Members', [])

  SecurityHubAddMemberDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: superwerker-securityhub
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables Security Hub in a newly provisioned Control Tower account and enrolls it as a member of the audit account.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AccountId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the account to enroll as a Security Hub member.
            allowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role SSM Automation assumes to run this document.
            default: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
          Partition:
            type: String
            description: AWS partition used to build cross-account role ARNs.
            default: !Ref AWS::Partition

          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/account_id_audit
            outputs:
              - Name: AuditAccountId
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
                Type: String
          - name: ValidateAccountIds
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 60
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.AuditAccountId }}'
                MemberAccountId: '{{ AccountId }}'
              Script: |
                import re

                PATTERN = re.compile(r'^\d{12}$')

                def handler(events, context):
                    for key in ('AuditAccountId', 'MemberAccountId'):
                        value = str(events.get(key, '')).strip()
                        if not PATTERN.match(value):
                            raise ValueError(
                                f'Invalid {key} "{value}": expected a 12-digit AWS account ID. '
                                'Check /superwerker/account_id_audit in Parameter Store and the Control Tower event payload.'
                            )

          - name: AddMember
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600

                ACTIVE = ('Enabled', 'Associated')
                RECREATE = ('Removed', 'Resigned', 'Deleted')

                def validate(name, value):
                    value = str(value).strip()
                    if not PATTERN.match(value):
                        raise ValueError(f'Invalid {name} "{value}": expected a 12-digit AWS account ID.')
                    return value

                def assume(partition, account_id, region):
                    creds = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region).assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:{partition}:iam::{account_id}:role/{ROLE_NAME}',
                        RoleSessionName='superwerker-securityhub',
                    )['Credentials']
                    return boto3.session.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=region,
                    )

                def ensure_hub(sh):
                    try:
                        sh.describe_hub()
                        return
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ('InvalidAccessException', 'ResourceNotFoundException'):

                def member_status(admin_sh, member_id):

                    admin_sh = assume(partition, audit_id, region).client('securityhub')
                    member_sh = assume(partition, member_id, region).client('securityhub')
                    ensure_hub(member_sh)

                    status = member_status(admin_sh, member_id)
                    if status in ACTIVE:
                        return {'MemberStatus': status}
                    if status is None or status in RECREATE:
                        check_unprocessed(admin_sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': member_id}]), 'CreateMembers')

                    for _ in range(6):
                        status = member_status(admin_sh, member_id)
                        if status in ACTIVE or status == 'Invited':
                            break
                        time.sleep(5)
                    if status in ACTIVE:
                        return {'MemberStatus': status}

                    if status == 'Created':
                        check_unprocessed(admin_sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[member_id]), 'InviteMembers')

                    for _ in range(6):
                        invitations = member_sh.list_invitations().get('Invitations', [])
                        match = [i for i in invitations if i.get('AccountId') == audit_id]
                        if match:
                            member_sh.accept_administrator_invitation(
                                AdministratorId=audit_id, InvitationId=match[0]['InvitationId']
                            )
                            break
                        current = member_sh.get_administrator_account().get('Administrator', {})
                        if current.get('AccountId') == audit_id:
                            break
                        time.sleep(5)

                    status = member_status(admin_sh, member_id)
                    if status not in ACTIVE:
                        raise RuntimeError(f'Account {member_id} did not become an active Security Hub member (status: {status}).')
                    return {'MemberStatus': status}
            outputs:
              - Name: MemberStatus
                Selector: $.Payload.MemberStatus
                Type: String

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared IAM roles, GuardDuty and the AWSQS Kubernetes/EKS CloudFormation registry
  type activations used by multiple EKS deployments. Deploy only to a region where
  the AWSQS public extensions (AWSQS-Kubernetes-Resource, AWSQS-Kubernetes-Helm,
  AWSQS-EKS-Cluster) are published, for example us-east-1, us-west-2 or eu-west-1.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: eks
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{0,16}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 16 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens.
    Description: Name prefix for every role, instance profile, log group and bucket.
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]{0,8}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 8 lowercase alphanumeric characters.
    Description: Optional suffix appended directly after the environment alias.
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional ARN of an IAM permissions boundary policy applied to every role. Leave empty for none.
  BastionBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-bastion-artifacts
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 3-31 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
    Description: Base name of the bastion artifact bucket. Account ID and region are appended for uniqueness.

Conditions:
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bastion artifact bucket encryption key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BastionBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the bastion artifact bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseViaS3
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-bucket-key'

  BastionBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-bucket'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BastionBucketKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bastion artifact bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BastionBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${BastionBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BastionBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-bucket'

  BastionBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref BastionBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BastionBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BastionBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyNonKmsEncryptionHeader
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${BastionBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              'Null':
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: 'false'
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GuardDuty
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Registry log groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  EksClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda discovery role (read-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-discovery'
      Description: Lambda execution role with read-only access for resource discovery.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda caller-identity role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-identity'
      Description: Lambda role for caller identity, CloudFormation and CloudTrail log access.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: caller-identity
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListExports
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudTrailRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudTrailLogsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS node-group describe role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EksNodegroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-eks-nodegroup-describe'
      Description: Role for describing EKS node groups.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-nodegroup-describe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeNodegroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:nodegroup/*'
              - Sid: ListClusters
                Effect: Allow
                Action: eks:ListClusters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DescribeAutoScaling
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFormation execution role (registry types)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CfnExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-execution'
      Description: Execution role for AWSQS Kubernetes/EKS CloudFormation registry types.
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EksManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecretsManager
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:TagResource
                  - secretsmanager:UntagResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*'
              - Sid: Kms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:CreateKey
                  - kms:CreateAlias
                  - kms:DeleteAlias
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:ListAliases
                  - kms:ListKeys
                  - kms:PutKeyPolicy
                  - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
                  - kms:TagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Sid: Ec2
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateTags

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS test infrastructure with KMS-encrypted standard and FIFO queues, dead-letter queues, and CloudWatch alarms

Resources:
  SqsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting all SQS queues in this test stack
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  SqsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sqs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey

  SeparateFifoQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  StandardDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  StandaloneFifoDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        redrivePermission: allowAll

  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-messages-sent'
      AlarmDescription: Sum of messages sent to the standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching

  FifoQueueWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly'
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection on average messages sent to the FIFO queue with a DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:

              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:

            Period: 300

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Builds the private networking for a Red Hat OpenShift on AWS (ROSA) PrivateLink cluster:
  a private ROSA VPC plus an egress VPC, connected by a Transit Gateway. Internet egress
  from the ROSA VPC flows through the Transit Gateway to a NAT gateway in the egress VPC.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: ROSA VPC
        Parameters:
          - AvailabilityZoneCount
          - RosaVpcCidr
          - RosaPrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - RosaPrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - RosaPrivateSubnet3Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Egress VPC
        Parameters:
          - EgressVpcCidr
          - EgressPublicSubnetCidr
          - EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: Optional Features
        Parameters:
          - CreateElbServiceLinkedRole
          - EnableFlowLogs
          - FlowLogsRetentionInDays

Parameters:
  AvailabilityZoneCount:
    Type: String
    Description: Number of availability zones for the ROSA VPC (1 for single-AZ, 3 for multi-AZ).
    AllowedValues:
      - '1'
      - '3'
    Default: '1'

  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the private ROSA VPC.
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  RosaPrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 1 (AZ index 0).
    Default: 10.1.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  RosaPrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 2 (AZ index 1, used only when AvailabilityZoneCount is 3).
    Default: 10.1.16.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  RosaPrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 3 (AZ index 2, used only when AvailabilityZoneCount is 3).
    Default: 10.1.32.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC.
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC public subnet (hosts the NAT gateway).
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC private subnet (hosts the Transit Gateway attachment).
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Description: Set to true to create the Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role (only if it does not already exist in the account).
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Description: Set to true to enable VPC Flow Logs to KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs for both VPCs.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  FlowLogsRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Retention period in days for the VPC Flow Logs log groups.
    AllowedValues:
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 180
      - 365
    Default: 30

Conditions:
  IsMultiAz: !Equals [!Ref AvailabilityZoneCount, '3']
  CreateElbRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole, 'true']
  FlowLogsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROSA VPC (fully private, no internet gateway)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc'

  RosaPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaPrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-rt'

  RosaPrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaPrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaPrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Egress VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc'

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-subnet'

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-subnet'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-igw'

  EgressVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: EgressVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-natgw'

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-rt'

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicToRosaRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-rt'

  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  EgressPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  EgressPrivateToRosaRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Transit Gateway connecting the ROSA VPC to the egress VPC for ${AWS::StackName}'
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt'

  RosaTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds: !If
        - IsMultiAz
        - - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
          - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
          - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
        - - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-tgw-attachment'

  EgressTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-tgw-attachment'

  RosaTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TgwDefaultRouteToEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  TgwRouteToRosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  TgwRouteToEgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing used by the ROSA cluster.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key encrypting VPC Flow Logs log groups for ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  RosaVpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc-flow-logs'

  EgressVpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc-flow-logs'

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the VPC Flow Logs service to deliver flow logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RosaVpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !GetAtt EgressVpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role'

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref RosaVpcFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc-flow-log'

  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref EgressVpcFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc-flow-log'

    Export:

Description: >-
  PCI DSS remediation prerequisites (CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group, KMS CMK,
  IAM roles) plus nine SSM Automation documents for use by custom AWS Config
  conformance packs. All outputs are exported.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisites
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 1827
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS

  PciRemediationKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: PCI DSS remediation CMK used for CloudTrail trail encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudTrail to encrypt logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudtrail:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
      Tags:

          Value: PCI-DSS

  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PCI-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revokes all inbound and outbound rules on the given default security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group to remediate.
            allowedPattern: '^sg-[a-z0-9]+$'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role that Automation assumes.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllRules
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    ingress_ids = []
                    egress_ids = []
                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_security_group_rules')
                    for page in paginator.paginate(Filters=[{'Name': 'group-id', 'Values': [group_id]}]):
                        for rule in page.get('SecurityGroupRules', []):
                            if rule.get('IsEgress'):
                                egress_ids.append(rule['SecurityGroupRuleId'])
                            else:
                                ingress_ids.append(rule['SecurityGroupRuleId'])
                    if ingress_ids:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=group_id, SecurityGroupRuleIds=ingress_ids)
                    if egress_ids:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=group_id, SecurityGroupRuleIds=egress_ids)
                    return {
                        'GroupId': group_id,
                        'RevokedIngressRules': len(ingress_ids),
                        'RevokedEgressRules': len(egress_ids)
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: RevokedIngressRules
                Selector: $.Payload.RevokedIngressRules
                Type: Integer
              - Name: RevokedEgressRules
                Selector: $.Payload.RevokedEgressRules
                Type: Integer

  RemoveCodeBuildCredentialEnvVarsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PCI-RemoveCodeBuildCredentialEnvVars'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Removes AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables from a CodeBuild project.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project to remediate.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the role that Automation assumes.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemoveCredentialEnvVars
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                BLOCKED = {'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'}

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    response = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    projects = response.get('projects', [])
                    if not projects:
                        raise ValueError('CodeBuild project not found: ' + project_name)
                    environment = projects[0]['environment']
                    current = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    kept = [v for v in current if v.get('name') not in BLOCKED]
                    removed = len(current) - len(kept)
                    if removed > 0:
                        environment['environmentVariables'] = kept
                        codebuild.update_project(name=project_name, environment=environment)
                    return {
                        'ProjectName': project_name,
                        'RemovedVariables': removed
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: RemovedVariables
                Selector: $.Payload.RemovedVariables
                Type: Integer
