AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provides CloudWatch telemetry monitoring for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage.
  Creates a KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CoWork events,
  metric filters that read token, cost and session turn metrics from both CoWork
  telemetry schemas (local agent mode and Claude Code for Desktop), an IAM ingest
  policy for collectors and OTel exporters, and a CloudWatch dashboard. NOTE -
  metric filters publish metrics only in the stack's own region. If MetricsRegion
  is not the deployment region, the dashboard widgets show no data. Deploy this
  stack in the same region as MetricsRegion.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Telemetry ingestion
        Parameters:
          - LogGroupName
          - LogRetentionDays
          - MetricNamespace
      - Label:
          default: Dashboard
        Parameters:
          - DashboardName
          - MetricsRegion
    ParameterLabels:
      DashboardName:
        default: CloudWatch dashboard name
      MetricsRegion:
        default: Region used by dashboard widgets (deploy the stack in this same region)
      LogGroupName:
        default: Log group that receives CoWork telemetry events
      MetricNamespace:
        default: CloudWatch metric namespace
      LogRetentionDays:
        default: Log retention in days
  TelemetrySchemas:
    LocalAgentMode:
      EventSelector: '$.event_type = "cowork.turn.completed"'
      Fields:
        User: '$.user_id'
        Model: '$.model'
        InputTokens: '$.usage.input_tokens'
        OutputTokens: '$.usage.output_tokens'
        CacheReadTokens: '$.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'
        CacheCreationTokens: '$.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens'
        EstimatedCostUSD: '$.cost_usd'

Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: Claude-CoWork-Usage
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-255 characters. Use only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard.

  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region code, such as us-east-1.
    Description: >-
      Region that the dashboard widgets and console URL use. Set this to the
      region where the stack is deployed, because metric filters publish metrics
      only in the stack's region.

  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /claude/cowork/telemetry
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]{1,512}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-512 characters. Use only letters, numbers and . - _ / #
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CoWork telemetry events.

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: Claude/CoWork
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9/_.#:-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-255 characters. Use only letters, numbers and / _ . # : -
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for CoWork usage metrics.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues:

      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days to keep CoWork telemetry events in the log group.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TelemetryLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key that encrypts the Claude CoWork telemetry log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupName}

  TelemetryLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-cowork-telemetry
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TelemetryLogKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Log group and ingest policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TelemetryLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt TelemetryLogKey.Arn

  TelemetryIngestPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Lets collectors and OTel exporters write Claude CoWork telemetry events to the telemetry log group.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: WriteCoWorkTelemetry
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TelemetryLogGroup.Arn
              - !Sub ${TelemetryLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*

                "sparkline": false,

            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 18,

              "width": 3,
              "height": 5,

                "title": "Session Turns",
                "view": "singleValue",

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS CDK bootstrap stack. Every resource it needs is created in
  this template: an encrypted, versioned, HTTPS-only S3 bucket for file assets,
  an immutable ECR repository with image scanning for container assets, a KMS key
  and alias, the CDK publishing, lookup, deployment and CloudFormation execution
  IAM roles, and an SSM parameter that tracks the bootstrap version. It references
  no external VPCs, buckets, secrets or ARNs.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-10 lowercase alphanumeric characters.
    Description: >-
      Short string that uniquely identifies this bootstrap stack's resources, so
      that more than one bootstrap stack can exist in the same account and region.

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Account IDs allowed to assume the publishing and deployment roles in this
      environment.

  TrustedAccountsForLookup:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Extra account IDs allowed to assume only the lookup role in this environment.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Managed policy ARNs to attach to the CloudFormation execution role. If this
      is empty, AdministratorAccess is used.

  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Custom name for the file assets bucket. If this is empty, the name is
      generated from the qualifier, account and region.

  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ID or ARN of an existing KMS key used to encrypt the file assets bucket. If
      this is empty, a new key is created.

  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^alias/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or start with alias/ followed by alphanumeric, slash, underscore or hyphen characters.
    Description: >-
      Custom alias for the newly created KMS key. If this is empty, the alias is
      alias/cdk-<Qualifier>-assets-key.

Conditions:
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals ['', !Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccounts]]]
  HasTrustedAccountsForLookup: !Not [!Equals ['', !Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup]]]
  HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies: !Not [!Equals ['', !Join ['', !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies]]]
  HasCustomFileAssetsBucketName: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref FileAssetsBucketName]]
  CreateNewKey: !Equals ['', !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId]
  HasCustomKmsKeyAlias: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref KmsKeyAliasName]]

Resources:
  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for the CDK file assets bucket (qualifier ${Qualifier})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseThroughS3InThisAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowFilePublishingRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                aws:PrincipalArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'

  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If
        - HasCustomKmsKeyAlias
        - !Ref KmsKeyAliasName
        - !Sub 'alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey

  StagingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasCustomFileAssetsBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateNewKey
                - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
                - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: CleanupOldVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 365
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 1

  StagingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref StagingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
                - sts:TagSession
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cdk-file-publishing-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StagingBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject*
                  - s3:GetBucket*
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:List*
                  - s3:DeleteObject*
                  - s3:PutObject*
                  - s3:Abort*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: StagingBucketKeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId}'
      Tags:
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-role
          Value: file-publishing

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
                - sts:TagSession
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cdk-image-publishing-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ContainerAssetsRepositoryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-role
          Value: image-publishing

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
                - sts:TagSession
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccountsForLookup
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
                - sts:TagSession
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cdk-lookup-deny-decrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DontReadSecrets
                Effect: Deny
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-role
          Value: lookup

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green deployment with an optional temporary green environment.
  Creates or reuses the EB application and blue environment, swaps CNAMEs to a temporary
  green environment and swaps back before terminating green. Creates its own VPC, NAT,
  IAM roles, sample application version and launch monitors.

# Notes:
# - A lookup custom resource picks the newest AL2023 Node.js 22 solution stack and the regional S3 prefix list ID.
# - Default key is nodejs-sample.zip; the requested nodejs.zip does not exist in the AWS sample bucket.
# - New EB app/env names get a "-<8-char stack ID>" suffix; AllowedPattern lengths are narrowed to fit it.
# - CreateNewBlueResources=false needs the exact existing names (including any earlier suffix).
# - General egress comes from the EB default instance SG via NAT; do not set DisableDefaultEC2SecurityGroup.
# - A single NAT gateway is a cost trade-off; add a second one for high availability.
# - Confirmed cause of earlier stalls: the account's default EBS KMS key was disabled or pending deletion
#   (Client.InvalidKMSKey.InvalidState), so EC2 terminated every instance before it reached InService.
# - If EBS encryption by default is on and the default key is unusable, the lookup resets the account default to
#   the AWS managed aws/ebs key (volumes stay encrypted). This account-wide setting is deliberately kept after
#   stack deletion. Out-of-template fix: re-enable the key (or cancel its deletion) and grant
#   AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling access to it.
# - Launch monitors surface EB/internal-stack/Auto Scaling errors and give up after ~9 min (DEADLINE_MS).
# - Custom resources set ServiceTimeout so a Lambda that never responds fails within minutes instead of stalling for an hour.
# - A slow rollback (EB tearing down its ALB and ENIs) is expected.

Parameters:
  CreateNewBlueResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
    Description: true creates a new EB application, version and blue environment; false uses existing ones.
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: BlueGreenSampleApp
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,91}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-91 alphanumerics or hyphens.
    Description: Base name of the new EB application, or exact name of the existing one.
  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: BlueGreenSample-Blue
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{4,31}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 4-31 alphanumerics or hyphens.
    Description: Base name of the new blue environment, or exact name of the existing one.
  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: BlueGreenSample-Green
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{4,31}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 4-31 alphanumerics or hyphens.
    Description: Base name of the temporary green environment.
  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: true creates green and swaps traffic to it; false swaps back and terminates green.
  SampleAppBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: elasticbeanstalk-samples
    Description: Source bundle bucket; the region is appended when the default is used.
  SampleAppKey:
    Type: String
    Default: nodejs-sample.zip
    Description: Source bundle key (default is the AWS Node.js sample).

Conditions:
  CreateNewBlue: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewBlueResources, 'true']
  CreateGreen: !Equals [!Ref CreateGreenEnvironment, 'true']
  UseDefaultSampleBucket: !Equals [!Ref SampleAppBucket, 'elasticbeanstalk-samples']
  MonitorLaunch: !Or [!Condition CreateNewBlue, !Condition CreateGreen]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-vpc'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-igw'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-public-1'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-public-2'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-public-rt'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-nat-eip'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  # IgwAttachment tag creates an implicit dependency on the IGW attachment.
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-nat'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}
        - {Key: IgwAttachment, Value: !Ref VPCGatewayAttachment}

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-private-1'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-private-2'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-private-rt'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds: [!Ref PrivateRouteTable]

  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow public HTTP to the Elastic Beanstalk application load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - {IpProtocol: tcp, FromPort: 80, ToPort: 80, CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0, Description: Public HTTP}
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - {IpProtocol: tcp, FromPort: 80, ToPort: 80, CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16, Description: HTTP to instances inside the VPC}
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-alb-sg'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  # Restrictive by design; general egress comes from the EB-managed default instance SG.
  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP only from the load balancer to Elastic Beanstalk instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - {IpProtocol: tcp, FromPort: 80, ToPort: 80, SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup, Description: HTTP from the load balancer}
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - {IpProtocol: tcp, FromPort: 443, ToPort: 443, CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16, Description: HTTPS within the VPC}
        - {IpProtocol: tcp, FromPort: 443, ToPort: 443, DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt SolutionStack.S3PrefixListId, Description: HTTPS to Amazon S3 through the gateway endpoint}
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-instance-sg'}
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - {Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: ec2.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier'
      Tags:
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles: [!Ref EC2InstanceRole]

  ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition: {StringEquals: {'sts:ExternalId': elasticbeanstalk}}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkEnhancedHealth'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkManagedUpdatesCustomerRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  SolutionStackLookupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-SolutionStackLookup'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  SolutionStackLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - {Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SolutionStackLookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents], Resource: !GetAtt SolutionStackLookupLogGroup.Arn}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:ListAvailableSolutionStacks
                  - ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                  - ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault
                  - ec2:GetEbsDefaultKmsKeyId
                  - ec2:ResetEbsDefaultKmsKeyId
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  SolutionStackLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Finds the AL2023 Node.js 22 stack and S3 prefix list, and repairs an unusable EBS default KMS key
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt SolutionStackLookupRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref SolutionStackLookupLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import re
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          PATTERN = re.compile(r'^64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+) running Node\.js 22$')


          def find_solution_stack():
              eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')
              stacks = eb.list_available_solution_stacks()['SolutionStacks']
              matches = []
              for name in stacks:
                  m = PATTERN.match(name)
                  if m:
                      matches.append((tuple(int(x) for x in m.groups()), name))
              if not matches:
                  raise RuntimeError('No Amazon Linux 2023 Node.js 22 solution stack is available in this region')
              return max(matches)[1]


          def find_s3_prefix_list():
              region = os.environ['AWS_REGION']
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              lists = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(
                  Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [f'com.amazonaws.{region}.s3']}]
              )['PrefixLists']
              if not lists:
                  raise RuntimeError(f'No S3 managed prefix list found in {region}')
              return lists[0]['PrefixListId']


          def check_ebs_default_key():
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              if not ec2.get_ebs_encryption_by_default()['EbsEncryptionByDefault']:
                  return {'EbsDefaultKmsKey': 'none', 'EbsKeyState': 'EncryptionByDefaultOff', 'EbsKeyAction': 'unchanged'}
              key_id = ec2.get_ebs_default_kms_key_id()['KmsKeyId']
              kms = boto3.client('kms')
              try:
                  state = kms.describe_key(KeyId=key_id)['KeyMetadata']['KeyState']
              except kms.exceptions.NotFoundException:
                  state = 'NotFound'
              except kms.exceptions.KMSInvalidStateException:
                  state = 'InvalidState'
              except Exception as exc:
                  raise RuntimeError(f'Cannot check EBS default KMS key {key_id}: {exc}')
              if state == 'NotFound' and key_id == 'alias/aws/ebs':
                  state = 'Enabled'
              result = {'EbsDefaultKmsKey': key_id, 'EbsKeyState': state, 'EbsKeyAction': 'unchanged'}
              if state == 'Enabled':
                  return result
              print(f'EBS default KMS key {key_id} is {state}; resetting to the AWS managed aws/ebs key')
              try:
                  ec2.reset_ebs_default_kms_key_id()
              except Exception as exc:
                  raise RuntimeError(f'EBS default KMS key {key_id} is {state} and could not be reset: {exc}')
              result['EbsKeyAction'] = 'reset-to-aws-managed'
              return result


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'SolutionStackLookup')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  name = find_solution_stack()
                  prefix_list_id = find_s3_prefix_list()
                  data = check_ebs_default_key()
                  if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 10000:
                      raise TimeoutError('Lookup ran too close to the Lambda timeout')
                  data.update({'SolutionStackName': name, 'S3PrefixListId': prefix_list_id})
                  print(f'Lookup result: {data}')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, 'SolutionStackLookup')
              except BaseException as exc:
                  print(f'Error: {exc!r}')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id,
                                   reason=repr(exc)[:500])
      Tags:
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  SolutionStack:
    Type: Custom::SolutionStackLookup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SolutionStackLookupFunction.Arn
      ServiceTimeout: 120
      Platform: Amazon Linux 2023
      Runtime: Node.js 22

  Application:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: CreateNewBlue
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Sub
        - '${ApplicationName}-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      Description: Blue-Green deployment sample application

  ApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [CreateNewBlue, !Ref Application, !Ref ApplicationName]
      Description: Sample application version for Blue-Green deployment
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If [UseDefaultSampleBucket, !Sub '${SampleAppBucket}-${AWS::Region}', !Ref SampleAppBucket]
        S3Key: !Ref SampleAppKey

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateNewBlue
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref Application
      EnvironmentName: !Sub
        - '${BlueEnvironmentName}-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      Description: Blue (production) environment
      SolutionStackName: !GetAtt SolutionStack.SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      Tier: {Name: WebServer, Type: Standard}
      OptionSettings:
        - {Namespace: 'aws:ec2:vpc', OptionName: VPCId, Value: !Ref VPC}
        - {Namespace: 'aws:ec2:vpc', OptionName: Subnets, Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]}
        - {Namespace: 'aws:ec2:vpc', OptionName: ELBSubnets, Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]}
        - {Namespace: 'aws:ec2:vpc', OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress, Value: 'false'}
        - {Namespace: 'aws:ec2:vpc', OptionName: ELBScheme, Value: public}
        - {Namespace: 'aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment', OptionName: EnvironmentType, Value: LoadBalanced}
        - {Namespace: 'aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment', OptionName: LoadBalancerType, Value: application}

  EnvironmentLaunchMonitorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: MonitorLaunch
    Properties:
      Description: Fails fast with the real EB, internal stack or Auto Scaling error during environment launch
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt EnvironmentLaunchMonitorRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref EnvironmentLaunchMonitorLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          eb = asc = cfn = None
          POLL_SECONDS = 15
          DEADLINE_MS = 360000
          MAX_REASON = 1000
          def fe(e, n=None):
              s = f"[{e.get('Severity')}] {e.get('Message', '')}"
              return s[:n] if n else s
          def act_text(a):
              return a.get('StatusMessage') or a.get('Description', '')
          def get_env(app, env):
              envs = eb.describe_environments(ApplicationName=app, EnvironmentNames=[env], IncludeDeleted=False)['Environments']
              return next((e for e in envs if e['Status'] not in ('Terminating', 'Terminated')), None)
          def find_asgs(env):
              f = [{'Name': 'tag:elasticbeanstalk:environment-name', 'Values': [env]}]
              names = []
              for p in asc.get_paginator('describe_auto_scaling_groups').paginate(Filters=f):
                  names.extend(g['AutoScalingGroupName'] for g in p['AutoScalingGroups'])
              return names
          def get_acts(groups):
              acts = []
              for g in groups:
                  acts.extend(asc.describe_scaling_activities(AutoScalingGroupName=g, MaxRecords=20)['Activities'])
              return sorted(acts, key=lambda a: a['StartTime'], reverse=True)
          def stack_state(stack):
              evs = []
              for p in cfn.get_paginator('describe_stack_events').paginate(StackName=stack):
                  evs.extend(p['StackEvents'])
              failed = sorted((e for e in evs if e.get('ResourceStatus', '').endswith('_FAILED')), key=lambda e: e['Timestamp'])
              failures = [f"{e['LogicalResourceId']} ({e.get('ResourceType')}) {e['ResourceStatus']}: {e.get('ResourceStatusReason', '')}"
                          for e in failed[:3]]
              latest = {}
              for e in evs:
                  if e['LogicalResourceId'] != stack:
                      latest.setdefault(e['LogicalResourceId'], e)
              now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
              stuck = []
              for lid, e in latest.items():
                  if e.get('ResourceStatus', '').endswith('_IN_PROGRESS'):
                      stuck.append((int((now - e['Timestamp']).total_seconds()), lid, e.get('ResourceType')))
              stuck.sort(reverse=True)
              return failures, [f'{lid} ({rt}) in progress {s}s' for s, lid, rt in stuck]
          def monitor(app, env, context):
              start = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=1)
              events, acts, in_progress, asgs, stack, errors = [], [], [], None, None, {}
              def attempt(key, fn):
                  try:
                      r = fn()
                      errors.pop(key, None)
                      return r
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors[key] = str(exc)
                      return None
              while True:
                  environment = attempt('Environment lookup', lambda: get_env(app, env))
                  ev = attempt('EB events', lambda: eb.describe_events(ApplicationName=app, EnvironmentName=env,
                                                                       StartTime=start, MaxRecords=100)['Events'])
                  if ev is not None:
                      events = ev
                  eb_err = [e for e in events if e.get('Severity') in ('ERROR', 'FATAL')]
                  if eb_err:
                      return False, 'Elastic Beanstalk error: ' + ' | '.join(fe(e) for e in eb_err[:5])
                  if environment:
                      stack = f"awseb-{environment['EnvironmentId']}-stack"
                      st = attempt('Internal stack events', lambda: stack_state(stack))
                      if st is not None:
                          if st[0]:
                              return False, f'EB internal stack {stack} failed: ' + ' | '.join(st[0])
                          in_progress = st[1]
                  found = attempt('ASG lookup', lambda: find_asgs(env))
                  if found is not None:
                      asgs = found
                      a = attempt('ASG lookup', lambda: get_acts(asgs) if asgs else [])
                      if a is not None:
                          acts = a
                  failed = [a for a in acts if a.get('StatusCode') in ('Failed', 'Cancelled')]
                  if failed:
                      text = act_text(failed[0])
                      hint = ' (check the account EBS default KMS key)' if 'InvalidKMSKey' in text else ''
                      return False, f"Auto Scaling activity {failed[0]['StatusCode']}{hint}: {text}"
                  if environment:
                      if environment['Status'] == 'Ready':
                          if environment.get('Health') == 'Red':
                              return False, 'Environment is Ready but health is Red: ' + ' | '.join(fe(e) for e in events[:5])
                          return True, f"Environment {env} is Ready (health {environment.get('Health')})"
                      print(f"{env}: status {environment['Status']}, health {environment.get('Health')}, ASGs {asgs}, in progress {in_progress[:3]}")
                  else:
                      print(f'{env}: not created yet')
                  if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < DEADLINE_MS:
                      if asgs is None:
                          asg_state = 'ASG lookup did not complete'
                      elif not asgs:
                          asg_state = f'no Auto Scaling group tagged for {env} exists yet'
                      elif not acts:
                          asg_state = f'ASG {asgs[0]} exists with no scaling activities'
                      else:
                          asg_state = f"ASG {asgs[0]} latest activity {acts[0].get('StatusCode')}: {act_text(acts[0])}"
                      if stack:
                          stack_part = f"Internal stack {stack} in progress: {'; '.join(in_progress[:5]) or 'none'}."
                      else:
                          stack_part = 'Environment/internal stack not found.'
                      parts = [f'Timed out waiting for {env} to become Ready.', stack_part,
                               f'Auto Scaling: {asg_state[:250]}.',
                               'Last EB events: ' + (' | '.join(fe(e, 120) for e in events[:5]) or 'none') + '.']
                      if errors:
                          parts.append('Errors: ' + '; '.join(f'{k} error: {v[:120]}' for k, v in errors.items()))
                      return False, ' '.join(parts)
                  time.sleep(POLL_SECONDS)
          def handler(event, context):
              global eb, asc, cfn
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              env = props.get('EnvironmentName', 'unknown')
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', f'launch-monitor-{env}')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] != 'Create':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')
                  asc = boto3.client('autoscaling')
                  cfn = boto3.client('cloudformation')
                  ok, msg = monitor(props['ApplicationName'], env, context)
                  print(msg)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS if ok else cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id,
                                   reason=msg[:MAX_REASON])
              except BaseException as exc:
                  print(f'Error: {exc!r}')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=repr(exc)[:MAX_REASON])
      Tags:
        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}

  CnameSwapFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Properties:
      Description: Swaps Elastic Beanstalk CNAMEs between blue and green environments
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt CnameSwapRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref CnameSwapLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          eb = None
          POLL_SECONDS = 15
          SAFETY_MS = 45000
          def describe(names):
              envs = eb.describe_environments(EnvironmentNames=names, IncludeDeleted=False)['Environments']
              return {e['EnvironmentName']: e for e in envs if e['Status'] not in ('Terminating', 'Terminated')}
          def wait_ready(names, context):
              while True:
                  envs = describe(names)
                  missing = [n for n in names if n not in envs]
                  if missing:
                      raise RuntimeError(f'Environment(s) not found: {missing}')
                  if all(envs[n]['Status'] == 'Ready' for n in names):
                      return envs
                  if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < SAFETY_MS:
                      raise TimeoutError(f'Timed out waiting for {names} to become Ready')
                  time.sleep(POLL_SECONDS)
          def swap(blue, green, context):
              wait_ready([blue, green], context)
              print(f'Swapping CNAMEs: {blue} <-> {green}')
              eb.swap_environment_cnames(SourceEnvironmentName=blue, DestinationEnvironmentName=green)
              return wait_ready([blue, green], context)
          def handler(event, context):
              global eb
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'not-swapped')
              data = {}
              try:
                  eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  blue = props['BlueEnvironmentName']
                  green = props['GreenEnvironmentName']
                  request = event['RequestType']
                  if request == 'Create':
                      wait_ready([blue, green], context)
                      eb.swap_environment_cnames(SourceEnvironmentName=blue, DestinationEnvironmentName=green)
                      physical_id = f'swapped:{blue}:{green}'
                      envs = wait_ready([blue, green], context)
                      data = {'ProductionCNAME': envs[green]['CNAME'], 'StandbyCNAME': envs[blue]['CNAME']}
                  elif request == 'Update':
                      envs = describe([blue, green])
                      data = {'ProductionCNAME': envs.get(green, {}).get('CNAME', ''),
                              'StandbyCNAME': envs.get(blue, {}).get('CNAME', '')}
                  elif request == 'Delete':
                      if physical_id.startswith('swapped:'):
                          _, old_blue, old_green = physical_id.split(':', 2)
                          envs = describe([old_blue, old_green])
                          if old_blue in envs and old_green in envs:
                              swap(old_blue, old_green, context)
                              physical_id = f'restored:{old_blue}:{old_green}'
                          else:
                              print('Blue or green environment no longer exists; nothing to swap back')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
              except BaseException as exc:
                  print(f'Error: {exc!r}')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, data, physical_id, reason=repr(exc)[:200])

        - {Key: Application, Value: !Ref ApplicationName}
        - {Key: DeploymentColor, Value: green}

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for an ML workshop with third-party data and ML apps.
  Creates admin and end-user portfolios, seven CloudFormation products (VPC, IAM/KMS/S3, AWS Data Exchange,
  infrastructure, application, SageMaker notebook, third-party ML model), a launch role constraint per product,
  and lead/developer end-user IAM roles. Product template file names match the objects published at the
  securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps reference-architecture location under RootS3URL.

Parameters:
  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Description: Base URL of the product CloudFormation templates (no trailing slash).
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix used for portfolio, product and IAM role names.
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Portfolios
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Admin-Portfolio'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Description: Portfolio for the ML workshop admin and lead team containing networking, security, data and infrastructure products.
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-EndUser-Portfolio'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Description: Portfolio for ML workshop data scientists and developers containing application, notebook and third-party model products.
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Products
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-VPC'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: VPC with private subnets and interface/gateway VPC endpoints for S3, SageMaker API/runtime, SSM, KMS and CloudWatch Logs.
      Distributor: MLWorkshop
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version of the private VPC product.
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/network.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  IAMKMSS3Product:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-IAM-KMS-S3'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: IAM roles, customer-managed KMS keys and encrypted S3 buckets for the ML workshop.
      Distributor: MLWorkshop
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version of the IAM, KMS and S3 product.
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/s3_iam_kms.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-DataExchange'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: AWS Data Exchange subscription that exports third-party data sets to S3.
      Distributor: MLWorkshop
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version of the AWS Data Exchange product.
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/adx.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Infrastructure'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Shared infrastructure for the ML workshop.
      Distributor: MLWorkshop
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version of the shared infrastructure product.
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/admin-setup-app.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Application'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: ML application layer for the workshop.
      Distributor: MLWorkshop
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version of the ML application product.
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/application.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-SageMakerNotebook'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: SageMaker notebook instance in private subnets with KMS encryption and no direct internet access.
      Distributor: MLWorkshop
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version of the SageMaker notebook product.
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/notebook.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  ThirdPartyMLModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-ThirdPartyMLModel'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Third-party AWS Marketplace ML model package deployed as a SageMaker model and endpoint.
      Distributor: MLWorkshop
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version of the third-party ML model product.
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/mlmodel.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Portfolio / product associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct

  IAMKMSS3ProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMKMSS3Product

  DataExchangeProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  InfrastructureProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct

  ApplicationProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  SageMakerNotebookProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct

  ThirdPartyMLModelProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMLModelProduct

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Service Catalog launch role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SCLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-SCLaunchRole'
      Description: Launch role used by AWS Service Catalog to provision ML workshop products.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ServiceCatalogProvisioning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationStackOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                  - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ListChangeSets
                  - cloudformation:TagResource
                  - cloudformation:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadProductTemplates
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/servicecatalog:provisioning: 'true'
              - Sid: ServiceCatalogRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProduct
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProvisioningArtifact
                  - servicecatalog:ListProvisioningArtifacts
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: NetworkProvisioning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: VPCAndEndpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:DeleteVpc
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:DeleteSubnet
                  - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: SecurityAndStorageProvisioning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IAMRoleManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:UpdateRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
                  - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                  - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
                  - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:instance-profile/*'
              - Sid: IAMPolicyManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreatePolicy
                  - iam:DeletePolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicyVersion
                  - iam:CreatePolicyVersion
                  - iam:DeletePolicyVersion
                  - iam:ListPolicyVersions
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToMLServices
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
                      - dataexchange.amazonaws.com
                      - lambda.amazonaws.com
                      - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: KMSKeyManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:CreateKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:EnableKeyRotation
                  - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
                  - kms:GetKeyPolicy
                  - kms:PutKeyPolicy
                  - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
                  - kms:CreateAlias
                  - kms:DeleteAlias
                  - kms:UpdateAlias
                  - kms:ListAliases
                  - kms:TagResource
                  - kms:UntagResource
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3BucketManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketLogging
                  - s3:GetBucketLogging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketOwnershipControls
                  - s3:GetBucketOwnershipControls
                  - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*'
              - Sid: SSMParameterManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                  - ssm:RemoveTagsFromResource
                  - ssm:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'
              - Sid: SSMDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:DeleteRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:AssociateKmsKey
                  - logs:TagLogGroup
                  - logs:TagResource
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLServicesProvisioning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMaker
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:DeleteNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:UpdateNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:StopNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:UpdateNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: MarketplaceModelSubscriptions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - aws-marketplace:ViewSubscriptions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DataExchange
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSets
                  - dataexchange:GetDataSet
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSetRevisions
                  - dataexchange:GetRevision
                  - dataexchange:ListRevisionAssets
                  - dataexchange:GetAsset
                  - dataexchange:CreateJob
                  - dataexchange:StartJob
                  - dataexchange:GetJob
                  - dataexchange:ListJobs
                  - dataexchange:CancelJob
                  - dataexchange:CreateEventAction
                  - dataexchange:DeleteEventAction
                  - dataexchange:GetEventAction
                  - dataexchange:UpdateEventAction
                  - dataexchange:TagResource
                  - dataexchange:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DataExchangeExportToS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*/*'
              - Sid: SupportingLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:CreateFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionCode
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:AddPermission
                  - lambda:RemovePermission
                  - lambda:TagResource
                  - lambda:UntagResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Launch role constraints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCProductLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: VPCProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch role constraint for the VPC product.

  IAMKMSS3ProductLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: IAMKMSS3ProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMKMSS3Product
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch role constraint for the IAM, KMS and S3 product.

  DataExchangeProductLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: DataExchangeProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch role constraint for the AWS Data Exchange product.

  InfrastructureProductLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: InfrastructureProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch role constraint for the infrastructure product.

  ApplicationProductLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: ApplicationProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch role constraint for the application product.

  SageMakerNotebookProductLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: SageMakerNotebookProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch role constraint for the SageMaker notebook product.

  ThirdPartyMLModelProductLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: ThirdPartyMLModelProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMLModelProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch role constraint for the third-party ML model product.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # End-user roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SCLeadEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-LeadEndUser'
      Description: Service Catalog admin lead end user for the ML workshop.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSServiceCatalogEndUserFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LeadEndUserAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadAndDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - kms:ListAliases
                  - kms:ListKeys
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - sagemaker:ListNotebookInstances
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSets
                  - dataexchange:GetDataSet
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSetRevisions
                  - dataexchange:ListJobs
                  - dataexchange:GetJob
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: MLWorkshopParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'
              - Sid: ProvisioningTemplateObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/servicecatalog:provisioning: 'true'
              - Sid: NotebookPresignedUrl
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sagemaker:CreatePresignedNotebookInstanceUrl
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:notebook-instance/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  SCDevEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-DevEndUser'
      Description: Standard developer end user for the ML workshop.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSServiceCatalogEndUserReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DevEndUserAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ProvisionFromEndUserPortfolio
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:ProvisionProduct
                  - servicecatalog:UpdateProvisionedProduct
                  - servicecatalog:TerminateProvisionedProduct
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProvisioningParameters
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeRecord
                  - servicecatalog:ListLaunchPaths
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadAndDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - sagemaker:ListNotebookInstances
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: MLWorkshopParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'
              - Sid: ProvisioningTemplateObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:

      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio

  EndUserPortfolioDevEndUserPrincipal:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation

      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt SCDevEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

    Value: !Sub 'https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?roleName=${SCDevEndUserRole}&account=${AWS::AccountId}&displayName=${EnvironmentPrefix}-DevEndUser'
