    Value: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Builds a single-environment dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) VPC for either a staging or a production environment, with public and private subnets, internet and egress-only gateways, an optional NAT gateway, network ACLs, a cluster placement group and a DHCP options set.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment to deploy. This selects the VPC and subnet CIDR ranges and the domain name.
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging

  DeployNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to deploy a NAT gateway with its own Elastic IP for the private subnets. A NAT gateway may not be needed when a bastion host performs NAT.
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

  BastionVpnPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: Port the bastion host VPN listens on. It is allowed inbound on the public network ACL over TCP and UDP.
    Default: 1194
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNatGateway, "true"]

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.10.0.0/16
      PublicSubnetLB1Cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
      PublicSubnetLB2Cidr: 10.10.1.0/24
      PublicSubnetComputeCidr: 10.10.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnetAppCidr: 10.10.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnetDataCidr: 10.10.20.0/24
      DomainName: staging.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.20.0.0/16
      PublicSubnetLB1Cidr: 10.20.0.0/24
      PublicSubnetLB2Cidr: 10.20.1.0/24
      PublicSubnetComputeCidr: 10.20.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnetAppCidr: 10.20.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnetDataCidr: 10.20.20.0/24
      DomainName: production.internal

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and IPv6 block
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-eigw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnetLB1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnetLB1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-lb-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnetLB2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnetLB2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-lb-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnetCompute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnetComputeCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-compute'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: compute

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetApp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PrivateSubnetAppCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-app'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateSubnetData:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PrivateSubnetDataCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-data'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: data

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - InternetGatewayAttachment
      - VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetLB1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetLB1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetLB2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetLB2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetComputeRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetCompute
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PrivateSubnetAppRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetApp
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetDataRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetData
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional NAT gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetLB1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public network ACL
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-nacl'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicAclInboundHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101

      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:

  PublicAclInboundVpnTcpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless Movies CRUD API (Python 3.12, DynamoDB, API Gateway REST)

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters and digits.
    Description: Deployment environment name used for the stage, resource names and tags.

Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  MoviesLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MoviesTableCrudAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/movies-api-create-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  GetMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/movies-api-get-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/movies-api-update-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/movies-api-delete-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-api-create-${Environment}
      Description: Creates a movie item in the Movies table
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          HEADERS = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}


          def _default(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o == o.to_integral_value() else float(o)
              return str(o)


          def resp(code, body):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body, default=_default)}


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  data = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}', parse_float=Decimal)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'Request body must be valid JSON'})
              if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get('title'):
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'title is required'})
              data['title'] = str(data['title'])
              try:
                  table.put_item(Item=data, ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(title)')
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ConditionalCheckFailedException':
                      return resp(409, {'message': 'Movie already exists'})
                  raise
              return resp(201, data)
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  GetMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: GetMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-api-get-${Environment}
      Description: Retrieves a movie item from the Movies table
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          from urllib.parse import unquote
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          HEADERS = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}


          def _default(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o == o.to_integral_value() else float(o)
              return str(o)


          def resp(code, body):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body, default=_default)}


          def handler(event, context):
              params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              title = unquote(params.get('title') or '')
              if not title:
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'title is required'})
              item = table.get_item(Key={'title': title}).get('Item')
              if not item:
                  return resp(404, {'message': 'Movie not found'})
              return resp(200, item)
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-api-update-${Environment}
      Description: Updates an existing movie item in the Movies table
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          HEADERS = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}


          def _default(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o == o.to_integral_value() else float(o)
              return str(o)


          def resp(code, body):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body, default=_default)}


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  data = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}', parse_float=Decimal)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'Request body must be valid JSON'})
              if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get('title'):
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'title is required'})
              title = str(data.pop('title'))
              if not data:
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'At least one attribute to update is required'})
              names, values, parts = {}, {}, []
              for i, (key, value) in enumerate(data.items()):
                  names['#k%d' % i] = key
                  values[':v%d' % i] = value
                  parts.append('#k%d = :v%d' % (i, i))
              try:
                  result = table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression='SET ' + ', '.join(parts),
                      ExpressionAttributeNames=names,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=values,
                      ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(title)',
                      ReturnValues='UPDATED_NEW',
                  )
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ConditionalCheckFailedException':
                      return resp(404, {'message': 'Movie not found'})
                  raise
              return resp(200, {'title': title, 'updated': result.get('Attributes', {})})
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-api-delete-${Environment}
      Description: Deletes a movie item from the Movies table
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          HEADERS = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}


          def resp(code, body):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body)}


          def handler(event, context):
              title = None
              body = event.get('body')
              if body:
                  try:
                      data = json.loads(body)
                  except (ValueError, TypeError):
                      return resp(400, {'message': 'Request body must be valid JSON'})
                  if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('title'):
                      title = str(data['title'])
              if not title:
                  title = (event.get('queryStringParameters') or {}).get('title')
              if not title:
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'title is required'})
              try:
                  table.delete_item(Key={'title': title}, ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(title)')
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ConditionalCheckFailedException':
                      return resp(404, {'message': 'Movie not found'})
                  raise
              return resp(200, {'message': 'Movie deleted', 'title': title})
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio user profile, its scoped
  execution role, and an optional self-contained SageMaker Studio domain
  (VPC, subnet and public-internet-access domain) when no existing domain
  ID is supplied.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: User Profile
        Parameters:
          - UserProfileName
      - Label:
          default: Existing SageMaker Studio Domain (optional)
        Parameters:
          - ExistingDomainId
          - ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds
          - ExistingDomainSubnetIds
      - Label:
          default: Network for a newly created domain
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetCidr

Parameters:
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-63 alphanumeric characters or hyphens, starting and ending with an alphanumeric character.
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer persona.

  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(d-[a-z0-9]{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a SageMaker domain ID such as d-xxxxxxxxxxxx.
    Description: Optional ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain. Leave empty to create a new self-contained domain.

  ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional comma-separated security group IDs associated with the existing domain. Used only when ExistingDomainId is set.

  ExistingDomainSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional comma-separated subnet IDs associated with the existing domain. Used only when ExistingDomainId is set.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created when no existing domain is supplied.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet created when no existing domain is supplied.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Condition CreateDomain]
  HasExistingSecurityGroups: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds], '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MlopsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SageMaker execution role scoped to the MLOps engineer persona.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: persona
          Value: mlops-engineer
        - Key: user-profile
          Value: !Ref UserProfileName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Persona policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allows passing only the per-user MLOps execution role, and only to SageMaker.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PassPerUserExecutionRoleToSageMaker
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt MlopsExecutionRole.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com

  PipelinesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allows managing SageMaker pipelines and pipeline executions.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManagePipelinesAndExecutions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
              - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
              - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
              - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
              - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
              - sagemaker:SendPipelineExecutionStepSuccess
              - sagemaker:SendPipelineExecutionStepFailure
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/*'
          - Sid: ListPipelines
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListPipelines
            Resource: '*'

  ModelMonitoringPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allows managing model monitoring schedules, job definitions and their processing jobs.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageMonitoringSchedules
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:monitoring-schedule/*'
          - Sid: ManageMonitoringJobDefinitions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:data-quality-job-definition/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-quality-job-definition/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-bias-job-definition/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-explainability-job-definition/*'
          - Sid: ManageMonitoringProcessingJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*'
          - Sid: ListMonitoringResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringAlerts
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringAlertHistory
              - sagemaker:ListDataQualityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelQualityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelBiasJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelExplainabilityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
            Resource: '*'

  ModelsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allows managing models, model packages and model package groups.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageModels
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateModel
              - sagemaker:DescribeModel
              - sagemaker:DeleteModel
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model/*'
          - Sid: ManageModelPackageGroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:GetModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:PutModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroupPolicy
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package-group/*'
          - Sid: ManageModelPackages
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
              - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package/*'
          - Sid: ListModelResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListModels
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
            Resource: '*'

  ExperimentsLineagePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Read-only access to experiments, trials, trial components and lineage information.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DescribeExperimentsAndLineage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:DescribeAction
              - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
              - sagemaker:DescribeContext
              - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
              - sagemaker:GetLineageGroupPolicy
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-trial/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-trial-component/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:action/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:artifact/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:context/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:lineage-group/*'
          - Sid: ListAndQueryExperimentsAndLineage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListExperiments
              - sagemaker:ListTrials
              - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
              - sagemaker:ListActions
              - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
              - sagemaker:ListContexts
              - sagemaker:ListAssociations
              - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
              - sagemaker:QueryLineage
              - sagemaker:Search
            Resource: '*'

  JobsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allows running training, transform, processing and hyperparameter tuning jobs.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageTrainingJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:training-job/*'
          - Sid: ManageTransformJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
              - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transform-job/*'
          - Sid: ManageProcessingJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*'
          - Sid: ManageHyperParameterTuningJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobsForHyperParameterTuningJob
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:hyper-parameter-tuning-job/*'
          - Sid: ListJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
              - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
              - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
              - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
            Resource: '*'

  EndpointsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allows managing SageMaker endpoints and endpoint configurations.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageEndpoints
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
              - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
              - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
              - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
              - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
              - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*'
          - Sid: ManageEndpointConfigs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
              - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
              - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
              - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint-config/*'
          - Sid: ListEndpoints
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
              - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
            Resource: '*'

  StudioAppsSpacesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allows using SageMaker Studio apps and private or shared spaces, restricted to those owned by this user profile.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CreatePresignedUrlForOwnUserProfile
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/*/${UserProfileName}'
          - Sid: DescribeAndListStudioResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
              - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
              - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
              - sagemaker:DescribeApp
              - sagemaker:ListDomains
              - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
              - sagemaker:ListSpaces
              - sagemaker:ListApps
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ManageAppsInOwnUserProfile
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${UserProfileName}/*'
          - Sid: ManageOwnedSpaces
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateSpace
              - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
              - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${UserProfileName}'
              StringEquals:
                sagemaker:SpaceSharingType:
                  - Private
                  - Shared
          - Sid: ManageAppsInOwnedSpaces
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${UserProfileName}'
              StringEquals:
                sagemaker:SpaceSharingType:
                  - Private
                  - Shared

  SupportingServicesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Supporting permissions required for SageMaker jobs, pipelines and endpoints to run.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: TagSageMakerResourcesOnCreate
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:AddTags
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
            Condition:
              'Null':
                sagemaker:TaggingAction: 'false'
          - Sid: SageMakerS3Buckets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:CreateBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*'
          - Sid: SageMakerS3Objects
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*/*'
          - Sid: SageMakerCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:GetLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*'
          - Sid: SageMakerCloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                cloudwatch:namespace:
                  - /aws/sagemaker/*
                  - aws/sagemaker/*
          - Sid: EcrAuthorization
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EcrPullImages
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:*:repository/*'
          - Sid: VpcNetworkingForJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional self-contained Studio domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-studio-vpc'
        - Key: persona
          Value: mlops-engineer

  StudioSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-studio-subnet'
        - Key: persona
          Value: mlops-engineer

  StudioDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Join
        - '-'
        - - mlops
          - !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref StudioSubnet
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MlopsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefaultSpaceSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MlopsExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: persona
          Value: mlops-engineer

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MlopsUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    DependsOn:
      - PassRolePolicy
      - PipelinesPolicy
      - ModelMonitoringPolicy
      - ModelsPolicy
      - ExperimentsLineagePolicy
      - JobsPolicy
      - EndpointsPolicy
      - StudioAppsSpacesPolicy
      - SupportingServicesPolicy
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - CreateDomain
        - !GetAtt StudioDomain.DomainId
        - !Ref ExistingDomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MlopsExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - HasExistingSecurityGroups
          - !Ref ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: persona
          Value: mlops-engineer
        - Key: user-profile
          Value: !Ref UserProfileName

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio user profile.
    Value: !GetAtt MlopsUserProfile.UserProfileArn

  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the MLOps engineer SageMaker execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt MlopsExecutionRole.Arn

  DomainId:
    Description: ID of the SageMaker Studio domain the user profile is attached to.
    Value: !If
      - CreateDomain
      - !GetAtt StudioDomain.DomainId
      - !Ref ExistingDomainId

  ExistingDomainSubnetIds:
    Condition: UseExistingDomain
    Description: Subnet IDs associated with the existing SageMaker Studio domain.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Sets up CloudWatch Logs monitoring for cross-language DB Encryption SDK
  performance benchmarks (Java, .NET, Python, Go, Rust). Creates a log group that
  receives structured JSON benchmark events, plus metric filters that pull
  memory, throughput and concurrency metrics out of those events.

# Expected JSON benchmark result event fields:
#   language          - "java" | "dotnet" | "python" | "go" | "rust"
#   test_type         - "memory" | "throughput" | "concurrency"
#   data_size         - payload size in bytes (number)
#   memory_efficiency - memory efficiency ratio (number, memory tests)
#   peak_memory_mb    - peak memory usage in megabytes (number, memory tests)
#   p50_latency_ms    - 50th percentile latency in milliseconds (number)
#   p95_latency_ms    - 95th percentile latency in milliseconds (number)
#   p99_latency_ms    - 99th percentile latency in milliseconds (number)

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/db-esdk/performance-benchmarks
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]{1,512}$'
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives benchmark result events.

Resources:
  BenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Java
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  JavaMemoryEfficiencyFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-java-memory-efficiency"
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.language = "java") && ($.test_type = "memory") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricNamespace: DB-ESDK-Performance/Java
          MetricValue: $.memory_efficiency
          Unit: None
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaPeakMemoryFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-java-peak-memory"
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.language = "java") && ($.test_type = "memory") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: PeakMemoryUsage
          MetricNamespace: DB-ESDK-Performance/Java
          MetricValue: $.peak_memory_mb
          Unit: Megabytes
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaThroughputP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-java-throughput-p50-latency"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Data Master project – IAM roles for the ingestion-to-analytics data pipeline

# This template creates only AWS::IAM::Role resources and their inline policies.
# It does not create KMS keys, VPCs, buckets, streams, secrets or other non-IAM
# resources. Deploy it with CAPABILITY_IAM.
#
# Role names: no role sets an explicit RoleName, so CloudFormation generates
# unique names. This avoids name collisions and the need for
# CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.
# AWS DMS looks for a role named exactly "dms-vpc-role" when it manages VPC
# resources itself. If you need that automatic behavior, add
# "RoleName: dms-vpc-role" to DmsVpcRole only, and deploy with
# CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of an existing KMS key used to encrypt raw data. If you leave it empty, KMS permissions are scoped to the keys in this account and region.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid KMS key ARN.

  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 12-digit AWS account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole trust conditions. If you leave it empty, the current account is used.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.

Conditions:
  HasKmsKeyArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]
  HasTargetAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetAccountId, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS VPC management role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - DMS VPC management role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDmsAssumeRoleScopedToTargetAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS -> Kinesis target role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - DMS role for writing to Kinesis Data Streams
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-dms-kinesis-write
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KinesisWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Sid: KmsEncryptForStream
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Pipes: Kinesis -> Firehose
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PipesFirehoseRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - EventBridge Pipes role for forwarding data to Firehose
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-pipes-firehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KinesisSourceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Sid: FirehoseTargetWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/dm-*
              - Sid: KmsDecryptSource
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Kinesis Data Firehose delivery role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FirehoseAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Firehose delivery role for raw data lake ingestion
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-firehose-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Delivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KinesisSourceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
              - Sid: TransformLambdaInvoke
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*:*
              - Sid: FormatConversionGlueCatalog
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTableVersion
                  - glue:GetTableVersions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/dm_*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/dm_*/*
              - Sid: DeliveryErrorLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/dm-*:log-stream:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda processing controller
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProcessingControllerFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Lambda processing controller execution role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-processing-controller
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3DataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
              - Sid: StartOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                Resource:

              - Sid: S3ReadForCrawling
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess

        - Key: Project

        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueEtlJobRole:

      Description: Data Master - Glue ETL job role

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*

        - Key: Component

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*

                  - kms:GenerateDataKey

          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

                  - s3:GetBucketLocation

                  - kms:GenerateDataKey

                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket

                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataEncryption

                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey

              - Sid: GlueCatalogAccess

                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/dm_*

              - Sid: JobLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/emr-serverless/dm-*
              - Sid: LakeFormationDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions orchestration role (only role that references other roles)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsOrchestrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Step Functions pipeline orchestration role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-stepfunctions-orchestration
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*:*

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:StartCrawler
                  - glue:GetCrawler
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:crawler/dm-*
              - Sid: EcsRunTask
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:RunTask
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:task-definition/dm-*:*
              - Sid: EcsTaskControl
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - ecs:DescribeTasks

              - Sid: EmrServerlessJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - emr-serverless:StartJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:GetJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:CancelJobRun
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:emr-serverless:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:/applications/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:emr-serverless:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:/applications/*/jobruns/*
              - Sid: SyncIntegrationRules
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutTargets
                  - events:PutRule
                  - events:DescribeRule
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/StepFunctionsGetEventsForECSTaskRule
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/StepFunctionsGetEventsForEMRServerlessJobRule

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:

                  - !GetAtt WorkerRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt EmrServerlessJobRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:

                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments

                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GrafanaMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Amazon Managed Grafana monitoring role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

        Statement:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Monitors the health of a cross-region failover Remittance application using CloudWatch metric alarms aggregated into API Gateway, Lambda and RDS composite alarms.

Resources:
  ApiGateway4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Average 4XX error rate for the Remittance API is above 0 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGateway5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Average 5XX error rate for the Remittance API is above 1 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Average latency for the Remittance API is at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
