final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight Admin Suite monitoring and data-extraction pipeline. Creates a private
  output S3 bucket encrypted with a customer managed KMS key, a single IAM role,
  seven scheduled AWS Glue jobs (five Python shell, two Spark ETL) that collect
  QuickSight asset access, asset metadata, folder, Q topic, Q access, dataset and
  data source details, and five CloudWatch metric streams that deliver QuickSight
  metrics to S3 through Kinesis Data Firehose DirectPut delivery streams.

# NOTE ON GLUE SCRIPTS:
# There is no pre-existing script bucket in this account. All Glue job scripts
# are expected under the glue-scripts/ prefix of the bucket created by this
# template: s3://admin-suite-<AccountId>/glue-scripts/<job_name>.py
# AWS Glue does not check that the script exists when a job is created, so you
# can upload the scripts after the stack is deployed. Until you do, scheduled
# runs will fail. Objects in the bucket are encrypted with the AdminSuiteKey
# customer managed KMS key, so whoever uploads the scripts needs
# kms:GenerateDataKey on that key.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key
  # The key policy does not reference AdminSuiteRole, which avoids a circular
  # dependency. The role gets key access through its own IAM policy, which the
  # account root statement allows.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the QuickSight Admin Suite bucket, Firehose delivery and logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AdminSuiteKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/admin-suite
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Output bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowAdminSuiteRoleAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role (Glue, CloudFormation, Firehose, CloudWatch metric streams)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'AdminSuiteRole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role for the QuickSight Admin Suite Glue jobs, Firehose delivery streams and CloudWatch metric streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteQuickSightRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteGlue
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueJobAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/etl_job_admin_suite_*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trigger/trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteS3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BucketLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ObjectLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource: !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteKms
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseAdminSuiteKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/admin-suite:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteFirehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: FirehoseDeliveryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteIAM
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IAMReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetUser
                  - iam:GetGroup
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListUsers
                  - iam:ListGroups
                  - iam:ListGroupsForUser
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassOwnRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/AdminSuiteRole-${AWS::Region}'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService':
                      - glue.amazonaws.com
                      - firehose.amazonaws.com
                      - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Python shell jobs (Python 3.9, Glue 3.0)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Collects QuickSight asset access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/glue-scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--S3_OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteBucket}/glue-temp/'
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminSuite
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  AssetsMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Collects QuickSight asset metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:

  IngestionDeliveryStream:

        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn

        Prefix: monitoring/quicksight/ingestion_metrics/

        BufferingHints:

          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:

        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: true
          LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
          LogStreamName: !Ref IngestionLogStream
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy

  # under AWS/QuickSight. If they are published elsewhere, the streams still
  # deploy but deliver no data.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IngestionMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-ingestion-metric-stream
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt IngestionDeliveryStream.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

        - Key: Project

        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ActionMetricStream:

    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-action-metric-stream
      OutputFormat: json

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless Kitten CRUD API using Amazon API Gateway with direct DynamoDB service integrations (no Lambda), on-demand DynamoDB billing, request validation, and full CORS support.

Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by API Gateway to call DynamoDB directly for the Kitten API
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  KittenApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenApi
      Description: Serverless CRUD API for the Kitten service
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  KittenModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: KittenModel
      Description: Request body schema for creating or replacing a Kitten
      ContentType: application/json
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: KittenModel
        type: object
        properties:
          name:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          color:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
        required:
          - name
          - color

  KittenRequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: KittenBodyAndParamsValidator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  CreateKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref KittenRequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref KittenModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Item": {
                "KittenId": {"S": "$context.requestId"},
                "name": {"S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.name')).replaceAll("\\'","'")"},
                "color": {"S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.color')).replaceAll("\\'","'")"}
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '201'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "KittenId": "$context.requestId"
                }
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"error": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"error": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '201'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  ListKittensMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/Scan'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                #set($inputRoot = $input.path('$'))
                [
                #foreach($elem in $inputRoot.Items)
                  {
                    "KittenId": "$util.escapeJavaScript($elem.KittenId.S).replaceAll("\\'","'")",
                    "name": "$util.escapeJavaScript($elem.name.S).replaceAll("\\'","'")",
                    "color": "$util.escapeJavaScript($elem.color.S).replaceAll("\\'","'")"
                  }#if($foreach.hasNext),#end
                #end
                ]
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"error": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"error": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  GetKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref KittenRequestValidator
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.id: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/GetItem'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Key": {
                "KittenId": {"S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('id')).replaceAll("\\'","'")"}
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:

            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                #set($inputRoot = $input.path('$'))
                #if("$!inputRoot.Item" == "" || $inputRoot.Item.isEmpty())
                #set($context.responseOverride.status = 404)
                {
                  "error": "Kitten not found"
                }
                #else
                {
                  "KittenId": "$util.escapeJavaScript($inputRoot.Item.KittenId.S).replaceAll("\\'","'")",
                  "name": "$util.escapeJavaScript($inputRoot.Item.name.S).replaceAll("\\'","'")",
                  "color": "$util.escapeJavaScript($inputRoot.Item.color.S).replaceAll("\\'","'")"
                }
                #end

            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:

            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"error": "Internal server error"}'

        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '404'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  UpdateKittenMethod:

      HttpMethod: PUT

      RequestValidatorId: !Ref KittenRequestValidator

        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Item": {
                "KittenId": {"S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('id')).replaceAll("\\'","'")"},
                "name": {"S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.name')).replaceAll("\\'","'")"},
                "color": {"S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.color')).replaceAll("\\'","'")"}
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "KittenId": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('id')).replaceAll("\\'","'")",
                  "message": "Kitten replaced"

          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:

            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        StartAt: PassState
        States:
          PassState:
            Type: Pass
            Result: 1
            End: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
      Description: Initial version of the Pass state machine

  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: live
      Description: Alias that sends all traffic to the published version
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  # API Gateway trigger
  ApiGatewayStartExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets API Gateway start executions on the state machine alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: StepFunctionsStartExecutionApi
      Description: REST API that starts executions on the state machine alias
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  ExecuteResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  ExecuteGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ExecuteResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      # NONE is used because the request asks for it. Use AWS_IAM in production.
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStartExecutionRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub '{"stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}"}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ExecuteGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment of the StartExecution API

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage
      TracingEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  # EventBridge rule for executions that end without success
  TerminatedRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets the terminated-state-change rule start executions on the alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  TerminatedStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the alias when a Step Functions execution is aborted, fails or times out
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.states
        detail-type:
          - Step Functions Execution Status Change
        detail:
          status:
            - ABORTED
            - FAILED
            - TIMED_OUT
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TerminatedRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge rule that runs every minute (starts disabled)
  ScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets the scheduled rule start executions on the alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the alias every minute (disabled at creation)
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt ScheduledRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge rule for AWS Tag service events
  TagRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets the tag-event rule start executions on the alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  TagEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the alias on AWS Tag service tag change events
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - Tag Change on Resource
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TagRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge Scheduler trigger
  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets EventBridge Scheduler start executions on the alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  StateMachineSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the alias every minute
      GroupName: default
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: ENABLED
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: 'OFF'
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn

    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineVersionArn:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the IAM bootstrap resources for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) on
  Amazon EKS. Creates four IAM roles, three instance profiles, four managed
  policies attached to those roles, and one standalone read-only EKS console
  policy. This template sets fixed RoleName, InstanceProfileName and
  ManagedPolicyName values, so you must deploy it with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMRoleControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA control-plane role assumed by EC2 control-plane instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  AWSIAMRoleNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA nodes role assumed by EC2 worker instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  AWSIAMRoleControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA controllers role assumed by EC2 instances and EKS Pod Identity.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession

  AWSIAMRoleEKSControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-controlplane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA EKS control plane service role assumed by Amazon EKS.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance Profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMInstanceProfileControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControllers

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleNodes

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policy: legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider (control plane)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyCloudProviderControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Permissions for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider running on CAPA control-plane nodes.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudProviderAutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudProviderEC2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudProviderLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudProviderELBServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: CloudProviderKMS
            Effect: Allow
            Action: kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policy: node registration and image pulls (control plane + nodes)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyCloudProviderNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Permissions for CAPA cluster nodes to register, pull images, read bootstrap data and use SSM.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleNodes
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: NodesEC2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: NodesECR
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
              - ecr:ListImages
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: NodesBootstrapSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: NodesSSM
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
              - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
            Resource: '*'

    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:

        Statement:

            Effect: Allow

            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: autoscaling.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ControllersELBServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ControllersSpotServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/spot.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForEC2Spot'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: spot.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ControllersPassCAPARoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io'
          - Sid: ControllersBootstrapSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:TagResource
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          # Public AWS-owned SSM parameters have an empty account field in their ARN.
          - Sid: ControllersEKSOptimizedAMIParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*::parameter/aws/service/eks/optimized-ami/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policy: EKS-specific controller permissions (controllers + control plane)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Omitted on purpose (objective 25): these EKS actions are not certain to be
  # valid in the current IAM service authorization reference, or CAPA does not
  # need them for bootstrap:
  #   - eks:DescribeClusterVersions
  #   - eks:CreatePodIdentityAssociation, eks:DescribePodIdentityAssociation,
  #     eks:UpdatePodIdentityAssociation, eks:DeletePodIdentityAssociation,
  #     eks:ListPodIdentityAssociations
  # Add them after you confirm them against the IAM service authorization reference.
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyControllersEKS:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers-eks.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: EKS-specific permissions for the Cluster API AWS controllers to manage EKS clusters, node groups, add-ons and Fargate profiles.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControllers
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSOptimizedAMIParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*::parameter/aws/service/eks/optimized-ami/*'
          - Sid: EKSServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: eks.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EKSNodegroupServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSNodegroup'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EKSFargateServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSForFargate'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EKSOIDCProviders
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:AddClientIDToOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:CreateOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:DeleteOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:GetOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:TagOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:UpdateOpenIDConnectProviderThumbprint
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:oidc-provider/*'
          - Sid: EKSListOIDCProviders
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:ListOpenIDConnectProviders
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSManageRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:TagRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
          - Sid: EKSGetManagedPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:GetPolicy
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'
          - Sid: EKSClusterAndAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:AssociateEncryptionConfig
              - eks:AssociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:ListUpdates
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:nodegroup/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:access-entry/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:identityproviderconfig/*'
          - Sid: EKSLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:DisassociateVpcCidrBlock
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:CreateFargateProfile
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListAccessPolicies
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:UpdateAddon
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSPassRoleToEKS
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: eks.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EKSKMSEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                kms:ResourceAliases: alias/cluster-api-provider-aws-*

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standalone Managed Policy: read-only EKS console access for human users
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyEKSConsole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: EKSConsole.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Read-only console visibility into EKS clusters, node groups and workloads. Attach to human users or groups as needed.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSConsoleReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:ListUpdates
              - ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: '*'

Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA control-plane IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt AWSIAMRoleControlPlane.Arn
  NodesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA nodes IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt AWSIAMRoleNodes.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt AWSIAMRoleControllers.Arn
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA control-plane instance profile.

  ControllersInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers instance profile.
    Value: !GetAtt AWSIAMInstanceProfileControllers.Arn
  NodesInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA nodes instance profile.
    Value: !GetAtt AWSIAMInstanceProfileNodes.Arn
  CloudProviderControlPlanePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the in-tree cloud provider control-plane managed policy.
    Value: !Ref AWSIAMManagedPolicyCloudProviderControlPlane
  CloudProviderNodesPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the nodes managed policy.
    Value: !Ref AWSIAMManagedPolicyCloudProviderNodes
  ControllersPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the controllers managed policy.

  ControllersEKSPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS controllers managed policy.
    Value: !Ref AWSIAMManagedPolicyControllersEKS
  EKSConsolePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the standalone read-only EKS console managed policy.

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Two-AZ VPC networking foundation with managed NAT gateways, VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs, and S3 gateway plus ECR interface VPC endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /22.
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC (prefix /16 to /22).
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days to retain VPC flow log events in CloudWatch Logs.
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in VPC flow logs.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: PublicAddressing
          Value: Explicit only - attach an Elastic IP or front with a load balancer

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: PublicAddressing
          Value: Explicit only - attach an Elastic IP or front with a load balancer

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver flow log records to the stack's CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogGroup}:log-stream:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-log-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS restricted to the VPC CIDR range
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from within the VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: First Availability Zone used by the network
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZ1'
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Second Availability Zone used by the network
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZ2'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1 (AZ 1); public IPs are not auto-assigned, request them explicitly
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2 (AZ 2); public IPs are not auto-assigned, request them explicitly

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provides VPC networking for the KerberosEMRonEKS Microsoft AD infrastructure, including public and private subnets, NAT Gateways, encrypted VPC flow logs and private interface endpoints for SSM, SSM Messages, EC2 Messages and Secrets Manager.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatEIP1

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatEIP2

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGW1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGW2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicRT

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRT1

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRT2

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting KerberosEMRonEKS VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogKey

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/KerberosEMRonEKS-flowlogs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogGroup

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogGroup}:log-stream:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogRole

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCFlowLog

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpoints-SG
      GroupDescription: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpoints-SG - HTTPS access to VPC interface endpoints from within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS from the VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS to the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpoints-SG

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the KerberosEMRonEKS VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCId

  VPCCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the KerberosEMRonEKS VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCCidr

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1Id

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2Id

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1Id

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2Id

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 1
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway1Id

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 2
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway2Id

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the shared VPC endpoint security group
    Value: !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpointSecurityGroupId

  FlowLogKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt VPC flow logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogKmsKeyArn

  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group receiving VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogGroupName

  SSMEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the SSM interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref SSMEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSMEndpointId

  SSMMessagesEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the SSM Messages interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref SSMMessagesEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSMMessagesEndpointId

  EC2MessagesEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the EC2 Messages interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref EC2MessagesEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-EC2MessagesEndpointId

  SecretsManagerEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Secrets Manager interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref SecretsManagerEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-SecretsManagerEndpointId
