  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:

  NatGateway1:

  NatEip2:

    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-eip-az3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3:

    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-az3'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable

      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway

      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If
        - CreatePerAzNat
        - !Ref NatGateway2
        - !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If
        - CreatePerAzNat
        - !Ref NatGateway3
        - !Ref NatGateway1

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting OpenSearch VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flowlogs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver logs to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryToCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}:log-stream:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Isolated private VPC for an AI-powered customer support application. Three private
  subnets across three AZs, no internet path, gateway and interface VPC endpoints for
  AWS services, KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs, and per-component security groups.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-support
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 3-32 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used as a prefix for resource names and Name tags.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-4])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /24.
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC. Three /24 subnets are derived from it.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and private networking (no IGW, NAT, EIP, public subnets or default routes)
  # Note: The VPC's default security group cannot have its rules removed with native
  # CloudFormation properties. No resource in this template is attached to it.
  # Handle it later with a separate remediation if required.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrefixListLookupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-prefix-list-lookup'
      RetentionInDays: 365

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-prefix-list-lookup-logs'
        - Key: Environment

        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support

  PrefixListLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-prefix-list-lookup-role'
      Description: Execution role for the managed prefix list lookup custom resource.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-prefix-list-lookup'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-prefix-list-lookup-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support

  PrefixListLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-prefix-list-lookup'
      Description: Resolves AWS-managed prefix list IDs for DynamoDB and S3 in the current region.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PrefixListLookupLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def lookup(ec2, name):
              resp = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(
                  Filters=[{"Name": "prefix-list-name", "Values": [name]}]
              )
              lists = resp.get("PrefixLists", [])
              if not lists:
                  raise ValueError("Managed prefix list not found: " + name)
              return lists[0]["PrefixListId"]

          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "managed-prefix-list-lookup")
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  region = event["ResourceProperties"]["Region"]
                  ec2 = boto3.client("ec2", region_name=region)
                  data = {
                      "DynamoDbPrefixListId": lookup(ec2, "com.amazonaws." + region + ".dynamodb"),
                      "S3PrefixListId": lookup(ec2, "com.amazonaws." + region + ".s3"),
                  }
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print("Error: " + str(exc))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc))
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-prefix-list-lookup'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support

  ManagedPrefixLists:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupFunction.Arn
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a three-AZ VPC with public and private subnets, NAT Gateways, and security groups for hosting an Amazon EKS cluster.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General Configuration
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PublicSubnet3Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet3Cidr

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Name prefix used to tag all resources.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.

  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the third Availability Zone.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.64.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.96.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the third Availability Zone.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways and Elastic IPs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-3'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing (one route table per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3'

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Communication between the EKS control plane and worker nodes
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS to the Kubernetes API server from within the VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound traffic to worker nodes within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-control-plane-sg'

  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt ControlPlaneSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt ControlPlaneSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      Description: Allow all traffic between the control plane and worker nodes sharing this security group

  ApplicationSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Application and ingress or service mesh gateway ports exposed to the internet
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow HTTP from the internet
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow HTTPS from the internet
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow alternate HTTP for the ingress gateway
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8443
          ToPort: 8443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow alternate HTTPS for the ingress gateway
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15021
          ToPort: 15021
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow service mesh gateway health checks
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15443
          ToPort: 15443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow service mesh gateway mTLS traffic
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound traffic to backend pods and nodes within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-application-sg'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the EKS control plane security group
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPlaneSecurityGroupId'

  ApplicationSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the application security group
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApplicationSecurityGroupId'

  SubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of all public and private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SubnetIds'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates the IAM execution role and its policies for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster that runs on Amazon EKS, along with a dedicated VPC, private subnets, security group, KMS-encrypted lifecycle scripts S3 bucket, and its customer managed KMS key.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod-eks
    Description: Prefix used for resource names. The execution role is named by appending "ExecRole" to this prefix.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 56
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with an alphanumeric character, contain only alphanumerics and hyphens, and be at most 56 characters.
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod-eks-cluster
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster used to scope the eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity permission.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 100
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the HyperPod VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  RigInputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name of the RIG input S3 bucket.
  RigOutputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name of a separate RIG output S3 bucket.
  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the RIG policy.
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to grant gated access permissions (S3 access points and SQS) in the RIG policy.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateRigResources: !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
  HasRigInputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputS3Bucket, '']]
  HasRigOutputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputS3Bucket, '']]
  IsGatedAccessEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  CreateRigPolicy: !And
    - !Condition ShouldCreateRigResources
    - !Condition HasRigInputBucket
  GrantGatedAccess: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Condition IsGatedAccessEnabled
  GrantRigOutputAccess: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Condition HasRigOutputBucket

Resources:
  HyperPodVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-vpc'
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  HyperPodSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker HyperPod cluster nodes
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-sg'
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  HyperPodSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow all traffic between HyperPod nodes in this security group

  LifecycleScriptsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the SageMaker HyperPod lifecycle scripts S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3UseOfKeyWithinAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  LifecycleScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  LifecycleScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  HyperPodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
      Description: Execution role for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with Amazon EKS
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-EKSCNIPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EKSCNIDescribeAndAttach
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EKSCNICreateTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-ExecutionRolePolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EniManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${HyperPodVPC}'
              - Sid: Ec2ReadNetworking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPullImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchDescribeAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksPodIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EKSClusterName}'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsGet
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsKmsDecrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  RigPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRigPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-RigPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RigInputList

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Private subnet tier with NAT egress and an S3 gateway endpoint. Creates a VPC,
  internet gateway, three public subnets hosting per-AZ NAT gateways, three private
  subnets with dedicated route tables defaulting to their same-AZ NAT gateway, a
  shared network ACL for the private subnets, and an S3 gateway VPC endpoint
  attached to all private route tables.

Mappings:
  CidrConfig:
    Vpc:
      Cidr: 10.24.0.0/16
    PublicSubnetA:
      Cidr: 10.24.0.0/24
    PublicSubnetB:
      Cidr: 10.24.1.0/24
    PublicSubnetC:
      Cidr: 10.24.2.0/24
    PrivateSubnetA:
      Cidr: 10.24.24.0/24
    PrivateSubnetB:
      Cidr: 10.24.25.0/24
    PrivateSubnetC:
      Cidr: 10.24.26.0/24
    PrivateGroup:
      Cidr: 10.24.24.0/21

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets (host NAT gateways only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PublicSubnetA, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PublicSubnetB, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PublicSubnetC, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT gateways (one per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEipA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatEipB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatEipC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PrivateSubnetA, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PrivateSubnetB, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PrivateSubnetC, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private route tables, default routes via same-AZ NAT, associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  PrivateSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network ACL for private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-nacl'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # Inbound: HTTPS between tiers inside the VPC
  PrivateNaclInboundHttpsVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # Inbound: TCP return traffic for NAT/S3 egress on ephemeral ports
  PrivateNaclInboundEphemeralTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Inbound: UDP return traffic on ephemeral ports (e.g. NTP)
  PrivateNaclInboundEphemeralUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Outbound: HTTPS via NAT gateways and to the S3 gateway endpoint
  PrivateNaclOutboundHttps:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # Outbound: HTTP via NAT gateways for OS and package repositories
  PrivateNaclOutboundHttp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  # Outbound: external NTP via NAT gateways
  PrivateNaclOutboundNtp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 123
        To: 123

  # Outbound: TCP replies to intra-VPC connections accepted by inbound rules
  PrivateNaclOutboundEphemeralTcpVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Outbound: UDP replies to intra-VPC traffic on ephemeral ports
  PrivateNaclOutboundEphemeralUdpVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PrivateSubnetANetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnetBNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnetCNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 gateway endpoint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: FullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-endpoint'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

Outputs:
  PrivateSubnets:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs (A, B, C)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnetA, !Ref PrivateSubnetB, !Ref PrivateSubnetC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnets'

  PrivateRouteTables:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private route table IDs (A, B, C)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateRouteTableA, !Ref PrivateRouteTableB, !Ref PrivateRouteTableC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTables'

  PrivateSubnetGroupCidr:
    Description: CIDR block covering the private subnet group
    Value: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PrivateGroup, Cidr]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetGroupCidr'

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created by this stack
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  NetworkAclId:
    Description: ID of the network ACL associated with the private subnets
    Value: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-NetworkAclId'

  S3EndpointId:
    Description: ID of the S3 gateway VPC endpoint
    Value: !Ref S3VpcEndpoint

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an IAM baseline of persona groups, roles, instance profiles and
  managed policies (SysAdmin, IAMAdmin, InstanceOps, ReadOnlyAdmin,
  ReadOnlyBilling) with MFA, billing-console and logging-KMS guardrails.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KNOWN LIMITATIONS
# 1. Instance profile (EC2 role) credentials never carry
#    aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true. Every Allow statement in the non-billing
#    policies needs MFA, so those policies grant nothing when used through an
#    instance profile. The EC2 roles and instance profiles exist only to meet
#    the baseline requirement. Remove the MFA condition from a role-specific
#    policy if workloads really need it.
# 2. The logging KMS protection matches keys that have an alias starting with
#    "alias/logging" or that carry the tag Purpose=logging. Keys with neither
#    are not protected. This template creates no logging key and references no
#    key ARN.
# 3. The IAMAdmin persona has iam:* and can change its own permissions,
#    including these policies. Treat that persona as fully privileged.
# 4. The SysAdmin persona uses NotAction on iam:*. It can still call
#    sts:AssumeRole on any role whose trust policy allows the account root,
#    including IAMAdminRole. Narrow the role trust policies if that matters.
# 5. DenyBillingConsole covers account:*, so the non-billing personas also
#    cannot manage account contact details or Regions.
# 6. ReadOnlyAdmin uses an enumerated read-only action set rather than the
#    AWS-managed ReadOnlyAccess policy. Services not listed are not visible.
# 7. Managed policies are limited to 6,144 characters. Adding more actions may
#    require splitting a persona across more than one policy.
# 8. Deploy with CAPABILITY_IAM. Names are generated by CloudFormation.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SysAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: System administrator persona - near-full access outside of IAM, MFA required.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAllExceptIam
            Effect: Allow
            NotAction:
              - 'iam:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Sid: AllowIamReadAndPassRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:Get*'
              - 'iam:List*'
              - 'iam:PassRole'
              - 'iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
              - 'payments:*'
              - 'tax:*'
              - 'invoicing:*'
              - 'purchase-orders:*'
              - 'consolidatedbilling:*'
              - 'freetier:*'
              - 'account:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action: &LoggingKmsActions
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                kms:ResourceAliases: 'alias/logging*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTamperingByTag
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: logging
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsAliasModification
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging*'

  IAMAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: IAM administrator persona - full IAM access, MFA required.

        Version: '2012-10-17'

              - 'access-analyzer:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:

              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'

              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'

            Resource: '*'
            Condition:

                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: logging
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsAliasModification
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging*'

              - 'kms:GetKeyRotationStatus'
              - 'sns:Get*'
              - 'sns:List*'
              - 'sqs:GetQueueAttributes'
              - 'sqs:GetQueueUrl'
              - 'sqs:List*'
              - 'route53:Get*'
              - 'route53:List*'
              - 'cloudfront:Get*'
              - 'cloudfront:List*'
              - 'elasticache:Describe*'
              - 'ecs:Describe*'
              - 'ecs:List*'
              - 'eks:Describe*'
              - 'eks:List*'
              - 'ecr:Describe*'
              - 'ssm:Describe*'
              - 'ssm:List*'
              - 'secretsmanager:ListSecrets'
              - 'secretsmanager:DescribeSecret'
              - 'guardduty:Get*'
              - 'guardduty:List*'
              - 'securityhub:Describe*'
              - 'securityhub:Get*'
              - 'securityhub:List*'
              - 'tag:Get*'
              - 'sts:GetCallerIdentity'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
              - 'payments:*'
              - 'tax:*'
              - 'invoicing:*'
              - 'purchase-orders:*'
              - 'consolidatedbilling:*'
              - 'freetier:*'
              - 'account:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                kms:ResourceAliases: 'alias/logging*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTamperingByTag
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: logging
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsAliasModification
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging*'

  ReadOnlyBillingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Read-only billing persona - view billing, usage, cost and budget information only.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBillingReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:ViewBilling'
              - 'aws-portal:ViewUsage'
              - 'billing:Get*'
              - 'billing:List*'
              - 'ce:Get*'
              - 'ce:Describe*'
              - 'ce:List*'
              - 'cur:DescribeReportDefinitions'
              - 'budgets:ViewBudget'
              - 'budgets:Describe*'
              - 'invoicing:Get*'
              - 'invoicing:List*'
              - 'payments:Get*'
              - 'payments:List*'
              - 'tax:Get*'
              - 'tax:List*'
              - 'consolidatedbilling:Get*'
              - 'consolidatedbilling:List*'
              - 'freetier:Get*'
              - 'account:GetAccountInformation'
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SysAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SysAdminPolicy

  IAMAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdminPolicy

  InstanceOpsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminPolicy

  ReadOnlyBillingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingPolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SysAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: System administrator persona role (EC2 and MFA-authenticated account principals).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2Assume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsWithMfa
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SysAdminPolicy

  IAMAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM administrator persona role (EC2 and MFA-authenticated account principals).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2Assume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsWithMfa
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdminPolicy

  InstanceOpsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Instance operations persona role (EC2 and MFA-authenticated account principals).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2Assume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsWithMfa
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Read-only administrator persona role (EC2 and MFA-authenticated account principals).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2Assume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsWithMfa
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminPolicy

  ReadOnlyBillingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Read-only billing persona role (MFA-authenticated account principals only, not EC2).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsWithMfa
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingPolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance profiles (one per EC2-assumable role)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SysAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref SysAdminRole

  IAMAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMAdminRole

  InstanceOpsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsRole

  ReadOnlyAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminRole

Outputs:
  SysAdminGroupId:
    Description: Name of the system administrator group.
    Value: !Ref SysAdminGroup
  SysAdminGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the system administrator group.
    Value: !GetAtt SysAdminGroup.Arn
  IAMAdminGroupId:
    Description: Name of the IAM administrator group.
    Value: !Ref IAMAdminGroup
  IAMAdminGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM administrator group.
    Value: !GetAtt IAMAdminGroup.Arn
  InstanceOpsGroupId:
    Description: Name of the instance operations group.
    Value: !Ref InstanceOpsGroup
  InstanceOpsGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the instance operations group.
    Value: !GetAtt InstanceOpsGroup.Arn
  ReadOnlyAdminGroupId:
    Description: Name of the read-only administrator group.
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyAdminGroup
  ReadOnlyAdminGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the read-only administrator group.
    Value: !GetAtt ReadOnlyAdminGroup.Arn
  ReadOnlyBillingGroupId:
    Description: Name of the read-only billing group.
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyBillingGroup
  ReadOnlyBillingGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the read-only billing group.
    Value: !GetAtt ReadOnlyBillingGroup.Arn
