final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Three-tier (web, application, database) VPC spanning three Availability Zones.
  The VPC uses 10.0.0.0/16 with one subnet per tier per AZ. The web tier shares one
  route table whose default route points to an Internet Gateway. Each AZ has its own
  NAT Gateway with an Elastic IP in its web subnet. Each application and database
  subnet has its own route table with a default route through the NAT Gateway in the
  same AZ.

# Notes:
# - This template does not create tier security groups or network ACLs. You could
#   add them later, for example web, application and database security groups that
#   allow only the traffic each tier needs.
# - Web subnets do not auto-assign public IPs (MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false) to meet
#   the AWS-0164 control. The web tier is still internet-routable through the
#   Internet Gateway route. Public-facing web workloads should get a public address
#   explicitly: by requesting one at launch, with an Elastic IP, or behind an
#   internet-facing load balancer.

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    VPC:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
    Web1:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/24
    Web2:
      CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
    Web3:
      CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24
    App1:
      CIDR: 10.0.10.0/24
    App2:
      CIDR: 10.0.11.0/24
    App3:
      CIDR: 10.0.12.0/24
    Db1:
      CIDR: 10.0.20.0/24
    Db2:
      CIDR: 10.0.21.0/24
    Db3:
      CIDR: 10.0.22.0/24

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web1, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web2, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web3, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application tier subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App1, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App2, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App3, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database tier subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db1, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db2, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db3, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier routing (shared route table -> Internet Gateway)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-rt'

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az1'

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az2'

  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az3'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ, placed in the web subnet of that AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az3'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application tier routing (one route table per AZ -> NAT Gateway in the same AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az1'

  AppDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az2'

  AppDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az3'

  AppDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database tier routing (one route table per AZ -> NAT Gateway in the same AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared IAM roles and instance profiles for the Amazon EKS Quick Start.
  Deploy with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming configuration
        Parameters:
          - RolePrefix
          - SsmParameterPath
    ParameterLabels:
      RolePrefix:
        default: IAM role name prefix
      SsmParameterPath:
        default: SSM parameter path

Parameters:
  RolePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-quickstart
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens, maximum 20 characters.
    Description: Prefix applied to every IAM role and instance profile name.
  SsmParameterPath:
    Type: String
    Default: /quickstart/amazon-eks
    AllowedPattern: '^/[a-zA-Z0-9/_.-]+[^/]$'
    MaxLength: 200
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a slash and must not end with a slash.
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path under which role ARNs and instance profile values are stored.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CopyZips'
      Description: Lambda execution role that copies Quick Start zip artifacts between S3 buckets.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: copy-zips
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSourceArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::aws-quickstart*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: WriteDestinationArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: ListDestinationBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  ReadResourceInfoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ReadResourceInfo'
      Description: Lambda execution role with read-only access across the account.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  CreateVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CreateVpcRole'
      Description: Lambda execution role that creates the CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC IAM role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: create-vpc-role
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageKubernetesVpcRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
              - Sid: AttachApprovedManagedPoliciesOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess'
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-DeleteBucketContents'
      Description: Lambda execution role that empties Quick Start S3 buckets before deletion.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: delete-bucket-contents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*'
              - Sid: DeleteObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancers'
      Description: Lambda execution role that removes load balancers created by Kubernetes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-load-balancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CleanupLoadBalancers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupSecurityGroupDependencies'
      Description: Lambda execution role that removes security group dependencies.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-security-group-dependencies
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CleanupSecurityGroupDependencies
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  CleanupLambdasRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupLambdas'
      Description: Lambda execution role that removes VPC-attached Lambda functions and their ENIs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-lambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAndCleanupEnis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  GetCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-GetCallerArn'
      Description: Lambda execution role that resolves the ARN of the stack caller.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: get-caller-arn
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ResolveCaller
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadStackInfo
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  RegisterTypeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-RegisterType'
      Description: Lambda execution role that registers CloudFormation custom resource types.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: register-type
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageTypeRegistration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeConfiguration
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadSchemaHandlerPackages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::aws-quickstart*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: PassTypeExecutionRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${RolePrefix}-*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  NodeSGRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-NodeSG'
      Description: Lambda execution role that manages EKS node security group rules.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: node-security-group
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageSecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DescribeEksCluster
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-FargateProfile'
      Description: Lambda execution role that creates and deletes EKS Fargate profiles.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: fargate-profile
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageFargateProfiles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:ListFargateProfiles
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:TagResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:fargateprofile/*/*/*'
              - Sid: DescribeSubnets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassFargateExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: eks.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  ResolveSsmParameterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ResolveSsmParameter'
      Description: Lambda execution role that resolves SSM parameter values.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: resolve-ssm-parameter
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${SsmParameterPath}*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/aws/service/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ControlPlane'

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: control-plane-ec2-describe

            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeNetworking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-FargateExecution'
      Description: EKS Fargate pod execution role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: managed-node-cfn-signal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SignalStackCompletion
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-UnmanagedNodeInstance'
      Description: Instance role for self-managed EKS worker nodes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: unmanaged-node-cfn-signal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SignalStackCompletion
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ManagedNodeInstanceProfile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeInstanceRole

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC with web and app tier subnets across two AZs, a shared route table, and private S3 gateway and Kinesis interface endpoints.

# Note: An interface endpoint service may not be available in every AZ of a
# region. Kinesis Data Firehose in particular is limited in some AZs. If the
# deployment fails for this reason, change the AZ index used by the web subnets.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-vpc

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-web-subnet-1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  FirehoseInterfaceEndpoint:

      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  One-time, per-account stack of shared IAM prerequisites for many Amazon EKS
  clusters provisioned through Lambda-backed CloudFormation custom resources.
  Deploy once per account with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM; per-cluster stacks consume
  the exported role ARNs and instance profiles.

# NOTE: The custom-resource Lambda function code, the custom-resource
# ServiceTokens and the deployment-asset S3 buckets are all created by the
# per-cluster stacks. This stack only creates the shared IAM roles and
# instance profiles and exports their identifiers.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,23}$'
    MaxLength: 24
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters,
      digits and hyphens, and be 2-24 characters long.
    Description: >-
      Common name prefix used to derive every role, instance profile and
      export name in this stack.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda custom-resource execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CopyZipsRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that copies deployment assets between S3 buckets.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CopyZips
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSourceAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Sid: WriteDestinationAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: ListDestinationBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CopyZipsRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  # This handler is read-only by design: it only describes/reads arbitrary
  # AWS resources and is never granted any write permissions.
  ResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResourceReaderRole'
      Description: Read-only execution role for the custom resource that reads arbitrary AWS resources.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResourceReaderRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  CreateVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateVpcRoleRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that creates the VPC-related IAM role.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVpcRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManagePrefixedVpcRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateVpcRoleRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-DeleteBucketContentsRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that empties S3 buckets.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteBucketContents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListPrefixedBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*'
              - Sid: DeletePrefixedBucketObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-DeleteBucketContentsRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancersRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that removes orphaned load balancers, security groups and ENIs after cluster teardown.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLoadBalancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DeleteLoadBalancers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:loadbalancer/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:targetgroup/*'
              - Sid: DeleteDependentSecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*'
              - Sid: DeleteDependentNetworkInterfaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancersRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  CleanupLambdasRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLambdasRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that removes leftover Lambda functions and their ENIs.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DeleteLeftoverFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
              - Sid: DeleteLeftoverNetworkInterfaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLambdasRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  GetCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-GetCallerArnRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that looks up the calling identity.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GetCallerArn
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GetCallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-GetCallerArnRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  RegisterTypeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-RegisterTypeRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that registers CloudFormation resource provider types.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegisterType
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RegisterTypes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageRegisteredTypes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:type/resource/*'
              - Sid: ReadProviderPackages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: PassPrefixedRolesToCloudFormation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                      - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-RegisterTypeRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  ResolveParameterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResolveParameterRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that resolves SSM parameters under the common configuration path.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveParameter
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadConfigParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${NamePrefix}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${NamePrefix}/*'
              - Sid: DecryptSecureStringViaSsm
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResolveParameterRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  CreateCfnVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateCfnVpcRoleRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that creates the IAM role CloudFormation assumes to provision cluster VPC resources.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateCfnVpcRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManagePrefixedCfnVpcRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateCfnVpcRoleRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS control plane and Fargate roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ControlPlaneRole'
      Description: Role assumed by the Amazon EKS control plane.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ControlPlaneRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-FargateProfileRole'
      Description: Pod execution role assumed by Amazon EKS Fargate profiles.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:fargateprofile/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-FargateProfileRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2 worker node roles and instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ManagedNodeInstanceRole'
      Description: EC2 instance role for EKS managed node groups.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

Description: Creates a test IAM user and group whose credentials come from a Secrets Manager secret. Deploy with the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability.

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: "999hadvhgchjesr"
    Description: Identifier appended to the IAM group name.

Resources:
  MinesweeperUserSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: "Minesweeper user secret"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "minesweeper-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 15
        ExcludeCharacters: '|;,."<>%`'
        ExcludeLowercase: false
        ExcludeUppercase: false
        ExcludeNumbers: false
        RequireEachIncludedType: true

  # WARNING: This policy is broad on purpose because it is for testing only.
  # It does not follow least privilege and must not be used in production.
  MinesweeperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "minesweeper-${ID}"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: minesweeper-full-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ec2:*"
                  - "cloudformation:*"
                  - "secretsmanager:*"
                Resource: "*"

  # These dynamic references are allowed because they point to the secret this
  # template creates (through ${MinesweeperUserSecret}), not to a secret that
  # must already exist. The !Ref inside !Sub also makes CloudFormation create
  # the secret before the user, so no DependsOn is needed.
  MinesweeperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub "{{resolve:secretsmanager:${MinesweeperUserSecret}::username}}"
      LoginProfile:
        Password: !Sub "{{resolve:secretsmanager:${MinesweeperUserSecret}::password}}"
        PasswordResetRequired: false
      Groups:
        - !Ref MinesweeperGroup

Outputs:
  MinesweeperUserArn:
    Description: ARN of the Minesweeper test IAM user.
    Value: !GetAtt MinesweeperUser.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MinesweeperUserArn"

Description: Creates a DynamoDB table and an IAM managed policy for application data storage.

Parameters:
  App:
    Type: String
    Description: Application name.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 36
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-36 characters containing only letters, numbers and hyphens.
  Env:
    Type: String
    Description: Target environment name.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 36
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-36 characters containing only letters, numbers and hyphens.
  Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Workload name.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 36
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-36 characters containing only letters, numbers and hyphens.

Resources:
  BsDynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: bs
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: bs
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: App
          Value: !Ref App
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref Name

  BsDynamoDBCrudPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb-crud'
      Description: Grants CRUD access to the bs DynamoDB table and its indexes.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BsDynamoDBTable.Arn
              - !Sub '${BsDynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*'

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref BsDynamoDBTable
  PolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM managed policy granting CRUD access to the table.
    Value: !Ref BsDynamoDBCrudPolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a Transit Gateway network hub and a Resource Access Manager (RAM) resource share
  for enterprise network transit. When deployed in a spoke account, it instead resolves the
  shared Transit Gateway through a custom resource.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Stack Dependencies
        Parameters:
          - ReferenceFunctionsStackName
      - Label:
          default: Naming Convention
        Parameters:
          - CompanyName
          - SystemName
          - AccountName
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Transit Gateway Configuration
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayAccount
          - TransitGatewayASN
          - AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
          - DnsSupport
          - VpnEcmpSupport
      - Label:
          default: Resource Share Configuration
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayResourceShareName
          - Organization
          - AllowExternalPrincipals
      - Label:
          default: Account Configuration
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationAccount
          - JumpstartAccount
          - ManagementAccount
          - LogAccount
          - RecoveryAccount
          - BuildAccount
          - CoreAccount
          - ProductionAccount
          - StagingAccount
          - UATAccount
          - QAAccount
          - TestingAccount
          - DevelopmentAccount

Parameters:
  ReferenceFunctionsStackName:
    Description: Name of the CloudFormation Stack containing Reference Functions (used only in spoke accounts)
    Type: String
    Default: ReferenceFunctions

  CompanyName:
    Description: Company Name
    Type: String
    Default: Camelz

  SystemName:
    Description: System Name
    Type: String
    Default: Prototype

  AccountName:
    Description: Account Name
    Type: String
    Default: Core

  EnvironmentName:
    Description: Environment Name
    Type: String
    Default: Core

  TransitGatewayAccount:
    Description: Account ID owning the Transit Gateway. Leave empty when this account is the primary transit account.
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  TransitGatewayASN:
    Description: Private Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Amazon side of a BGP session
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534

  AutoAcceptSharedAttachments:
    Description: Automatically accept cross-account attachments
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  DnsSupport:
    Description: Enable DNS support
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  VpnEcmpSupport:
    Description: Enable Equal Cost Multipath Protocol support for VPN
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  TransitGatewayResourceShareName:
    Description: Name of the RAM Resource Share for the Transit Gateway
    Type: String
    Default: Core-TransitGatewayResourceShare

  Organization:
    Description: Organization ARN to share the Transit Gateway with. Leave empty to share with individual accounts only.
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:organizations::\d{12}:organization/o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid AWS Organizations organization ARN

  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Description: Allow principals outside the Organization. Forced to true when individual accounts are specified without an Organization.
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  OrganizationAccount:
    Description: Organization Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  JumpstartAccount:
    Description: Jumpstart Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  ManagementAccount:
    Description: Management Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  LogAccount:
    Description: Log Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  RecoveryAccount:
    Description: Recovery Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  BuildAccount:
    Description: Build Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  CoreAccount:
    Description: Core Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  ProductionAccount:
    Description: Production Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  StagingAccount:
    Description: Staging Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  UATAccount:
    Description: UAT Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  QAAccount:
    Description: QA Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  TestingAccount:
    Description: Testing Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  DevelopmentAccount:
    Description: Development Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

Conditions:
  IsPrimaryTransitAccount: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, '']
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
  IsSpokeAccount: !Not [!Condition IsPrimaryTransitAccount]
  HasOrganization: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Organization, '']]
  HasOrganizationAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationAccount, '']]
  HasJumpstartAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref JumpstartAccount, '']]
  HasManagementAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ManagementAccount, '']]
  HasLogAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogAccount, '']]
  HasRecoveryAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RecoveryAccount, '']]
  HasBuildAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BuildAccount, '']]
  HasCoreAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CoreAccount, '']]
  HasProductionAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ProductionAccount, '']]
  HasStagingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StagingAccount, '']]
  HasUATAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref UATAccount, '']]
  HasQAAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref QAAccount, '']]
  HasTestingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestingAccount, '']]
  HasDevelopmentAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, '']]
  HasAnyAccount: !Or
    - !Or
      - !Condition HasOrganizationAccount
      - !Condition HasJumpstartAccount
      - !Condition HasManagementAccount
      - !Condition HasLogAccount
      - !Condition HasRecoveryAccount
      - !Condition HasBuildAccount
      - !Condition HasCoreAccount
    - !Or
      - !Condition HasProductionAccount
      - !Condition HasStagingAccount
      - !Condition HasUATAccount
      - !Condition HasQAAccount
      - !Condition HasTestingAccount
      - !Condition HasDevelopmentAccount
  ForceExternalPrincipals: !And
    - !Condition HasAnyAccount
    - !Not [!Condition HasOrganization]

Resources:
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: !Ref AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: !Ref DnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref VpnEcmpSupport
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
        - Key: Company
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: System
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: Account
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals: !If
        - ForceExternalPrincipals
        - true
        - !Ref AllowExternalPrincipals
      ResourceArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway/${TransitGateway}'
      Principals:
        - !If [HasOrganization, !Ref Organization, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasOrganizationAccount, !Ref OrganizationAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasJumpstartAccount, !Ref JumpstartAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasManagementAccount, !Ref ManagementAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasLogAccount, !Ref LogAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasRecoveryAccount, !Ref RecoveryAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasBuildAccount, !Ref BuildAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasCoreAccount, !Ref CoreAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasProductionAccount, !Ref ProductionAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
