AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a dedicated Amazon SES SMTP IAM user (with group, scoped send-only policy and access key)
  and stores the derived SES SMTP credentials as SecureString parameters in SSM Parameter Store.
  Deploy with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM. Operator note - SES sending also requires a verified identity and
  production access (out of the SES sandbox), which this template does not create.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: SMTP User
        Parameters:
          - SmtpUserName
          - AccessKeyVersion
      - Label:
          default: Credential Generator
        Parameters:
          - LogRetentionInDays
          - KmsKeyArn
    ParameterLabels:
      SmtpUserName:
        default: IAM username for SES SMTP
      AccessKeyVersion:
        default: Access key rotation version
      LogRetentionInDays:
        default: Lambda log retention (days)
      KmsKeyArn:
        default: Optional customer-managed KMS key ARN

Parameters:
  SmtpUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters of letters, numbers and +=,.@_- only.
    Description: Name of the dedicated IAM user used for SES SMTP sending.

  AccessKeyVersion:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: >-
      Access key rotation counter. Increase this value to create a new access key and regenerate
      the stored SMTP credentials.

  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Retention period in days for the credential generator Lambda function logs.

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid KMS key ARN.
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of a customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the SSM SecureString parameters.
      Leave empty to use the AWS-managed key (alias/aws/ssm).

Conditions:
  UseCustomKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]

Resources:
  SmtpGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${SmtpUserName}-ses-smtp-group'

  SmtpGroupSendPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${SmtpUserName}-ses-send-email'
      Groups:
        - !Ref SmtpGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSesSendOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ses:SendEmail
              - ses:SendRawEmail
            Resource: '*'

  SmtpUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SmtpUserName
      Groups:
        - !Ref SmtpGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ses-smtp

  SmtpAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SmtpUser
      Serial: !Ref AccessKeyVersion
      Status: Active

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-ses-smtp-credential-generator'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WriteLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
        - PolicyName: ManageSmtpParameters
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses-smtp/${SmtpUserName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'
        - !If
          - UseCustomKmsKey
          - PolicyName: UseCustomKmsKey
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:Encrypt
                    - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  CredentialGeneratorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ses-smtp-credential-generator'
      Description: Converts an IAM secret access key into an SES SMTP password and stores it in SSM.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref LogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import logging

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")

          # Constants from the AWS published SES SMTP credential conversion algorithm.
          DATE = "11111111"
          SERVICE = "ses"
          TERMINAL = "aws4_request"
          MESSAGE = "SendRawEmail"
          VERSION = 0x04


          def _sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()


          def calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region):
              signature = _sign(("AWS4" + secret_access_key).encode("utf-8"), DATE)
              signature = _sign(signature, region)
              signature = _sign(signature, SERVICE)
              signature = _sign(signature, TERMINAL)
              signature = _sign(signature, MESSAGE)
              signature_and_version = bytes([VERSION]) + signature
              return base64.b64encode(signature_and_version).decode("utf-8")


          def _owner_tag(physical_id):
              return "Managed by CloudFormation custom resource " + physical_id


          def _put(name, value, description, kms_key_id):
              kwargs = {
                  "Name": name,
                  "Value": value,
                  "Type": "SecureString",
                  "Overwrite": True,
                  "Description": description,
              }
              if kms_key_id:
                  kwargs["KeyId"] = kms_key_id
              ssm.put_parameter(**kwargs)
              logger.info("Stored parameter %s", name)


          def _owned_by(name, physical_id):
              resp = ssm.describe_parameters(
                  ParameterFilters=[{"Key": "Name", "Option": "Equals", "Values": [name]}]
              )
              params = resp.get("Parameters", [])
              if not params:
                  return False
              return params[0].get("Description", "") == _owner_tag(physical_id)


          def _delete(name, physical_id):
              # Only delete if this resource instance still owns the parameter. A replacement that
              # reuses the same parameter name will have already re-tagged it with its own ID.
              try:
                  if not _owned_by(name, physical_id):
                      logger.info("Skipping delete of %s (not present or owned by newer resource)", name)
                      return
                  ssm.delete_parameter(Name=name)
                  logger.info("Deleted parameter %s", name)
              except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                  logger.info("Parameter %s not found, nothing to delete", name)


          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              user_name = props.get("UserName", "unknown")
              version = props.get("KeyVersion", "0")
              username_param = props.get("UsernameParameterName", "")
              password_param = props.get("PasswordParameterName", "")
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or "ses-smtp-{}-v{}".format(user_name, version)
              logger.info("Received %s request for parameters %s and %s",
                          request_type, username_param, password_param)

              try:
                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):
                      physical_id = "ses-smtp-{}-v{}".format(user_name, version)
                      access_key_id = props["AccessKeyId"]
                      secret_access_key = props["SecretAccessKey"]
                      region = props["Region"]
                      kms_key_id = props.get("KmsKeyId", "")

                      smtp_password = calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region)
                      description = _owner_tag(physical_id)
                      _put(username_param, access_key_id, description, kms_key_id)
                      _put(password_param, smtp_password, description, kms_key_id)
                  elif request_type == "Delete":
                      if username_param:
                          _delete(username_param, physical_id)
                      if password_param:
                          _delete(password_param, physical_id)

                  data = {
                      "UsernameParameterName": username_param,
                      "PasswordParameterName": password_param,
                  }
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.error("Failed to process %s request: %s", request_type, type(exc).__name__)
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {},
                      physical_id,
                      reason="Failed to process {} request: {}".format(request_type, type(exc).__name__),
                  )

  SesSmtpCredentials:
    Type: Custom::SesSmtpCredentials
    DependsOn:
      - SmtpGroupSendPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CredentialGeneratorFunction.Arn
      UserName: !Ref SmtpUserName
      KeyVersion: !Ref AccessKeyVersion
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SmtpAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SmtpAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region
      UsernameParameterName: !Sub '/ses-smtp/${SmtpUserName}/username'
      PasswordParameterName: !Sub '/ses-smtp/${SmtpUserName}/password'
      KmsKeyId: !If [UseCustomKmsKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, '']

Outputs:
  SmtpIamUserName:
    Description: Name of the IAM user used for SES SMTP.
    Value: !Ref SmtpUser
  SmtpIamUserArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM user used for SES SMTP.
    Value: !GetAtt SmtpUser.Arn
  SmtpGroupName:
    Description: IAM group that grants SES send permissions.
    Value: !Ref SmtpGroup
  SmtpUsernameParameterName:
    Description: SSM SecureString parameter holding the SES SMTP username.
    Value: !GetAtt SesSmtpCredentials.UsernameParameterName
  SmtpPasswordParameterName:
    Description: SSM SecureString parameter holding the SES SMTP password.
    Value: !GetAtt SesSmtpCredentials.PasswordParameterName
  SmtpEndpoint:
    Description: SES SMTP endpoint for this region (use port 587 with STARTTLS or 465 with TLS).
    Value: !Sub 'email-smtp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
  AccessKeyVersion:
    Description: Current access key rotation version.
    Value: !Ref AccessKeyVersion
  CredentialGeneratorFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function that derives and stores the SMTP credentials.
    Value: !GetAtt CredentialGeneratorFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  WebSocket API (API Gateway v2) backed by a single Python Lambda function that pushes
  live grant-processing job status updates to connected clients. Includes a DynamoDB
  connections table, a customer-managed KMS key for Lambda environment encryption, and
  a separate customer-managed KMS key for API Gateway CloudWatch Logs encryption.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: grant-status
    Description: Application name used as a prefix for resource names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,39}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3-40 chars).
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API deployment stage.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    Description: Retention period in days for CloudWatch Logs log groups.
    AllowedValues: [30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
  RelatedFunctionNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: grant-status-job-processor,grant-status-notifier
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated names of related Lambda functions in this same account that may also
      use the Lambda environment KMS key for decryption.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key #1 - Lambda environment variable encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaEnvKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for encrypting ${AppName} Lambda environment variables'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:RotateKeyOnDemand
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLambdaEnvEncryptionAtDeployTime
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'lambda.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowRestrictedDecryptForApprovedFunctions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'lambda.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:EncryptionContext:LambdaFunctionName: !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Join
                    - ','
                    - - !Sub '${AppName}-ws-handler'
                      - !Join [',', !Ref RelatedFunctionNames]
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  LambdaEnvKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AppName}-lambda-env'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key #2 - CloudWatch Logs encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for encrypting ${AppName} CloudWatch Logs log groups'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:RotateKeyOnDemand
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  LogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AppName}-apigw-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB connections table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda log group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AppName}-ws-handler'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for ${AppName}-ws-handler'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LambdaLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'
        - PolicyName: ConnectionsTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: LambdaEnvKeyDecrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: PushToConnectedClients
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-ws-handler'
      Description: Handles WebSocket connect, disconnect, default and sendmessage routes for grant-processing status updates.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 29
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CONNECTIONS_TABLE: !Ref ConnectionsTable
          STAGE_NAME: !Ref StageName
          CONNECTION_TTL_SECONDS: '7200'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import time

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['CONNECTIONS_TABLE'])
          TTL_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get('CONNECTION_TTL_SECONDS', '7200'))


          def _response(status_code, body):
              return {'statusCode': status_code, 'body': json.dumps(body)}


          def _management_client(request_context):
              endpoint = 'https://{}/{}'.format(request_context['domainName'], request_context['stage'])
              return boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint)


          def _post(client, connection_id, payload):
              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(ConnectionId=connection_id, Data=json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8'))
                  return True
              except ClientError as err:
                  if err.response.get('Error', {}).get('Code') == 'GoneException':
                      TABLE.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                      return False
                  raise


          def _all_connection_ids():
              kwargs = {'ProjectionExpression': 'connectionId'}
              while True:
                  page = TABLE.scan(**kwargs)
                  for item in page.get('Items', []):
                      yield item['connectionId']
                  if 'LastEvaluatedKey' not in page:
                      break
                  kwargs['ExclusiveStartKey'] = page['LastEvaluatedKey']


          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event['requestContext']
              route_key = request_context['routeKey']
              connection_id = request_context['connectionId']
              now = int(time.time())

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  TABLE.put_item(Item={
                      'connectionId': connection_id,
                      'connectedAt': now,
                      'ttl': now + TTL_SECONDS,
                  })
                  return _response(200, {'message': 'connected'})

              if route_key == '$disconnect':
                  TABLE.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return _response(200, {'message': 'disconnected'})

              client = _management_client(request_context)

              if route_key == 'sendmessage':
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  except ValueError:
                      _post(client, connection_id, {'error': 'Message body must be valid JSON'})
                      return _response(400, {'error': 'invalid JSON'})
                  update = {
                      'type': 'job-status',
                      'jobId': body.get('jobId'),
                      'status': body.get('status'),
                      'detail': body.get('detail'),
                      'timestamp': now,
                  }
                  delivered = 0
                  for target_id in _all_connection_ids():
                      if _post(client, target_id, update):
                          delivered += 1
                  return _response(200, {'message': 'status broadcast', 'recipients': delivered})

              _post(client, connection_id, {
                  'error': 'Unrecognised action',
                  'supportedActions': ['sendmessage'],
              })
              return _response(200, {'message': 'default route handled'})
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  # WebSocket API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-ws-api'
      Description: WebSocket API pushing live grant-processing job status to connected clients.
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Purpose: grant-processing-status

  WebSocketIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Lambda proxy integration for all WebSocket routes
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: ConnectRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${WebSocketIntegration}'

  DisconnectRoute:

  DefaultRoute:

      OperationName: DefaultRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${WebSocketIntegration}'

  SendMessageRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: sendmessage
      OperationName: SendMessageRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${WebSocketIntegration}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda invoke permissions (one per route)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectRoutePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$connect'

  DisconnectRoutePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$disconnect'

  DefaultRoutePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$default'

  SendMessageRoutePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/sendmessage'

                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs'
      Tags:

        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup

      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AppName}-ws-access'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  ApiExecutionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKey.Arn
      Tags:

          Value: grant-processing-status

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - SendMessageRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Deployment of grant-processing status WebSocket API

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayAccount
      - ApiExecutionLogGroup
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      Description: !Sub '${StageName} stage for ${AppName} WebSocket API'
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebSocketDeployment
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","eventType":"$context.eventType","connectionId":"$context.connectionId","status":"$context.status","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","integrationError":"$context.integrationErrorMessage"}'
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        LoggingLevel: INFO
        DataTraceEnabled: false
        DetailedMetricsEnabled: true
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 50
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Purpose: grant-processing-status

Description: Creates standard IAM Identity Center permission sets for centralized administrative access. When no InstanceArn is provided, the stack deploys only a configuration record. The permission sets are created once a valid IAM Identity Center organization instance ARN is supplied.

Parameters:
  InstanceArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of the IAM Identity Center instance. Leave it empty to deploy only the configuration record.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:(aws|aws-us-gov|aws-cn):sso:::instance/(sso)?ins-[a-zA-Z0-9-.]{16}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IAM Identity Center instance ARN.
  DefaultSessionDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT12H
    Description: Session duration in ISO-8601 format, from 1 to 12 hours.
    AllowedPattern: '^PT([1-9]|1[0-2])H$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an ISO-8601 duration from PT1H to PT12H.
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: IdentityCenter
    Description: Prefix for every permission set name.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]+$'
    MaxLength: 15
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 15 characters. Allowed characters are letters, digits and +=,.@-_
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment tag value.
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
    Description: Custom tag key applied to each permission set.
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
    Description: Custom tag value applied to each permission set.

  HasInstanceArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref InstanceArn, '']]

Description: >-

  release pipeline demo. The EC2 instance role is granted AdministratorAccess
  for demo and testing only and must not be used in production. Deploying this
  template requires CAPABILITY_IAM. The wildcard admin, orchestration and
  PassRole permissions are intentionally broad for the demo and should be
  reduced to least privilege before any non-demo use.

# NOTE: Deploy with --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM.
# All roles and the instance profile use CloudFormation-generated names
# (no RoleName / InstanceProfileName), so CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM is not needed.

Resources:
  # EC2 instance role - AdministratorAccess is for DEMO/TESTING ONLY.
  # Replace with a least-privilege policy before any non-demo use.
  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  InstanceRoleInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  # CodeDeploy service role - limited to EC2 describe and Auto Scaling
  # lifecycle hook actions required for blue/green-style deployments.
  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codedeploy.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
                - codedeploy.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeDeployServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction
                  - autoscaling:DeleteLifecycleHook
                  - autoscaling:DescribeLifecycleHooks
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook
                  - autoscaling:RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat
                Resource: '*'

  # CodePipeline service role - permissions are intentionally broad for the
  # demo and should be reduced to least privilege before any non-demo use.
  CodePipelineServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodePipelineServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

              # so Resource is '*'. If a bucket is added later, narrow this to
              # the bucket ARN using !Sub or !GetAtt (e.g. <bucket-arn>/*).
              - Sid: PipelineArtifactAccess
                Effect: Allow

                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObjectAcl
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                Resource: '*'
              # Orchestration permissions - intentionally broad for the demo.
              # S3 is no longer granted as a wildcard (s3:*); S3 access is limited
              # to the named artifact and bucket-read actions in
              # PipelineArtifactAccess above.
              - Sid: PipelineOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:*
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - sns:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - rds:*
                  - sqs:*
                  - ecs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CodeDeployAccess

                  - codedeploy:GetApplicationRevision
                  - codedeploy:GetDeployment
                  - codedeploy:GetDeploymentConfig
                  - codedeploy:RegisterApplicationRevision
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaAccess

              # PassRole is intentionally broad for the demo. In production,
              # add a Condition with iam:PassedToService scoped to the services
              # the pipeline orchestrates (e.g. codedeploy.amazonaws.com,
              # cloudformation.amazonaws.com, ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com,
              # elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com, ec2.amazonaws.com) and narrow

              - Sid: PassRoleAccess

                Resource: '*'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Stripe -> Squarespace -> SNS (Slack relay) webhook handler. API Gateway POST /webhooks (prod stage) invokes a Lambda function that verifies Stripe webhook events, looks up the matching Squarespace Commerce order and inventory, and publishes a formatted sales notification to an SNS topic for relaying to Slack.

Parameters:
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 0
    Default: ''
    Description: Squarespace Commerce API token. Stored in Secrets Manager. If you leave it blank, the stack generates a placeholder secret that you must replace after deployment.
  StripeWebhookSigningSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 0
    Default: ''
    Description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Stored in Secrets Manager. If you leave it blank, the stack generates a placeholder secret that you must replace after deployment.

Conditions:
  HasSquarespaceToken: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SquarespaceApiToken, '']]
  HasStripeSecret: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StripeWebhookSigningSecret, '']]

Resources:
  SquarespaceApiTokenSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/squarespace-api-token'
      Description: Squarespace Commerce API token used by the Stripe webhook handler.
      SecretString: !If
        - HasSquarespaceToken
        - !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GenerateSecretString: !If
        - HasSquarespaceToken
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - PasswordLength: 32
          ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  StripeSigningSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/stripe-webhook-signing-secret'
      Description: Stripe webhook signing secret used to verify incoming webhook events.
      SecretString: !If
        - HasStripeSecret
        - !Ref StripeWebhookSigningSecret
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GenerateSecretString: !If
        - HasStripeSecret
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - PasswordLength: 32
          ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  SalesNotificationTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key that encrypts the sales notification SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  SalesNotificationTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sales-notifications'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SalesNotificationTopicKey

  SalesNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sales-notifications'
      DisplayName: Sales Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn

  WebhookFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-stripe-webhook-handler'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  WebhookFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Stripe webhook handler Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebhookFunctionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: PublishSalesNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
              - Sid: EncryptSalesNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn
              - Sid: ReadWebhookSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource:
                  - !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
                  - !Ref StripeSigningSecret
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  WebhookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-stripe-webhook-handler'
      Description: Verifies Stripe webhooks, enriches them with Squarespace order and inventory data, and publishes to SNS.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref WebhookFunctionLogGroup
        LogFormat: Text
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
          STRIPE_SECRET_ARN: !Ref StripeSigningSecret
          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN_ARN: !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
          SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS: '300'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, os, time, urllib.request
          import boto3

          sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
          sns = boto3.client('sns')
          API = 'https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce'
          _cache = {}

          def secret(arn):
              if arn not in _cache:
                  _cache[arn] = sm.get_secret_value(SecretId=arn)['SecretString']
              return _cache[arn]

          def resp(code, msg):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': msg})}

          def log(level, msg, **kw):
              print(json.dumps({'level': level, 'msg': msg, **kw}))

          def verify(payload, header, sec):
              ts, sigs = None, []
              for item in (header or '').split(','):
                  k, _, v = item.strip().partition('=')
                  if k == 't':
                      ts = v
                  elif k == 'v1':
                      sigs.append(v)
              if not ts or not ts.isdigit() or not sigs:
                  return False
              if abs(time.time() - int(ts)) > int(os.environ.get('SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS', '300')):
                  return False
              exp = hmac.new(sec.encode(), f'{ts}.{payload}'.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
              return any(hmac.compare_digest(exp, s) for s in sigs)

          def sq(path, token):
              req = urllib.request.Request(f'{API}/{path}', headers={
                  'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'User-Agent': 'stripe-webhook-handler/1.0'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
                  return json.loads(r.read())

          def handler(event, context):
              body = event.get('body') or ''
              if event.get('isBase64Encoded'):
                  body = base64.b64decode(body).decode('utf-8')
              headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in (event.get('headers') or {}).items()}
              if not verify(body, headers.get('stripe-signature'), secret(os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET_ARN'])):
                  log('WARN', 'invalid stripe signature')
                  return resp(400, 'invalid signature')
              try:
                  evt = json.loads(body)
              except ValueError:
                  return resp(400, 'invalid json')
              obj = (evt.get('data') or {}).get('object') or {}
              meta = obj.get('metadata') or {}
              order_id = meta.get('squarespace_order_id')
              amount = obj.get('amount_received') or obj.get('amount_total') or obj.get('amount') or 0
              lines = [f"Stripe event {evt.get('type')} ({evt.get('id')})",
                       f"Amount: {amount / 100:.2f} {str(obj.get('currency', '')).upper()}"]
              if order_id:
                  try:
                      tok = secret(os.environ['SQUARESPACE_TOKEN_ARN'])
                      order = sq(f'orders/{order_id}', tok)
                      lines.append(f"Squarespace order #{order.get('orderNumber')} for {order.get('customerEmail')}")
                      items = order.get('lineItems') or []
                      vids = [i['variantId'] for i in items if i.get('variantId')][:50]
                      stock = {}
                      if vids:
                          inv = sq('inventory/' + ','.join(vids), tok)
                          stock = {i.get('variantId'): i for i in inv.get('inventory', [])}
                      for i in items:
                          s = stock.get(i.get('variantId'), {})
                          left = 'unlimited' if s.get('isUnlimited') else s.get('quantity', 'n/a')
                          lines.append(f"- {i.get('productName')} x{i.get('quantity')} "
                                       f"(SKU {i.get('sku')}, stock left: {left})")
                  except Exception as e:
                      log('ERROR', 'squarespace lookup failed', order=order_id, error=str(e))
                      lines.append(f'Squarespace order {order_id}: lookup failed')
              else:
                  lines.append('No squarespace_order_id found in Stripe metadata')
              sns.publish(TopicArn=os.environ['TOPIC_ARN'],
                          Subject=f"New sale: {evt.get('type', 'stripe event')}"[:100],
                          Message='\n'.join(lines))
              log('INFO', 'notification published', event_id=evt.get('id'), order=order_id)
              return resp(200, 'ok')

  WebhookApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-webhooks'
      Description: Receives Stripe webhook events for sales notifications.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  WebhooksResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt WebhookApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi

  WebhooksPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ResourceId: !Ref WebhooksResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebhookFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  WebhookApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: WebhooksPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      Description: Deployment of the webhooks API.

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage for Stripe webhooks.
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebhookApiDeployment
      TracingEnabled: true
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          MetricsEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 50

  ApiGatewayInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt WebhookFunction.Arn
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebhookApi}/*/POST/webhooks'

  WebhookFunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-stripe-webhook-handler-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when the Stripe webhook handler Lambda function reports any invocation errors within one minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref WebhookFunction
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  WebhookUrl:
    Description: Stripe webhook endpoint URL (POST).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${WebhookApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ProdStage}/webhooks'
  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the webhooks REST API.
    Value: !Ref WebhookApi
  WebhookFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the webhook handler Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt WebhookFunction.Arn
  WebhookFunctionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the webhook handler execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionRole.Arn
  SalesNotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic to subscribe the Slack relay (AWS Chatbot or HTTPS endpoint) to.
    Value: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
  SalesNotificationTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts the sales notification topic.
    Value: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn
  SquarespaceApiTokenSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the Squarespace API token.
    Value: !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
  StripeSigningSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the Stripe webhook signing secret.
    Value: !Ref StripeSigningSecret
  WebhookFunctionLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group for the webhook handler.
    Value: !Ref WebhookFunctionLogGroup
  WebhookFunctionErrorsAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm on function errors.
    Value: !Ref WebhookFunctionErrorsAlarm

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SAA lab 05 - On-demand DynamoDB table with an optional DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster and supporting private networking.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: saa-lab-05
    Description: Prefix used to name all lab resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,15}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (2-16 characters).
  EnableDax:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to "true" to deploy the DAX cluster, subnet group and service role.
  DaxReplicationFactor:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
    Description: Number of nodes in the DAX cluster.

Conditions:
  DaxEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableDax, 'true']

Resources:
  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-orders'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  LabVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-a'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-b'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ClientSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Clients allowed to connect to the DAX cluster
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8111
          ToPort: 8111
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
          Description: DAX traffic within the lab VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-client-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: DAX cluster - allows port 8111 only from the client security group
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8111
          ToPort: 8111
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt ClientSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: DAX unencrypted endpoint from client security group
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within the lab VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DAX::SubnetGroup
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      SubnetGroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-subnets'
      Description: DAX subnets across two AZs
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB

  DaxServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-role'
      Description: Service role that allows DAX to access the orders table
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dax.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-dynamodb-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: OrdersTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OrdersTable.Arn}/index/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxCluster:
    Type: AWS::DAX::Cluster
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax'
      Description: DAX cache for the orders table
      NodeType: dax.t3.small
      ReplicationFactor: !Ref DaxReplicationFactor
      IAMRoleARN: !GetAtt DaxServiceRole.Arn
      SubnetGroupName: !Ref DaxSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DaxSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the orders DynamoDB table

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained, two-AZ Amazon ElastiCache for Redis (cluster mode enabled) resilience and gameday test environment with a private VPC, a customer-managed KMS key, an encrypted SNS alarm topic and an SSM Automation approval role.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: redis-resilience-test
    Description: Lowercase name prefix used in resource names and tags.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (max 40 characters).
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the first private subnet (first Availability Zone).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the second private subnet (second Availability Zone).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  RedisSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows Redis traffic between the two private subnets
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          Description: Redis from private subnet 1
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          Description: Redis from private subnet 2
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          Description: Redis to private subnet 1
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          Description: Redis to private subnet 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-redis-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

  RedisSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Private subnets across two Availability Zones for the Redis replication group
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EnvironmentKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for ElastiCache at-rest encryption and SNS topic encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowElastiCacheUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub "elasticache.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
          - Sid: AllowSnsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-key"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

  EnvironmentKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${EnvironmentName}-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EnvironmentKmsKey

  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: !Sub "${EnvironmentName} Redis cluster mode enabled replication group for resilience testing"
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: '7.1'
      CacheNodeType: cache.t4g.medium
      CacheParameterGroupName: default.redis7.cluster.on
      ClusterMode: enabled
      Port: 6379
      NumNodeGroups: 2
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EnvironmentKmsKey.Arn
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      TransitEncryptionMode: required
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref RedisSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt RedisSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SnapshotRetentionLimit: 1
      NodeGroupConfiguration:
        - NodeGroupId: '0001'
          PrimaryAvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
          ReplicaAvailabilityZones:
            - !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
        - NodeGroupId: '0002'
          PrimaryAvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
          ReplicaAvailabilityZones:
            - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-redis"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-alarms"
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName} alarm notifications"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref EnvironmentKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*"
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AutomationApprovalRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by an SSM Automation runbook approval step to send automation signals
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ssm-automation-signal"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowSendAutomationSignal
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-gameday-testing

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the test environment VPC
    Value: !Ref Vpc
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  RedisSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the Redis security group
    Value: !GetAtt RedisSecurityGroup.GroupId
  RedisSubnetGroupName:
    Description: Name of the ElastiCache subnet group
    Value: !Ref RedisSubnetGroup
  ReplicationGroupId:
    Description: ID of the Redis replication group
    Value: !Ref RedisReplicationGroup
  RedisConfigurationEndpointAddress:
    Description: Cluster mode enabled configuration endpoint address
    Value: !GetAtt RedisReplicationGroup.ConfigurationEndPoint.Address
  RedisConfigurationEndpointPort:
    Description: Cluster mode enabled configuration endpoint port
    Value: !GetAtt RedisReplicationGroup.ConfigurationEndPoint.Port
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt EnvironmentKmsKey.Arn
  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !Ref EnvironmentKmsKeyAlias
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the encrypted SNS topic for CloudWatch alarm notifications
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic
  AutomationApprovalRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used for the SSM Automation approval step
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationApprovalRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL songs API with IAM auth, X-Ray tracing and a DynamoDB backend

Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role that allows AppSync to read and write the songs table
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SongsTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role that allows AppSync to push logs to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  SongsApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-songs-api'
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ERROR
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  SongsSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String): Song
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  SongsTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source for the songs table
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  ValidationNoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidationNoneDataSource
      Description: Local NONE data source used for input validation
      Type: NONE

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateArtistFunction
      Description: Validates that the artist argument is present and contains only letters
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt ValidationNoneDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const artist = ctx.args.artist;
          if (artist === undefined || artist === null || artist === '') {
            util.error('Artist is required', 'ValidationError');
          }
          const isValid = util.matches('^[A-Za-z]+$', artist);
          if (isValid === false) {
            util.error('Artist must contain only letters', 'ValidationError');
          }
          return { payload: { artist: artist } };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  AddSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: AddSongFunction
      Description: Writes a new song to DynamoDB with an automatically generated id
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: util.autoId() }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({
              name: ctx.args.name,
              artist: ctx.args.artist
            }),
            condition: {
              expression: 'attribute_not_exists(#id)',
              expressionNames: { '#id': 'id' }
            }
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateArtistFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt AddSongFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return { operation: 'Scan' };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: GraphQL endpoint URL of the songs API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: ID of the songs AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the songs AppSync API (callers need appsync:GraphQL on <ApiArn>/types/*/fields/*)
    Value: !GetAtt SongsApi.Arn
  SongsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores songs
    Value: !Ref SongsTable
  SongsTableArn:
