        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  IdentityFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Returns the caller's authenticated identity claims, if any.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get("requestContext") or {}
              authorizer = request_context.get("authorizer") or {}
              claims = authorizer.get("claims") or {}
              body = {
                  "path": event.get("path"),
                  "method": event.get("httpMethod"),
                  "authenticated": bool(claims),
                  "claims": claims,
              }
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }

  IdentityFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${IdentityFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi

  MeResource:

      ParentId: !GetAtt Api.RootResourceId

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:

      ParentId: !GetAtt Api.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  MeGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - aws.cognito.signin.user.admin
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  OpenGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  ApiInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      FunctionName: !GetAtt IdentityFunction.Arn
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api}/*/GET/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeGetMethod

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      Description: Deployment of identity API methods.

  ApiStage:

    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage.

    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the public Cognito app client (no secret).
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  ApiId:
    Description: ID of the REST API.
    Value: !Ref Api
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Description: Base invoke URL of the prod stage.

  OpenEndpoint:

    Value: !Sub 'https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ApiStage}/open'

    Value: !Ref IdentityFunction

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'marbot.io account connection and monitoring integration - connects this AWS account to marbot.io via an EventBridge API destination, a cross-account monitoring role with feature-flagged permissions, and a custom resource that registers the connection.'

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: 'marbot endpoint'
        Parameters:
          - EndpointId
      - Label:
          default: 'Feature flags'
        Parameters:
          - AutomatedMonitoring
          - AccountAlias
          - AlarmGraphs
          - CodePipelineApproval

Parameters:
  EndpointId:
    Description: 'Your marbot endpoint ID (used as API key, keep secret). Supply it through parameter overrides. If left empty, the marbot API destination, keep-alive rule and connection registration are not created.'
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,64})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be empty or 1-64 characters of letters, digits, and hyphens.'
  AutomatedMonitoring:
    Description: 'Allow marbot to automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and monitoring rules.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  AccountAlias:
    Description: 'Allow marbot to enrich account IDs with friendly aliases.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  AlarmGraphs:
    Description: 'Allow marbot to embed metric graphs into CloudWatch alarm notifications.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  CodePipelineApproval:
    Description: 'Allow marbot to approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval requests.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'

Mappings:
  MarbotConfig:
    Vendor:
      AccountId: '853553028582'
      ApiBaseUrl: 'https://api.marbot.io'

Conditions:
  HasEndpointId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EndpointId, '']]
  HasAutomatedMonitoring: !Equals [!Ref AutomatedMonitoring, 'true']
  HasAccountAlias: !Equals [!Ref AccountAlias, 'true']
  HasAlarmGraphs: !Equals [!Ref AlarmGraphs, 'true']
  HasCodePipelineApproval: !Equals [!Ref CodePipelineApproval, 'true']

Resources:
  Connection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection

      Description: 'marbot.io API connection'
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY

        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: 'X-API-Key'

  ApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Condition: HasEndpointId
    Properties:
      Description: 'marbot.io endpoint'
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt Connection.Arn

      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 5

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained mobile/web backend that provisions a DynamoDB table, a Cognito
  identity pool with guest (unauthenticated) access, and an IAM role for
  unauthenticated users. NOTE - Amazon Mobile Analytics and Amazon Cognito Sync
  are legacy services (modern replacements are Amazon Pinpoint and AWS AppSync);
  their IAM actions are retained as requested.

Metadata:
  DeprecationNotice:
    MobileAnalytics: Amazon Mobile Analytics is a legacy service. Amazon Pinpoint is the modern replacement. The mobileanalytics:PutEvents action is kept as requested.
    CognitoSync: Amazon Cognito Sync is a legacy service. AWS AppSync is the modern replacement. The cognito-sync actions are kept as requested.

Resources:
  AppTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  SnsTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the app notification SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  SnsTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sns'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SnsTopicKey

  AppNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SnsTopicKey.Arn

  AppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}_identity_pool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false

  CognitoUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref AppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UnauthenticatedGuestAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsPutEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CognitoSyncScopedToPool
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:ListDatasets
                  - cognito-sync:ListRecords
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeDataset
                  - cognito-sync:UpdateRecords
                  - cognito-sync:BulkPublish
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AppIdentityPool}/*'
              - Sid: SnsPublishToAppTopic
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AppNotificationTopic
              - Sid: KmsForEncryptedTopicPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SnsTopicKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: DynamoDbPutItemToAppTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt AppTable.Arn

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref AppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  AppTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref AppTable
  AppTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt AppTable.Arn
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool
    Value: !Ref AppIdentityPool
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by unauthenticated identities
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthenticatedRole.Arn
  NotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS notification topic
    Value: !Ref AppNotificationTopic
  SnsTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the SNS topic
    Value: !GetAtt SnsTopicKey.Arn
  Region:
    Description: AWS Region where the backend is deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provides the Glue Data Catalog database, an optional crawler and an optional
  Spark ETL job for the catalog and transform layer of a data lake. Greenfield
  deviation: instead of accepting the ARN of an existing source bucket, this
  template creates the source S3 bucket itself (along with the target and
  artifacts buckets used by the ETL job) and references it internally.
  All data lake buckets are encrypted with a customer managed KMS key that this
  template creates.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: datalake
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, starting with a letter (2-31 characters).
    Description: Naming prefix used for the database, crawler, job, role and log group names.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names and tags.
  SourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: raw/
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-zA-Z0-9!_.*'()-]+/)*$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a sequence of path segments each ending with a slash.
    Description: Key prefix inside the source bucket that the crawler scans and the role can read.
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
    AllowedPattern: '^cron\(.+\)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must use the Glue cron(...) format.
    Description: Glue cron schedule expression for the crawler (default is daily at 02:00 UTC).
  EnableCrawler:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the Glue crawler.
  EnableEtlJob:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the Glue Spark ETL job and its supporting resources.
  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - G.025X
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
    Default: G.1X
    Description: Glue worker type for the ETL job.
  NumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299
    Default: 2
    Description: Number of workers allocated to the ETL job.
  JobTimeoutMinutes:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2880
    Default: 60
    Description: ETL job timeout in minutes.
  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Default: 1
    Description: Maximum number of concurrent runs allowed for the ETL job.
  ScriptKey:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/etl_job.py
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9!_.*'()/-]+\\.py$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an S3 object key ending in .py.
    Description: Object key of the Spark script inside the template-created artifacts bucket.
  TargetPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: curated/
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-zA-Z0-9!_.*'()-]+/)+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one or more path segments each ending with a slash.
    Description: Output prefix inside the target bucket.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period in days for the ETL job CloudWatch log group.

Conditions:
  CrawlerEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableCrawler
    - 'true'
  EtlJobEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableEtlJob
    - 'true'

Resources:
  DataLakeKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${NamePrefix} data lake buckets (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DataLakeKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-datalake'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataLakeKey

  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-source'

  SourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${SourceBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  TargetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-target'

  TargetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TargetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TargetBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireTemporaryFiles
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: temporary/
            ExpirationInDays: 7
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 1
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-artifacts'

  ArtifactsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}_${Environment}_db'
        Description: !Sub 'Data lake catalog database for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'

  EtlJobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws-glue/jobs/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-glue-service-role'
      Description: Shared service role for the data lake Glue crawler and ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataLakeS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListSourceBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource: !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadSourceObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${SourceBucket.Arn}/${SourcePrefix}*'
              - Sid: DecryptDataLakeObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: EncryptDataLakeObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                    - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  Resource: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: WriteTargetObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:ListBucket'
                    - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                    - 's3:PutObject'
                    - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
                    - !Sub '${TargetBucket.Arn}/${TargetPrefix}*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: ReadEtlScript
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                  Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactsBucket.Arn}/${ScriptKey}'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: UseTemporaryDirectory
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:ListBucket'
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                    - 's3:PutObject'
                    - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt ArtifactsBucket.Arn
                    - !Sub '${ArtifactsBucket.Arn}/temporary/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: WriteEtlJobLogs
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                    - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                    - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt EtlJobLogGroup.Arn
                    - !Sub '${EtlJobLogGroup.Arn}:*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler

Description: Provisions the Cognito auth resources (user pool, app client, identity pool) and the authenticated and unauthenticated IAM roles for an Amplify sandbox (friendly name "amplifyAuth").

Resources:
  # Sandbox behaviour: the user pool is deleted with the stack because a sandbox is temporary and holds no data worth keeping.
  # Change DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy to Retain if this template is ever reused outside a sandbox.
  AmplifyAuthUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      UserPoolTags:
        amplify:deployment-type: sandbox
        amplify:friendly-name: amplifyAuth
        created-by: amplify

  # AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient has no tagging property, so it carries no tags.
  AmplifyAuthUserPoolAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref AmplifyAuthUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # Sandbox behaviour: change DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy to Retain if this template is ever reused outside a sandbox.
  AmplifyAuthIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref AmplifyAuthUserPoolAppClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt AmplifyAuthUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: amplify:deployment-type
          Value: sandbox
        - Key: amplify:friendly-name
          Value: amplifyAuth
        - Key: created-by
          Value: amplify

  # The role has only a trust policy. Amplify adds category-specific permissions later.
  AmplifyAuthAuthenticatedUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:

              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated

        - Key: amplify:deployment-type
          Value: sandbox
        - Key: amplify:friendly-name
          Value: amplifyAuth
        - Key: created-by

              ForAnyValue:StringLike:

        - Key: amplify:deployment-type

        - Key: amplify:friendly-name
          Value: amplifyAuth
        - Key: created-by
          Value: amplify

    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:

  UnauthenticatedUserRoleRef:
    Description: Name of the IAM role for unauthenticated users

  UnauthenticatedUserRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for unauthenticated users
    Value: !GetAtt AmplifyAuthUnauthenticatedUserRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys an AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job that converts Shapefiles into individual
  GeoJSON files, along with its IAM service role and the supporting S3 buckets
  (raw GIS data, Glue scripts, and knowledge base). Requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\-]{1,255}$'
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue ETL job.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters of letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    AllowedPattern: '^s3://.+$'
    Description: >-
      S3 URI of the Glue ETL Python script. When left at the default, the script
      location resolves to the scripts bucket created by this stack.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 URI beginning with s3://.

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@\-]{1,64}$'
    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by AWS Glue.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters of letters, digits, and +=,.@_- characters.

Conditions:
  UseStackScriptsBucket: !Equals
    - !Ref GlueScriptLocation
    - 's3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py'

Resources:
  DataBucketsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the map-appraiser data and Glue script S3 buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  DataBucketsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub
        - 'alias/map-appraiser-data-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataBucketsKmsKey

  RawGisBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - 'map-appraiser-data-raw-gis-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  GlueScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - 'map-appraiser-glue-scripts-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  KnowledgeBaseBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - 'map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  RawGisBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RawGisBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${RawGisBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref GlueScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  KnowledgeBaseBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref KnowledgeBaseBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS Glue for the Shapefile to GeoJSON ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCloudWatchLogsFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'logs:*'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
        - PolicyName: GlueS3ReadSourceAndScripts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListSourceAndScriptBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadSourceAndScriptObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${RawGisBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: WriteSparkLogsAndTempData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/spark-logs/*'
                  - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/temp/*'
        - PolicyName: GlueS3KnowledgeBaseReadWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListKnowledgeBaseBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource: !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadWriteKnowledgeBaseObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: GlueKmsDataKeyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseDataBucketsKeyViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GlueJobName
      Description: Converts Shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - UseStackScriptsBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py'
          - !Ref GlueScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-spark-ui': 'true'
        '--spark-event-logs-path': !Sub 's3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/spark-logs/'
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-enable'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/temp/'
        '--additional-python-modules': 'geopandas==0.14.1,shapely==2.0.2,pyproj==3.6.1,fiona==1.9.5'
      Tags:
        Project: map-appraiser

Outputs:
  GlueJobName:
    Description: Name of the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueJobName'

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue service role.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueServiceRoleArn'

  ScriptUploadCommand:
    Description: Command to upload the ETL script to S3 before the first job run (the stack does not upload it). The caller needs kms:GenerateDataKey on the data buckets KMS key.
    Value: !If
      - UseStackScriptsBucket
      - !Sub 'aws s3 cp shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py s3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py'
      - !Sub 'aws s3 cp shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py ${GlueScriptLocation}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ScriptUploadCommand'

  DataBucketsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts the S3 buckets.
    Value: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DataBucketsKmsKeyArn'

  RawGisBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket holding the raw GIS Shapefiles.
    Value: !Ref RawGisBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RawGisBucketName'

  GlueScriptsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket holding the Glue scripts, Spark UI logs, and temp data.
    Value: !Ref GlueScriptsBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueScriptsBucketName'

  KnowledgeBaseBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket receiving the generated GeoJSON files.
    Value: !Ref KnowledgeBaseBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys the "DatadogPolicy" CloudFormation macro and its Lambda function,
  which build IAM policy documents for the Datadog integration role.

# The function is built from native CloudFormation resources (AWS::Lambda::Function
# plus an explicit IAM role). These are the same resources SAM's AWS::Serverless::Function
# would produce, so deploying this template does not need CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND.
# It needs only CAPABILITY_IAM, because it creates an unnamed IAM role.
#
# Usage from a consuming stack (a macro cannot be used in the stack that defines it):
#   DatadogIntegrationRole:
#     Type: AWS::IAM::Role
#     Properties:
#       ...
#       Policies:
#         - Fn::Transform:
#             Name: DatadogPolicy
#             Parameters:
#               PolicyType: LogArchive        # or CloudTrail
#               BucketNames: my-bucket-a,my-bucket-b   # or BucketName: my-bucket

Resources:
  DatadogPolicyMacroLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      RetentionInDays: 30

  DatadogPolicyMacroFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the DatadogPolicy macro function (basic CloudWatch Logs access only).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      Description: Processes DatadogPolicy macro fragments and generates Datadog integration IAM policies.
      # The request asked for Python 3.14. That runtime is not on the approved list,
      # so this uses python3.12, the newest approved Python runtime.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroFunctionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref DatadogPolicyMacroLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def _partition(region):
              region = region or ""
              if region.startswith("cn-"):
                  return "aws-cn"
              if region.startswith("us-gov-"):
                  return "aws-us-gov"
              return "aws"


          def _bucket_arns(params, partition):
              raw = params.get("BucketNames", params.get("BucketName"))
              if raw is None:
                  raise ValueError("A BucketName or BucketNames parameter is required")
              if isinstance(raw, str):
                  raw = raw.split(",")
              arns = []
              for item in raw:
                  value = str(item).strip()
                  if not value:
                      continue
                  if value.startswith("arn:"):
                      arns.append(value.split("/", 1)[0])
                  else:
                      arns.append("arn:{}:s3:::{}".format(partition, value))
              if not arns:
                  raise ValueError("At least one S3 bucket must be supplied")
              return arns


          def _policy(name, bucket_actions, object_actions, arns):
              return {
                  "PolicyName": name,
                  "PolicyDocument": {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                          {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": object_actions,
                           "Resource": [a + "/*" for a in arns]},
                          {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": bucket_actions,
                           "Resource": arns},
                      ],
                  },
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              request_id = event.get("requestId")
              fragment = event.get("fragment")
              try:
                  params = event.get("params") or {}
                  policy_type = params.get("PolicyType")
                  partition = _partition(event.get("region"))
                  if policy_type == "LogArchive":
                      result = _policy("DatadogLogArchiveAndRehydratePolicy",
                                       ["s3:ListBucket"],
                                       ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
                                       _bucket_arns(params, partition))
                  elif policy_type == "CloudTrail":
                      result = _policy("DatadogCloudTrailsPolicy",
                                       ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
                                       ["s3:GetObject"],
                                       _bucket_arns(params, partition))
                  else:
                      result = fragment
                  print(json.dumps({"requestId": request_id, "policyType": policy_type, "status": "success"}))
                  return {"requestId": request_id, "status": "success", "fragment": result}
              except Exception as e:
                  print(json.dumps({"requestId": request_id, "status": "failure", "error": str(e)}))
                  return {
                      "requestId": request_id,
                      "status": "failure",
                      "fragment": fragment,
                      "errorMessage": str(e),
                  }

  DatadogPolicyMacro:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Macro
    Properties:
      Name: DatadogPolicy
      Description: Generates IAM policies for the Datadog integration role.
      FunctionName: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn

Outputs:
  MacroName:
    Description: Name of the CloudFormation macro to reference with Fn::Transform.
    Value: DatadogPolicy
  MacroFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function backing the DatadogPolicy macro.
    Value: !Ref DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
  MacroFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function backing the DatadogPolicy macro.
    Value: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MacroFunctionArn'
  MacroFunctionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the execution role used by the macro function.
    Value: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroFunctionRole.Arn
  MacroLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for the macro function.
    Value: !Ref DatadogPolicyMacroLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) cluster, control panel,
  routing controls, safety rule and RECOVERY_CONTROL health checks for multi-region recovery.

# The ARC control-plane API is hosted in us-west-2. These CloudFormation resource types
# can still be deployed from us-east-1. Region1 and Region2 are only naming labels and
# do not decide where the resources are deployed.
#
# ARC routing control and safety rule resources only support Name, ClusterArn/ControlPanelArn,
# AssertionRule/GatingRule, RuleConfig and Tags. Tags are supported only on the Cluster,
# ControlPanel and SafetyRule resources. No other properties are used.

Parameters:
  Region1:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name format (e.g. us-east-1).
    Description: Region label used in the name of routing control for Cell 1.

  Region2:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name format (e.g. us-west-2).
    Description: Region label used in the name of routing control for Cell 2.

  ProjectId:
    Type: String
    Default: Dynamo59
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,63}$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    ConstraintDescription: alphanumeric, must start with a letter, 1-64 characters
    Description: Project identifier used as a prefix for resource names.

Resources:
  RecoveryCluster:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cluster'

  ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-ControlPanel'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn

  RoutingControlCell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell1-${Region1}'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn

  RoutingControlCell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell2-${Region2}'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn

  # Assertion rule only. GatingRule is not set because only one of the two can be specified.
  MinCellsActiveSafetyRule:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::SafetyRule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-MinCellsActive'
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
      AssertionRule:
        WaitPeriodMs: 5000
        AssertedControls:
          - !GetAtt RoutingControlCell1.RoutingControlArn
          - !GetAtt RoutingControlCell2.RoutingControlArn
      RuleConfig:
        Type: ATLEAST
        Threshold: 1
        Inverted: false

  # RECOVERY_CONTROL health checks do not take endpoint properties
  # (IPAddress, FullyQualifiedDomainName, Port, ResourcePath, RequestInterval, FailureThreshold).
  HealthCheckCell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: RECOVERY_CONTROL
        RoutingControlArn: !GetAtt RoutingControlCell1.RoutingControlArn
      HealthCheckTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell1-${Region1}-HealthCheck'

  HealthCheckCell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: RECOVERY_CONTROL
        RoutingControlArn: !GetAtt RoutingControlCell2.RoutingControlArn
      HealthCheckTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell2-${Region2}-HealthCheck'

Outputs:
  ClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC cluster.
    Value: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClusterArn'

  ControlPanelArn:
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC control panel.
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPanelArn'

  HealthCheckCell1Id:
    Description: ID of the RECOVERY_CONTROL health check for Cell 1.
    Value: !Ref HealthCheckCell1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HealthCheckCell1Id'

  HealthCheckCell2Id:
    Description: ID of the RECOVERY_CONTROL health check for Cell 2.
    Value: !Ref HealthCheckCell2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HealthCheckCell2Id'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates a customer-managed KMS key and key alias to secure AWS service data encryption, with optional alerts when the key is scheduled for deletion or disabled.'

Metadata:
  'AWS::CloudFormation::Interface':
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: 'Parent Stacks'
        Parameters:
          - ParentAlertStack
      - Label:
          default: 'KMS Parameters'
        Parameters:
          - Service

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Description: 'Optional but recommended stack name of parent alert stack based on operations/alert.yaml template. Leave empty to disable deletion and disable alerts.'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Service:
    Description: 'Which AWS service is allowed to use this key? ALL_SERVICES allows all services in the caller account; S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS additionally allows public decryption through S3.'
    Type: String
    Default: 'ALL_SERVICES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'ALL_SERVICES'
      - 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS'
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces

Conditions:
  HasAlertTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, '']]
  HasServiceAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'ALL_SERVICES']
  HasS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS']
  HasServiceRestriction: !Not [!Or [!Condition HasServiceAllServices, !Condition HasS3PublicAccess]]

Resources:
  Key:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Key'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key created by stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCryptographicUseByCallerAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
              - 'kms:ListGrants'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition: !If
              - HasServiceRestriction
              - StringEquals:
                  'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub '${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - StringEquals:
                  'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - !If
            - HasS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: AllowPublicS3Decryption
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: '*'
              Action: 'kms:Decrypt'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  KeyAlias:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Alias'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref Key

  KeyDeletionAlertRule:
    Type: 'AWS::Events::Rule'
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Alerts when KMS key from stack ${AWS::StackName} is scheduled for deletion or disabled'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - 'aws.kms'
        detail-type:
          - 'AWS API Call via CloudTrail'
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - 'kms.amazonaws.com'
          eventName:
            - 'ScheduleKeyDeletion'
            - 'DisableKey'
          requestParameters:
            keyId:
              - !Ref Key
      Targets:
        - Id: rule
          Arn:
            'Fn::ImportValue': !Sub '${ParentAlertStack}-TopicARN'

Outputs:
  StackName:
    Description: 'Stack name.'
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
  KeyId:
    Description: 'Key ID.'
    Value: !Ref Key
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyId'
  KeyArn:
    Description: 'Key ARN.'
    Value: !GetAtt Key.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) lifecycle policy and its supporting IAM role to automate EBS volume snapshots for web servers.

Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Type: String
    Default: '17:00'
    AllowedPattern: '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid 24-hour time in HH:MM format (e.g. 17:00).
    Description: Time of day (UTC) in HH:MM 24-hour format when the daily snapshot schedule starts.
  SnapshotInterval:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    AllowedValues:
      - 2
      - 3
      - 4
      - 6
      - 8
      - 12
      - 24
    Description: Interval in hours between snapshots.
  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of snapshots to retain for each volume.
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebServers
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens (max 32 characters).
    Description: Logical name used in resource names and tags.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
    Description: Environment tag value used to target EBS volumes.
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
    MinLength: 1
    Description: Key of the custom tag used to target EBS volumes.
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
    MinLength: 1
    Description: Value of the custom tag used to target EBS volumes.

Resources:
  DataLifecycleManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Service role that allows Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to manage EBS snapshots.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataLifecycleManagerSnapshotPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowSnapshotCreation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshots
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:volume/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}::snapshot/*'
              - Sid: AllowSnapshotDeletion
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}::snapshot/*'
              - Sid: AllowSnapshotTagging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}::snapshot/*'
              - Sid: AllowDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'

  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Daily EBS snapshot lifecycle policy for ${LogicalName}'
      State: ENABLED
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        PolicyType: EBS_SNAPSHOT_MANAGEMENT
        ResourceTypes:
          - VOLUME
        TargetTags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref TagKey
            Value: !Ref TagValue
        Schedules:
          - Name: Daily Snapshots
            CreateRule:
              Interval: !Ref SnapshotInterval
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - !Ref DailySnapshotScheduledAt
            RetainRule:
              Count: !Ref SnapshotRetainRule
            CopyTags: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}'

Outputs:
  LifecyclePolicyId:
    Description: ID of the DLM lifecycle policy.
    Value: !Ref LifecyclePolicy
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the DLM lifecycle policy.
    Value: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicy.Arn
  DataLifecycleManagerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by Data Lifecycle Manager.
    Value: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn

Resources:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Systems Manager Automation to enforce account-level S3 Block Public Access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3BlockPublicAccessEnforcement

  EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables all four S3 Block Public Access settings at the account level and verifies the configuration.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run this document.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: PutPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ global:ACCOUNT_ID }}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
          - name: VerifyPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: GetPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ global:ACCOUNT_ID }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: BlockPublicAcls
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicAcls
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: BlockPublicPolicy
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicPolicy
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: IgnorePublicAcls
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.IgnorePublicAcls
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: RestrictPublicBuckets
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.RestrictPublicBuckets
                Type: Boolean
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3BlockPublicAccessEnforcement

  EventBridgeSsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EventBridge to start the S3 Block Public Access SSM Automation document.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartS3BlockPublicAccessAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3BlockPublicAccessEnforcement

  DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the S3 Block Public Access enforcement SSM Automation document once a day.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 day)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessAutomation
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeSsmAutomationRole.Arn

Outputs:
  SsmAutomationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document that enforces S3 Block Public Access.
    Value: !Ref EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument
  SsmAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by SSM Automation.
    Value: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
  EventBridgeSsmAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role EventBridge uses to start the Automation execution.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeSsmAutomationRole.Arn
  DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the daily EventBridge scheduled rule.
    Value: !GetAtt DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule.Arn
