AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Test environment for validating Service Catalog preventive controls. NOTE - the IAM
  role dms-vpc-role is account-global and mandated by DMS; if it already exists in the
  account this stack fails with a name conflict (greenfield account assumed).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-1'

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-2'

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog preventive control test resources
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
        - Description: Redis to within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
        - Description: Memcached to within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 11211
          ToPort: 11211
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-sg'

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Cache security group for ElastiCache test clusters
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Redis from the test security group
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
        - Description: Memcached from the test security group
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 11211
          ToPort: 11211
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Deny all outbound traffic (loopback only)
          IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-elasticache-sg'

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for Service Catalog preventive control testing
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLaunchRolesUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt AlbLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt AutoScalingLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DmsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DynamoDbLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EbsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EfsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElastiCacheLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElasticsearchLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FsxLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt KinesisLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SnsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SqsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt S3LaunchRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLaunchRolesGrantsForAwsResources
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt AlbLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt AutoScalingLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DmsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DynamoDbLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EbsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EfsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElastiCacheLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElasticsearchLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FsxLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt KinesisLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SnsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SqsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt S3LaunchRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sc-controls-test-key'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sc-controls-test'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: Service role required by AWS DMS to manage VPC resources
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole'

  DmsReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    DependsOn: DmsVpcRole
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: DMS replication subnet group for Service Catalog control testing
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dms-subnet-group'

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: ElastiCache subnet group for Service Catalog control testing
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-elasticache-subnet-group'

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SageMaker execution role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerExecutionLeastPrivilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:*:repository/*'
              - Sid: S3SageMakerBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}*/*'
              - Sid: VpcNetworkInterfaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                Resource: '*'

  ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Common permissions for Service Catalog launch roles
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudFormationStackOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudformation:CreateStack
              - cloudformation:DeleteStack
              - cloudformation:UpdateStack
              - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
              - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
              - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
              - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
              - cloudformation:ListStackResources
              - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
              - cloudformation:ContinueUpdateRollback
              - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
              - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
              - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
              - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
              - cloudformation:ListChangeSets
              - cloudformation:TagResource
              - cloudformation:UntagResource
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/SC-*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:changeSet/*'
          - Sid: CloudFormationTemplateValidation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
              - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ServiceCatalogTemplateAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:ExistingObjectTag/servicecatalog:provisioning: 'true'

  ServiceCatalogLaunchKmsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: KMS permissions for launch roles of KMS-capable products (bounded by the key policy)
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: KmsForEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  AlbLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - ALB, listeners, target groups
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AlbProductPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ElbManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'elasticloadbalancing:*'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:loadbalancer/app/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:listener/app/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:listener-rule/app/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:targetgroup/*'
              - Sid: ElbDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'elasticloadbalancing:Describe*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2Describe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ElbServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com

  AutoScalingLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - Auto Scaling
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchKmsPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AutoScalingProductPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AutoScalingManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'autoscaling:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2LaunchTemplates
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AutoScalingServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: autoscaling.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: PassInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ec2.amazonaws.com

  DmsLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - DMS endpoints and instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchKmsPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DmsProductPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DmsManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'dms:*'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: DmsDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dms:Describe*
                  - dms:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2Describe
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassDmsVpcRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt DmsVpcRole.Arn

  DynamoDbLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - DynamoDB
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchKmsPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDbProductPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDbManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:CreateTable
                  - dynamodb:DeleteTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:UpdateContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTimeToLive
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTimeToLive
                  - dynamodb:DescribeKinesisStreamingDestination
                  - dynamodb:TagResource
                  - dynamodb:UntagResource
                  - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
              - Sid: DynamoDbList
                Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:ListTables
                Resource: '*'

  EbsLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - EBS
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchKmsPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EbsProductPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EbsVolumeManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVolume
                  - ec2:DeleteVolume
                  - ec2:ModifyVolume
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:volume/*'
              - Sid: EbsDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumeAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'

  EfsLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - EFS
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchKmsPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EfsProductPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EfsManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'elasticfilesystem:*'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticfilesystem:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:file-system/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticfilesystem:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:access-point/*'
              - Sid: EfsCreateAndDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticfilesystem:CreateFileSystem
                  - elasticfilesystem:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2ForMountTargets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EfsServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticfilesystem.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: elasticfilesystem.amazonaws.com

  ElastiCacheLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - ElastiCache
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchKmsPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElastiCacheProductPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ElastiCacheManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'elasticache:*'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticache:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: ElastiCacheDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action: elasticache:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2Describe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ElastiCacheServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticache.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: elasticache.amazonaws.com

  ElasticsearchLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - Elasticsearch
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchCommonPolicy
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchKmsPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticsearchProductPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EsManage
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'es:*'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:es:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*'
              - Sid: EsDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - es:Describe*
                  - es:List*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2Describe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EsServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/es.amazonaws.com/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/opensearchservice.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName:
                      - es.amazonaws.com
                      - opensearchservice.amazonaws.com

  FsxLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SC launch role - FSx

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI multi-channel campaign orchestration platform.
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: campaign-ai
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,19}$'
    Description: Name prefix and Project tag.
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9.:_-]{3,128}$'
    Description: Bedrock model or inference profile ID.
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Deploy the OpenSearch Serverless vector collection.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: alerts@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Alarm notification email (subscription stays pending until confirmed).
  SenderEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: no-reply@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Placeholder SES sender address.
  SmsOriginationIdentity:
    Type: String
    Default: phone-number-id-placeholder
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_:/+.-]{1,256}$'
    Description: Placeholder SMS origination identity.
Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, "true"]
Resources:
  CampaignKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'}
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'}
            Action: [kms:Encrypt*, kms:Decrypt*, kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:GenerateDataKey*, kms:Describe*]
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike: {kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'}
          - Sid: ServicePublishers
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: [cloudwatch.amazonaws.com, ses.amazonaws.com, sms-voice.amazonaws.com]}
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey*]
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals: {aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId}
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  CampaignKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-campaign-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey
  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: true
      AttributeDefinitions: [{AttributeName: customerId, AttributeType: S}, {AttributeName: segment, AttributeType: S}]
      KeySchema: [{AttributeName: customerId, KeyType: HASH}]
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: segment-index
          KeySchema: [{AttributeName: segment, KeyType: HASH}]
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn}
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: true
      AttributeDefinitions: [{AttributeName: channel, AttributeType: S}]
      KeySchema: [{AttributeName: channel, KeyType: HASH}]
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn}
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  MessageTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: true
      AttributeDefinitions: [{AttributeName: messageId, AttributeType: S}, {AttributeName: campaignId, AttributeType: S}]
      KeySchema: [{AttributeName: messageId, KeyType: HASH}]
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: campaign-index
          KeySchema: [{AttributeName: campaignId, KeyType: HASH}]
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      TimeToLiveSpecification: {AttributeName: expiresAt, Enabled: true}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn}
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: {SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms, KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn}
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration: {BlockPublicAcls: true, BlockPublicPolicy: true, IgnorePublicAcls: true, RestrictPublicBuckets: true}
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules: [{ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced}]
      VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - {Id: ExpireNoncurrent, Status: Enabled, NoncurrentVersionExpiration: {NoncurrentDays: 90}}
          - {Id: AbortUploads, Status: Enabled, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload: {DaysAfterInitiation: 7}}
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  CampaignAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource: [!GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn, !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*']
            Condition: {Bool: {aws:SecureTransport: 'false'}}
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
  DeliveryStatusTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  DeliveryStatusTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics: [!Ref DeliveryStatusTopic]
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: MessagingProviders
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: [ses.amazonaws.com, sms-voice.amazonaws.com]}
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref DeliveryStatusTopic
            Condition: {StringEquals: {aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId}}
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref DeliveryStatusTopic
            Condition: {Bool: {aws:SecureTransport: 'false'}}
  PipelineLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement: [{Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}]
      ManagedPolicyArns: [arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole]
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Pipeline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan, dynamodb:BatchGetItem, dynamodb:BatchWriteItem]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CustomerProfilesTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt MessageTrackingTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MessageTrackingTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject]
                Resource: !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/campaigns/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey]
                Resource: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/${BedrockModelId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${BedrockModelId}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [ses:SendEmail, ses:SendRawEmail]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler

      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables: {RATE_LIMIT_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable, ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket}
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,boto3
          s3=boto3.client("s3");rl=boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["RATE_LIMIT_TABLE"])
          CT={"email":"email","sms":"phone"}
          def score(cu,ch):
           try: s=float(cu.get(ch+"Engagement",0.5))
           except (TypeError,ValueError): s=0.5
           return s+(0.3 if cu.get("preferredChannel")==ch else 0)
          def handler(e,c):
           b=os.environ["ASSETS_BUCKET"]
           au=json.loads(s3.get_object(Bucket=b,Key=e["audienceKey"])["Body"].read())
           al=[x for x in (e.get("plan",{}).get("channels") or []) if x in CT] or list(CT)
           pz={x for x in al if rl.get_item(Key={"channel":x}).get("Item",{}).get("paused")}
           mix={}
           for cu in au:
            op=[x for x in al if x not in pz and cu.get(CT[x])]
            ch=max(op,key=lambda x:score(cu,x)) if op else None
            cu["channel"]=ch;mix[str(ch)]=mix.get(str(ch),0)+1
           s3.put_object(Bucket=b,Key=e["audienceKey"],Body=json.dumps(au).encode(),ContentType="application/json")
           e["channelMix"]=mix

  DeliverMessagesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 900
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          RATE_LIMIT_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref MessageTrackingTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket

          SMS_ORIGINATION_IDENTITY: !Ref SmsOriginationIdentity
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,time,uuid,boto3
          E=os.environ;s3=boto3.client("s3");ses=boto3.client("sesv2");sms=boto3.client("pinpoint-sms-voice-v2")
          db=boto3.resource("dynamodb");rl=db.Table(E["RATE_LIMIT_TABLE"]);tr=db.Table(E["TRACKING_TABLE"])
          CCF=rl.meta.client.exceptions.ConditionalCheckFailedException;LIM={"email":600,"sms":60}
          def take(ch):
           w=int(time.time())//60*60
           try:
            rl.update_item(Key={"channel":ch},UpdateExpression="SET windowStart=:w, used=:one",ConditionExpression="attribute_not_exists(windowStart) OR windowStart<:w",ExpressionAttributeValues={":w":w,":one":1});return True
           except CCF: pass
           try:
            rl.update_item(Key={"channel":ch},UpdateExpression="ADD used :one",ConditionExpression="windowStart=:w AND ((attribute_not_exists(maxPerMinute) AND used<:d) OR used<maxPerMinute)",ExpressionAttributeValues={":w":w,":one":1,":d":LIM[ch]});return True
           except CCF: return False
          def send(cu,ct,cid):
           if cu["channel"]=="email":
            r=ses.send_email(FromEmailAddress=E["SENDER_EMAIL"],Destination={"ToAddresses":[cu["email"]]},Content={"Simple":{"Subject":{"Data":ct["emailSubject"]},"Body":{"Text":{"Data":ct["emailBody"]}}}},EmailTags=[{"Name":"campaignId","Value":cid}])
           else:
            r=sms.send_text_message(DestinationPhoneNumber=cu["phone"],OriginationIdentity=E["SMS_ORIGINATION_IDENTITY"],MessageBody=ct["smsText"],MessageType="PROMOTIONAL",Context={"campaignId":cid})
           return r["MessageId"]
          def handler(e,c):
           cid=e["campaignId"];ex=int(time.time())+90*86400;st={}
           au=json.loads(s3.get_object(Bucket=E["ASSETS_BUCKET"],Key=e["audienceKey"])["Body"].read())
           for cu in au:
            if not cu.get("channel"): continue
            s,mid,err="SENT",None,""
            if not take(cu["channel"]): s="THROTTLED"
            else:
             try: mid=send(cu,e["content"],cid)
             except Exception as x: s,err="FAILED",str(x)[:500]
            tr.put_item(Item={"messageId":mid or str(uuid.uuid4()),"campaignId":cid,"customerId":str(cu.get("customerId")),"channel":cu["channel"],"status":s,"error":err,"updatedAt":int(time.time()),"expiresAt":ex})
            st[s]=st.get(s,0)+1
           e["delivery"]=st
           return e
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]

          import hashlib,json,os,time,urllib.request,boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Key

          from botocore.awsrequest import AWSRequest
          s3=boto3.client("s3");tr=boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TRACKING_TABLE"])
          def index(sm):
           ep=os.environ.get("COLLECTION_ENDPOINT")
           if not ep: return
           u=ep+"/campaigns/_doc";b=json.dumps(sm).encode()
           rq=AWSRequest(method="POST",url=u,data=b,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","x-amz-content-sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
           SigV4Auth(boto3.Session().get_credentials(),"aoss",os.environ["AWS_REGION"]).add_auth(rq)
           urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(u,data=b,headers=dict(rq.headers),method="POST"),timeout=10)
          def handler(e,c):
           cid=e["campaignId"];n={};kw={"IndexName":"campaign-index","KeyConditionExpression":Key("campaignId").eq(cid)}
           while True:
            pg=tr.query(**kw)
            for i in pg.get("Items",[]): s=i.get("status","UNKNOWN");n[s]=n.get(s,0)+1
            if "LastEvaluatedKey" not in pg: break
            kw["ExclusiveStartKey"]=pg["LastEvaluatedKey"]
           p=e.get("plan",{})
           sm={"campaignId":cid,"objective":p.get("objective"),"message":p.get("message"),"audienceSize":e.get("audienceSize",0),"channelMix":e.get("channelMix",{}),"deliveryCounts":n,"completedAt":int(time.time())}
           s3.put_object(Bucket=os.environ["ASSETS_BUCKET"],Key="campaigns/%s/results.json"%cid,Body=json.dumps(sm,default=str).encode(),ContentType="application/json")

    Properties:

        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,re,boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Key
          sfn=boto3.client("stepfunctions");tr=boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TRACKING_TABLE"])
          def rs(c,b): return {"statusCode":c,"headers":{"Content-Type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps(b,default=str)}
          def handler(e,c):
           cid=(e.get("pathParameters") or {}).get("campaignId","")
           if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,80}",cid): return rs(400,{"error":"Invalid campaignId"})
           arn=os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"].replace(":stateMachine:",":execution:")+":"+cid
           try: x=sfn.describe_execution(executionArn=arn)
           except sfn.exceptions.ExecutionDoesNotExist: return rs(404,{"error":"Campaign not found"})
           n={};kw={"IndexName":"campaign-index","KeyConditionExpression":Key("campaignId").eq(cid),"ProjectionExpression":"#s","ExpressionAttributeNames":{"#s":"status"}}
           while True:
            pg=tr.query(**kw)
            for i in pg.get("Items",[]): s=i.get("status","UNKNOWN");n[s]=n.get(s,0)+1
            if "LastEvaluatedKey" not in pg: break
            kw["ExclusiveStartKey"]=pg["LastEvaluatedKey"]
           return rs(200,{"campaignId":cid,"executionArn":arn,"status":x["status"],"startDate":x["startDate"].isoformat(),"stopDate":x["stopDate"].isoformat() if x.get("stopDate") else None,"deliveryCounts":n})

  DeliveryStatusCallbackFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt CallbackLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables: {TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref MessageTrackingTable, RATE_LIMIT_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable}
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,time,boto3
          db=boto3.resource("dynamodb");tr=db.Table(os.environ["TRACKING_TABLE"]);rl=db.Table(os.environ["RATE_LIMIT_TABLE"])
          CCF=tr.meta.client.exceptions.ConditionalCheckFailedException
          DLV={"delivery","text_delivered","text_successful"};BNC={"bounce","complaint"}
          PND={"text_queued","text_pending","text_sent","send","deliverydelay","open","click"}
          def cls(v):
           m=v.get("mail");k=v.get("eventType") or (v.get("notificationType") if m else v.get("messageStatus")) or ""
           return (m or v).get("messageId"),k.lower()
          def sf(k): return "DELIVERED" if k in DLV else "BOUNCED" if k in BNC else None if not k or k in PND else "FAILED"
          def handler(e,c):
           done=0
           for r in e.get("Records",[]):
            try: v=json.loads(r["Sns"]["Message"])
            except (KeyError,TypeError,ValueError): continue
            mid,k=cls(v);s=sf(k)
            if not mid or not s: continue
            it=tr.get_item(Key={"messageId":mid}).get("Item")
            if not it: continue
            t=int(time.time())
            try: tr.update_item(Key={"messageId":mid},UpdateExpression="SET #s=:s, providerEvent=:k, updatedAt=:t",ConditionExpression="attribute_exists(messageId)",ExpressionAttributeNames={"#s":"status"},ExpressionAttributeValues={":s":s,":k":k,":t":t})
            except CCF: continue
            rl.update_item(Key={"channel":it["channel"]},UpdateExpression="ADD #c :one SET lastEventAt=:t",ExpressionAttributeNames={"#c":s.lower()+"Count"},ExpressionAttributeValues={":one":1,":t":t})
            done+=1
           return {"processed":done}
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]

                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [xray:PutTraceSegments, xray:PutTelemetryRecords, xray:GetSamplingRules, xray:GetSamplingTargets]
                Resource: '*'
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-campaign-orchestrator
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      TracingConfiguration: {Enabled: true}
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations: [{CloudWatchLogsLogGroup: {LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}}]
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ParseArn: !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
        SegmentArn: !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
        PredictArn: !GetAtt PredictChannelFunction.Arn
        SafetyArn: !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
        AdaptArn: !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
        DeliverArn: !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
        RecordArn: !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
      Definition:
        StartAt: ParseInstruction
        States:
          ParseInstruction:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${ParseArn}"
            Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}]
            Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: "$.error", Next: CampaignFailed}]
            Next: SegmentCustomers
          SegmentCustomers:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${SegmentArn}"
            Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}]
            Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: "$.error", Next: CampaignFailed}]
            Next: PredictChannel
          PredictChannel:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${PredictArn}"
            Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}]
            Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: "$.error", Next: CampaignFailed}]
            Next: SafetyCheck
          SafetyCheck:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${SafetyArn}"
            Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}]
            Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: "$.error", Next: CampaignFailed}]
            Next: EvaluateSafety
          EvaluateSafety:
            Type: Choice
            Choices: [{Variable: "$.safety.safe", BooleanEquals: true, Next: AdaptContent}]
            Default: ContentRejected
          AdaptContent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${AdaptArn}"
            Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}]
            Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: "$.error", Next: CampaignFailed}]
            Next: DeliverMessages
          DeliverMessages:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${DeliverArn}"
            TimeoutSeconds: 900
            Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 2, BackoffRate: 2}]
            Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: "$.error", Next: CampaignFailed}]
            Next: RecordResults
          RecordResults:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${RecordArn}"
            Retry: [{ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException], IntervalSeconds: 2, MaxAttempts: 3, BackoffRate: 2}]
            Catch: [{ErrorEquals: [States.ALL], ResultPath: "$.error", Next: CampaignFailed}]
            End: true
          ContentRejected: {Type: Fail, Error: ContentRejected, Cause: Safety check failed.}
          CampaignFailed: {Type: Fail, Error: CampaignFailed, Cause: Pipeline step failed.}

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool

      UserPoolName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-users

      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits: {AccessToken: hours, IdToken: hours, RefreshToken: days}

  HttpApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:

      IdentitySource: ["$request.header.Authorization"]
      JwtConfiguration:
        Issuer: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}
        Audience: [!Ref UserPoolClient]

    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt CampaignLauncherFunction.Arn

  StatusIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt CampaignStatusFunction.Arn
      PayloadFormatVersion: "2.0"
  LaunchCampaignRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: POST /campaigns
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref HttpApiAuthorizer
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LauncherIntegration}
  CampaignStatusRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:

      AuthorizerId: !Ref HttpApiAuthorizer
      Target: !Sub integrations/${StatusIntegration}

      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/apigateway/${ProjectName}-campaign-api

      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]
  HttpApiStage:

      DefaultRouteSettings: {ThrottlingBurstLimit: 50, ThrottlingRateLimit: 25}
      Tags: {Project: !Ref ProjectName}

      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*
  CampaignStatusApiPermission:

    Properties:

      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*

    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled

      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-enc

  VectorNetworkPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-net
      Type: network
      Policy: !Sub '[{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-vectors"]},{"ResourceType":"dashboard","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-vectors"]}],"AllowFromPublic":true}]'
  VectorDataAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::AccessPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-data
      Type: data
      Policy: !Sub '[{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-vectors"],"Permission":["aoss:CreateCollectionItems","aoss:DescribeCollectionItems","aoss:UpdateCollectionItems"]},{"ResourceType":"index","Resource":["index/${ProjectName}-vectors/*"],"Permission":["aoss:CreateIndex","aoss:DescribeIndex","aoss:UpdateIndex","aoss:ReadDocument","aoss:WriteDocument"]}],"Principal":["${PipelineLambdaRole.Arn}"]}]'

      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Dimensions: [{Name: StateMachineArn, Value: !Ref StateMachine}]
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      Tags: [{Key: Project, Value: !Ref ProjectName}]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless URL shortener using Amazon API Gateway (regional REST API), AWS Lambda
  (Python create and retrieve functions) and Amazon DynamoDB, including the
  account-level API Gateway CloudWatch logging role.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 3-255 characters; letters, numbers, underscore, hyphen and period only.
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores short identifiers and long URLs.
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-40 characters; letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore only.
    Description: Prefix used for Lambda function names, the IAM role name and log group names.
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.12
      - python3.11
    Description: Python runtime for both Lambda functions.
  AppUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Base URL used to build returned short links (for example https://sho.rt). Leave
      empty to use the API Gateway stage invoke URL.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Environment tag value.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: platform-team
    Description: Owner tag value.

Resources:
  UrlTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:

      Description: Generates a random short identifier and stores it against a long URL.
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref UrlTable
          APP_URL: !Ref AppUrl
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import json
          import os
          import secrets
          import string
          from datetime import datetime, timezone
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])
          APP_URL = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "").strip()
          ALPHABET = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
          MIN_LEN = 12
          MAX_LEN = 16
          MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5


          def _response(status, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }


          def _base_url(event):
              if APP_URL:
                  return APP_URL.rstrip("/")
              ctx = event.get("requestContext") or {}
              headers = event.get("headers") or {}
              host = ctx.get("domainName") or headers.get("Host", "")
              stage = ctx.get("stage", "")
              return ("https://%s/%s" % (host, stage)).rstrip("/")


          def _generate_id():
              length = MIN_LEN + secrets.randbelow(MAX_LEN - MIN_LEN + 1)
              return "".join(secrets.choice(ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))


          def handler(event, context):
              raw = event.get("body") or "{}"
              if event.get("isBase64Encoded"):
                  raw = base64.b64decode(raw).decode("utf-8")
              try:
                  payload = json.loads(raw)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Request body must be valid JSON."})
              if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Request body must be a JSON object."})

              long_url = str(payload.get("long_url") or payload.get("url") or "").strip()
              parsed = urlparse(long_url)
              if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parsed.netloc or len(long_url) > 2048:
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Provide a valid http(s) URL in 'long_url'."})

              for _ in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
                  short_id = _generate_id()
                  try:
                      TABLE.put_item(
                          Item={
                              "short_id": short_id,
                              "long_url": long_url,
                              "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                          },
                          ConditionExpression="attribute_not_exists(short_id)",
                      )
                  except ClientError as err:
                      if err.response["Error"]["Code"] == "ConditionalCheckFailedException":
                          continue
                      print("DynamoDB error: %s" % err)
                      return _response(500, {"message": "Unable to store the URL."})
                  return _response(
                      200,
                      {
                          "short_id": short_id,
                          "short_url": "%s/%s" % (_base_url(event), short_id),
                          "long_url": long_url,
                      },
                  )
              return _response(500, {"message": "Could not generate a unique identifier."})
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: RetrieveFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve'
      Description: Looks up a short identifier and redirects to the original URL.
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref UrlTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import re

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])
          ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9]{12,16}$")


          def _error(status, message):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": message}),
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              params = event.get("pathParameters") or {}
              short_id = str(params.get("shortid") or "")
              if not ID_PATTERN.match(short_id):
                  return _error(400, "Invalid short identifier.")
              try:
                  result = TABLE.get_item(Key={"short_id": short_id})
              except ClientError as err:
                  print("DynamoDB error: %s" % err)
                  return _error(500, "Unable to look up the URL.")
              item = result.get("Item")
              if not item or "long_url" not in item:
                  return _error(404, "Short link not found.")
              return {
                  "statusCode": 301,
                  "headers": {
                      "Location": item["long_url"],
                      "Cache-Control": "max-age=300",
                  },
                  "body": "",
              }

          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

      Tags:

          Value: !Ref AppName

  NotifierFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-notifier
      Description: Sends on-call and escalation notifications through SES.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          APP_NAME: !Ref AppName
          SSM_PREFIX: !Sub /${AppName}/
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmail
          CONFIGURATION_TABLE: !Ref ConfigurationTable
          SERVICES_TABLE: !Ref ServicesTable
          ONCALL_SCHEDULES_TABLE: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
          INCIDENTS_TABLE: !Ref IncidentsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder: real code is deployed separately.
              print(json.dumps(event))
              return {"status": "notification placeholder"}
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  IncidentProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${IncidentProcessorFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  NotifierLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${NotifierFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeNotifier
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub ${NotifierFunction.Arn}:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  IncidentStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub ${AppName}-incident-workflow
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Notify the on-call responder immediately and escalate after five minutes.
        StartAt: AlertInParallel
        States:
          AlertInParallel:
            Type: Parallel
            End: true
            Branches:
              - StartAt: NotifyOnCall
                States:
                  NotifyOnCall:
                    Type: Task
                    Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::lambda:invoke
                    Parameters:
                      FunctionName: !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
                      Payload:
                        notificationType: INITIAL
                        incident.$: $
                    OutputPath: $.Payload
                    Retry:
                      - ErrorEquals:
                          - Lambda.ServiceException
                          - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                          - Lambda.SdkClientException
                          - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                        IntervalSeconds: 2
                        MaxAttempts: 3
                        BackoffRate: 2
                    End: true
              - StartAt: WaitForEscalation
                States:
                  WaitForEscalation:
                    Type: Wait
                    Seconds: 300
                    Next: SendEscalation
                  SendEscalation:
                    Type: Task
                    Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::lambda:invoke
                    Parameters:
                      FunctionName: !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
                      Payload:
                        notificationType: ESCALATION
                        incident.$: $
                    OutputPath: $.Payload
                    Retry:
                      - ErrorEquals:
                          - Lambda.ServiceException
                          - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                          - Lambda.SdkClientException
                          - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                        IntervalSeconds: 2
                        MaxAttempts: 3
                        BackoffRate: 2
                    End: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/apigateway/${AppName}-api-access-logs
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  HttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AppName}-api
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      Description: HTTP API for the on-call incident alerting service.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  IncidentProcessorIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  GetIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: GET /incidents/{incidentId}
      Target: !Sub integrations/${IncidentProcessorIntegration}

  PutIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: PUT /incidents/{incidentId}
      Target: !Sub integrations/${IncidentProcessorIntegration}

  HttpApiDefaultStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - GetIncidentRoute
      - PutIncidentRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      StageName: $default
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength","integrationError":"$context.integrationErrorMessage"}'
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 50
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 25
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  IncidentProcessorApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref IncidentProcessorFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*/incidents/*

  SenderEmailParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${AppName}/sender-email
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref SenderEmail
      Description: SES sender email address for notifications.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  StateMachineArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${AppName}/state-machine-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref IncidentStateMachine
      Description: ARN of the incident escalation state machine.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ApiEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${AppName}/api-endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt HttpApi.ApiEndpoint
      Description: Endpoint URL of the incident HTTP API.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

    Description: HTTP API endpoint URL.
    Value: !GetAtt HttpApi.ApiEndpoint

    Description: HTTP API identifier.
    Value: !Ref HttpApi

    Description: ARN of the incident escalation state machine.
    Value: !Ref IncidentStateMachine

    Description: ARN of the incident processor Lambda function.

    Description: Log group for HTTP API access logs.
    Value: !Ref ApiAccessLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploys an AWS Config conformance pack for operational best practices on Amazon CloudWatch, including the AWS Config recorder, delivery channel, KMS-encrypted S3 delivery bucket and IAM role it needs.

Parameters:
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "TRUE"
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one alarm action (TRUE or FALSE). Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "TRUE"
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one insufficient-data action (TRUE or FALSE). Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "FALSE"
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one OK action (TRUE or FALSE). Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType:
    Type: String
    Default: "AWS::EC2::Instance"
    Description: AWS resource type that must have a CloudWatch alarm for the specified metric. Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CPUUtilization"
    Description: Metric name that must have a CloudWatch alarm for the specified resource type. Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CPUUtilization"
    Description: Metric name whose CloudWatch alarm settings are evaluated. Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod:
    Type: String
    Default: "300"
    Description: Required alarm evaluation period in seconds. Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.

Resources:
  ConfigBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key that encrypts AWS Config delivery data in the Config S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSConfigServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowUseViaS3InAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ConfigBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldConfigData
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 365
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  ConfigBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketPermissionsCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketExistenceCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ConfigRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigS3Delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn

  ConfigRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: true

  DeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn: ConfigBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigBucket
      S3KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn

  CloudWatchConformancePack:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConformancePack
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigRecorder
